normalizedText: Company OverviewFactori is a rapidly growing location and consumer intelligence company built for an AI-first world. Each day we ingest billions of privacy-compliant signals and maintain the world’s most comprehensive consumer, mobility and point-of-interest database. Our AI-driven insights help Fortune 500 brands, global media agencies and technology innovators decide where to invest, build and grow. The role will be responsible for creating qualified demand, improving funnel conversion, generating sales-ready opportunities, building autonomous GTM systems, and driving measurable pipeline growth for a data-led B2B business.The ideal candidate should be able to market a complex data, AI, or technology product by translating technical capabilities into clear commercial use cases. Beyond traditional growth marketing, the candidate should leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to improve speed, personalization, operational efficiency, and decision-making across the go-to-market function. The role requires hands-on ownership of campaigns, content-led demand, paid acquisition, account-based marketing, AI-powered growth systems, sales alignment, and growth analytics.Key ResponsibilitiesBuild and own Factori.ai’s AI-native growth marketing strategy across target industries, buyer personas, geographies, and high-value account segments.Define and refine the ideal customer profile by working closely with sales, product, and leadership teams to identify high-propensity accounts, buying signals, and commercial use cases.Create a predictable, AI-powered demand generation engine focused on qualified pipeline, opportunity creation, and revenue contribution rather than lead volume alone.Develop and execute multi-channel growth campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, email, SEO, retargeting, content, partner channels, and emerging AI-native distribution channels.Drive account-based marketing programs for strategic enterprise and mid-market accounts using AI-driven research, account enrichment, persona-led campaigns, and sales-aligned outreach.Translate Factori.ai’s data, location intelligence, mobility, places, and audience capabilities into clear growth use cases for industries such as retail, real estate, financial services, logistics, advertising, AI platforms, and enterprise data teams.Build campaign narratives around business outcomes such workflows.Improve website and landing-page conversion through AI-assisted experimentation, sharper messaging, personalization, A/B testing, SEO improvements, and continuous performance optimization.Create high-converting growth assets including landing pages, email journeys, product explainers, case studies, industry reports, use-case pages, executive content, and AI-assisted ROI, and channel-level performance.Build segmented nurture programs that move prospects from awareness to sales readiness through AI-powered email workflows, content sequencing, retargeting, and persona-specific messaging.Partner closely with SDR and sales teams to improve lead quality, qualification criteria, campaign feedback loops, handoff processes, and opportunity conversion.Design optimize campaign targeting, messaging, channel mix, creative performance, landing pages, distribution strategies, and funnel movement.Establish growth dashboards and AI-powered reporting systems to track campaign performance, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, revenue influence, and automation effectiveness.Identify and test new growth channels including partnerships, ecosystem campaigns, organization.Required Experience5+ years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, performance marketing, revenue marketing, integrated marketing, or AI-enabled GTM.Experience marketing SaaS, data products, analytics platforms, AI platforms, APIs, martech, adtech, or other enterprise technology solutions.Proven experience in building demand generation programs that contribute directly to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.Hands-on experience with paid media, LinkedIn campaigns, Google campaigns, email marketing, SEO, content-led demand, account-based marketing, and growth analytics.Experience working closely with sales teams on lead quality, qualification, funnel movement, campaign feedback, and opportunity conversion.Hands-on experience building workflow automation using platforms such as n8n, Clay, Make, Zapier, or similar automation technologies.Experience integrating AI tools, APIs, LLMs, or workflow automation into marketing, sales, or GTM processes.Comfort working with growth and marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Apollo, Clay, OpenAI, Anthropic, enrichment platforms, and similar AI-native GTM tools.Skills & CapabilitiesStrong ability to simplify complex data and technology propositions into clear business value and buyer-specific messaging.Strong analytical ability across funnel metrics, campaign ROI, attribution, channel performance, cost per qualified opportunity, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution.Ability to create and execute integrated campaigns across awareness, acquisition, nurture, conversion, and pipeline acceleration.Strong understanding of AI-native marketing, workflow automation, agentic systems, and modern GTM Strategy Teams, Retail Expansion Teams, Real Estate Teams, Enterprise AI Teams, and Revenue Operations leaders would also be relevant.Experience building AI-powered GTM workflows, agentic systems, autonomous distribution engines, or internal marketing automation platforms would be a strong advantage. normalizedText: Key Responsibilities:1. Brand Strategy & Growth Management:-Develop and execute annual and long-term brand strategies aligned with business objectives.Define brand positioning, architecture, and communication strategy to strengthen brand equity.Identify growth opportunities through market expansion, portfolio optimization, and innovation.Monitor competitor activities, category trends, and consumer behavior to drive strategic decisions.2. Product & Innovation Management:-Lead new product development (NPD), renovations, and line extensions based on consumer insights.Manage product lifecycle including launch planning, performance tracking, and optimization.Work closely with R&D, packaging, procurement, and supply teams to deliver successful launches.Ensure innovation pipeline supports category growth targets.3. Marketing & Communication Execution:-Plan and execute integrated 360 marketing campaigns across TV, digital, social media, retail, and e-commerce platforms.Oversee creative development, media strategy, and agency management.Ensure consistent brand messaging across all consumer touchpoints.Drive digital-first marketing initiatives and consumer engagement programs.4. Commercial & Sales Collaboration:-Partner with Sales and Trade Marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies and promotional plans.Support channel-specific initiatives including modern trade, general trade, and e-commerce platforms.Provide brand guidance for in-store visibility, merchandising, and activation programs.Monitor sales performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve targets.5. Consumer & Market Insights:-Leverage market research, panel data (Nielsen/Kantar), and consumer analytics to guide decision-making.Track brand health metrics such as awareness, penetration, repeat purchase, and loyalty.Translate insights into actionable marketing and innovation strategies.6. Financial & P&L Management:-Own brand P&L including revenue growth, margins, and marketing investments.Manage A&P budgets and ensure effective ROI on campaigns and promotions.Support pricing strategies and profitability improvement initiatives.7. Stakeholder & Agency Management:-Manage relationships with creative, media, digital, and research agencies.Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations to ensure execution excellence.Lead cross-functional alignment on brand priorities and timelines.

normalizedText: Senior Manager, Marketing (FRWD) – MarTechRegion: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. normalizedText: LocationBengaluru, Karnataka BenefitsPulled from the full job descriptionHealth insurance Full job description The Role Loop is India's fastest-growing health benefits platform, serving over 1.2 million members across 1,000+ employers. We're building the country's first true payor-provider — combining insurance, primary care, and a software layer that makes employer health benefits actually work. As we scale into the mid-market and enterprise segments and prepare for our next chapter as a company, we need a leader who can architect the GTM engine that gets us there. The VP of Revenue Operations will sit at the center of how Loop acquires, retains, and expands customer relationships — owning the strategy, systems, and intelligence layer that powers every commercial decision. This is a senior leadership role reporting to the COO, with immediate management of a four-person RevOps team. What You'll Own 1. Own GTM Strategy & Scale-Up to Enterprise Help define how Loop wins in the enterprise segment — a fundamentally different motion from the mid-market business that got us here. Longer cycles, larger committees, more complex underwriting, higher expectations on service. You'll work with Marketing, Sales and AM leadership to design the playbook: segmentation, coverage models, deal desk, pricing strategy, and the operational muscle to support 7- and 8-figure logos. 2. Reporting & Business Intelligence Build the intelligence layer the executive team runs the business on, using AI. Weekly pipeline reviews, monthly revenue bridges, cohort retention, NDR, AE productivity, product attach, CAC/LTV, Quick Ratio — all clean, all trusted, all in one place. You'll own the GTM metrics that show up in board decks and the next round's data room, and you'll make sure they tell a coherent story. 3. Product Roadmap Partnership Be the voice of the customer and the commercial team inside Product. You'll work directly with our Product and Engineering leaders to translate what Sales and AM are seeing in the market — friction in quoting, gaps in policy admin, unmet needs around healthcare, enterprise-grade reporting requirements — into a prioritized roadmap. The best RevOps leaders shape the product. You'll help decide what gets built and why, and you'll be accountable for whether it actually moves the metrics that matter. 4. AI & Agentic Workflows You’ll lead Loop's GTM automation agenda. You'll identify the highest-friction workflows across Sales and AM and design AI-powered solutions to eliminate manual effort at scale: agentic workflows for renewal forecasting, at-risk account detection, pipeline hygiene, outbound sequencing, automated QBR generation, AE and AM copilots. You'll bring a sharp point of view on where automation creates real leverage versus where human judgment is irreplaceable, and you'll build a framework for evaluating, deploying, and sunsetting tools based on ROI. 5. Pipeline, Forecasting & Account Management Ops Own the operating rhythm that keeps the commercial engine humming. Bottoms-up pipeline models with real stage-gate discipline. Weekly and monthly forecasting in partnership with Finance, with risks and upside surfaced early. Renewal calendars, upsell playbooks, health scores, escalation workflows, and clearly-defined NDR targets with the levers to hit them. Quota setting, territory design, and incentive plan administration that drives the behaviors we want in our sales and retention teams. 6. Systems & Infrastructure Own the revenue tech stack — Salesforce, engagement tools, contract management, and the integrations into our policy administration and billing systems — and the data governance standards that make everything above possible. This is the foundation, not the destination, but it has to be rock solid. 7. Team Leadership Lead, develop, and expand the existing four-person RevOps team. Set clear ownership, build career paths, raise the performance bar. Drive cross-functional alignment between Sales, AM, Finance, and Product on pricing, quoting, and policy fulfillment. What We're Looking For 10+ years in Business Operations, P&L Ownership, Sales Operations, or GTM, with at least 3 years at a senior level including direct team management A track record of helping a company move upmarket — you've built or scaled the GTM operating model for an enterprise motion, not just optimized an existing SMB funnel Demonstrated experience supporting both a new business Sales motion and a high-retention Account Management function Hands-on experience deploying AI or automation tooling in a GTM context — sales engagement platforms, AI-assisted forecasting, LLM-powered workflows Analytical depth: SQL or BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau), and the ability to build financial models that Sales and Finance both trust Experience in running a Business Unit or P&L strongly preferred; Indian B2B sales context a plus Executive-level communication — you'll regularly present to the COO, CEO, and board Why This Role You'll be the person who decides how revenue actually moves through Loop as we scale to the enterprise. You'll have the resources, the team, the executive air cover, and the mandate to build something that doesn't exist yet in the Indian health benefits market. If you've been waiting for a role where strategy, systems, and AI tooling all sit in the same job description — this is it.

Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.AI at Cvent: Leading the FutureAre you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. This role is the senior-most marketing leader in India.This individual will be a critical force multiplier: ensuring that India’s 200+ marketing professionals are high performing, deeply aligned with global priorities, and operating at the frontier of marketinginnovation. Beyond operational stewardship, this executive will serve as a recognized champion of the Event Technology and Martech landscape — representing Cvent’s perspective externally in India & APAC/IMEA region.The role operates within a global matrix structure: functional direction flows from discipline leaders based across the US, EMEA, and APAC, while this executive holds full ownership of people leadership, operational excellence, talent strategy, and site culture for India. People Leadership, Coaching & Talent Management Serve as the primary people leader for 200+ India-based marketing professionals across multiple disciplines, coaching and developing talent in close partnership with global functional leaders. Drive a comprehensive India marketing talent strategy: workforce planning, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, career pathing, and retention — with depth in demand generation, Martech, digital, analytics, events, and creative. Identify and accelerate high-potential leaders; build robust succession pipelines and a strong internal bench across all marketing functions. Foster a high-performance, inclusive culture aligned with Cvent’s values and spirit of intrapreneurship — where every marketer is empowered to think like an owner and act with urgency. Champion of Event Technology & the Marketing StackAct as a credible “internal customer”: represent the marketer’s perspective when evaluating Cvent’s own product portfolio and translate those insights into actionable feedback for Product, GTM, and Customer Success teams.Champion Event-Led Growth (ELG) thinking across the India organization, ensuring teams deeply understand how Cvent’s platform drives pipeline, revenue, and engagement for enterprise B2B marketers globally.Represent India marketing in global forums and industry events as a confident, opinionated voice on modern B2B marketing and Event Technology. AI Transformation Champion Lead Cvent India’s AI transformation within marketing — actively monitoring best-in-class AI tool developments, enterprise adoption trends, and emerging agentic workflows across the global marketing industry. Experiment with and evaluate frontier AI platforms — generative content tools, AI-driven video automation (including Goldcast’ s capabilities), intelligent personalization, and analytics automation — bringing informed, hands-on recommendations to the organization. Partner with Global Marketing Operations to identify, pilot, and scale high-impact AI and automation use cases in India-based workstreams: content production, QA, campaign operations, and workflow automation. Build a culture of AI-first thinking: upskill teams, reduce manual effort, and enable India marketing to operate with the agility and leverage that modern AI tooling provides. Translate AI adoption into measurable outcomes — velocity, quality, cost efficiency — and report on impact in global leadership reviews with clarity and precision. Operational Excellence & Follow-the-Sun Execution Own the day-to-day operational rhythm of India-based marketing teams, ensuring reliable delivery against SLAs and commitments to global discipline leaders and regional stakeholders. Design and continuously improve follow-the-sun workflows across US-EMEA-APAC time zones for campaigns, events, marketing operations, and creative services — optimizing for speed, quality, and continuity of execution. Partner with Global Marketing Operations on capacity planning, prioritization, and skills-to-work alignment, ensuring India bandwidth maps to the highest-impact global initiatives. Drive continuous improvement in processes, tooling, and collaboration models — positioning India as a recognized center of operational excellence within global marketing. normalizedText: Job Title: Brand Services DirectorExperience: 3 yrs + Role OverviewWe are seeking a visionary who can create and implement a robust integrated roadmap for our clients, particularly those with traditionally offline brands. This individual will bring a fresh perspective, demonstrating the power of digital marketing beyond just social media and collaborations. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker who can drive content strategies and collaborative approaches, ultimately enhancing customer journeys and converting engagement into tangible results. Key Responsibilities • Build comprehensive integrated roadmaps tailored to each client's brand, focusing on transforming traditional marketing approaches to digital-first strategies. • Educate clients on the power and potential of digital marketing, moving beyond basic social media tactics to comprehensive digital content and collaboration strategies. • Develop and implement creative content strategies that align with clients' brand goals and drive engagement. • Foster collaborative efforts between brands and digital influencers, media, and other stakeholders to enhance brand visibility and reach. • Analyse and map out customer journeys, identifying key touchpoints and opportunities for digital engagement. • Develop strategies to enhance customer experiences and drive conversions through personalized and targeted digital interactions. • Work closely with business operations to understand and address customer and brand challenges. • Apply creative problem-solving skills to develop innovative digital solutions that support brand building and customer retention. • Collaborate with various departments, to ensure cohesive and effective digital strategies. • Lead and mentor a team of account managers, fostering a culture of creativity and digital innovation. • Set clear KPIs and objectives for integrated campaigns and initiatives. • Regularly analyse and report on the performance of digital strategies, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Key Attributes• Visionary thinker.• Creative and strategically fertile, capable of generating innovative ideas and solutions. • Strong advocate for the power of digital marketing. • Results-oriented with a focus on driving customer engagement and brand growth. If you are a dynamic and creative integrated marketing professional with a passion for transforming brands and driving digital success, we would love to hear from you. role: Head of Commercial Enablement, Commercial Strategy
normalizedText: LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States. The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations. Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment. The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go-to-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion. The Head of Commercial Enablement (CE) is a dual-mandate leader – a credentialed industry subject matter expert (SME) who also builds and runs the firm’s Commercial Enablement function. You will drive both firmwide CE strategy and operating model while owning the commercial agenda for your respective industry sector. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Strategy, this leader owns one of the firm’s industry verticals while directing the broader CE operating model that spans all verticals, the account and pipeline disciplines and Commercial Operations. As an SME, this leader carries the same sector mandate as the firm’s Industry Vertical Leaders – building the commercial point of view (POV) for an assigned industry, producing the market insight that drives origination, supporting business development efforts and proposal creation. As the function head, this leader sets the CE operating model, manages the Vertical Leaders and the Account and Pipeline Vice Presidents (VPs) and serves as the senior CE voice to the Managing Director (MD) and leadership team. Success is measured by the commercial output of the assigned vertical, the maturity and consistency of the CE operating model across all verticals and the degree to which key stakeholders rely on CE for industry expertise (content and context) and as the engine for origination and pipeline discipline. Responsibilities Partner with senior team members and Account Teams to convert sector insight into qualified business opportunities Own the CE operating model – structure, roles, service levels, and jdEvidence.value: Drive business development, growth, and product innovation for merchant payments in the SaaS/Fintech sector.

normalizedText: LocationDelhi Full job description About the Company Easebuzz is India’s one of the first and foremost end-to-end SAAS enabled payments platform. We are a SaaS-unifying payment aggregation platform interconnecting banks, networks, acquirers and processors for merchant payments. We create value by enabling seamless workflows which help merchant to have a better collection efficiency. Our vision is to verticalize payments with industry specific solutions that can increase the online GDP of India. We’ve been building on business value for our merchants since 2014 and are trusted by more than 1.5 lacs merchant base . We are unique in terms of our offering to our merchants and our excitement lies in building together where we all can thrive for future. About the Role At Easebuzz, business development managers build deep relationships with our customers and drive forward our growth engine. We are so obsessed about our customers we like to think of business managers more as customer-facing product managers who can co-create new product innovations for them. You are a consultant to a problem where you have access to the management of the company to build on solutions which can help us have better vertical solutions for the market. You are adept of doing product related conversations with various stakeholders on the customer’s side. You are able to communicate and establish value propositions that solves a problem and where you can also take new feedback to convert them into product opportunities. You are analytical and derive actionable insights from customer conversations. You are then able to convert these insights into product and business ideas and drive our relationship deeper into our merchant-ecosystem. What you’ll do Own a category of merchant customers. You are responsible for growing relationships, revenue, product usage, and adoption. Develop different tactics to build merchant base within varied categories of business. You have to work on pitch decks, product related documentation, RFP responses, technical and commercial proposals. You to drive excellence in customer relationship. Work with your managers and other stakeholders in different teams and create a winning formula for your customers. Derive opportunities to ideate and co-create with internal products and engineering teams to drive Easebuzz product strategy and plans. Work with legal to structure contracts that are win-win for the customer and Easebuzz. Drive product related use-cases which are not payments but payment related product which solves for a problem and you should be technically sound to understand. What we’re looking for 7+ years of experience in SaaS/Fintech companies, in sales management or customer-facing product management. Understanding of regulatory framework, compliances and understanding of payments as well as SAAS ecosystems. Ability to understand and simplify complex technical and product requirements. Ability to participate in the co-creation process. Ability to negotiate with customers on delivery milestones and commercials. Great problem-solving, communication, and verbal skills. Experience with developing business plans and helping set up business strategy for a category. Great presentation skills and the ability to think on your feet. We believe product deck creation is an art and a product genre by itself! Empathy towards external and internal stakeholders. Persuasion skills without being forceful. You use both data and intuition to do that. Ability to go into unknown territories and navigate comfortably

jdEvidence.value: Execute and optimize digital marketing campaigns across various platforms to achieve customer acquisition and lead generation goals.
Responsible for achieving business goals like customer acquisition and lead generation, optimizing marketing budgets for maximum ROI, and driving conversion rates.

normalizedText: LocationChennai, Tamil Nadu Full job description Role: Performance Marketing Executive Experience: 2- 8 years Location: Chennai Key Responsibilities: Campaign Execution & Optimization: Manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns across platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, and LinkedIn to achieve business goals (e.g., customer acquisition, lead generation). Performance Analysis: Track and analyze campaign performance metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, and conversion rates using tools like Google Analytics and Facebook Ads Manager. A/B Testing & Experimentation: Conduct A/B tests on ads, creatives, landing pages, and audience segments to continuously improve performance and drive better results. Budget Management: Oversee and optimize marketing budgets across channels, ensuring effective allocation and maximum ROI for all paid campaigns. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the creative, content, and product teams to align on campaign messaging, design, and strategy. Reporting & Insights: Provide regular performance reports to stakeholders, including actionable insights and recommendations to enhance campaign outcomes. Customer Acquisition & Conversion: Drive customer acquisition strategies through paid media while focusing on optimizing conversion rates across funnels. Market Trend Awareness: Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, and platform updates to leverage new strategies for campaign growth. Tool Proficiency: Utilize marketing tools like Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and other performance tracking platforms to manage campaigns and analyze results.

Marketing and Communication Lead Navitas is seeking a dynamic and results-driven, Marketing & Communications Lead for one of its university partners, Western Sydney University. This role will be responsible for leading the development and execution of integrated marketing, communications, and brand strategies to support the successful launch and continued growth of Western Sydney University's Greater Noida campus Working closely with teams across India and Australia, the successful candidate will drive brand awareness, student recruitment, stakeholder engagement, and institutional reputation through innovative marketing campaigns, media engagement, digital marketing, content creation, and strategic partnership initiatives. This is a hands-on opportunity for a proactive self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment, can work independently, effectively manage external agencies, and build strong relationships across media, education, and industry networks. Key Responsibilities: Marketing Strategy & CampaignsDevelop and execute annual marketing plans aligned to student recruitment and brand objectives.Plan and deliver integrated campaigns across digital, social, search, media, events, and partnerships.Manage campaign performance, reporting, and optimisation.Support student recruitment activities and lead generation initiatives. Digital Marketing & PerformanceManage paid media campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and local Indian channels.Oversee SEO, website performance, and digital content strategy.Monitor campaign KPIs, including leads, conversions, CPL, and ROI.Work with external agencies to optimise performance and audience targeting. Media & Public RelationsDevelop relationships with media outlets, journalists, and education publications.Coordinate media opportunities, interviews, press releases, and announcements.Manage local PR agency relationships.Identify opportunities to position Western Sydney University as a leading international education provider in India. Content & CommunicationsDevelop compelling content showcasing student outcomes, industry partnerships, and campus developments.Coordinate the production of videos, case studies, social content, and thought leadership.Ensure messaging aligns with global brand standards and local market needs. Partnerships & Stakeholder EngagementSupport engagement with schools, pathway partners, government stakeholders, and industry organisations.Assist with launch events, recruitment activities, and partnership initiatives.Work closely with recruitment teams to ensure marketing activities support enrolment targets. Brand ManagementEstablish and maintain Western Sydney University's brand presence in India.Ensure consistent application of brand guidelines across all channels.Monitor competitor activity and market trends. Essential Experience6+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or student recruitment marketing.Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns.Strong experience in digital marketing and paid media campaign management.Experience managing external agencies and third-party vendors.Demonstrated experience managing marketing budgets, campaign performance, and reporting. KnowledgeStrong understanding of the Indian higher education sector.Knowledge of student recruitment marketing and the prospective student journey.Sound understanding of media relations and public relations practices in India. SkillsExcellent stakeholder management, interpersonal, and communication skills.Strong project management and organisational capabilities.Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, start-up environment.Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills. DesirableExperience working within a university, international education provider, pathway provider, or education agency.Experience supporting the launch of a new brand, campus, or education venture.Established network of digital media, creative, PR, and production partners within India. Key Relationships: Reporting to: Marketing Manager, International (based in Australia)This position supervises: NIL Internal StakeholdersInternational Recruitment TeamFuture Students Marketing & Communications TeamLaunchPad TeamGlobal Partnerships TeamGlobal Mobility TeamAdmissions TeamDigital Marketing TeamUniversity Communications & Media TeamIndia Campus Leadership TeamAcademic and Professional Staff supporting India operations External StakeholdersMedia and PR AgenciesCreative and Digital AgenciesMedia Organisations and JournalistsEducation Agents and Recruitment PartnersIndustry and Corporate PartnersGovernment and Regulatory BodiesAlumni and Student Ambassadors Key ChallengesBuilding awareness and establishing the Western Sydney University India campus in a highly competitive higher education market.Delivering integrated marketing and communications campaigns while collaborating with cross-functional teams across India and Australia.Balancing immediate student recruitment objectives with long-term brand growth, reputation, and stakeholder engagement.Thriving in a fast-paced start-up environment where systems, processes, partnerships, and brand presence are continually evolving. University Expectations: The University expects all employees to be aware of, and comply with, relevant legislation and Western Sydney University's policies and procedures applicable to their role, including but not limited to:Code of ConductWork Health and Safety and Wellbeing Management SystemEnterprise Agreement or AwardAnti-discrimination principles, Equal Employment Opportunity, and staff and student equity About NavitasNavitas is a leading global education provider supporting more than 60,000 students each year through innovative, life-changing learning opportunities around the world. You'll be part of a purpose-driven organisation where your work directly contributes to helping learners achieve their goals. How to ApplyShape the future of international education. Join us as a Marketing & Communications Lead and drive impactful marketing, communications, and brand strategies that support the launch and growth of Western Sydney University's Greater Noida campus. Apply online via www.navitas.com/careers. Applications will close on 15 July 2026. Early applications are encouraged, as we may appoint before the closing date. Applicants must have full working rights in India and be available to start immediately or on short notice. By applying, you agree to Navitas' Privacy Policy. normalizedText: SummaryAbout the role:The Head of Digital Finance Hyderabad Hub leads a cross-functional team that plays a central role in advancing the Finance transformation agenda at Novartis. By combining strong people leadership with operational excellence and data-driven decision-making, this role builds a modern, product-oriented hub that improves how Finance operates and delivers value. The position offers a unique opportunity to shape a modern digital hub at the center of Finance transformation.About The RoleKey responsibilitiesTransform the current hub into a modern digital organization with a clear vision, scalable operating model, and execution roadmap aligned to the Finance transformation agenda.Lead people, culture, and capability building to develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary team and a future-ready organization.Build critical capabilities, strengthen the leadership bench, and ensure talent development and succession for key roles. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning. Implement a data and analytics vision for the hub: define key metrics, dashboards, and reporting standards. Ensure that key decisions (prioritization, process changes, resource allocation) are backed by data and insights. Promote self-service analytics capabilities and data literacy across all profiles in the hub. About The TeamOpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions,, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.About The RoleOur Go To Market team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. We are seeking a GTM Readiness Lead who will be a key player in building the foundational processes and programs to enable our team to achieve this mission.You will build and deliver the programs to accelerate the onboarding of newly hired reps, support customer facing roles to achieve and exceed goals, and elevate the knowledge and skills of our technical team members across our product suite. You will work cross-functionally with product, solution strategists, sellers, marketing, and leadership to build the enablement programs and collateral that will help accelerate the success of our customers and our organization.This role is based in Mumbai, India.In This Role, You Will:Define our sales enablement strategy by identifying obstacles and gaps and prioritizing initiatives that will support our GTM teams in achieving and succeeding our goals.Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Adoption, Deployment, and other teams to build internal and external facing collateral that will support the GTM team in best selling to and serving our customers.Build, manage and automate information and collateral that GTM team members need in order to be effective in their roles.Manage the regional Sales and Technical Success training calendar and run trainings that may include new process roll-outs, product launches, and other programs to make the teams more effective in their roles.You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have:Experience building programs and initiatives from scratch to enable rapidly scaling GTM teams.Exceptional project management skills, with experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.Outstanding communication skills and executive presence, with experience presenting in front of large audiences.A combination of technical depth and strategic thinking; and enjoy translating day-to-day patterns into scalable solutions.An understanding of the AI landscape, our applications, and the problems they solve for our customers.The ability to thrive in ambiguity and work autonomously.Exceptional organizational skills.The ability to operate with high horsepower, be adept at frequent context switching and working on multiple projects at once with expansive ownership, and ruthless prioritization.About OpenAIOpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jdEvidence.value: Lead brand strategy and client relationships for a portfolio of 12-16 brands, managing a team of account managers.

normalizedText: Life & Half is a strategy-led creative agency out to build brand culture — not just brand content. We work with some of India's most recognisable consumer brands, like UNO India, District, Ferns N Petals, Hyatt hotels, Coffee Island, Vip Shaadi and others who care deeply about culture, craft, and getting it right.Eligibility: Previous Account Management + team management + strategy planning or brand management experience. normalizedText: About WPP ProductionWe are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.About WPPWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.Internal Responsibilities Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of Hogarth’s business model, services, and technology. Ensure complete awareness of contractual obligations, commercial arrangements, and SLAs for your accounts, and make sure the wider team understands relevant details. Maintain optimum productivity levels and high team morale. Continuously review team structure and resource allocation to ensure clients are serviced appropriately while maintaining profitability. Establish and maintain succession plans for the Client Servicing team and coordinate with other department heads as needed. Coach, mentor, and develop team members to achieve their Personal Development Plans, including performance management and trainingManage internal administration, including leave, sick days, and timesheet accuracy for all direct reports. Ensure relevant case studies are created and knowledge is shared across teams to optimize workflow and cross-functional collaboration.Client Management Responsibilities Develop and nurture long-term strategic partnerships with key clients, positioning the agency as a trusted advisor and integral part of their growth strategy. Lead initiatives to introduce innovative digital solutions and services, keeping the agency at the forefront of industry trends and client needs. Ensure clients understand and follow agreed workflows, and guide them through the process. Set and manage client expectations regarding deliverables and timelines. Escalate significant client issues to your line manager promptly and recommend solutions wherever possible. Identify opportunities to improve workflows and processes for the benefit of both Hogarth and the client. Build and maintain strong day-to-day relationships with clients and agency stakeholders. Continuously strive to enhance client and stakeholder relationships. Identify and provide training opportunities for clients to improve adherence to processes and optimize workflow.Financial Responsibilities Prepare accurate cost estimates based on contracted rates and obtain approvals from your manager. Contribute to account profitability, budgeting, and forecasting processes.New Business & Growth Responsibilities Actively identify new revenue and business growth opportunities within existing clients and prospects. Lead and support the development of proposals for new business opportunities. Build and maintain client relationships to drive ongoing growth and expansion. Collaborate with internal teams to create compelling pitches and innovative solutions that position Hogarth as a strategic partner.Requirements 10+ years of experience managing and servicing international accounts, preferably in a digital advertising or agency environment. Proven ability to lead and manage a dynamic account team, including resource planning and performance management. Strong client focus, interpersonal, and communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to perform effectively under pressure Demonstrated experience in identifying and driving new business growth. Strategic thinking with the ability to identify opportunities for workflow improvement, process optimization, and business growth. Positive, can-do attitude with a track record of delivering high-quality results.Why work here: At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.Inclusion and Impact WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.DataWe rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. normalizedText: About This RoleTeam Description Preqin, a part of BlackRock, plays a critical role in transforming private markets data, benchmarks, and analytics for clients globally. The Benchmarks & Indices team is responsible for developing and scaling benchmark and index capabilities across private equity, private credit, real assets, and hedge funds. Working closely with Product, Technology, Aladdin, eFront, Index Services, and client-facing teams, the organization helps embed private markets intelligence directly into investment workflows, enabling institutional investors to make more informed decisions with speed, confidence, and precision.Why is your role important?This role is responsible for setting the vision, strategy, and operating model for one of Preqin's most strategic data franchises. As the MD, Global Head of Derived Data, you will be accountable for Preqin’s benchmark and index datasets and drive overall data quality across Preqin data. You will also partner closely with Product, Technology, and Client teams to deliver market-leading data solutions and data customer services. This role would encompass leadership and strategic direction over Preqin’s benchmarks and indices, covering fund-level benchmarks, asset-level indices, and next-generation benchmark products developed in partnership with Aladdin, eFront and BlackRock Index Services.As a senior leader, you will influence enterprise priorities, lead a global function, and help shape the future of private markets intelligence. You will also serve as Head of the BlackRock Bangalore office, responsible for site leadership and organizational capability building.Key ResponsibilitiesIn every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:Set and execute the global strategy for Client & Benchmarks Data, aligned to BlackRock's private markets and technology priorities. Define the long-term vision for client intelligence, benchmark data, and analytics capabilities. Provide executive oversight of data quality, governance, coverage, and scalability. Lead and manage leaders, develop a global organization, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and client focus. Partner with Product, Technology, Index services teams to drive client value, adoption, and growth. Champion data modernization, AI-enabled capabilities, and operational excellence to improve efficiency and scale. Represent the organization in executive forums, strategic initiatives, and key client engagements. Ensure strong risk management, governance, and controls appropriate for a global institutional data business. The role extends beyond functional leadership to encompass enterprise responsibility across a wider stakeholder group, with a mandate to develop and execute talent strategies, cultivate future leaders, and act as a visible ambassador of the firm's culture and leadership principles. What are we looking for?20+ years of experience in financial data, private markets, benchmarks, analytics, or related data businesses. Proven track record leading large-scale global data organizations and senior leadership teams. Deep understanding of private markets, institutional investors, and data-driven products. Strong strategic, commercial, and operational leadership capabilities Experience partnering across Product, Technology, Client, and Commercial functions, lead to change and drive positive outcomes through transformation and innovation Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred. Our BenefitsTo help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.Our hybrid work modelBlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.Guidance on AI use for candidatesAt BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.About BlackRockAt BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law. normalizedText: Job match scoreEarly ApplicantKeyskillsLocationWork ExperienceJob description Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact. Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable: end to end. ABOUT THE ROLE: Portcast has already been used by global freight forwarding companies, manufacturers and cargo airlines. Our customers trust us to deliver fast, reliable and secure predictions, our engine answers when, where, why, and by how many days a container will be delayed. That trust lives or dies on data quality, and thats what youll own. As our Data Analyst, you will be reporting directly to our Analytics Manager and work closely with our Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams. Youll sit on a data-heavy product that gives customers end-to-end visibility of their cargo across the ocean journey, making sure the data we ingest into the models and share with customers is error-free and of the highest quality. You wont just run the query and close the ticket here. When an anomaly shows up, youll chase why its there, trace it to the real source, and fix the process so it doesnt come back. Curiosity isnt a nice-to-have on this team, its how we build. WHAT YOULL OWN: Documentation, reporting, and root-cause analysis of prediction issues: owning the problem end to end, not just flagging it. Analyze ingested and system-generated data for anomalies and gaps, and refer to various data sources to plug those gaps. Turn data into stories: surface the pattern behind an issue, propose the fix (QA process-flow change and/or automation), and own the subsequent plan and execution. Automate performance/accuracy review processes, report generation, and data visualization using Python and SQL: building reusable, scalable workflows, not one-off scripts. Support Engineering and Data Science on system-level data fixes. Understand how the engine makes predictions, and explore improvements by fixing or introducing new data and features. Support Customer Operations and Marketing with insights from the data: performance, accuracy metrics, the impact of real-time events, as needed. Maintain and own internal and customer dashboards based on trial/account requirements (prediction accuracy, timeliness, coverage, explainability). WHAT WERE LOOKING FOR: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. At least 2-3+ years in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role, preferably in a product-based, lean startup particularly in logistics, ecommerce or B2B SaaS data-heavy domain. Exceptionally skilled in Python and SQL, with a demonstrated ability to consistently produce reusable and highly scalable code. An eye for detail: you go looking for anomalies in the system before a customer does, and proven experience turning messy data into clear visualizations. First Principles Thinker: when you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You dont reach for a new tool when a tighter use of an existing one would do the job. Curious by Default: you dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When the data surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix, and you ask the good questions early. You own your output, AI included. You use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, etc.) where they make you faster on QA, automation, and analysis, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read and validate what they produce - you dont just paste it. You can explain the anomaly, the root cause, and the fix without saying "the AI found it," and you flag AI-assisted work without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking. Empathy and Urgency: you feel the customers pain and react promptly on a day-to-day basis (either programmatically or manually) to meet expectations and deliver on time. You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a data decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed. You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic, and cross-cultural team, with a strong ownership mindset, efficiency, and a data-driven approach. Good to have: a basic understanding of machine learning algorithms. WHATS IN IT FOR YOU: Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. Data-first team: Youll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems with data. Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning data quality and analytics from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains, and youll be a major part of our story. Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. Youll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do: Curiosity: We read the data before we trust it. We dig into why a number looks the way it does, not just how to make the anomaly disappear. Ownership: We act like founders. We dont wait for someone to flag a data issue, and we stay on a problem until its actually fixed at the source. Raising the bar: We dont settle for a report that only works this once. We aim for data pipelines and dashboards that are reliable, reusable, and easy for the team to trust. Effectiveness: We focus on analysis that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship work that improves outcomes, not just output. Join us at Portcast and be part of a high-performing team that is shaping the future of the logistics and shipping industry through cutting-edge predictive analytics! LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States. The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations. Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment. The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go-to-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion. The Vice President, Pipeline is responsible for the firm's pipeline discipline within the Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the local Head of CE, the Vice President, Pipeline will own the opportunity pipeline integrity and the pipeline review rigor across industry verticals. This role institutionalizes pipeline discipline: how opportunities are staged, reviewed and forecast and how risk and aging are surfaced and acted on. This Vice President will turn pipeline data into reliable commercial intelligence for Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and firm leadership. Success is measured by forecast reliability and the degree to which firm leadership relies on the pipeline as a single source of truth for commercial performance. Responsibilities Partner with senior team members across all practice lines to strategically embed pipeline discipline into firm's commercial cadence Own pipeline standards and hygiene, including stage definitions, probability discipline and required data at each stage Run pipeline reviews with clarity and accountability, ensuring no opportunity drifts without commentary or next steps Track opportunity aging, conversion ratios, stage velocity and forecast accuracy Surface pipeline risk signals and data gaps for escalation to the relevant owners Produce pipeline dashboards and forecast reporting on a defined cadence for practice line and firm leadership Translate pipeline data into actionable commercial intelligence on performance, risk and opportunity Support board-level reporting preparation and ensure pipeline figures are verified with PLLs and opportunity owners Coordinate with the Intapp DealCloud Product Manager ensuring pipeline workflows and reporting are well supported by firm systems Support business development efforts while maintaining strong relationships with existing clients Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture Qualifications Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon Six plus years in sales operations, revenue operations, pipeline management or a related commercial discipline Demonstrated experience running pipeline reviews and forecasting for a senior audience Experience operating within professional services, consulting, investment banking or private equity environments (preferably serving U.S. clients) Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate pipeline data into commercial insight Experience within the middle market private equity and advisory ecosystem is preferred Familiarity with CRM platforms, ideally Intapp DealCloud Exposure to revenue analytics and forecast governance is preferred Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset Track record of success in high-pressure environments #LI-Hybrid Position: Senior Director, Performance Marketing (Full time)Total Annual Package (OTE): $220,000–$240,000 + comprehensive benefitsBase: $185,000–$200,000/yearPerformance bonus: up to 20% of base, paid monthlyLocation: Remote (Global) About Us:A leading e-commerce company operating a high-growth D2C brand in the US market. We run a data-driven, performance-first marketing operation where analytical depth, system thinking, and speed of execution define how capital is deployed across paid channels.The Role:We are looking for a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own the full paid media engine, multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across search and social platforms, with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team. This is a high-autonomy, P&L-ownership position for a professional who combines deep platform expertise with strategic and operational rigor, reporting directly to the CEO.The Problems you'll Own:Primary — Grow revenue while holding margin.Grow revenue from a multi-million-dollar monthly paid budget across the two major platforms while holding contribution margin after returns and financing. This is a high-AOV, sparse-conversion category, so each added dollar of spend normally returns less — the job is to push growth to the point where margin still holds. Allocate capital on true marginal return, not platform-reported ROAS.Secondary — Build the system that runs the scaling decisions.Design and document the rules that govern spend — when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back — and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day-to-day executive oversight.Responsibilities:Own Paid Media Efficiency. Manage and allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta. Allocate capital between platforms based on marginal return, not platform-reported averages.Build Decision Systems. Design and document the pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols that govern all paid spend. Systems must be operable by any team member, with automation layered where it earns its place.Own Measurement. Platform attribution vs. backend reality, MER, incrementality testing. Serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance.Run Creative as a System. Concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting. Creative velocity by design, not ad hoc.Design Promo Architecture. Pulse strategy across the retail calendar, financing offers, funnel alignment.Lead the Team. Lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function. Org design authority with CEO sign-off.Scale New Channels. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Channel identification is part of the mandate.Drive Profitability. Convert paid media efficiency to profit through a contribution-margin lens, after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation.Required Qualifications:7+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M+/month on each of the two major platforms (concurrent or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution. Who we are The NS Raghavan Centre for Entrepreneurial Learning (NSRCEL) is IIM Bangalore’s startup hub and incubation centre. The centre is structured as a section-8 not-for-profit entity. NSRCEL’s mission is to support ventures in the start-up ecosystem that demonstrate potential to create significant economic and societal impact. This financial year alone NSRCEL has engaged with 662 ventures through 13 unique program tracks across 82 townsin the country.NSRCEL is supported by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and foundations like Pernod Ricard India Foundation and SBI Foundation. NSRCEL has partnered with corporates like Alstom,Capgemini, Unilever, Kotak Mahindra Bank and Maruti Suzuki among others.Background to the role:NSRCEL has been focussed until now on early-revenue stage incubation, helping founders navigate from MVP to PMF. Many of our founders come back when they are confident of their PMF, in seeking assistance to now create break-out growth. We realise that the founder and organizational capability to reach PMF is very different from the ability required to create break-out growth. We have experimented with this need in small ways through the FintechCoE, a circularity track pilot in partnership with Acumen, and a women-in-tech scale-up sub-track.NSRCEL is now creating a growth-stage track to address this. The objective is to help put these ventures on a 5x growth path in 3 years. The track will focus on growth stage ventures that have already achieved PMF, operational stability and early capital infusion. Some of the entry criteria for the track may be:• Rs 10 Cr+ or $ 6Mn in ARR• Pre-series A funded• Tech-enabled or tech-embedded• Operating in high-growth marketsThe responsibilities will:• Lead the ongoing Fintech CoE• Design and roll out a sector-inclusive growth stage accelerator• Design and implement track variants for women entrepreneurs and social impact enterprises• Track and deliver to impact outcomesWhat you will be doingThe role will conceptualize, design, and execute the Growth Stage Accelerator.This will include: Defining the thesis and quantified outcomes of the track Creating and owning the design and execution from outreach and cohort selection to venture & founder outcomes Securing resources, partners, mentors, experts to ensure desired results Creating and owning the revenue and financial plan for the track As part of the leadership team of NSRCEL you will play an important role in shaping strategic decisions for the centre and will serve as a spokesperson for the organization. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Paymissing preference₹30,00,000 - ₹40,00,000 a yearJob typematching preferenceFull-time LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job descriptionAbout Us We are a Gen Z-focused commerce platform for fashion, beauty, home, and lifestyle. We believe that discovery is as important as assortment. In a world of infinite choice, customers need inspiration, curation, and context. We're looking for a seasoned merchandising leader to own how customers discover, browse, and shop across our app and mobile web experiences. This is a highly strategic role at the intersection of customer experience, fashion, data, and growth. About the Role As the Head of Merchandising & Discovery, you will own the digital storefront for our platform. You will be responsible for shaping customer demand through intelligent placement, trend-led curation, homepage strategy, collections, campaigns, navigation, and content-led discovery experiences across fashion, beauty, home, and lifestyle categories. You will use customer behaviour, performance data, inventory availability, seasonality, trends, and business priorities to determine what customers see, where they see it, and how they discover it. Success in this role will be measured through improvements in conversion, engagement, category traffic distribution, and overall shopping experience quality. As the business scales, you will build and lead the merchandising function and establish the processes, frameworks, and operating rhythms that support long-term growth. What You'll Own Digital Storefront Strategy Own the merchandising strategy across our app and mobile web platforms. Define how customers discover products, brands, trends, and campaigns. Build merchandising frameworks that balance customer relevance, business priorities, and brand visibility. Create a best-in-class discovery experience for shoppers. Homepage, Navigation & Discovery Own homepage architecture, navigation strategy, category storefronts, collections, and campaign placements. Design data-driven wireframes and merchandising journeys that improve customer engagement and conversion. Continuously optimize placement strategies based on performance data and customer behaviour. Develop scalable merchandising playbooks for launches, campaigns, trends, and seasonal moments. Curation & Trend Leadership Create compelling edits, collections, and discovery moments that inspire customers. Translate cultural trends, social signals, and customer insights into merchandising actions. Ensure our platform remains relevant, fresh, and differentiated in its customer experience. Performance & Optimization Own key metrics including Conversion Rate, Traffic Distribution Across Categories, Click-through Rates, and Engagement Metrics. Drive experimentation through A/B testing of layouts, collections, placements, and customer journeys. Partner closely with Analytics and Product teams to identify opportunities for optimization. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with Category, Curation, Marketing, Product, Design, and Analytics teams to align merchandising priorities. Influence category visibility strategies and launch plans through data-backed recommendations. Act as the voice of the customer in discovery and merchandising decisions. Team Building Build and lead the merchandising and discovery function. Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team as the business scales. Establish operating processes, reporting structures, and merchandising best practices. What We're Looking For 10+ years of experience in digital merchandising, on-site merchandising, e-commerce merchandising, category merchandising, or related functions. Proven experience owning homepage strategy, category discovery, collections, campaigns, and customer journeys for a large-scale e-commerce business. Strong understanding of fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and consumer trends. Demonstrated ability to use customer and performance data to influence conversion and engagement outcomes. Deep understanding of digital customer behaviour and merchandising levers. Experience partnering closely with Product, Design, Growth, and Category teams. Strong commercial acumen combined with customer-centric thinking. Prior experience building or leading merchandising teams is preferred. Success in This Role Within the first 12 months, you will: Establish a scalable merchandising operating model across app and mobile web. Improve customer discovery and conversion across key categories. Create a differentiated, trend-led shopping experience for Gen Z customers. Build the foundations of a high-performing merchandising function. Become a key driver of demand and customer engagement across the platform.

normalizedText: Job DescriptionDirector, Technology - ESRE EcommJob DescriptionAbout the RoleThe Enterprise Site Reliability Engineering (ESRE) E Commerce Support Director will lead a high-performing team responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence of the e-commerce ecosystem. This role oversees incident management, service operations, platform stability, continuous improvement initiatives, and cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Customer Experience teams.Responsibilities Lead day-to-day support operations for all e-commerce platforms, services, and integrations. Own the complete incident lifecycle including identification, triage, escalation, communication, and post-incident reviews. Ensure SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs related to uptime, latency, and platform health are consistently met. Drive continuous service improvements through automation, tooling, and process optimization. Manage, mentor, and develop ESRE support engineers and leads across onshore and offshore locations. Establish a culture of ownership, accountability, operational rigor, and high performance. Provide coaching, performance evaluations, and career development guidance. Oversee monitoring, observability, alerting, and proactive detection of system anomalies. Partner with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to deliver fixes, optimizations, and resiliency improvements. Ensure readiness and execution support for peak seasons and high-traffic sale events. Act as a liaison between Operations, Engineering, Product, Security, and business stakeholders. Strong understanding of e-commerce ecosystems including checkout, payments, catalog, order management, loyalty, and APIs. Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as ELK/Splunk, AppDynamics/Dynatrace, Grafana, and RUM tools.
