Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.About UsFounded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. We currently operate retail stores globally. normalizedText: Job SummaryWe are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Support Manager to lead our Functional Support Consultant team. This team is responsible for providing high-quality support for our robust and scalable SaaS products. As a Support Manager, you will be a key leader, ensuring our team delivers continuous, delightful customer experiences and resolves issues efficiently.Key ResponsibilitiesTeam Leadership: Lead and manage a team of Functional Support Consultants, fostering a people-first mentality and a collaborative environment. You'll be responsible for coaching, mentoring, and developing your team to ensure they are the "ultimate HighRadian ambassador".Performance Management: Monitor team and individual performance against key metrics and SLAs. Use your knowledge of support KPIs to drive continuous improvement in areas like response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.Operational Excellence: Oversee the day-to-day operations of the support team, ensuring that best practices for service delivery are followed. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationRemote Full job descriptionAbout the Team The APAC Partnerships team builds and grows a high-impact partner ecosystem that helps customers adopt OpenAI solutions successfully, advances OpenAI’s mission, and supports the company’s growth. About the Role We are hiring a Partner Director to shape and execute OpenAI’s partner strategy in India, with a major focus on building a high-impact AWS-centered go-to-market motion. You will work closely with AWS and a prioritised ecosystem of services partners to generate partner-sourced opportunities, deliver customer wins, and develop repeatable solutions. You will translate the broader APAC AWS strategy into a practical India operating plan, aligning AWS field teams, services partners, and OpenAI teams around the most valuable opportunities. This is a hands-on role with responsibility across the full services-partner lifecycle: identifying and prioritising prospective partners, leading contracting, activating newly signed partners, growing strategic relationships, and managing performance. You will work with a mix of India-headquartered and global services partners, selecting the right portfolio based on market needs. You will build senior executive relationships while also driving the operating rhythms required to turn partnerships into measurable results. This role reports to the APAC Partnerships Lead in Singapore and is based in India. In this role you will: Contribute to and partially own the India partner strategy and annual operating plan, with a primary focus on AWS. Translate the APAC AWS partnership strategy into local priorities, target accounts, partner activation plans, and measurable outcomes for India. Build strong relationships with AWS India leadership and its partner, sales, and technical teams. Mobilise a prioritised portfolio of services partners around the OpenAI and AWS opportunity in India. Identify, evaluate, recruit, and contract with services partners based on market needs and strategic priorities. Own the contracting process end to end, coordinating with legal, finance, and leadership teams through approval and signature. Drive joint account planning and field engagement with AWS and priority services partners to grow partner-sourced opportunities and deliver customer wins. Manage strategic relationships with both India-headquartered partners and the India or regional leadership teams of global partners. Drive partner onboarding across sales training, technical enablement, security and provisioning, and support operations. Collaborate with AWS, services partners, and internal teams to develop repeatable solutions, customer propositions, demo assets, delivery playbooks, and localised technical documentation. Establish governance for priority partnerships, including operating reviews, executive business reviews, milestone tracking, and escalation processes. Build scalable operating processes for the India partner ecosystem, including reporting, playbooks, activation plans, and performance management. Monitor partner performance, identify risks early, and drive remediation or acceleration plans. Coordinate across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Enablement, Operations, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure internal alignment and partner success. Coordinate with Marketing on AWS-related launches, campaigns, enablement activities, and market-facing events. Represent OpenAI with senior partner executives and at relevant external events. Travel regularly across India, with occasional travel across APAC and to the United States. You might thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of experience in partnerships, alliances, partner success, or enterprise sales within enterprise software, consulting, or systems-integration environments. Demonstrated experience building partner-led go-to-market motions with AWS, ideally within the Indian enterprise market. A strong understanding of the AWS ecosystem, including how hyperscaler field teams, partner organisations, and services partners work together to generate and convert customer opportunities. Experience building and growing a portfolio of services partners, from initial identification and contracting through activation and scaled execution. Strong knowledge of the Indian enterprise ecosystem and experience working with both local and global partner organisations. A track record of influencing partner-sourced growth, supporting customer wins, and developing repeatable solutions. The ability to translate a regional partnership strategy into local account priorities, partner plans, and operating cadences. Experience managing senior executive relationships while remaining comfortable working through operational details. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to prioritise investments across a diverse partner landscape. Excellent program-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and hold cross-functional stakeholders accountable. Experience operating in an early-stage or high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without authority and drive urgency with empathy. Professional fluency in English. Preferred Experience working with AI products, AI-enabled solutions, or an emerging technology ecosystem. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

normalizedText: About RevaReva is building the authorization and security control plane for the Agentic AI era. LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job description About Ugaoo Ugaoo is India’s leading gardening and home-grown lifestyle brand, building a deeper connection between people and plants. What started as a horticulture-first business has evolved into a full-stack D2C ecosystem, with our website serving as a key growth engine where customers across the country discover plants, gardening essentials, and plant care solutions. Alongside our D2C platform, Ugaoo also reaches customers through select offline (Retail, Corporate Gifting, Services & Maintenance) and marketplace channels. As we continue to scale, our focus remains on building a category-defining brand that makes gardening accessible, enjoyable, and aspirational for modern consumers. About the Role We are looking for a D2C Growth Lead who will own and scale revenue from the company’s website by optimizing the entire digital customer journey — from traffic acquisition to conversion and repeat purchases. This role will be responsible for driving website growth through performance marketing alignment, conversion optimization, product storytelling, and data-led experimentation. The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking with strong customer intuition and has a deep understanding of how D2C brands convert traffic into revenue. Responsibilities 1. Website Revenue & Growth Ownership Own and drive revenue growth from the website through continuous optimization of the digital sales funnel. Define and track key metrics including conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, and repeat purchase rate. Build monthly and quarterly growth plans aligned with business revenue targets. 2. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimization Own the end-to-end customer journey on the website, ensuring a seamless and high-conversion experience. Identify friction points across product discovery, add-to-cart, checkout, and payment flows. Lead A/B testing and experimentation across landing pages, PDPs, messaging, and checkout experience to improve conversion rates. 3. Performance Marketing Alignment Work closely with the performance marketing team and external agencies to ensure high-quality traffic acquisition. Align marketing campaigns with product priorities, seasonal launches, and growth objectives. Monitor funnel metrics and continuously improve traffic quality and conversion efficiency. 4. Creative Strategy for Ads & Campaigns Collaborate with internal design teams and agencies to develop high-performing ad creatives and campaign content. Provide clear creative briefs, campaign messaging, and performance feedback to improve ad performance. Ensure marketing communication clearly highlights product value propositions and customer benefits. 5. Product Storytelling & PDP Optimization Lead the optimization of Product Detail Pages (PDPs) to maximize conversion. Develop compelling product storytelling, benefit-driven content, FAQs, images, and videos that help customers make purchase decisions. Ensure product pages effectively communicate usage guidance, differentiation, and key selling points. 6. Product Merchandising & Website Campaigns Manage website merchandising including category pages, product prioritization, bundles, and seasonal collections. Collaborate with product and supply chain teams to align campaigns with inventory availability and demand trends. Build high-converting landing pages and promotional campaigns for launches and seasonal events. 7. Data Analytics & Growth Insights Track and analyze website performance metrics and user behavior using analytics tools. Build dashboards and reports to track growth performance, campaign effectiveness, and conversion insights. Translate data into actionable growth experiments and optimization initiatives. 8. Experimentation & Continuous Growth Drive a culture of rapid experimentation across marketing campaigns, landing pages, pricing, and product positioning. Run structured growth experiments to unlock new acquisition and conversion opportunities. Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition efficiency and lifetime value. Key Skills & Experience 6–8 years of experience in D2C growth, or performance marketing roles. Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and digital funnel analytics. Experience working with performance marketing platforms (Meta, Google, etc.). Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as GA4, marketing dashboards, and customer behavior insights. Ability to combine data-driven decision-making with creative experimentation. Experience working in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments. What We’re Looking For A growth-first mindset with strong ownership of revenue outcomes. Someone who understands how traffic converts into revenue on a D2C website. Ability to connect marketing, product, and customer insights to drive growth. A builder who enjoys experimenting, optimizing, and scaling digital growth engines. Join us, and help shape the future of gardening and grow with us, because Plants Grow People.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.PayUp to ₹5,00,000 a yearJob typeFull-time LocationMohali, Punjab Full job descriptionJob Title: Digital Marketing Manager – Brand Visibility & Organic Growth Location: Mohali – Phase 8 B, Sector 74 (On-site, full-time) Experience Required: 4–8 years in B2B digital marketing (SaaS / technology products preferred) Reporting: Directly to Founder & CEO Employment Type: Full-time | Monthly salary + performance-linked incentives About Confiex Data Room Confiex Data Room Private Limited is India’s longest-serving and most trusted Virtual Data Room (VDR) provider with 18+ years of experience in secure document sharing. We specialize in supporting high-stakes processes such as M&A due diligence, NCLT/IBC insolvency resolutions (90+ cases), banking, real estate, compliance, e-tenders, and IPOs (100+). Our platforms emphasize enterprise-grade security, compliance (ISO 9001/27001, DPDPA, Startup India), and AI-powered features like redaction, summarization, and real-time collaboration. Trusted by major banks, corporates, and resolution professionals, we deliver affordable, India-first secure data room solutions with full data sovereignty. To learn more about us, visit www.confiexdataroom.com. About the Role We are looking for an experienced B2B Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale the organic brand visibility, content authority, and qualified lead pipeline for our Virtual Data Room platforms. This is a hands-on, results-driven role focused on long-term organic growth — SEO, content, review platforms, LinkedIn & X presence, backlinks, website authority, and systematic lead generation & qualification. You will work closely with Sales and Support teams, own clear monthly and quarterly targets, and use data to continuously improve performance. Key Responsibilities Brand Visibility & Organic Growth Own end-to-end organic strategy for our VDR platforms across SEO, content, listings, and social channels. Develop and execute keyword strategy, technical SEO, on-page optimisation, Google Sitemaps, Search Console monitoring, and site architecture improvements. Build high-quality backlinks through outreach, guest posts, digital PR, and industry partnerships. Continuously enhance website content, structure, and conversion paths to improve organic traffic, engagement, and lead conversion. Review & Listing Platforms Manage and grow presence on Capterra, G2, and other relevant B2B software review platforms. Drive genuine reviews, optimise profiles, respond to feedback, and improve ranking/visibility. Monitor competitor listings and positioning on these platforms. Content & Thought Leadership Plan and produce high-quality, SEO-optimised content: blogs, case studies, comparison pages, guides, LinkedIn carousels/posts, and X content. Maintain consistent publishing calendar and ensure content supports both brand authority and lead generation. Position the company as a trusted Indian VDR expert (especially in M&A, insolvency/NCLT, banking, and real estate due diligence). Social & Community Engagement Own LinkedIn (primary B2B channel) and X strategy — organic posting, engagement, community building, and thought leadership. Grow meaningful engagement and follower quality rather than vanity metrics. Lead Generation, Qualification & Handover Design and run organic lead generation systems (content upgrades, gated assets, website CTAs, LinkedIn lead forms, etc.). Qualify inbound leads using clear criteria and pass high-quality opportunities to the Sales team with proper context and tracking. Maintain clean lead tracking, feedback loops with Sales, and conversion reporting. Cross-functional Collaboration & Feedback Loops Regularly coordinate with Sales and Support teams to gather market feedback, objection insights, win/loss learnings, and content ideas. Translate sales/support inputs into better content, messaging, and targeting. Competitive Intelligence Continuously track competitor digital strategies (SEO rankings, content, review scores, messaging, campaigns, and positioning). Provide actionable insights and recommendations. Measurement, Reporting & Reviews Define and track clear KPIs (organic traffic, keyword rankings, backlinks, review scores, content performance, MQLs/SQLs generated, lead-to-opportunity conversion, engagement metrics, etc.). Use tools such as Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, LinkedIn Analytics, CRM, and review platform dashboards. Present structured monthly progress reports and quarterly business reviews with clear wins, gaps, and next-quarter plans. Maintain transparent dashboards for leadership visibility. Required Experience & Skills 4–8 years of hands-on B2B digital marketing experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology products. Proven track record of growing organic traffic, rankings, and qualified leads for B2B products. Strong practical experience in SEO (technical + content + off-page), content marketing, and LinkedIn/X organic growth. Direct experience managing Capterra, G2, or similar B2B review platforms. Comfortable owning lead generation systems and working closely with Sales on qualification and handover. Excellent written English and ability to create clear, professional B2B content. Data-driven mindset with experience using marketing analytics and reporting tools. Ability to work independently, prioritise, and deliver against monthly/quarterly targets in a lean, founder-led environment. Prior experience coordinating with Sales and Support/Customer Success teams. Preferred Experience in the Virtual Data Room, secure collaboration, legal-tech, fintech, or compliance software space. Familiarity with Indian B2B buying cycles (banking, corporate, insolvency professionals, real estate). Basic understanding of HubSpot or similar CRM + marketing automation. Experience building backlink profiles and digital PR for B2B brands. What Success Looks Like Measurable improvement in organic visibility (rankings, traffic, domain authority). Stronger presence and higher rankings/reviews on Capterra & G2. Consistent flow of qualified leads passed to Sales with clear tracking and feedback. High-quality content engine that supports both brand and pipeline. Transparent monthly and quarterly reporting with clear progress against agreed KPIs. Questions? Whatsapp Message Only for queries - +91 9082467325. normalizedText: About Credit SaisonEstablished in 2019, Credit Saison India (CS India) is one of the country’s fastest growing Non-Bank Financial Company (NBFC) lenders, with verticals in wholesale, direct lending and tech-enabled partnerships with Non-Bank Financial Companies (NBFCs) and fintechs. Its tech-enabled model coupled with underwriting capability facilitates lending at scale, meeting India’s huge gap for credit, especially with underserved and under penetrated segments of the population.Credit Saison India is committed to growing as a lender and evolving its offerings in India for the long-term for MSMEs, households, individuals and more. Credit Saison India is registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and has an AAA rating from CRISIL (a subsidiary of S&P Global) and CARE Ratings.Currently, Credit Saison India has a branch network of 80+ physical offices, 2.06 million active loans, an AUM of over US$2B and an employee base of about approx ~2000 employees.Credit Saison India is part of Saison International, a global financial company with a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, creating resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact. Across its business arms of lending and corporate venture capital, Saison International is committed to being a transformative partner in creating opportunities and enabling the dreams of people.Saison International is the international headquarters (IHQ) of Credit Saison Company Limited, founded in 1951 and one of Japan’s largest lending conglomerates with over 70 years of history and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The Company has evolved from a credit-card issuer to a diversified financial services provider across payments, leasing, finance, real estate and entertainment. Job description: Analytics Senior Analyst Function: Talent Executive, Talent Insights and Analytics Sub Function: Advanced Analytics Position Summary: This position is responsible for working across a range of analytics projects and solutions for internal clients, collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to support informed decision-making. The Analytics Senior Analyst will utilize advanced analytics modeling techniques to extract insights, predict trends, and optimize decision-making, while ensuring that data is presented in a clear and usable format. Essential Functions of the Job: Work on a variety of analytics projects and solutions, collaborating with internal clients to understand theirneeds and deliver tailored insights that drive business outcomes. Participate in project planning and execution, ensuring alignment with client objectives and timelines. Collect, analyze, and interpret large data sets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies that inform strategic decision-making within EY. Utilize advanced analytics modeling techniques to derive actionable insights and support data-driven recommendations. Develop and implement advanced analytics models to extract insights and predict trends, optimizing decision-making processes for internal clients. Collaborate with team members to refine modeling approaches and ensure alignment with project goals. Continuously develop knowledge of analytics methods and best practices to effectively address the evolving needs of internal clients. Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies in analytics, integrating new techniques into project work as appropriate. As required, gather and analyze external market data to provide additional insights for internal clients,enhancing the depth and relevance of analytics projects. Ensure that data insights are presented in a clear and usable format, utilizing data visualization tools to enhance understanding and facilitate decision-making. Prepare reports and presentations that effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders at all levels. Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities: Collection, analysis, and interpretation of large data sets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies that inform strategic decision-making for internal clients. Utilization of advanced analytics modeling techniques to extract insights and predict trends, providing data-driven recommendations that optimize decision-making processes. Generation of actionable insights from data analysis, translating findings into clear recommendations that support informed business decisions. Gathering and analysis of external market data as needed, enhancing the depth and relevance of insights provided to internal clients. Ensures that analytical results are presented in a clear and usable format, facilitating understanding and enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions based on the insights provided. Identification of opportunities for process improvements in data analysis and modeling practices, proposing enhancements that increase efficiency and effectiveness in analytics efforts. Knowledge and Skills Requirements: Strong proficiency in data analysis techniques and methodologies, with the ability to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights. Understanding of statistical methods and concepts, including regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and data distribution, to support data-driven decision-making. Familiarity with advanced analytics modelling techniques, including machine learning and predictive analytics, to extract insights and predict trends. Proficiency in data manipulation and programming languages such as SQL, Python, or R, enabling effective data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to create compelling visual representations of data that facilitate understanding and communication of insights. Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and implement effective solutions in the context of data analysis. High level of attention to detail to ensure data accuracy and consistency in analysis and reporting. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey analytical findings to diverse stakeholders, ensuring clarity and engagement. A commitment to staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analytics, adapting skills and knowledge accordingly. Job description: Analytics Senior Analyst Supervision Responsibilities: Provide support and guidance to junior team members, assisting in their development and fostering a collaborative team environment. Share knowledge and best practices with team members to promote continuous learning and improvement. Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment, contributing to group efforts and supporting colleagues in achieving common goals. Other Requirements: Due to global nature of the role; travel and willingness to work alternative hours will be required Due to global nature of the role; English language skills - excellent written and verbal communication will be required Job Requirements: Education: Educated to degree level Higher professional or master s qualification is preferred, not required Certification Requirements: Higher professional or master s qualification in a related discipline is preferred, not required Active membership in related professional bodies or industry groups is preferred, not required Experience: Significant experience in a closely related Data analytics / data / insights driven role. Experience in solving problems in a structured manner and delivering results in a complex and dynamic environment. Experience of developing digital capability, defining key digital competencies for the team, and ensuring provision of learning to advance skills. Demonstrable experience of collaborating with talent colleagues to understand needs / requirements and of shaping digital solutions. Demonstrable experience of working with third party vendors / external system implementors to deliver reporting, insights, and analytical solutions from design to enablement. Experience of leading and participating in global dispersed teams to enhance services, processes, and standards. Demonstrable experience of working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments to deliver required results. Demonstrable experience of anticipating issues and challenges and proactively working to navigate challenges. Experience of conducting internal and external research and analysis, providing best practices and insights to drive improvements. Demonstrable experience of having worked to lead or provide SMR advice to achieve successful change outcomes. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force. normalizedText: Who We AreBoston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.What You'll DoThe People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest & most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable the global technology for BCG’s entire HR & People Function including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility, & Career Development); L&D and Teaming; and Core HR (including Workday & Compensation). Over the past two years, the HR Product Portfolio has more than doubled in size, and there is more growth to come.With this growth comes amazing new leadership opportunities, including the Product Owner for a new squad focused on delivering Data & Analytics for Learning@BCG. This product owner role will be responsible for a new data product, consolidating Learning completions and other HR data about Learners to support both reporting, analytics and agentic personalization.Initially, this role will be part of a larger Learning Transformation project. Long-term this role will be part of a growing suite of data products and analytics, focused on enabling our HR functions.As the Product Owner, you will represent the voice of the customer, manage stakeholder alignment, and oversee the squad's backlog to deliver impactful results. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and high data quality.Your Responsibilities IncludeDeliver business results and customer value Drive incremental delivery of features for the Learning Data Product, ensuring timely customer value creation. Monitor product performance metrics and adjust strategies based on insights. Support Learning reporting, analytics in the long-term. Prioritize impactful work to meet measurable Key Results for the squad. Manage the squad’s budget and collaborate with leadership on funding needs. Serve as the voice of the customer or end-user Gather and translate user needs into actionable user stories for Data & Analytics. Engage stakeholders to align expectations and enhance trust. Conduct ongoing discovery activities to identify pain points and opportunities. Balance customer value, cost, and execution speed in decision-making. Set an overall vision to direct and inform the squad’s work Bring a strong sense of ownership to the product squad and engage deeply in understanding the current and future needs of the function. Align squad activities with broader product and organizational goals. Translate objectives into a roadmap with clear goals. Foster collaboration with other Product Owners to ensure organizational alignment. Oversee what is delivered by the squad and when Apply design-thinking to understand system user engagement and solve problems effectively. Maintain a prioritized backlog of user stories with clear delivery timelines. Define acceptance criteria ensuring output meets business needs. Support and enable the squad to get its work done Collaborate with the squad to remove impediments and clarify requirements. Partner with Chapter Leads for resourcing and technical expertise. Provide performance feedback to squad members and cross-functional team members. What You'll Bring13+ years of overall professional experience, with 7+ years in a Product Owner or equivalent HR technology/product delivery roleExperience in managing data-driven products and analytics solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with HR leadership. Agile product management expertise, with proven experience in leading Agile teams. Working knowledge of Snowflake and SQL sufficient to engage with technical teams and interpret data workflows.A data-driven mindset, leveraging insights for strategic decision-making. Knowledge of integrations, including API and data ingestion workflows is a plus. Experience in consulting, learning products or HR is a plus. Who You'll Work WithSquad members, as their Product Owner and guide. Internal customers, to understand and translate their needs into user stories. Product Team and Portfolio Leaders, for vision, roadmap, and budget alignment. Technical Area Leaders, for architectural alignment. Scrum Leads, to address operational challenges and maintain Agile workflows. Other Product Owners, for best practice sharing and cross-team alignment. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typematching preferenceFull-time LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description About US: Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Currently headquartered in Saudi Arabia, Soar is growing throughout the region with a mission to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools through its multi-purpose platform, designed to offer a simple and seamless user experience. The Mission: Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth — trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work — sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing — with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define what that product is, build it from zero, and use it to fundamentally reinvent how real estate works. This is not a role for someone who wants to optimize an existing roadmap. It is for a builder who wants to create a category. What “agentic-first” means here Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. Job Summary The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is responsible for leading the overall financial strategy, governance, and performance . The CFO will oversee financial planning, accounting, taxation, treasury,banking, budgeting, compliance, audits, risk management, project finance, investor relations, and business strategy. The role requires a commercially driven leader who can support business growth, optimize profitability, and ensure strong financial control across all business verticals. Lead annual budgeting and business planning. . Develop rolling forecasts and long-term financial models. . Monitor business performance against budgets. . Conduct profitability, cost, and variance analysis. . Present financial insights and recommendations to senior management. Accounting & Financial Reporting . Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements. . Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting. . Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and applicable regulations. . Maintain robust accounting policies and internal controls. . Ensure timely financial closing. Treasury & Banking . Manage the Group& treasury operations. . Optimize working capital and cash flow. . Develop banking relationships. . Negotiate and manage: . Working Capital Limits . Term Loans . Bank Guarantees . Letters of Credit (LC) . Foreign Currency Facilities . Oversee fund utilization and liquidity planning. Taxation & Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with: . GST . Income Tax . TDS . Customs Regulations . FEMA . Companies Act . RBI Guidelines . MCA Filings . Transfer Pricing (if applicable) . Other statutory and regulatory requirements. Coordinate with tax consultants and authorities during assessments and audits. Audit & Internal Controls  Lead statutory, internal, tax, and cost audits.  Strengthen internal financial controls.  Develop and implement financial policies and SOPs.  Monitor compliance across all business units.  Ensure effective risk mitigation processes. Project Finance & Capital Investment  Evaluate capital expenditure (CAPEX) proposals.  Conduct investment appraisals, ROI, IRR, and NPV analysis.  Support financing for manufacturing expansion and EPC projects.  Monitor project profitability and financial performance.  Oversee project funding and lender compliance. Commercial & Business Finance  Evaluate commercial contracts and pricing strategies.  Support procurement and sales teams with financial insights.  Improve business margins through cost optimization.  Review customer credit limits and payment terms.  Drive profitability improvement initiatives. Risk Management  Identify financial, operational, legal, and market risks.  Develop enterprise risk management frameworks.  Monitor foreign exchange exposure and commodity price risks.  Ensure adequate insurance coverage.  Establish business continuity and financial contingency plans. Team Leadership  Lead Finance, Accounts, Taxation, Treasury, and Commercial Finance teams.  Build a high-performance finance function.  Mentor and develop finance professionals.  Define KPIs and performance objectives.  Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with:  Managing Director  Board of Directors  Investors  Banks & Financial Institutions  Auditors  Legal Advisors  Government Authorities  Customers  Vendors  Department Heads to support strategic and operational decision-making. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  EBITDA and Net Profit Growth  Budget Accuracy  Cash Flow Management  Working Capital Efficiency  Return on Capital Employed (ROCE)  Return on Investment (ROI)  Debt-Equity Management  Timely Financial Reporting  Audit Compliance  Tax Compliance  Cost Reduction Initiatives  Project Profitability  Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)  Inventory Turnover  Internal Control Effectiveness Required Qualifications  Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.  MBA (Finance) preferred.  Additional qualifications such as CFA or CMA will be an advantage. Experience  15 years of progressive experience in finance and accounts.  Minimum 5 years in a senior finance leadership role (CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, or Head of Finance).  Experience in manufacturing, renewable energy, EPC, infrastructure, or industrial sectors is highly preferred.  Proven experience in strategic finance, banking, treasury, taxation, and corporate governance. Chat Operations Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the performance of customer service team focused on chat interactions. This role drives the achievement of key digital customer service indicators (KPIs), ensures efficient handling of chat volumes, and maintains a consistently high-quality customer experience across all chat channels. The manager will lead, develop, and mentor their agents, implement strategic initiatives for chat operations, and foster a culture of digital excellence and continuous improvement.Key Responsibilities:Operational Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of customer service team, ensuring optimal staffing, efficient chat queue management, and adherence to digital communication policies and procedures.Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.Team Development & Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.Strategy & Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.Reporting & Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision-making.Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risksProjects & Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.Qualifications:Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred.Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in customer service operations, with at least 6+ years in a leadership role managing customer service team (people manager)Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment and manage multiple digital priorities effectively.Leadership Skills: Strong leadership, motivational, and coaching abilities, with a track record of developing high-performing teams in a digital context.Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret digital interaction data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.Communication: Exceptional written communication skills, with a keen understanding of digital communication etiquette, brand voice, and clarity. Strong verbal communication for internal leadership.Technical Proficiency: Proficient in chat management systems, knowledge base systems, and familiarity with AI/chatbot technologies. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.Desired Attributes:Strategic thinker with an ability to anticipate future trends in digital customer service.Proactive and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over digital channels.Ability to inspire and influence others towards achieving digital excellence.High level of integrity and professionalism.------------------------------------------------------Job Family Group: Operations - Core------------------------------------------------------Job Family:Operations Support------------------------------------------------------Time Type:------------------------------------------------------Most Relevant SkillsPlease see the requirements listed above.------------------------------------------------------Other Relevant SkillsFor complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.------------------------------------------------------Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster. normalizedText: Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.,We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Lead Manager to lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of consumer technology solutions within the Ralph Lauren Consumer Technology division. This role combines technical leadership, people management, and hands-on solution oversight across mobile, backend, API, integration, and AI-enabled platforms. The individual will be responsible for shaping scalable architecture, driving engineering best practices, guiding a high-performing team, and ensuring successful delivery of business-critical digital initiatives.This position requires close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, DevOps, QA, Architecture, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment. The ideal candidate will lead technical direction, mentor engineers, manage delivery across multiple workstreams, align engineering solutions with business priorities, and ensure applications are secure, scalable, maintainable, and integrated effectively with enterprise platforms and services.This is an exciting opportunity to play a strategic leadership role in advancing Ralph Lauren’s digital technology landscape by building strong engineering teams, establishing technical standards, and delivering modern, high-impact consumer solutions that support innovation and business growth., Technical Leadership and Solution Ownership: Lead the end-to-end technical direction for consumer technology initiatives, define solution approaches, establish architecture guardrails, and ensure alignment with business and platform strategy. Team Leadership and People Management: Mentor, coach, and support engineers across the development lifecycle, foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, and help build a strong, collaborative engineering team. Delivery Management: Drive execution across multiple workstreams, manage priorities, remove delivery blockers, and ensure high-quality solutions are delivered on time and in line with business expectations. Architecture and Engineering Standards: Guide application design across frontend, backend, integration, and API layers while promoting reusable design patterns, coding standards, security, scalability, and maintainability. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, Architecture, DevOps, QA, and business stakeholders to translate goals into actionable technical plans and successful releases. Risk, Quality, and Operational Excellence: Oversee technical risk management, code quality, testing discipline, production readiness, and support models to ensure resilient and reliable application performance. Enterprise Integration and Platform Enablement: Ensure solutions integrate effectively with enterprise systems, data services, and AI-enabled capabilities while supporting long-term platform evolution. Continuous Improvement and Innovation: Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, accelerate delivery, modernize platforms, and introduce technologies that enhance business value and user experience.,Technical Skills Strong experience leading the design and delivery of scalable digital applications across frontend, backend, API, and integration layers. Solid understanding of modern application architecture, system integration patterns, security principles, and performance optimization across enterprise environments. Experience guiding engineering teams working with technologies such as React Native, Node.js/NestJS, GraphQL, APIs, and cloud-based platforms. Ability to review technical designs, influence architectural decisions, and ensure solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned to business requirements. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, observability, testing strategies, release management, and secure software development practices. Experience with enterprise integrations, service orchestration, and collaboration across platform, infrastructure, and business teams.AI Integration Awareness of AI-enabled platforms such as Azure AI Foundry and the ability to evaluate, guide, and govern the adoption of intelligent capabilities within enterprise applications.Collaboration & Professional Experience Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in an Agile environment and communicate technical strategy, delivery status, and solution trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience mentoring engineers, supporting career development, conducting technical reviews, and driving engineering excellence across teams. Strong professional experience managing delivery across development, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement initiatives.Quality, Testing & Delivery Experience establishing quality standards, reviewing testing strategies, managing technical debt, and driving reliable delivery practices across teams. Knowledge of production support models, release governance, application security, operational readiness, and engineering processes that support stable and scalable delivery. Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, technical leadership, and delivery management, including experience leading cross-functional engineering teams. jdEvidence.value: End-to-end ownership of the marketing function, including strategy, product marketing, events, and inbound pipeline, reporting to the CEO.
Accountable for pipeline growth, customer expansion, and demonstrating marketing's contribution to revenue growth.

normalizedText: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact.Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains.Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of marketers, software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable, end to end.About The RolePortcast is already trusted by global freight forwarders, manufacturers, and cargo airlines. Marketing is how we tell that story to the rest of the industry, fill the pipeline, and make our product impossible to ignore. We want a Marketing Director who can do both: set the strategy and roll up their sleeves to ship it.Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the marketing function end to end and lead a lean team consisting of a Growth Marketing Manager and a Content Marketing Manager. This is not a role where you inherit a large organization or simply review campaigns.Product Marketing will be your primary area of ownership. You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions to launch new capabilities, refine our positioning, build compelling messaging, and equip our commercial teams with the assets they need to win. You'll also own our events strategy, deciding where Portcast shows up and ensuring every event creates measurable business impact.This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building. You are comfortable switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution, thrive in fast moving startup environments, and naturally take ownership without waiting for direction. You're curious about our domain, excited by AI, and enjoy learning the nuances of logistics and supply chains to tell better product stories.What You’ll OwnMarketing strategy and direction: Take company goals and what the CEO, Sales, and Product need, turn it into a clear, prioritized marketing plan and translate business priorities into clear quarterly marketing plans with measurable goals, ensuring every initiative contributes to pipeline growth, customer expansion, or brand awareness. Product marketing: Own Portcast's product marketing strategy from positioning through launch execution. Work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Solutions, and customers to deeply understand new capabilities, identify differentiated messaging, and bring new products and features to market. Build sales enablement materials, competitive positioning, customer stories, and launch plans that help our Commercial team succeed. Build positioning, messaging, launch plans, sales enablement, customer communications, and supporting campaigns that help customers understand the value of what we're building. We don't want marketing to simply receive launch requests. We want someone who actively drives the launch process, challenges whether we're telling the right story, and ensures great product work never goes unnoticed. Event marketing: Decide which events are worth attending or sponsoring each quarter, own organizer outreach and logistics, and make sure we show up where our buyers are. Cross Functional Leadership: Partner closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions to align marketing with business priorities. Proactively identify opportunities for launches, campaigns, and market education instead of waiting for requests. You'll be expected to navigate pressure from multiple stakeholders, prioritize effectively, communicate trade offs clearly, and ensure marketing consistently delivers the highest business impact. Team leadership: Lead and mentor a lean team of two marketers. Set clear priorities, coach team members, provide regular feedback, raise the quality bar across marketing, and create an environment where people continue to grow while maintaining high execution standards. Data-driven decisions: Own the inbound pipeline and every lever in it. Measure what matters, find the right insights, and reallocate spend and effort to what's working. Your reporting should make trade-offs obvious. What We’re Looking ForBachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent. Enterprise B2B SaaS Marketing: You have significant experience leading marketing within an enterprise B2B SaaS environment. You understand complex buying committees, long sales cycles, and how marketing contributes to revenue growth beyond lead generation. Product Marketing Expertise: You have a strong product marketing foundation with experience owning positioning, messaging, go to market strategy, product launches, customer storytelling, and sales enablement. You know how to turn technical products into compelling business narratives. Ownership and Initiative: You naturally spot opportunities before others do. You don't wait for someone to ask you to market a new feature, write a customer story, or launch a campaign. You proactively identify what matters, build momentum across teams, and drive initiatives through to completion with minimal direction. Curiosity for Logistics Domain: You enjoy learning technical domains and quickly becoming fluent in new industries. Experience in logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is highly valued, but equally important is a genuine curiosity to understand our customers, products, competitive landscape and market in depth. Marketing leadership: Proven senior marketing experience in B2B SaaS selling into the enterprise. You have led marketing and can point to pipeline and revenue impact, not just activity. You are fluent in marketing metrics such as CAC, CPL, LTV, MQL-to-SQL Growth and demand generation: You have a good working understanding of performance marketing and the key metrics behind it (CAC, CPL, LTV, MQL-to-SQL). The Growth Marketing Manager will own execution, day-to-day delivery, and experiment design. Your role is to stay close to performance, provide input where needed, and ensure work is aligned to broader business priorities. Content quality and standards: Execution and production of content will sit with the Content Marketing Manager, while your role is to guide direction, review output, and set them to a higher standard. AI Forward Mindset: You consistently apply AI across advanced marketing workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge. Startup Builder Mentality: You thrive in lean, fast moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited. You're comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution and enjoy building processes, programs, and marketing assets yourself when needed. Cross Functional Influence: You work effectively across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating competing priorities, and driving alignment across teams. People leader and mentor: You develop the people around you. You give honest feedback and care about your team's growth as much as their output. Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right. You can simplify complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and build trust across diverse groups. What’s In It For YouBuild in an industry that's still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics & supply chain technology is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant opportunities to rethink how enterprise software is marketed. We believe curiosity, strong product marketing fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly matter more than prior logistics experience. You'll have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great marketing looks like in this industry. Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels how we market and keeps us curious. Visibility & Impact: With a lean structure, your work is effective from day one, owning one of the company's most strategic functions, you'll see your decisions move pipeline and revenue directly and shape how Portcast goes to market. You'll own marketing end to end, influence company strategy, and work alongside Product, Sales, and Customer Success to drive business growth. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll shape strategy while staying close to execution. From product launches and messaging to event strategy and GTM initiatives, you'll have the autonomy to move ideas from concept to impact without layers of approval. OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DOCuriosity: We dig into why a campaign worked or didn't, why a buyer behaves the way they do, not just what to ship next. We seek to understand customers, products, markets, and results at a deeper level. Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to market, and we stay on a problem until it actually moves the number. Raising the bar: We don't settle for content or campaigns that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for quality, craft, and the experience our brand creates. Effectiveness: We focus on marketing that creates real pipeline and revenue impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship work that drives outcomes, not just output. Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through marketing that is as sharp as the product behind it.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Combining our tech-enabled model with underwriting capability has allowed us to lending at scale to meet India’s huge gap for credit, especially with underserved and under penetrated segments of the population. Business Unit: Financial and Valuation Advisory Industry: Transaction Advisory Services Vice President, Digital Value Creation Group Overview Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a global investment bank with expertise in mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Houlihan Lokey serves corporations, institutions, and governments worldwide with offices in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region. Independent advice and intellectual rigor are hallmarks of the firm s commitment to client success across its advisory services. The firm is the No. 1 investment bank for all global M&A transactions for the past two years, the No. 1 M&A advisor for the past 10 years in the U.S., the No. 1 global restructuring advisor for the past 11 years, and the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years, all based on number of transactions and according to data provided by LSEG. Financial and Valuation Advisory Over the past 40 years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise, leadership in the field of valuation, and objective approach to independent due diligence advice inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, retained counsel, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2020, Refinitiv (formerly known as Thomson Reuters) ranked us the No. 1 U.S. M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 20 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices. Transaction Advisory Services Houlihan Lokey s Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) practice assists private equity and corporate clients with financial, IT and tax due diligence, business analytics, and technical accounting matters associated with corporate mergers, divestitures, and acquisitions (M&A). Drawing on Houlihan Lokey s market leadership in middle-market M&A transactions, our due diligence experts provide candid, unbiased, and rigorous support on matters most impacting deal value, and assist investors in identifying and evaluating key value drivers and risk factors. TAS India TAS India covers Financial due diligence, Accounting and financial reporting and Digital value creation services. We have a highly integrated one-team working model where TAS India team members are fully embedded into an engagement lifecycle - from client pitch to client discussions through closure. They have similar exposure to project complexities and client situations as their counterparts in the global TAS teams, and work in similar ownership and accountability construct. With a strong industry orientation and innovation-focused environment, we offer a unique proposition comprising best-in-class functional, industry and technology competencies along with an exposure to global M&A markets. Job Description TAS is seeking talented professionals to join our fast-growing Digital Value Creation group (DVC) at the Vice President level. DVC provides our clients value-creating insights from vast market, operational, and financial data. DVC professionals work closely with HL due diligence, valuation and investment banking teams alongside clients deal and operating teams. As a professional in the group, you will be teamed with highly talented and dedicated M&A professionals in various industry groups including Industrials, Consumer, Technology, Business Services and Financial Services. This opportunity provides you broad exposure to different transactional issues affecting businesses in an M&A environment. This is a unique opportunity for someone with proficiency in data analytics along with experience in applying data analytics techniques to financial and operational analyses that is fundamental to an M&A process. DVC provides you ample exposure to the M&A and corporate finance industry and capital markets. You will further develop and extend your data analytics knowledge, and hone your interpersonal skills as you deliver valuable insights that derive transaction and strategic decision making for internal and external stakeholders. normalizedText: LocationHyderabad, Telangana Full job description Zuddl is the unified events platform that gives B2B marketing teams complete ownership of their brand, their data, and their pipeline impact — across conferences, field events, webinars, and trade shows. Instead of duct-taping point solutions together or waiting on agencies and web dev queues, teams at Figma, CrowdStrike. Iterable, and Grafana Labs use Zuddl to design pixel-perfect event experiences, launch programs in minutes, and prove revenue impact back to the business — all from one platform they actually control. What YOU WILL DO You own end-to-end demand creation across our multi-product platform, with one clear objective: 2–3× YoY revenue growth. Multi-Product Demand Engine - Design and execute demand strategies across Zuddl's modular platform (webinars, field events, conferences, third-party events). You'll build systems that drive both new customer acquisition and expansion across product lines. Team Leadership- Build and lead a high-caliber demand team with clear channel ownership and minimal handoffs. You'll hire for judgment and autonomy, using AI and automation to eliminate low-judgment work. Channel Portfolio Management - Own paid search, paid social, SEO, content, events/community, and emerging channels. You'll make explicit trade-offs based on marginal pipeline contribution, not historical momentum. BDR Function - Own the BDR outcome end-to-end in partnership with sales, including ICP definition, sequencing, AI-assisted outbound, and conversion mechanics. ABM & Orchestration - Design account-centric plays that coordinate events, digital channels, outreach, and content to collapse buyer indecision across the buying committee. Market Gravity Creation - Ideate and direct the creation of free tools, benchmarks, and interactive growth assets that generate authentic demand at scale. What We're Looking For Experience: 5–8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation, with demonstrated success building scalable demand engines Track record of managing both channels and teams in high-growth environments Experience with multi-product or platform marketing (not single-SKU SaaS) Proven ability to forecast and deliver pipeline commitments How You Think: Systems thinker who designs for compounding returns, not just campaign outcomes First principles approach to strategy; willing to challenge "best practices" Comfortable making trade-offs between competing priorities Data-informed but not paralyzed by analysis How You Operate: High agency: You translate business objectives into execution plans without needing detailed direction Bias to action: You ship and iterate rather than wait for perfect information Early problem surfacing: You flag risks and blockers before they become critical Comfortable with accountability: You're on the hook for numbers and own both wins and misses What Success Looks Like Predictable pipeline across segments that sales commits to and converts Channels managed by returns, with data-driven optimization and portfolio rebalancing Marketing is trusted to commit and deliver on pipeline and revenue forecasts Why You Want To Work Here Competitive compensation Employee Friendly ESOPs Remote working with an option to rent coworking spaces Flexible Leave Program Home Workstation Setup A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing series A startup

normalizedText: Role PurposeThe role of the Project Manager is to assist with and, where required, to co-ordinate planning & execution of transformation projects according to strict deadlines and within budget. This includes coordinating the efforts of team members and third-party contractors or consultants in order to deliver projects according to plan. The Project Manager will be able to work independently or with the Program Managers through the project initiation process, help to oversee quality control throughout the project’s life cycle and formal closure and review for each project.Key responsibilities include:Engage with stakeholders companywide to understand and advise on their objectives and problems. Support the delivery of benefits from transformational programs or projects, taking ownership from start to finish. Build and maintain effective communications with key stakeholders, cross functional leaders and project team members. Lead or support project activities, plans, and schedules associated with deliverables and milestones. Manage the project execution to deliver tangible deliverables within businesses and support functions. Support knowledge management efforts with clients and within the team. Work with the relevant business area in helping to identify other areas of transformation opportunity within the same project or business area. Utilize project management disciplines and where necessary provide input to improve the processes and documents within project management systems. Preferably have previous experience in one or more relevant areas [e.g., Operating Model Design, Process Design & Optimization, Change Management & Communications]. The CandidateThe successful candidate will combine the ability to lead multiple teams/workstreams with project management skills and prior experience delivering the benefits of transformational change.The candidate needs a demonstrable and highly commercial mind-set, strong financial acumen in addition to excellent listening and communication skills. A logical, structured approach to problem solving and common sense are key.ExperienceProfessional experience, ideally with a top-tier strategy consulting firm and/or with a firm with a well-established transformation agenda. Direct experience of major international business transformation projects. Excellent analytical and program management skills are essential. Commercially and financially astute, comfortable with company P&L and, ideally, also balance sheet. Diverse industry and functional backgrounds gained through consulting or elsewhere. Understanding of or exposure to global real estate markets preferred but not essential. Ability to effectively design, gain alignment and successfully execute significant transformation change initiatives from project start to finish. Change/Leadership SkillsLeadership Skills: exceptional communication skills coupled with excellent active listening skills. Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences. Establish and maintain strong relationships on all levels of organisation. Influencing and teamwork: Ability to influence others and move toward a common vision or goal. Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization. Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others. Project Management Skills: Knows how to effectively structure, staff and manage projects and teams to insure there is clarity of expectation, timely execution, corrective action when needed and successful outcomes. Analytical Skills: Has a structured approach to problem solving with a natural inclination for planning strategy and tactics. Drives to fix the ultimate root causes to drive sustainable change. Character with high perseverance and resourcefulness required to keep driving and finding ways to get the required steps done. Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations. Resilient and tenacious with a propensity to persevere. Forward looking with a holistic approach. job descriptionLeading at Cognizant This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors , leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values , role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture , creating a workplace where all can thrive. At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture. About the role As a Delivery Director (Head of GCC) , you will make an impact by leading large-scale BOTT, managed services, and transformation programs, enabling successful and expedited BOT/GCC setup and driving delivery excellence across complex enterprise engagements. You will be a valued member of the delivery leadership team and work collaboratively with business leaders, delivery teams, technology teams, functional stakeholders, and clients. In this role, you will: Lead large BOTT, managed services, and transformation programs, ensuring parallel execution across HR, infrastructure, security, real estate, risk and compliance, audits, hiring, transition, and transformation workstreams. Own delivery governance, PMO discipline, operating models, and transition frameworks to drive predictable outcomes across global, multi-shore delivery environments. Oversee application development, maintenance, IT operations, business operations, and business process transformation, including follow-the-sun delivery models. Drive automation, AI-enabled productivity transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery quality, efficiency, and business value. Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Program Managers, Engineering leaders, and Operations leaders while building accountable, high-performing teams with a strong ownership culture. Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen) What you need to have to be considered 25+ years of overall IT, digital delivery, or enterprise technology delivery experience. 8–10+ years of experience leading large, multi-million-dollar enterprise engagements with P&L ownership and strong financial acumen. Strong experience in BOTT, managed services, GCC/BOT setup, large transformation programs, delivery governance, PMO, and operating models. Proven experience in banking or other regulated industries, with the ability to manage risk, compliance, audit, security, and client governance requirements. Experience managing global, multi-shore delivery models across application development, maintenance, IT operations, and business operations. Executive stakeholder management experience, including structured, data-driven communication, crisis and escalation management, and influence without authority. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent qualification preferred. Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead : Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It These will help you succeed Experience driving automation, AI, and productivity transformation across delivery and operations environments. Strong transition and knowledge management experience across complex enterprise transformation programs. Ability to drive talent development, succession planning, attrition management, and a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement. Work model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring presence in a Cognizant office in Bangalore . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements.
