normalizedText: LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States. The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations. Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment. The Vice President, AI Solutions role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to lead the end-to-end design, development and delivery of AI-driven solutions that redefine how the firm operates and serves its clients. This Vice President will own discrete AI product workstreams, guide junior team members, report to the Director of AI Solutions and collaborate with senior stakeholders to bring scalable agentic AI platforms to life. This person will bridge technical depth and business acumen, translating complex consulting frameworks into production-ready AI workflows. If you are a technically strong leader who thrives in high-performance environments and wants to drive the future of AI in consulting, this is the right role for you. Responsibilities Lead the design, development and delivery of agentic AI solutions and automation workflows that encode Portage Point’s financial and operational advisory methodologies into scalable, reliable platforms Own end-to-end AI product workstreams from requirements gathering and prototyping through deployment, monitoring and iteration Apply AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) to drive rapid, high-quality development and establish engineering best practices for the AI Solutions team Collaborate with Practice Line Leaders, Delivery Enablement teams and domain experts to translate business requirements into AI-powered product features and workflows Manage and mentor junior team members, providing technical guidance, code reviews and professional development support Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools, LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks, recommending and implementing the most impactful technologies Define and enforce AI governance standards including prompt safety, data privacy, bias mitigation and responsible AI practices across all workstreams Drive measurable impact by tracking solution performance, adoption metrics and ROI, and iterating based on stakeholder feedback Lead internal knowledge sharing sessions, training and documentation efforts to scale AI capability across the firm Support business development efforts by contributing to AI-related proposals, client presentations and solution demonstrations Support talent acquisition and firm-building initiatives Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related technical field from a top undergraduate program; MBA or advanced degree preferred Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including US-based teams Five to nine years of progressive experience in AI/ML development, software engineering or a related technical discipline; management consulting or professional services experience is a plus Proven track record of building and delivering LLM-powered applications, agentic AI solutions and automation workflows at scale Expert-level proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and strong development skills in Python or JavaScript Deep experience with AI/ML frameworks, APIs and orchestration platforms including tools such as OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, N8N, Zapier or similar Strong understanding of data engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and modern software development practices Demonstrated ability to embed responsible AI principles, including bias detection, explainability and data privacy, into production AI systems Proven ability to manage and mentor junior team members and drive delivery across cross-functional teams Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset Track record of success in high-pressure environments Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jdEvidence.value: Lead large, complex enterprise transformation programmes across functions and countries, shaping strategy and driving delivery.

normalizedText: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead large, complex enterprise transformation programmes across functions and countries. You will shape strategy, drive delivery and work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. We value practical strategy, strong delivery skills, and the ability to influence with clarity and empathy. This role offers growth, meaningful impact, and the chance to help unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Lead design and delivery of enterprise transformation programmes across functions and India and global geographies. - Build and manage business cases, budgets, timelines, risks and benefit tracking to deliver measurable outcomes. - Engage and align senior sponsors and stakeholders; maintain governance and clear escalation routes. - Coach and lead a team of transformation professionals and support skill building across the organisation. - Apply digital, data and agile approaches to accelerate change and embed scalable solutions. - Turn ambiguous problems into clear plans and decisions, tracking value and adapting as needed. Why You? This role is based in India and is hybrid, with regular in-office collaboration and flexibility for remote work as agreed with your manager. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification. - 10 to 15 years’ experience leading large transformation programmes in industry or consulting. - Proven experience in programme delivery: planning, budgeting, risk and benefits tracking. - Strong experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams. - Practical knowledge of digital transformation, data and modern delivery approaches. - Clear communicator who can simplify complexity and influence without formal authority. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - MBA or advanced degree from a recognised institution. - Experience in life sciences, healthcare or regulated industries. - Track record of adopting AI, automation or advanced analytics at scale. - Experience building transformation capability and mentoring teams. - Formal training or certification in change management or programme management. - Comfortable working in global, matrixed organisations and across cultures. What we value in you We look for people who are collaborative, curious and resilient. We welcome candidates who bring empathy, openness and a learning mindset. You will act with integrity, create psychological safety for others and drive outcomes that matter. How to apply If you are excited by the chance to lead meaningful, enterprise-wide change, we want to hear from you. Please apply and tell us how your experience matches this role and how you would contribute to our transformation goals. Position Summary You will lead large, complex enterprise transformation programmes across functions and countries. You will shape strategy, drive delivery and work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. We value practical strategy, strong delivery skills, and the ability to influence with clarity and empathy. This role offers growth, meaningful impact, and the chance to help unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Lead design and delivery of enterprise transformation programmes across functions and India and global geographies. - Build and manage business cases, budgets, timelines, risks and benefit tracking to deliver measurable outcomes. - Engage and align senior sponsors and stakeholders; maintain governance and clear escalation routes. - Coach and lead a team of transformation professionals and support skill building across the organisation. - Apply digital, data and agile approaches to accelerate change and embed scalable solutions. - Turn ambiguous problems into clear plans and decisions, tracking value and adapting as needed. Why You? This role is based in India and is hybrid, with regular in-office collaboration and flexibility for remote work as agreed with your manager. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification. - 10 to 15 years’ experience leading large transformation programmes in industry or consulting. - Proven experience in programme delivery: planning, budgeting, risk and benefits tracking. - Strong experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams. - Practical knowledge of digital transformation, data and modern delivery approaches. - Clear communicator who can simplify complexity and influence without formal authority. What we value in you We look for people who are collaborative, curious and resilient. We welcome candidates who bring empathy, openness and a learning mindset. Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Women Empowerment & Education Location: Mulund, MumbaiTravel: Pan-India travel requiredSector Preference: Development / NGO sector experience preferred About the Role We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and mission-driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead the operational strategy and execution of our Women Empowerment & Education vertical. The COO will be responsible for driving organizational growth, ensuring effective program implementation, managing financial performance, and building sustainable systems that create measurable social impact. This role requires a dynamic leader who can balance program excellence with financial discipline, including managing Profit & Loss (P&L), while scaling women empowerment and education initiatives across India. Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Leadership Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the organization's mission of empowering women through education, skill development, livelihood generation, and social inclusion. Collaborate with the leadership team to expand programs, partnerships, and nationwide impact. Identify opportunities for innovation, growth, and operational excellence. Operational Management Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Women Empowerment & Education vertical. Ensure seamless execution of education, vocational training, entrepreneurship, community development, and capacity-building programs. Design and implement SOPs, operational frameworks, and scalable systems to improve efficiency and impact. Financial Management Manage the Profit & Loss (P&L) of the vertical, ensuring financial sustainability and effective resource utilization. Lead budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and performance monitoring. Strengthen revenue streams through grants, CSR partnerships, institutional funding, and strategic collaborations. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage cross-functional teams across multiple locations. Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and mission-driven work culture. Develop leadership capabilities and strengthen team engagement. Partnerships & Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, educational institutions, NGOs, CSR partners, donors, foundations, and corporate stakeholders. Represent the organization at national forums, conferences, and key stakeholder meetings. Drive collaborations that enhance program reach and sustainability. Compliance & Governance Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, NGO governance standards, and funding requirements. Establish transparent reporting mechanisms and impact measurement frameworks to track program effectiveness and organizational performance. Candidate Profile Experience: 10–20 years in leadership roles, preferably within NGOs, development organizations, social enterprises, educational institutions, or mission-driven organizations. Proven experience in managing Profit & Loss (P&L) for a business unit, program, or vertical. Strong expertise in operations management, financial planning, strategic execution, and organizational development. Demonstrated experience in scaling programs across multiple locations. Prior experience in women empowerment, education, skill development, livelihood initiatives, or community development will be a strong advantage. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and strategic thinking abilities. Education Master's degree in Management, Public Policy, Social Work, Development Studies, Education, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. normalizedText: Leading at CognizantThis is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values, role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.About The RoleAs a Director - Marketing & Communications, you will make an impact by shaping and amplifying the market narrative for Cognizant’s Intuitive Operations and Automation (IOA) practice across marketing, executive communications, and people communications. You will be a valued member of the IOA team and work collaboratively with IOA business leaders, global corporate marketing and communications teams, sales, solutioning, delivery, client-facing teams, analysts, agencies, and regional stakeholders.In This Role, You WillDefine and own the end-to-end IOA messaging and positioning strategy, including differentiated AI, automation, and agentic AI narratives for clients, analysts, employees, and internal stakeholders.Drive an always-on, multi-channel marketing presence across the IOA website, social media, practice decks, campaigns, events, digital platforms, and sales enablement assets.Build a robust case study and proof-point library by partnering with delivery teams, client partners, and service line specialists to translate client impact into compelling market-facing stories.Partner with sales and solutioning teams on strategic pursuits by developing bespoke narratives, tailored presentations, credentials decks, competitive experiences.Work modelWe believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. normalizedText: Job Title: Assistant Finance Manager - GCAD Group Balance Sheet Reporting Location: Bangalore About Unilever Be part of the world s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas, and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life - giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future. Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we ll work to help you become a better you. About Bangalore Hub Unilever Bangalore Hub is the global technology and operations engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. It serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end-to-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit. About the Role The Group Chief Accountant s Department (GCAD) is part of Unilever s Controller s organization and is responsible for external financial reporting, global financial controls (including Sarbanes-Oxley compliance), management of the Group audit relationship, and the development and implementation of Unilever s accounting policies. GCAD also plays a key role in a range of strategic initiatives that support how Unilever measures, reports, and communicates its financial performance to external stakeholders. The Assistant Finance Manager - Group Balance Sheet Reporting reports to the Senior Finance Manager - Global Group Accounting and is responsible for supporting the preparation and review of Unilever s Balance Sheet. The role involves analysing Balance sheet and major movements across balance sheet items, supporting external reporting and control activities, partnering with markets and key stakeholders to resolve reporting queries, and driving continuous improvements in Balance sheet reporting processes, governance, and automation. This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in Group reporting, technical accounting, and financial controls while working with stakeholders across Treasury, Investor Relations, Business Finance, and external auditors. Responsibilities - Support the preparation and review of the Group Balance sheet, ensuring accurate and timely reporting in line with applicable IFRS and Group reporting requirements. - Analyse Balance sheet items and key variances, providing clear insights for decision-making. - Act as a key contact for markets and operating centres on balance Sheet reporting matters, resolving accounting and reporting queries and providing practical guidance. - Support the preparation of balance sheet disclosures, commentary, and supporting schedules for quarterly results, press releases, and the Annual Report Accounts. - Perform and document key reporting controls, ensuring compliance with SOX, Group control requirements, and external reporting standards. - Support internal and external audits by coordinating responses to audit queries and maintaining robust documentation for Balance Sheet reporting processes. - Assist in delivering training and guidance to stakeholders on Balance sheet reporting requirements, working capital reporting, and accounting policies. - Contribute to the implementation of new reporting requirements, system enhancements, and reporting process improvements across the Group. - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, data quality, reporting efficiency, and standardization. - Work closely with Reporting and accounting manager - Consolidation on preparation and review of Statement of changes in Equity (SOCIE) schedules and perform associated controls. - Participate in GCAD projects and transformation initiatives, supporting the delivery of strategic and operational objectives. - Support on ad hoc financial analysis and queries. Please Note All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Offers from individuals or unofficial sources may be fraudulent-please verify before proceeding Disclaimer: This job description has been sourced from a public domain and may have been modified by Naukri.com to improve clarity for our users. We encourage job seekers to verify all details directly with the employer via their official channels before applying.

normalizedText: LocationRemote Full job description About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.Our people With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.Our impact Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts Why This Role Exists The Sr. Director, Product Management (Platform & Core Products) will lead the foundational layer of HighLevel's product stack, spanning infrastructure platforms, automation capabilities, CRM primitives, and shared systems like identity, permissions, notifications, and audit logging. This is a critical org-wide leadership role, owning HighLevel’s platform extensibility, data model reliability, cross-surface consistency, and internal product development velocity. You will manage a team of 25–30 PMs via 3 Group Product Managers and drive strategy, execution, and org design for a portfolio that underpins everything from marketing automation and conversation management to AI-driven workflows and CRM object modeling. You’ll be expected to scale a high-performance product org, influence product direction across pods, and partner closely with engineering to deliver a scalable, secure, and elegant platform for millions of users. Strategic Priorities Build an Extensible Platform: Architect reusable primitives (identity, roles, objects, notifications, reporting) that enable faster development across HighLevel. Modernize Core CRM: Scale performance and usability across contacts, companies, tasks, opportunities, and conversations — the backbone of daily SMB workflows. Unlock Scalable Automation: Advance our workflows engine and Workflow AI to power increasingly complex use cases with speed and simplicity. Drive UX Consistency Across Surfaces: Ensure UI, interaction patterns, and product language are coherent across contact, sub-account, and agency layers. Support Data-Driven Product Maturity: Enforce strong instrumentation, analytics readiness, and reporting across all core products. Operationalize Product Management Excellence: Raise the bar for product planning, prioritization, execution, and accountability across 30+ PMs and APMs. Key Responsibilities Define and drive the long term product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for platform and core product areas. Manage and coach a team ofGroup PMs and PMs,.cultivating a strong leadership bench and ensuring high performance. Serve as the bridge between platform engineering, infra, and product — enabling other teams to move faster through well-designed interfaces and reusable systems. Set quality standards for API design, system performance, scalability, and reliability. Lead cross-functional coordination with design, engineering, QA, support, data, and legal to deliver on-time, high-quality launches. Represent the needs of agencies, sub-accounts, and end contacts in platform and CRM decisions — ensuring we build with deep user empathy. Collaborate with the Product leadership to influence org-wide product strategy, culture, and planning cadences. Lead strategic quarterly and annual planning for the org — bringing clarity to priorities across technical debt, product innovation, and user experience. Act as a thought partner to engineering leadership in shaping architecture and development investment decisions. What Success Looks Like HighLevel’s platform teams are recognised as enablers, not blockers — other pods build faster using your team's APIs, patterns, and systems. CRM primitives and workflows become more reliable, performant, and deeply adopted by our users — visible in activation and retention metrics. The organization experiences clean product ownership, predictable roadmaps, and fast decision-making under your leadership. Workflow AI and Workflow Core support a growing number of use cases without sacrificing speed, reliability, or clarity. The data model becomes flexible and extensible, enabling custom objects, relationships, and analytics without friction. You are viewed as a strategic thought partners and executional anchor for platform and core products at HighLevel Ideal Candidate Profile 12–15+ years in product management, with at least 5+ years managing managers (GPMs,Directors or equivalents). Experience scaling platform and core product orgs in fast-growth B2B SaaS companies, (ideally between $500M-$1B ARR). Deep fluency in CRM, automation platforms, or workflow engines — understands data models, APIs, and system-level product thinking. Prior experience building internal platforms or developer tools that support multiple product teams. Ability to scale orgs, implement processes, and hire/coach high-performing PMs. Technical fluency — capable of earning trust with engineering leads and making calls on infra trade-offs, architecture, and scalability. Familiar with two-tier SaaS, multi-tenant environments, and role-based access control models. Strong written and asynchronous communication skills — capable of driving clarity across functions and time zones. Bonus Points For Experience working on workflow builders, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools. Background in B2B2SMB or agency-led SaaS models. Exposure to design systems, shared component libraries, or analytics platforms. Hands-on familiarity with platform performance metrics (e.g., P95 latency, Sentry, Grafana). Experience integrating with third-party platforms like Stripe, Meta, Google, or TikTok (even if not leading monetization). Equal Employment Opportunity Information The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision. We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application #LI-Remote #LI-MP1 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. normalizedText: About ENILEntertainment Network India Limited (ENIL) is one of India’s leading media and entertainment companies, with strong brands across radio, audio, digital, content, live experiences, influencer marketing, branded solutions and music streaming. With Mirchi and Gaana, ENIL is now transforming from a traditional media business into a multi-format, digital-first, data-led entertainment company.We are looking for a high-calibre strategy professional to work closely with the leadership team on some of the most important transformation priorities for the organisation.This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous business problems, working with CXOs, building new initiatives, using data to drive decisions and shaping the future of a listed media company.Role SummaryThe Strategy & CEO Office role will work closely with the CXOs and business leaders across ENIL, Mirchi and Gaana to drive strategic initiatives, business transformation projects, AI-led efficiency programs, data and MIS improvements, board reporting, M&A evaluation and strategic analysis.This is not a narrow planning role. It is a business-building role.The person will be expected to identify opportunities, structure problems, build business cases, work across functions, drive execution and create measurable business impact. The role will evolve based on the person’s capability, ownership and ambition.Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Initiatives & Business TransformationWork closely with CXOs and business heads on priority projects across Mirchi, Gaana, digital solutions, events/IPs, influencer marketing, branded content and new growth areas.2. CEO Office / CXO SupportAct as a thought partner to senior leadership on key business questions, strategic choices and operating priorities.3. Data, MIS & Decision SystemsImprove business dashboards, MIS systems and operating reviews to enable sharper decision-making.4. AI-Led TransformationDesign and lead projects to integrate AI into day-to-day working across content, sales, marketing, operations, analytics, support functions and internal workflows.5. Strategic Analysis & Business PlanningLead market scans, competitor benchmarking, business case development, pricing analysis, revenue modelling and scenario planning.6. M&A, Partnerships & New OpportunitiesSupport evaluation of potential acquisitions, investments, partnerships and strategic alliances.7. Stakeholder ManagementIdeal Candidate ProfileWe are looking for someone with around 7–10 years of experience in strategy, consulting, corporate strategy, CEO office, business transformation or digital business roles.The person should ideally have experience in one or more of the following:Media and entertainmentOTT / audio / music / digital contentConsumer internet / digital subscription businessesAdvertising, creator economy or branded contentManagement consultingCorporate strategy in a fast-moving consumer or digital businessRequired SkillsStrong problem-solving and structured thinkingAbility to work with ambiguity and create clarityStrong business and financial understandingExcellent presentation and communication skillsComfort with data, dashboards, MIS and business metricsAbility to build business cases and financial modelsStrong stakeholder managementHigh ownership and execution orientationInterest in AI, digital transformation and media-tech trendsAbility to work directly with senior leadershipPreferred BackgroundMBA from a reputed institution preferred, but not mandatory if the candidate has strong relevant experience.Prior experience in consulting, corporate strategy, digital media, OTT, consumer internet, subscription businesses or media-tech will be preferred.Experience in board presentations, leadership reviews, investor-facing material, AOP planning or transformation projects will be an advantage. An 11-time winner of the coveted Microsoft Dynamics Partner of the Year Award, sa.global is also a part of Microsoft’s elite Inner Circle. Established in 1990, we are now a 1000+ member strong global organization with a presence in 25 countries.For more information about sa.global, please click www.saglobal.com.Why choose sa.global Open, flexible, vibrant, collaborative, and diverse – these are just some of the terms that our employees use to describe the culture at sa.global. Our culture and values give us the extra edge to help us scale greater heights.Led by our Core Values: Agile, Capable, and Committed, which form an integral part of who we are, we constantly strive to provide an inclusive work environment. If it’s working in a collaborative environment that encourages and supports growth and change – keep reading.Who are we looking for? We are looking for someone to develop marketing plans and strategies to deliver measurable results. The key ownership area of this role it to ensure marketing campaigns achieve their objectives. Forecast marketing campaign growth and ROI for marketing campaigns Work within a budget and report any overspend. Vice President, Global Growth and Marketing The Opportunity This is an executive business leadership role. We are looking for a Vice President, Global Growth and Marketing to architect one of Manifest Global's core operating systems — the commercial growth engine that connects strategy, product, brand, sales, customer success, partnerships, AI, and marketing into one integrated capability that accelerates the performance of the entire organisation. Working closely with the CEO, COO, and Business Leaders, you will help determine where we grow, how we compete, where we invest, how our portfolio evolves, and how Growth and Marketing create measurable enterprise value. You will inherit strong brands, talented people, and significant market opportunity, but you will not inherit a finished global organisation. Your first year will be about building from zero to one. You will design the operating system, establish common standards, build shared capabilities, create commercial discipline, embed AI into everyday execution, and earn organisational trust by demonstrating measurable business impact. We are looking for a builder who enjoys creating clarity where none exists, designing systems before optimising them, and laying foundations that will scale globally over the coming decade. Your Executive Mandate As a member of the executive leadership team, your responsibility extends far beyond leading the marketing function. You will help shape company strategy, portfolio strategy, commercial priorities, market expansion, product direction, investment decisions, annual planning, organisational design, AI transformation, strategic partnerships, and the integration of future acquisitions where appropriate. Growth and Marketing will not simply support these conversations — they will actively shape them. Your mandate is to build a single global Growth and Marketing operating system that creates leverage across every company within the Manifest portfolio while preserving the strengths and identities of each individual business. You will create alignment in strategy, planning, execution, governance, measurement, operating rhythms, and resource allocation so that every team benefits from shared capabilities while remaining deeply connected to its customers and markets. You will build one commercial growth engine where brand, product marketing, demand generation, content, events, partnerships, customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, and sales enablement function as one integrated system. Growth and Marketing should influence every stage of the customer journey, from shaping market perception and generating demand to increasing customer lifetime value and strengthening long-term customer relationships. You will continuously evolve how the various brands at Manifest Global work together as an ecosystem. You will identify opportunities for shared positioning, ecosystem storytelling, cross-selling, portfolio leverage, and common capabilities that enable every business to become stronger because it belongs to Manifest. You will establish one global brand architecture while simultaneously building sophisticated commercial intelligence capabilities that allow Growth and Marketing to understand business performance with the same rigour that Finance understands financial performance. Attribution, forecasting, experimentation, customer insight, investment analysis, and performance measurement should become strategic capabilities that influence executive decision-making across the company. You will also lead the transformation of our organisation into one of the world's most AI-enabled commercial functions, embedding AI across research, customer intelligence, creative development, content production, campaign execution, localisation, analytics, reporting, workflow automation, and operational excellence. Technology should multiply the capability of exceptional people, allowing the organisation to operate with greater speed, quality, and strategic focus. Above all, you will build a world-class organisation. You will develop exceptional leaders, create clarity and accountability, raise standards relentlessly, simplify complexity, and establish an environment where ambitious marketers and growth leaders come to do the best work of their careers. Commercial Accountability Growth and Marketing exist to create enterprise value. Success will not be measured by campaigns, impressions, or activity alone, but by meaningful contribution to profitable revenue growth, customer acquisition, customer expansion, retention, market leadership, brand equity, commercial efficiency, marketing return on investment, EBITDA, and long-term enterprise value. Every investment should have a clear commercial rationale, every initiative should strengthen our competitive position, and every member of the organisation should understand how their work contributes directly to the success of the business. What Success Looks Like In the first 12 months Within your first year, you will have built the foundations of a truly global Growth and Marketing organisation from the ground up. You will have designed and implemented a common operating system across the Manifest portfolio, established shared ways of working, introduced commercial measurement frameworks, embedded AI into everyday execution, and built trusted partnerships with every Business Leader. You will have transformed a collection of capable marketing teams into one aligned global leadership organisation with shared goals, shared standards, and shared accountability. Sales, Product, Customer Success, and every Business Leader will recognise Growth and Marketing as a strategic commercial partner rather than a support function, and executive decisions will increasingly be informed by customer insight, commercial intelligence, and marketing performance. Most importantly, you will have demonstrated that Growth and Marketing directly influence revenue, profitability, and enterprise value — earning credibility not through presentations or strategy documents but through execution and measurable business outcomes. Over time Growth and Marketing become one of Manifest Global's defining competitive advantages. The organisation consistently drives profitable growth across every business. Our brands become recognised globally as the most trusted ecosystem in international education. Our shared capabilities create meaningful leverage across the portfolio. Our commercial decisions become increasingly informed by customer insight, market intelligence, and sophisticated performance measurement. Growth and Marketing earn their place alongside Product, Finance, and Operations as one of the company's primary strategic functions — attracting exceptional talent and becoming a benchmark for excellence within the global education sector. Who You Are You are a business leader first and a growth builder second. You understand that Growth and Marketing exist to create enterprise value, not simply campaigns. You naturally think in systems rather than functions, enjoy solving business problems as much as marketing challenges, and combine creativity with commercial discipline. You are equally comfortable thinking like an executive and operating like a builder. You can define long-term strategy in the morning, review a campaign, challenge a positioning statement, redesign an operating cadence, or coach a team in the afternoon, and finish the day discussing commercial performance with the executive team. You are not precious about hierarchy or titles because you understand that exceptional organisations are built by leaders who are willing to fly high when strategic thinking is required and fly low when execution demands it. You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building from zero to one, raise standards without creating bureaucracy, earn trust through execution, and build organisations that continue creating value long after individual initiatives are complete. Your Experience We are interested in the scale of the problems you have solved. You have likely built and led global marketing or growth organisations within high-growth technology, SaaS, platform, marketplace, or multi-brand businesses, partnered closely with COOs, Boards, and executive leadership teams on company strategy, and built commercial growth engines that have materially influenced revenue, profitability, and enterprise value. You have successfully led functions spanning brand, product marketing, communications, demand generation, content, marketing operations, and commercial enablement while developing exceptional leaders capable of scaling alongside the business. Most importantly, you have built organisations before. You know what it takes to move from zero to one, and you enjoy building as much as operating. Manifest is one of the few organisations that serves both institutions and individuals at scale. Success in this role requires an equal appreciation for enterprise sales cycles and consumer behaviour. You should be as comfortable building trust with a university Vice Chancellor as you are understanding what inspires a student to choose a destination, what reassures a parent making a life-changing investment, and how consumer brands earn attention, trust, and advocacy over time. You have built at least one global brand. You have led both B2B and B2C marketing. You know enterprise sales and consumer psychology. You have built functions from zero to one and transformed organisations along the way. You have managed multi-country teams, have marketplace or ecosystem experience, understand AI deeply, and are commercially obsessive. You can partner with a COO. You love execution. Why Join Manifest Global Manifest Global stands at an inflection point. The brands are established. The products are proven. The markets are global. The opportunity is no longer to build another successful marketing department — it is to build one of the defining commercial growth organisations in global education. If you are excited by creating something that does not yet exist, if you enjoy building as much as leading, if you are equally energised by shaping strategy and executing the details, and if you want your work to influence the trajectory of an entire global education ecosystem, we would love to meet you. Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50+ countries with $80M raised from Tiger Global, SIG, and Square Peg.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description About the Role FinAgra is an agri-fintech company transforming commercial farming in India through its Rural Entrepreneur Partner (REP) model using strategic capital deployment, technical expertise, and operational excellence to maximise productivity, profitability, and environmental sustainability. We aim at building resilient, scalable agricultural enterprises that deliver attractive returns while creating long-term value across the agricultural value chain. The Growth & Partnerships Lead is responsible for owning revenue growth, market positioning, and sustainable buyer partnerships across local, regional, and export markets. The role integrates commercial growth strategy, REP Expansion strategy, core partnership development, downstream coordination, and performance oversight to ensure predictable demand, optimized supply alignment, and long-term market competitiveness. Reports to Global Head of Supply Chain (functional) and to Country Manager (operational) Core Responsibilities Strategic growth & market development Growth strategy: design and execute growth strategies across priority crop value chains, anchored on the REP production model and prioritize and penetrate the highest-value buyers. Market intelligence: track pricing and buyer demand to inform commercial decisions and the crop decision gate. New market access: open new channels such as trade platforms, regional distribution hubs, strategic partnerships to diversify the pipeline and cut concentration risk. Buyer acquisition, offtake & negotiation Buyer acquisition: target and engage processors, feed manufacturers, aggregators, cooperatives, and exporters. Contract negotiation & management: lead negotiations for off-take agreements, ensuring favorable terms on pricing, quality standards, delivery schedules, payment conditions and risk allocation. Maintain the documented contracts and ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms. Relationship management: run a structured cadence with key buyers with regular check-ins, quarterly reviews, joint planning where possible. Enabling partnerships & stakeholder alliances Enabling partnerships: originate and manage key partnerships that support the delivery of all offtake commitments at scale. Stakeholder alliances: build alliances with industry associations, regulators, service providers, and government agencies to enhance credibility, unlock opportunities and strengthen FinAgra’s standing. Partner network: support identification and due diligence of REP partners, onboarding, network expansion, and manage overall partner relationships. Brand representation: represent FinAgra at trade fairs, exhibitions, and industry forums to strengthen brand visibility and commercial positioning. Demand–supply alignment & downstream execution Forecast alignment: work with Agronomy, Procurement, and Operations to match demand forecasts to production capacity and forward-contracts against forecast harvests. Downstream execution: convert signed offtakes into orders, delivery, and quality compliance, through to invoicing, reconciliation, and settlement. Quality compliance: confirm that all shipments meet buyer specifications and regulatory standards prior to dispatch. Risk mitigation: develop contingency strategies to manage supply chain disruptions, market volatility, and logistical constraints. Performance, systems & insight Growth KPIs: buyer acquisition and retention, contracted volume and revenue. Operational KPIs: delivery performance, efficiency, and partner-network growth. Reporting: deliver quarterly performance and market-intelligence reports to leadership. Continuous improvement: recommend commercial and operational improvements from performance data and market feedback. Key Deliverables Signed offtake and strategic partnership agreements across priority crops and markets. Buyer-engagement tracker and offtake pipeline. Quarterly growth and market-intelligence reports. Success Measures Signed offtake agreements across priority crops, with contracted volume coverage tracked against forecast harvest. Growth in contracted revenue and a more diversified buyer base. Enabling partnerships in place to deliver contracted volumes at scale. Downstream execution discipline — on-time, on-spec delivery with clean invoicing and settlement. What We Offer Leadership ownership of FinAgra’s commercial growth and partnerships in India. Direct reporting line to the Country Director and Global Supply Chain Lead — real authority, central to growth and market strategy. Opportunity to shape and execute market entry, buyer engagement, and partnership development in a critically important sector. Competitive compensation and benefits.

normalizedText: Hungry, Humble, Honest, with HeartThe OpportunityAs the Director of India Marketing at Nutanix, you will be the architect and chief execution for one of our most dynamic markets. This is a high-impact, role where you will lead a talented local team and work in lockstep with India Sales leadership to accelerate pipeline and revenue growth.Operating at the intersection of high-level strategy and relentless execution, you will champion the Nutanix narrative across India. You will optimize a modern marketing mix—spanning enterprise ABX, digital demand gen, high-touch executive events, a powerful partner ecosystem —to directly fuel our local expansion in the hybrid multicloud and cloud native and AI markets.About The TeamAs a vital part of Nutanix’s Global Demand Center, you will lead a skilled, diverse, and high-energy team focused on scaling demand initiatives across India and driving Pipeline. We foster a collaborative, fast-paced culture where bold ideas are encouraged, calculated risks are rewarded, and success is shared. We are deeply passionate about leveraging the latest in marketing technology and data analytics to deliver measurable business outcomes.Your Role (What You’ll Do)Drive Strategy, Own Execution: Architect the comprehensive annual and quarterly marketing plans for India, utilizing a data-driven approach. Turn that strategy into flawless execution, taking personal ownership of pipeline impact and ROI. Lead & Empower: Mentor, manage, and inspire the marketing team. Foster an environment of continuous learning, execution excellence, and accountability. Sales & Ecosystem Alignment: Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the India Sales Leadership team. Co-develop quarterly pipeline acceleration plans and maximize marketing ROI alongside top channel and alliance partners. Deploy Modern ABX & Demand Gen: Design and execute localized, multi-channel demand generation and ABX programs tailored to India’s top enterprises, banks, and public sector organizations. Architect Executive Experiences: Oversee and actively participate in high-touch regional events, CXO roundtables, user groups, and major industry trade shows, acting as a visible brand ambassador for Nutanix. Localise the Narrative: Translate global campaign frameworks into highly relevant, localised stories that resonate with the specific pain points, compliance landscapes, and spending profiles of Indian CXO’s. Amplify Brand Voice: Partner with APJ and Corporate communications teams to steer local PR/AR activities, positioning Nutanix as the undisputed thought leader in hybrid multicloud. Funnel Optimization: Continuously analyse the end-to-end sales funnel, measure ROI across all marketing investments, and optimize programs to close gaps and accelerate velocity. Capture Customer Success: Identify, nurture, and develop compelling public references and case studies featuring India’s leading enterprises. What You Will Bring15+ Years of B2B Tech Marketing Experience: A proven track record of leadership in high-growth, enterprise B2B technology companies (SaaS, Cloud, or Datacenter Infrastructure). The "Owner" Mindset: You possess an "own-the-business" mentality. You are a seasoned strategic thinker who is equally thrilled to roll up your sleeves, write content, review event details, and jump into execution alongside your team. GSI & Partner Marketing Mastery: Demonstrated experience co-marketing with global system integrators, distributors, and regional partners to scale market reach. Storyteller: Exceptional communication skills with the unique ability to turn complex architectural technology into highly engaging, problem-solving narratives. Data & MarTech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern marketing technology stacks, specifically Salesforce.com and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo), with an obsession for clean data and funnel metrics. Agility & Resilience: The ability to thrive, prioritize, and maintain composure in a fast-paced, high-velocity matrix environment. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Work ArrangementHybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. normalizedText: Location: Remote (India) Travel: 5–10% (Customer meetings, conferences, and partner events) Employment Type: Full-time About Vikara Vikara is an AI implementation and advisory firm that helps organizations turn AI into measurable business outcomes. We partner with companies to identify where AI can create the greatest impact, design practical AI strategies, and implement production-ready AI solutions that improve revenue, customer experience, productivity, and operational efficiency. Our expertise spans AI strategy, agentic AI, voice AI, AI-powered automation, enterprise AI adoption, and custom AI applications across industries including healthcare, life sciences, retail, manufacturing, financial services, and professional services. We’re building a global business and are looking for a highly entrepreneurial GTM leader to help us acquire customers across the US, Europe, and APAC. About the Role This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for a builder—someone who enjoys creating opportunities, opening doors, developing relationships, and closing business in fast-moving markets. As our Founding GTM Lead, you’ll work directly with the founder to build Vikara’s global customer acquisition engine. Your primary focus will be acquiring small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs), while supporting selective enterprise opportunities. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys wearing multiple hats and wants to play a meaningful role in shaping the growth of an AI-first company. What You’ll Do Own New Customer Acquisition Drive the complete sales process from prospecting through closing. Identify and engage prospective customers across the US, Europe, and APAC Conduct discovery conversations with founders, executives, and business leaders Understand customer challenges and position Vikara’s AI advisory and implementation services Prepare proposals and commercial agreements Negotiate and close new business Maintain a healthy and predictable sales pipeline Build a Repeatable Outbound Engine Design and execute outbound growth programs using modern sales techniques and AI-powered tools. Channels include: LinkedIn Personalized email campaigns AI-assisted prospecting Founder-led outreach Referrals Virtual events and webinars Industry communities Strategic networking Continuously refine messaging, targeting, and conversion rates. Develop Strategic Partnerships Build relationships with organizations that can create long-term growth opportunities. Examples include: Technology partners AI platform companies Cloud providers Industry associations Startup ecosystems Venture Capital and Private Equity firms Regional consulting partners Help Shape Our Go-to-Market Strategy Work closely with the founder to continuously improve: Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) Industry focus Service packaging Pricing strategy Messaging Sales playbooks Customer acquisition strategy Represent Vikara Help build Vikara’s reputation by participating in: Industry conferences Customer meetings Executive roundtables Webinars Community events Travel will typically be limited to 5–10%. Who You Are You enjoy creating opportunities from scratch. You don’t wait for leads—you create them. You are naturally curious, commercially driven, and excited about how AI is transforming businesses. You thrive in fast-moving environments where initiative matters more than hierarchy. What We’re Looking For Required 5–10 years of experience in Business Development, Enterprise Sales, Partnerships, or Go-to-Market roles Proven experience selling technology, SaaS, consulting, cloud, or AI solutions Experience selling into US and/or international markets Excellent written and verbal English communication skills Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills Comfortable engaging founders, CXOs, and senior business leaders Experience managing a CRM and sales pipeline Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely Preferred Experience in one or more of the following: Artificial Intelligence Data & Analytics Cloud Technologies Digital Transformation Enterprise Software Management Consulting Regulated Industry Experience selling into SMBs is highly preferred. An existing network within technology companies, startups, consulting firms, or industry ecosystems is a strong advantage. Experience using modern GTM tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Clay, or AI-powered sales tools is a plus. Success in This Role Within 90 Days Develop a strong understanding of Vikara’s offerings Build target account lists across priority markets Launch outbound campaigns Generate qualified meetings Build an active sales pipeline Within 6 Months Close initial customers Establish repeatable outbound processes Develop strategic referral partnerships Consistently generate qualified opportunities Within 12 Months Become a key driver of Vikara’s global revenue growth Build a predictable international pipeline Help establish Vikara as a trusted AI advisory partner across key markets Why Join Vikara? Build the GTM function from the ground up Work directly with the founder and leadership team Sell cutting-edge AI solutions with real business impact Engage with customers across the US, Europe, and APAC Shape the future of an ambitious, fast-growing AI company Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives Significant opportunity for career growth as the company scales If This Sounds Like You… If you’re excited about helping businesses unlock the value of AI, enjoy building relationships across global markets, and want to be part of creating something meaningful from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your resume and a brief note describing a business opportunity you’ve personally created and closed through proactive outreach. Hiring Manager’s NoteWe’re not looking for someone who simply manages an existing pipeline. We’re looking for someone who loves creating one. If you’re energized by opening new markets, building trusted relationships, and helping customers solve real business problems with AI, you’ll thrive at Vikara. Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹3,000,000.00 per year Benefits: Flexible schedule Work from home Work Location: Remote

normalizedText: Position Overview:P. N. Gadgil & Sons Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and strategic Head Marketing to spearhead the organization's marketing initiatives, strengthen brand presence, and accelerate business growth. The role is responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing strategies across traditional and digital platforms to enhance brand visibility, increase showroom footfalls, drive customer acquisition, and maximize revenue across all retail locations.Key Roles & Responsibilities:Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans. Lead integrated ATL, BTL, Digital, Social Media, Influencer, and Seasonal/Festive marketing campaigns. Design innovative promotional activities and localized marketing initiatives to enhance showroom footfalls and customer engagement. Drive brand positioning through effective advertising, public relations, corporate communications, and media planning. Oversee digital marketing functions including SEO, SEM, website management, email marketing, social media, online reputation management, and performance marketing. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer behavior studies to identify emerging trends and business opportunities. Plan and execute new jewellery collection launches, exhibitions, promotional events, and brand activations. Develop annual marketing budgets, monitor expenditures, and optimize campaign ROI. Collaborate closely with Sales, Merchandising, CRM, Operations, E-commerce, and Retail teams to ensure seamless campaign execution. Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising agencies, media houses, digital partners, influencers, and external vendors. Track campaign effectiveness through analytics, prepare MIS reports, and provide data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing marketing team while fostering innovation and accountability. Desired Candidate ProfileMBA in Marketing or an equivalent postgraduate qualification. 1015+ years of progressive experience in Marketing, preferably within Jewellery, Luxury Retail, Fashion, Lifestyle, or Consumer Brands. Demonstrated expertise in brand management, retail marketing, digital marketing, campaign planning, and customer engagement. Strong leadership, strategic thinking, communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, Google Analytics, Meta Ads, and other digital marketing technologies. Ability to manage multiple projects, budgets, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

normalizedText: LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description About Payoneer Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. Role summary - Payoneer is looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead paid acquisition across multiple regions and markets. Based in the Bangalore, this person will work closely with regional marketing, sales, web, analytics, product marketing, lifecycle, and external partners to drive high-quality acquisition and measurable revenue growth. This is a hands-on strategic role for someone who understands how to manage paid campaigns at scale, but also knows how to connect media performance to business outcomes. The right candidate should be comfortable going deep into campaign data, reading funnel performance, identifying where spend is working or not working, and clearly articulating the impact on CAC, ROAS, registrations, approvals, FFT, and revenue. We are looking for someone with strong performance marketing experience across both agency and client-side environments, preferably within fintech, banking, payments, SaaS, or another performance-led business. What you'll do Paid Acquisition Strategy & Execution Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of paid acquisition campaigns across global and regional markets. Manage campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, programmatic/display, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and relevant local channels. Build market-level campaign strategies aligned to business goals, ICP/TICP segments, funnel quality, and revenue targets. Partner with regional marketing teams to define campaign priorities, budgets, audiences, messaging, and testing plans. Ensure campaigns are optimized not only for registrations, but for quality outcomes such as company registrations, A-leads, approvals, FFT, and revenue. Performance, CAC & ROAS Management Analyze campaign performance across markets, channels, audiences, cohorts, and funnel stages. Track and improve key metrics including cost per registration, cost per approval, cost per FFT, CAC, ROAS, payback, and revenue contribution. Turn campaign data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans. Identify inefficient spend, funnel leakage, and opportunities to improve quality or scale. Prepare performance updates and business narratives for senior stakeholders. Funnel Quality & Conversion Work with web, analytics, lifecycle, and sales teams to improve conversion from click to registration, approval, FFT, and revenue. Improve traffic and lead quality by using first-party data, lead scoring, ICP/TICP signals, and platform optimization. Partner with web/CRO teams on landing pages, user journeys, messaging, and conversion experiments. Collaborate with lifecycle and CRM teams to improve nurture journeys for paid leads. Support testing across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, landing pages, and conversion signals. Stakeholder & Partner Management Act as a key performance marketing partner for regional teams across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and other priority markets. Balance global best practices with local market needs and opportunities. Work closely with sales and onboarding teams to improve lead follow-up, activation, and FFT outcomes. Manage agency, vendor, and platform relationships where required. Ensure clear reporting, governance, and accountability across all paid acquisition activity. Data, Measurement & Budget Ownership Work with analytics, BI, and marketing operations teams to improve tracking, attribution, reporting, and data quality. Ensure campaign setup, tagging, conversion tracking, and reporting are accurate and consistent. Use offline conversion data, CDP audiences, lead scoring, and value-based bidding to improve campaign outcomes. Manage paid media budgets and recommend shifts based on performance, CAC efficiency, and revenue potential. Build business cases for new market tests, platform expansion, and additional investment. Who you are 10+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital acquisition, or paid media. Experience across both agency and client-side environments is strongly preferred. Experience in fintech, banking, payments, SaaS, B2B, or high-consideration acquisition businesses is preferred. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen, programmatic/display, and related platforms. Strong understanding of full-funnel acquisition metrics including registrations, qualified leads, approvals, FFT, CAC, ROAS, payback, and revenue. Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to read campaign data and translate it into business action. Strong commercial mindset and ability to connect media investment to business growth. Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, attribution, and BI platforms. Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to work across regions and functions. Clear communication style, with the ability to present performance insights to both technical and senior business audiences. High ownership, strong attention to detail, and ability to operate in a fast-moving global environment. What Success Looks Like Growth in high-quality paid acquisition across priority markets. Improved contribution of A-leads, company registrations, approvals, FFT, and revenue from paid channels. Stronger CAC and ROAS performance across markets and campaigns. Better use of data, lead scoring, and first-party signals in campaign optimization. Improved collaboration between paid media, web, lifecycle, sales, and onboarding teams. Clearer reporting, stronger governance, and more confident investment decisions. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a strong performance marketer with a commercial mindset. They should be hands-on enough to understand campaign setup and optimization, but senior enough to step back, read the business impact, and guide the right investment decisions. They should be analytical, collaborative, and comfortable working across multiple regions, stakeholders, and priorities. Most importantly, they should be able to help Payoneer build a more scalable, efficient, and revenue-focused paid acquisition engine globally. Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. Continuously improve Always striving for a higher standard than our last. Build each other upHelping each other grow, as professionals and people. refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers. We work with retailers like Puma, EuroShop, and Orlen and are scaling fast across Europe and beyond. We are a close-knit team, distributed across three continents, with a base in Berlin. We're building an AI powered startup, flat heirarchy and a tight, efficient team.This is a Head of Marketing operating model inside a lean-team structure. You own the entire marketing function: strategy, content, SEO, events, partner co-marketing, and brand, and you run most of it through AI-powered workflows and agentic automation rather than headcount.The bar is high: you need to zoom from annual content strategy to line-level copy review to prompting a new automation pipeline - and know which mode each situation calls for. We move in sprints, ship fast, and never let perfect be the enemy of good.TasksContent quality and brand voice: Own the editorial standard across everything that goes out — LinkedIn posts, blog content, SEO copy, case studies, newsletter. You are the last human filter before anything is published. You can tell the difference between content that performs and content that just sounds like AI generated it, and you fix the latter.AI content engine: Direct and maintain agentic pipelines that produce content at scale. You set direction, write the prompts, evaluate the output, and intervene when the machine gets it wrong. This is already partially built; you evolve and own it.Account-based marketing support: Align the content calendar with live pipeline priorities. Brief assets for key accounts. Make sure sales has what it needs, when it needs it — not generic collateral.SEO and inbound: Own organic growth. Blog strategy, keyword targeting, distribution playbook, conversion path optimisation.Brand and thought leadership: Evolve the Retail Spotlight podcast into a content ecosystem. Ghostwrite and direct founder voice content across two distinct voices. Build refive's presence as the authoritative voice on in-store customer engagement in Europe.Events and field: Project-manage event participation remotely — NRF, EuroShop, RTS London and similar. Own the full loop: logistics, pre-event content, on-site coordination with vendors and booth teams, lead capture workflows, post-event follow-up content. You run this independently; founders show up and present.Partner co-marketing: Develop joint campaigns and launch materials with white-label and integration partners as the pipeline scales.Metrics and reporting: Own the automated weekly marketing dashboard (GA4, HubSpot, LinkedIn). Know your numbers. Flag what is not working before anyone asks.Requirements6-8 years of B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience, with real ownership - not just execution support.You have run campaigns end to end and have results to show.Fluent, flawless native spokend and written englishAgentic automation fluency. You have built or designed workflows using tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. You are comfortable prompting LLMs for structured outputs and wiring them into repeatable pipelines. This is not a nice-to-have it is how this role operates day to day.Strategic range with execution instinct. You can write a marketing plan in the morning and review a CTA in the afternoon. You know when to go deep and when to move on.Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.BenefitsEnd-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth pathThe chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problemAttractive compensation package and options after year 1Training budget and access to the latest AI toolingDirect access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day oneWork from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connectionWe use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think.
