About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.For more information, visit wppmedia.com.About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comAt WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role Summary And ImpactAs part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.We are looking for a Senior Director – Media Planning who will:Strategic Client Leadership & Planning: Act as the senior planning lead and strategic partner for global and multi‑market clients, ensuring media planning excellence aligned with client business objectives.Maintain a relentless focus on driving client outcome growth, applying performance‑led planning principles, data‑informed audience insights, optimisation thinking and advanced analytical perspectives to planning decision‑making.Serve as a subject‑matter expert across multiple channels and planning practices, with a strong understanding of how channels work together to deliver short‑ and long‑term client outcomes.Provide strategic guidance and recommendations on the optimal use of media products, services and solutions, ensuring alignment with client needs, business strategy and return on investment expectations.Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, nurturing long‑term relationships and supporting clients in navigating complex business challenges, organisational change and evolving market dynamics.Demonstrate deep understanding of client businesses, including successes, challenges and strategic priorities, and apply experience‑based judgement to identify opportunities, risks and trade‑offs from a business perspective.Lead senior‑level planning discussions across multiple stakeholders, effectively synthesising and reconciling diverse or conflicting inputs to drive alignment and shared understanding.Embed performance‑led and outcome‑oriented thinking into the planning process by ensuring that insights, intelligence and forecasts from activation and specialist teams are reflected in strategic recommendations.Define and oversee planning‑level KPIs, governance frameworks and planning processes that enable optimisation, benchmarking and continuous improvement across client portfolios.Champion a data‑driven planning culture, partnering with analytics and data science teams to prioritise initiatives and ensure insights are effectively translated into planning outputs.Develop high‑level growth and commercial planning perspectives for assigned clients or portfolios, including directional forecasts, profitability considerations and identification of priority growth areas.Maintain a strong understanding of WPP Media agency deliverables and committed campaign KPIs, ensuring planning outputs are aligned with agreed client expectations.Represent the planning discipline with credibility in senior client meetings, contributing technical and strategic expertise when required.Own the senior client engagement cadence from a planning perspective, including strategic sessions, status forums and cross‑functional meetings, ensuring consistent and high‑quality representation of the planning function.Take ownership of key planning workstreams on complex or multi‑market initiatives, ensuring clarity of scope, appropriate governance and high‑quality outputs.Capability Development: Identify capability gaps within media planning teams supporting client portfolios and define actions to address them through development, upskilling or targeted hiring. Partner with global planning practices, investment, product and solutions teams to help develop and drive adoption of new proprietary solutions on behalf of the OpCo.Represent the planning perspective in shaping capability priorities for the Polish GOC, ensuring alignment with broader WPP Media standards, expectations and strategic direction.Own the development and long‑term evolution of the Media Planning discipline within the Polish GOC, including definition of role profiles, competency frameworks and quality standards.Provide leadership and oversight for planning talent, establishing consistent development approaches, evaluation principles and coaching practices that support high performance and career progression.Build and maintain planning governance, including methodologies, templates and quality assurance standards, to ensure consistency, scalability and excellence of planning outputs.Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the planning community, supporting best‑practice exchange across teams and markets.Collaboration & Leadership: Operate effectively within a complex, matrixed organizational environment, providing leadership through influence and partnership across client, planning and activation teams.Collaborate closely with client leadership, activation leads and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategic intent, planning outputs and execution delivery.Represent the planning discipline with credibility across cross‑functional forums, ensuring consistent understanding of objectives, priorities and expectations.Enable effective communication and knowledge sharing between planning and activation teams, fostering clarity, collaboration and continuous improvement.Outline, monitor and support adherence to agreed client and WPP Media standards, ensuring planning excellence is consistently reflected across engagements.Partner with senior stakeholders to identify gaps, risks or misalignments, and contribute to the development of action plans and improvement frameworks.Act as a senior counterpart to Activation Directors and Leads, promoting shared accountability for client outcomes and strong collaboration across disciplines.Lead by example in building a collaborative, inclusive and high‑performance culture, encouraging teamwork, ownership and professional growth across teams.Data-Driven Insights: Utilize advanced data analytics to understand media performance deeply, and guide optimization strategies ensuring maximum ROI. Provides expert insights on the application of data science and how to effectively use client and all biddable data signals. Future-Forward Thinking: Stay ahead of media and technology trends, providing guidance on emerging opportunities and threats. Proactively develops blueprints and action plans to help propel achieving client business objectives by bringing together practitioners across practices, proprietary solutions and extended WPP Media capabilities, at a regional level.Skills And Experience15+ years of experience in across paid media, strategy, retail, or consulting, including senior roles requiring leadership and accountability for teams and stakeholders.Expertise in digital media, adtech, martech and data platforms Proven track record of managing complex, multi-market accounts where you’ve delivered measurable business outcomes.Deep knowledge of multi-practice area/industry usage and trends, and how it impacts customer businesses.Ability to communicate in a way that is highly persuasive, engaging and comprehensive (written and verbal).Fluent in different types of media strategy – and understands that the road to strong brand is paved with performance marketing principles at the core.Sophisticated understanding of the media investment, ad tech and agency ecosystemExperience overseeing technology and/or operations transformation programs.Ability to tell complex narratives in a simple and compelling way.Passion for digital and data, well versed on the latest global advancements & dynamics.Ability to lead through influence, demonstrating strong interpersonal skills, empathy and credibility across seniority levels.Demonstrated experience owning and leading senior client planning relationships across large, complex, and matrixed client teams.Proven capability leadership: building a planning team, hiring for defined profiles, and developing a discipline at scale, including people development, performance management and succession planning.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide. job description Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do The Senior Technical Manager is a hands-on senior engineer and technical leader responsible for designing, building, and owning enterprise-grade applications. This is a Chapter Lead role — meaning the individual both leads the technical chapter (standards, practices, engineering culture) and remains deeply hands-on in architecture and implementation. This role is part of a cross-functional Agile squad in the Enterprise Services portfolio — including the Meetings & Events, Security & Travel squads — working closely with Product Owners, Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, production-ready solutions. The individual will lead the technical design and implementation of applications leveraging Python, .NET Core and React. The role demands a strong ownership mindset, deep technical expertise across tech stack, and the ability to guide and grow other engineers while remaining fully hands-on. Your Responsibilities Chapter Leadership Setting technical standards, driving code/design reviews, mentoring engineers, and building a high-performing chapter culture. Act as the technical lead for application development, owning solutions, design decisions, and implementation while remaining fully hands-on. Align stakeholders on technical trade-offs and represent engineering perspective in cross-functional planning. Partner with Agile teams to ensure timely delivery, continuous improvement, and alignment with non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, reliability, cost optimization). Application Development Develop and maintain enterprise-grade APIs and microservices using .NET Core for high-throughput, integration-heavy enterprise service scenarios. Setting integrations with SaaS applications DBT experience is good to have Apply security, privacy, and compliance best practices including data protection, access control. Identify technical risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and contribute to the broader ES roadmap. Identify technical risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and contribute to the broader GenAI roadmap. Create and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational guides. What You'll Bring Experience & Background 12+ years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise-grade applications. 7+ years of hands-on experience in Python, .Net Core, React Proven experience leading engineering chapters or technical teams while remaining hands-on. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional teams. Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset. Self-starter who can operate independently while leading others in a collaborative team environment Comfortable owning ambiguous problem spaces and driving solutions end-to-end. Passion for continuous learning, and applying emerging technologies responsibly. Strong leadership qualities with the ability to mentor, guide, and elevate team performance. Core Technical Skills — .NET Core & Python Strong hands-on expertise in both .NET Core and Python for application development. Ability to architect and build services, APIs, and data pipelines in either stack depending on use-case requirements. Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, Identity management and cloud-native integration patterns across both ecosystems. Good to have experience with AWS cloud services Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. normalizedText: LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description Who are we ? Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation. Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia. What is this role all about? As a Associate Director- Growth , you will work closely with enterprise customers to identify growth opportunities through AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives. You will act as a trusted strategic advisor, helping clients unlock business value while driving platform adoption, expansion, and long-term partnerships. Sounds interesting? Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role: You will build and manage relationships with enterprise stakeholders, ranging from operational teams to CXO-level decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor for customer growth and transformation initiatives. You will identify AI-led business opportunities, uncover new use cases, and drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities across your account portfolio. You will lead strategic business reviews, workshops, and executive presentations that demonstrate measurable business impact and ROI. You will partner with Product, Solutions, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and execution of customer growth initiatives. You will analyze customer business challenges, operational metrics, and market trends to recommend scalable automation and customer experience improvements. This is a Bengaluru -based role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility. What does success look like in this role? You consistently help customers realize measurable business outcomes through AI and automation while driving strong adoption, executive engagement, revenue expansion, and long-term customer retention. What would make you a good fit for this role? Here are the basic requirements: You have 4-8 years of experience in Consulting, GTM Strategy, Growth Strategy, Founder’s Office or Strategic Account Management roles. You have experience working directly with enterprise customers and influencing senior business stakeholders. About OleriaOleria provides adaptive and autonomous identity security solutions to protect and enable today's dynamic enterprise. Our platform delivers unparalleled fine-grained access visibility, including usage insights at the individual resource level, so CISOs can confidently answer: Who has access to what? How did they get it? What are they doing with it?With our recent launch of Adaptive Identity Governance, we have a massive opportunity to disrupt the legacy IGA market. We're replacing multi-year, multi-million dollar deployments with a data-first, AI-native platform that gets organizations governed in under an hour. It's a wide-open market, and we're just getting started.Founded by cybersecurity veterans Jim Alkove and Jagadeesh Kunda, who built and secured platforms used by billions globally, we've raised $60M+ from Evolution Equity Partners, Salesforce Ventures, Tapestry VC, Zscaler, and other technology luminaries. Our Fortune 500 and public sector clients trust us to protect millions of users worldwide.We're proud to be recognized as a LinkedIn Best Startup and a Best Startup to Work For by Built In. Join a well-funded team with real traction, a game-changing new product, and a mission to deliver identity security that sets your business free.Learn more: www.oleria.comThe MissionYou are the operational engine of Oleria’s marketing function. You own the growth number, run the weekly operating cadence across Bay Area and Bangalore teams, and ensure every external interaction—from analyst briefings to conference keynotes—reinforces Oleria’s position as the leader in AI-native identity security. This is a hands-on senior IC role. You build campaigns, review pipeline data, prep founders for market-facing moments, and ship work product every week. With AI leverage, you do what used to require a team.What You ShipAI-powered campaign workflows: automated lead nurturing, signal-based outbound triggers, and personalized ABM sequences built with AI — not manually assembled in spreadsheets Content velocity: 3-5 campaign assets per week (landing pages, email sequences, social, ads) using AI drafting and the Bangalore web/design engineer for production Pipeline model management: own the marketing-sourced path of Oleria's two-path pipeline model, tracking from lead to closed-won with full attribution Campaign strategy and execution across paid, organic, and event channels Marketing budget allocation and pipeline contribution reporting Founder prep and messaging frameworks for conferences, analyst briefings, and media Partnership activation from the marketing side (AWS Marketplace, channel partners) Cross-functional operating rhythm: continuous pipeline reviews with sales, campaign retrospectives, planning aligned to the business target Marketing attribution and full-funnel transparency What We Look For8-20 years in B2B SaaS growth marketing, demand generation, or marketing operations — ideally at a Series A-C cybersecurity or enterprise software company where you were the first or second marketing hire, not inheriting an existing machine You’ve personally built and run campaigns, not just managed vendors who did. You know Pardot (or HubSpot/Marketo), Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and SEMrush at an operator level Experience preparing executives or founders for high-stakes moments: keynotes, analyst briefings, board presentations, media interviews Comfort with data: you pull your own pipeline reports, build your own dashboards, and make budget decisions based on what the numbers say You are AI-native. Claude, GPT, and AI research tools are your daily multipliers — not experiments. You draft campaigns in hours, pull competitive intel in minutes, and generate 10 messaging variants before most marketers finish one. Show us your AI workflow in the interview. You've rebuilt or stood up a marketing function from scratch. You know what it means to have no playbook, no existing campaigns, and no team to inherit — and that energizes you. You’ve worked across time zones and can set clear weekly objectives for a remote team while giving them autonomy to deliver Strong opinions on what works in enterprise security marketing, loosely held when the data says otherwise Nice to HaveExperience working directly with product/engineering teams on PLG or product-led sales motions Familiarity with the Rule of 60 or similar GTM efficiency frameworks for capital-efficient growth Experience in identity security, IAM, IGA, or adjacent cybersecurity markets Familiarity with Clay, Dreamdata, or similar modern GTM tooling Experience with product-led growth motions alongside enterprise sales Background at an AI-first or AI-native company What Makes This Role RewardingWe believe in taking care of the people who power our mission. Here's how we invest in you:Compensation that reflects your value - We strive to offer compensation that matches leading companies in our industry, because exceptional talent deserves exceptional recognition. Health coverage you can count on - Your wellbeing matters. A culture that brings out your best - Join a team where everyone takes initiative and accountability for our shared success. You'll be surrounded by colleagues who ask bold questions, challenge assumptions, and never stop learning. Here, individual brilliance amplifies through collective impact as we collaborate to achieve what none of us could alone. This is where your growth and our mission become one. Oleria is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.Oleria is committed to providing a safe and respectful workplace for all employees. We have a zero-tolerance policy for sexual harassment and maintain an Internal Complaints Committee in accordance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act).We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.In accordance with applicable Indian data protection law, please be aware that personal information submitted through this application will be collected and used for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Oleria, and may be shared with third-party service providers involved in our recruitment process. For more information on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please review our Privacy Policy.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. normalizedText: Consolidated is a diversified Consumer Electronics, IT Infra and Value Added Services company having the Business Verticals of Retail, Service, B2B and Wellness of Top leading Brands with its significant presence across South India. The company is a valued Apple Partner with a significant presence across South & West, under the iPlanet Apple Premium Reseller store format and the Planet Care, Premium Service Provider. Consolidated is an Authorised Partner for Apple products for Enterprise and Education. Also, partnered with top leading brands Sony, Linen Club and under the Wellness Business Vertical partnered with Cultfit We are headquartered out of Coimbatore, and we have our Regional Offices based out of Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai and Cochin. The Company Revenue has grown significantly and has crossed 1800 crs in FY 24-25. How we imagine you: We imagine you as a visionary marketing leader with a deep appreciation for premium brand storytelling and the Apple ethos. You combine strategic foresight with hands-on agility, data-driven decision-making, and creative flair. You thrive in dynamic, multi-channel environments, lead teams with empathy and clarity, and are passionate about crafting seamless customer experiences that inspire loyalty and growth. What we expect from you: To lead the marketing function across all verticals Retail, Service, B2B, and Education ensuring a unified brand presence that reflects Apple s premium standards. You will drive strategic marketing initiatives that enhance customer engagement, generate leads, strengthen brand affinity, and deliver measurable business outcomes through innovation, digital excellence, and data-driven insights. Job Responsibilities: Brand Management: Strengthen brand salience and ensure consistency across all channels, aligning with Apple s global marketing standards. Retail Marketing: Develop and execute in-store campaigns to drive footfall, conversion, and loyalty while promoting cross-category sales. Digital & Performance Marketing: Build and implement digital strategies across paid, owned, and earned media to enhance awareness, traffic, and conversion. B2B & Education Marketing: Create and manage marketing programs that support lead generation and brand preference among enterprise and institutional clients. Service Centre Marketing: Design retention campaigns to drive repeat visits and reinforce after-sales brand loyalty. CRM, Data & Analytics: Build unified customer data platforms, use AI/ML for predictive insights, and continuously optimise campaign performance. Leadership & Collaboration: Lead and mentor a diverse marketing team while partnering cross-functionally to ensure marketing initiatives align with business goals. Budget Management: Strategically allocate and track marketing spend to maximise ROI and efficiency. Requirements: MBA / Postgraduate in Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline. 10 15 years of experience in marketing, including 5+ years in leadership within premium consumer retail, electronics, or lifestyle brands. Strong expertise in digital marketing tools (Google Ads, Meta, CRM, Analytics, Automation platforms). Proven success in multi-channel marketing (Retail + Digital + B2B). Exposure to the Apple ecosystem or luxury/premium brand marketing. Exceptional communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. What we offer: Cross-Functional Collaboration Career growth opportunities Merit-Based Advancement Performance-Based Incentives More than just a job, Consolidated is a lifestyle a different kind of experience. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description Company Description Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes. Job Description Role Overview We are seeking a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead our technology strategy and execution with a strong focus on AI and Data Science platforms. Based in Mumbai, this role carries group-wide responsibility for both internal and external platforms, supporting our AI-driven offerings and digital transformation initiatives. The CTO will play a critical role in industrializing AI and data capabilities, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that power both internal operations and client-facing solutions. This is a hybrid role combining technology leadership, platform engineering, and AI enablement. Key Responsibilities Technology & AI Strategy Define and execute the group’s technology strategy with a strong emphasis on AI, data, and analytics platforms Partner with AI & Data Science leadership to industrialize models into scalable products and platforms Drive innovation in areas such as GenAI, advanced analytics, and data-driven products Platform Ownership (Internal & Client-Facing) Own the architecture and scalability of: Internal platforms (data platforms, knowledge systems, AI tooling, internal apps) External/client-facing platforms (AI-powered solutions, digital products, client delivery platforms) Ensure seamless data pipelines, model deployment, and system integration Build reusable, modular, and scalable platform components AI & Data Platform Engineering Lead the development of end-to-end AI/ML platforms (data ingestion, training, deployment, monitoring) Establish best practices for: MLOps / LLMOps Data engineering and governance Model lifecycle management Ensure reliability, reproducibility, and scalability of AI solutions Engineering Leadership & Delivery Build and lead multidisciplinary teams across: Software engineering Data engineering ML engineering Platform & DevOps Drive a strong engineering culture focused on quality, speed, and innovation Oversee delivery of complex, multi-platform initiatives Data, Security & Infrastructure Define and implement data architecture and governance frameworks Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and AI governance standards Oversee cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), ensuring scalability and cost efficiency Implement robust cybersecurity and model risk management practices Stakeholder & Client Engagement Act as a senior technology partner to business and AI leaders Support client engagements where deep technology expertise is required Translate business and AI use cases into scalable platform solutions Governance & Operations Establish governance frameworks for platform and AI investments Manage technology budgets, vendors, and partnerships (including AI/tech ecosystems) Track KPIs across platform performance, AI adoption, and delivery excellence Qualifications Qualifications & Experience Proven experience as a CTO, Head of Engineering, or senior technology leader in AI/data-driven environments Strong experience building and scaling AI/ML platforms and data ecosystems Deep understanding of: Cloud-native architectures Data platforms (lakehouse, streaming, etc.) MLOps / LLMOps frameworks Experience delivering both internal platforms and client-facing digital/AI products Strong leadership experience managing cross-functional technical teams Preferred Experience Experience in consulting, digital services, or AI-driven organizations Exposure to GenAI and large language model ecosystems Experience scaling technology teams in India or global delivery models Key Competencies Strategic vision in AI and technology Strong execution and platform mindset Ability to bridge data science and engineering worlds Stakeholder influence at executive level Innovation with pragmatic delivery Why Join Us Opportunity to shape and scale AI-driven platforms at a group level High-impact role at the intersection of technology, data, and business Exposure to cutting-edge AI use cases and global clients Additional Information Sia Partners is an equal opportunity employer. Role OverviewWe are hiring a Managing Director to lead the strategy, delivery, and enterprise‑scale adoption of agent‑based automation across global financial services operations. This role sits within the Global Delivery Simplification organization and is accountable for transforming how complex, control‑intensive operational processes are executed using agentic AI in a highly regulated environment.The Managing Director will own the end‑to‑end product portfolio for agent‑driven solutions across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody, with full accountability for value realization, risk posture, and sustained operational performance at scale.This role combines senior product leadership, people management, and executive‑level stakeholder accountability, requiring strong judgment, organizational influence, and ownership of outcomes well beyond initial delivery.ROLE PURPOSEThe Managing Director leads multiple cross‑functional PODs responsible for conceiving, delivering, scaling, and governing agentic AI solutions across core business services including Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody.The role is accountable for enterprise‑level product strategy, investment prioritization, roadmap governance, and value realization of agent‑based automation, ensuring solutions deliver material operational impact while meeting regulatory, audit, data governance, and model risk management expectations.Success in this role requires the ability to set clear strategic direction, balance innovation with operational resilience, and institutionalize controls, auditability, and explainability as non‑negotiable product standards.Key Responsibilities Own enterprise‑level business outcomes for agent‑based automation, including efficiency, capacity, quality, client experience, and risk reduction. Define and communicate the long‑term vision and strategy for agentic AI across global operations. Set strategic priorities across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody based on materiality, risk, and value. Sponsor identification and sequencing of high‑impact automation opportunities across the operating model. Ensure alignment of product strategy with regulatory expectations, enterprise AI risk frameworks, and control standards. Govern translation of simplification objectives into coherent product portfolios, roadmaps, and investment cases. Provide executive oversight of agile delivery, ensuring consistency of standards, outcomes, and operational readiness across PODs. Own the full lifecycle governance of agentic AI solutions, including approval frameworks, human‑in‑the‑loop models, escalation design, and decommissioning decisions. Establish enterprise standards for controls, auditability, explainability, and evidence capture in agent‑based solutions. Set materiality thresholds, risk tolerances, and escalation models for autonomous and semi‑autonomous execution. Make portfolio‑level decisions to scale, pause, remediate, or retire agents based on performance, risk, and value realization. Oversee production performance management including accuracy trends, systemic failure patterns, and control effectiveness. Lead and develop senior Product Owners and product leaders, setting clear expectations and accountability for outcomes. Partner with senior operations, risk, compliance, audit, data, and technology leaders to ensure enterprise alignment. Define, track, and report value realization, risk metrics, and control outcomes to executive governance forums. Represent Global Delivery Simplification in senior leadership discussions related to AI strategy, operational resilience, and regulatory engagement.Skills And Capabilities Advanced product leadership capability, including portfolio strategy, investment governance, and organizational alignment. Exceptional judgment in balancing automation ambition, operational risk, regulatory scrutiny, and reputational considerations. Proven experience leading and developing senior product and delivery leaders. Executive‑level communication and influencing skills across business, technology, and control functions. Deep expertise in one or more operational domains (Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody) with enterprise perspective. Strong understanding of agentic AI risk, evaluation, monitoring, and control design at scale. Ability to interpret enterprise‑level telemetry, systemic risk signals, and performance trends. Deep understanding of data governance, model risk management, and audit expectations in regulated environments.Experience Requirements 12+ years of experience leading products, platforms, or transformations in complex, regulated operational environments. Senior leadership experience in global financial services operations. Demonstrated ownership of enterprise‑scale automation or AI portfolios. Extensive experience working with risk, compliance, audit, and regulators. Proven track record of scaling solutions into sustained business‑as‑usual operations. Experience operating in product‑centric, agile organizations at scale.About State StreetAcross the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. normalizedText: About SarvamSarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.About The RoleSarvam is building sovereign AI for India - foundational models, a developer platform, and enterprise products that put AI to work across BFSI, healthcare, and the public sector. The Head of Brand & Communications owns how that story is understood: how Sarvam shows up to developers, enterprises, the media, policymakers, and the public, and how a coherent brand and narrative are built across every channel.The mandate is to define Sarvam's brand and lead its communications — shaping press narratives, driving proactive media engagement, placing the founders and research where they matter, and building credibility with technical, business, and policy audiences. You will set the strategy and build the system: the brand identity, the narrative, the newsroom, and the team and partners to execute across earned, owned, and social channels.You will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and the founders, and play a critical role in ensuring communications is not a service function but a driver of business outcomes — pipeline, adoption, talent, and trust.What You’ll DoBrand strategy & identity. Own Sarvam's brand end-to-end — positioning, narrative, voice, and visual identity — and keep it coherent across product, marketing, recruiting, and public moments as the company scales. Communications strategy. Define and drive the communications strategy across developer, enterprise, policy, and consumer audiences. Build the system, the cadence, and the team to execute it. Press & media engagement. Own the press narrative. Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, and trade press in India and globally, and proactively drive coverage that advances Sarvam's positioning. Narrative & messaging. Translate complex models, platform capabilities, and research into clear, credible narratives that resonate with developers, technical buyers, executives, and policymakers — without diluting the technical depth. Founder & executive visibility. Place Sarvam's founders and research in the rooms that matter — AI summits, policy circles, global benchmarks, and tier-1 media. Prepare leaders to be effective spokespeople across press, podcasts, panels, and stage. Thought leadership & policy comms. Shape Sarvam's voice on sovereign AI, India's AI stack, and the policy conversations the company is part of. Produce POVs, briefings, and narratives that establish category leadership. Product & launch communications. Lead comms for every model and product release — from launch narrative to the steady cadence of capability releases and developer-facing news. Know which moments deserve the spotlight and which don't. Integrated marcomms. Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Developer Relations, and Sales to co-develop integrated campaigns and storytelling that span earned, owned, and social channels in a single coordinated voice. Owned & social channels. Own Sarvam's owned newsroom, blog, and social presence. Drive proactive storytelling that increases the volume and consistency of high-quality narratives about Sarvam's impact. Customer & ecosystem storytelling. Partner with GTM teams and customers to bring real-world use cases and impact to life across industries and regions, turning adoption into credible, repeatable stories. Crisis & issues management. Exercise sound judgment in high-velocity, high-scrutiny moments — prioritise, triage, and lead the company's response through ambiguity. Build & scale the function. Hire, structure, and develop the brand and communications team, and bring in agencies or partners for social, content, design, and programmatic execution where needed. a track record of shaping narratives and landing impactful coverage with business, technology, and industry mediaDemonstrated ability to operate as a strategic advisor to founders and senior executives — not just an executor of comms plansExperience building and owning a brand — positioning, narrative, voice, and identity — and keeping it coherent as a company scalesExperience engaging technical and enterprise stakeholders — developers, CIOs, CTOs, and line-of-business leaders — with the ability to tailor messaging across segmentsExperience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed organisations, with strong instincts for alignment across product, GTM, and marketingAbility to build and scale teams, including structuring complementary capabilities such as social, PointsExperience at a founder-led or early-stage deep-tech company where the brand, narrative, and comms function had to be built from the ground upExisting relationships with reporters, analysts, and editors covering AI, enterprise tech, and the Indian technology ecosystemExperience managing communications for AI or ML products, and an understanding of both developer culture and enterprise buyingFamiliarity with the policy and regulatory conversation around AI in India, and experience with policy or public-affairs communicationsStrong editorial judgment and taste across narratives, decks, landing pages, customer stories, and event momentsAre very online — you follow the right channels, catch what is moving through developer and AI conversation early, and read timing and tone normalizedText: Chief Business & Technology Officer – Greenfield Hyperscale Data CentreRole OverviewThe Chief Business & Technology Officer holds full P&L, commercial, and technical accountability for establishing, commercializing, and scaling a greenfield hyperscale data centre platform. This executive role owns the complete asset lifecycle—from overarching investment strategy, capital structuring, land and utility acquisition, government engagement, and aggressive customer development through technical architecture, design governance, construction, commissioning, commercial ramp-up, and steady-state operations.The incumbent will personally lead high-value strategic, capital, commercial, regulatory, and technology decisions while building high-performing functional teams and engaging specialist engineering, design, EPC, MEP, commissioning, and operating partners.The leader will be accountable for creating a bankable, highly resilient, energy-efficient, and scalable campus capable of supporting major global hyperscalers, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), large enterprises, and high-density AI/GPU compute workloads.Key Responsibilities1. Business Strategy, P&L & Enterprise GovernanceVision & P&L Leadership: Own the overall platform strategy, business plan, market positioning, P&L performance, cash flows, and long-term return-on-capital objectives.Commercial Model Optimization: Define the optimal business model and portfolio allocation across wholesale hyperscale capacity, build-to-suit (BTS) solutions, powered shell, enterprise colocation, and high-value managed services.Capital Allocation & Phasing: Prepare rigorous investment cases, secure board approvals, and determine campus scale, phase sequencing, and capital deployment to match demand and avoid speculative overbuilding.Governance & Risk Management: Establish board reporting, decision rights, risk controls, and operational governance across commercial, technical, financial, and legal functions.2. Hyperscale Sales, Business Development & Commercial EngineCommercial Strategy & Go-To-Market (GTM): Build, direct, and scale the commercial organization responsible for revenue generation across hyperscalers, cloud service providers (CSPs), GCCs, global enterprises, and strategic tech clients.CXO Account Relationship Management: Personally cultivate and own executive CXO/SVP-level relationships with global hyperscale procurement heads, site-selection teams, and enterprise infrastructure leaders.Anchor Tenant & BTS Pursuits: Originate, pipeline-govern, and personally drive high-value deal pursuits for anchor tenants, multi-megawatt capacity reservations, and custom build-to-suit deployments.Contractual Negotiations & Structure: Lead end-to-end commercial deal structuring and contract negotiations, including detailed pricing models, Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), capacity reservation deposits, and risk-allocation frameworks.Deal Sponsor & RFP Leadership: Serve as executive commercial and technical sponsor for key customer RFPs, bid defenses, technical due diligence reviews, site walkthroughs, and custom customer design workshops.Pipeline & Revenue Alignment: Ensure tight synchronization between contracted customer demand, available power capacity, construction delivery schedules, and revenue ramp-up schedules.3. Capital Strategy, Financing & Development EconomicsCapital Raising & Structuring: Lead capital planning across promoter equity, project debt, private credit, infrastructure funds, joint ventures, and customer pre-commitments.Financial Modeling & Benchmarking: Own platform economics, cost-per-MW benchmarks, yield targets, cash-flow projections, and sensitivity analysis.Investor & Lender Engagement: Lead investment discussions with institutional investors, debt providers, equity partners, and anchor customers.Commercial Controls: Ensure disciplined procurement, commercial controls, change-order management, and lifecycle-cost optimization across development.4. Site Selection, Land, Utilities & Regulatory ApprovalsCorridor Acquisition: Lead site selection and due diligence across the Vizag and Hyderabad corridors, evaluating land titles, power availability, water access, fibre diversity, and natural hazard risks.Critical Utility Sourcing: Secure high-voltage grid connections, transmission clearances, water rights, and carrier-neutral connectivity dependencies.Government Engagement: Drive central and state government relations to secure single-window clearances, power subsidies, tax incentives, and SEZ/non-SEZ operational benefits.5. Technical Strategy & Executive Design AuthorityDesign Basis: Establish and approve the technical design basis for the campus, covering MW capacity, rack density, redundancy, efficiency (PUE/WUE), security, and maintainability.Electrical & Mechanical Architecture: Oversee high-voltage utility intake, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, N+1/2N resilience topologies, cooling generation/distribution, and airflow containment.Industry Certifications: Drive facility design, construction, and operational audit pathways for Uptime Institute Tier standards, TIA-942, and ASHRAE guidance.Integrated Systems: Oversee implementation of DCIM, BMS, SCADA, physical security, carrier-neutral meet-me-rooms, and operational technology (OT).6. AI/GPU & Future-Technology ReadinessHigh-Density Compute Strategy: Formulate commercially justified roadmaps for high-density AI/GPU workloads and high-capacity compute racks.Cooling Evolution: Define migration pathways from conventional air cooling to rear-door heat exchangers, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, and immersion cooling architectures.Infrastructure Adaptability: Future-proof floor loadings, cooling distribution units (CDUs), facility water loops, leak detection, and power distribution systems.7. Energy Strategy, PPAs & SustainabilityPower Sourcing & PPAs: Formulate energy procurement strategies using grid supply, open-access renewables, group-captive structures, and 24/7 green energy matching.Storage & Clean Tech: Evaluate business cases for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), microgrids, peak shaving, and advanced energy management systems.ESG & Environmental Excellence: Drive water-efficient cooling, Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD), waste-heat recovery, and certifications including LEED/IGBC and ISO 50001.8. Construction, EPC & Commissioning GovernanceVendor Selection: Lead evaluation and selection of design consultants, EPC/MEP contractors, commissioning agents, and major equipment OEMs.Project Delivery: Oversee master planning, FEED, detailed engineering, modular MW phasing, construction schedules, safety standards, and change controls.Commissioning & Handover: Own asset delivery through factory testing, site acceptance, load-bank testing, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and customer acceptance.Operational Readiness: Establish SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, preventive maintenance, spare-parts logistics, and 24/7 critical facilities management systems.Qualifications & Required ExperienceLeadership & Track Record20+ Years Experience: Extensive senior executive experience in data centre development, critical infrastructure, power/energy infrastructure, or telecom/tower networks.Executive Accountability: Proven background with P&L accountability, capital allocation, and board-level reporting as CEO, Business Head, Chief Development Officer, CTO, or Chief Engineering Officer.Greenfield Delivery: Demonstrated ownership of at least one greenfield data centre campus or mission-critical asset from land acquisition through construction, commissioning, customer onboarding, and operations.Hyperscale Sales & BD CapabilitiesHyperscale Deal Making: Proven track record in originating, negotiating, and closing large-scale data centre contracts with global hyperscalers, CSPs, and enterprise accounts.Commercial Pipeline Management: Direct experience building a sales organization, managing multi-year sales cycles, and managing capacity reservation pipelines.Contracting Expertise: Fluency in negotiating complex MSAs, SLAs, power pass-through pricing, and capacity reservation agreements.Technical & Regional ExpertiseTechnical Depth: Deep knowledge of data centre economics (Cost/MW, Pricing/kW, PUE, WUE), critical electrical/mechanical systems, and high-density liquid cooling pathways.Power Markets: Sound understanding of Indian power sector regulations, grid connections, open-access renewable policies, group-captive PPAs, and BESS applications.Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power, or related Engineering discipline. Master’s degree or MBA is highly advantageous. normalizedText: LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description Location: Hyderabad, India Reports to: Board of Directors About Client: Our client is driven by a vision to be a bridge between climate-resilient agricultural practices and the use of food as a tool for preventative healthcare Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic, visionary CEO. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the intersection of agriculture, health, and sustainability. They should have the grit and determination to drive innovation and growth while embracing a startup mindset. The CEO should have deep experience in food innovation to catapult the company’s efforts from a food sciences standpoint. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement a comprehensive business strategy aligned with mission of bridging climate-resilient agricultural practices and preventative healthcare through food. Drive the long-term vision and establish a clear roadmap for achieving sustainable growth and market leadership. Operational Management: Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring that all departments work cohesively to meet business objectives. Drive operational excellence by optimizing production processes, maintaining product quality, and achieving financial goals. Innovation & Product Development: Champion innovation in millet-based nutrition, fortification techniques, and sustainable food processing technologies. Lead efforts in food sciences to develop and launch innovative products that set new benchmarks in the industry. Partnerships & Market Expansion: Build strategic partnerships with regenerative farming cooperatives, healthcare institutions, and key industry stakeholders. Identify and penetrate new markets to expand our footprint in both domestic and international markets. Financial Management: Establish financial goals and ensure sound financial planning and risk management to maintain healthy cash flows and profitability. Drive cost optimization initiatives without compromising on quality or sustainability. Team Leadership & Culture Building: Cultivate a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning across all levels of the organization Mentor and develop the leadership team, fostering an environment that encourages innovative thinking and agility. Stakeholder Engagement: Maintain transparent communication with the board, investors, and stakeholders regarding the company’s performance and strategic priorities. Act as a spokesperson and advocate for the company’s mission at industry events, conferences, and public forums. Qualifications & Experience: Proven experience in a senior leadership role within the F&B or AgriTech industry. Experience in startups or scaling businesses is highly desirable. Strong understanding of sustainable agriculture practices, food fortification, and preventative healthcare principles. Deep experience in food innovation, with a track record of driving breakthroughs in product development and food sciences. Demonstrated ability to build and lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. Exceptional financial acumen and experience in P&L management. Passion for health, nutrition, and sustainability, with a willingness to embrace a mission-driven approach.

normalizedText: About UsACKO is the protection destination for over 200 million tech-savvy families across India, protecting their families, assets and money. Launched in 2016, ACKO started by reimagining insurance, making it simple, hassle-free and customer-first. Today, our mission goes beyond that: we aim to touch the lives of 1 million users, building products that solve real-world problems with technology at the core.We are not just another insurance company, our DNA is product-tech, and our approach is bold, innovative, and digital-first. From zero commission, zero paperwork, and instant renewals to same-day claims settlements and app-based tracking, ACKO is a Welcome Change from traditional insurers.But what truly sets us apart? Our people. At ACKO, every Acker’s voice and ideas matter. We’re a vibrant, inclusive team of creators, thinkers, and doers, building products that redefine protection while ensuring each Acker grows, thrives and does meaningful work.Join us at ACKO, where bold ideas, real impact and tech-driven innovation redefine protection and peace of mind - and where YOU can make a real difference in people's lives. ACKO is a product-tech company, launched in 2016, solving real-world problems for customers, starting with insurance. And as a customer-first organization serving the digitally-savvy, ACKO’s value proposition of ‘Welcome Change’ focuses on offerings that make insurance simple and hassle-free! With features such as zero commission, zero paperwork, instant renewal, same-day claim settlements, and app-based updates on claims, ACKO is a 'Welcome Change' from traditional insurers.Having said that, we are not just another conventional insurance firm, or the people consulted solely for "claims”! Anchored in a tech-centric philosophy, ACKO’s approach fuels innovation, empowering us to develop comprehensive products that cater to every aspect of our customers' insurance requirements. And while we are at it, we put our Ackers at the heart of everything we do. We're not your typical 9-to-5 workplace; we're a vibrant and inclusive bunch of innovators and creators making sure every Acker’s idea matters, their voice is heard, and their growth is part of our mission.About The RoleAt ACKO, we believe claims are the moment that defines an insurance company. Every interaction, every decision and every minute spent waiting shapes customer trust.We are looking for a Head of Product – Claims & Customer Experience to build the future of claims.Reporting to Head of Auto Business, you will define the long-term product vision for one of ACKO's most strategic customer journeys. Your mandate is to transform claims into an AI-first, technology-driven platform that delivers exceptional customer experiences while creating sustainable operational advantage.This role sits at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, Customer Experience and Claims Operations.You will also lead the Product team responsible for Claims and Customer Experience, partnering closely with Engineering to build intelligent products that redefine the future of insurance claims.With access to one of India's richest proprietary claims datasets - including more than eight years of claims history, millions of vehicle images and operational intelligence - you will have a unique opportunity to build AI-native capabilities that create a lasting competitive advantage for ACKO.This is not a role about optimizing today's processes. normalizedText: About RateGainRateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality, working with 13,000+ customers and 700+ partners across 160+ countries. RateGain helps travel and hospitality businesses accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet-share expansion.Today, RateGain is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data, enabling revenue management, distribution, and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, metasearch companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises, and ferries to drive better business outcomes.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, RateGain works with 33 of the Top 40 Hotel Chains, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, 7 of the Top 10 Car Rental companies, and all leading Destination Marketing Organizations, Online Travel Agents, and metasearch platforms, including 25 Global Fortune 500 companies, unlocking new revenue every day.Recognized globally for its innovation and impact, RateGain has been named Best Digital Marketing Agency by HotelTechReport Awards and Best Channel Manager by the World Travel Tech Awards. The company has also been certified as a Great Place to Work® in the USA, Spain, and India, with recognition in India for seven consecutive years. In 2025, RateGain was honored as Emerging Company of the Year at The Economic Times Awards for Corporate Excellence, named among Deloitte India Technology Fast 50 for the sixth time, and won Excellence in Best AI Solution Showcase for UNO VIVA at the CII National AI Awards 2025, among other industry recognitions.Mission: Build and institutionalize RateGain’s growth engine by systematically identifying, prioritizing, and executing the highest return growth opportunities across products, markets, and go -to-market, ensuring capital is deployed deliberately to maximize growth and profitability.Purpose & Strategic Significance This role exists to answer one question, every quarter: “Where should RateGain invest next to grow fastest and most profitably?” You will understand how the company allocates capital across products, markets, and go-to-market, ensuring every investment is deliberate, sequenced, and accountable for outcomes.Primary Responsibilities: 1. Portfolio Strategy • Classify current product lines: DaaS, Distribution, MarTech, and sub-products across growth, share, and profitability to define clear invest/scale / maintain / harvest/exit postures.• Build a forward -looking view of the business across:- Core revenue engines (driving current cash flow)- Growth accelerators (scaling businesses)- Future bets (emerging opportunities)• Translate this portfolio view into explicit capital allocation decisions, including:- Where to increase investment (product, GTM, partnerships)- Where to protect margins and optimize- Where to reduce or redeploy resources• Own the annual portfolio strategy and quarterly refresh cycles, stress-testing assumptions with data, scenario planning, and market signals.2. Market Expansion & Segmentation • Define where to play & how to win across geos, verticals, and customer segments.• Build clear go / no -go frameworks for expansion across: Geos, Verticals, Customer segments, including hotel chains vs independents, OTAs, airlines, DMOs, cruise, car rental, TMCs, etc.• Size opportunities with rigorous TAM/segment economics/win-thesis modeling, and define: Expected growth potential, Time to scale, Required investment intensity,• Recommend entry strategies for each priority segment: Direct, Channel-led, or M&A.• Identify white spaces within existing markets:- Under-penetrated geographies,- High -potential sub -segments,- Cross-sell/bundling opportunities across the portfolio.3. New Product & Category Strategy • Identify adjacencies across data, distribution, MarTech , and AI -led experiences• Balance investment across: Core business optimization, adjacent growth, future category creation• Drive build vs buy vs partner decisions with clear ROI logic.4. Go -to -Market Investment Allocation • Decide where to: Add or scale Sales capacity, expand CS/Account Management, build partner-led growth channels, pull back underperforming investments.• Own: CAC payback, LTV/CAC, Coverage, and productivity models.5. Customer -Centric Growth & Conversion • Anchor growth strategy in deep customer understanding and real use-cases.• Translate insights into: Stronger value propositions, Better onboarding and activation, Improved conversion and expansion.• Identify and fix growth bottlenecks across the funnel.6. Pricing, Packaging & Monetization • Own pricing as a structured growth lever.• Drive: Value-based pricing, Packaging and bundling, cross-product monetization.• Eliminate: Revenue leakage, Discount inconsistency, Legacy pricing constructs.7. Deal Economics & Commercial Discipline • Define guardrails for: Discounting, Deal approvals, Commercial consistency.• Partner with Sales to improve win rates through value articulation.8. Growth System & Execution • Build a repeatable growth system that combines: Strategic prioritization, Data-led decision making, and Continuous experimentation.• Align Product, Sales, and CS around: Shared growth priorities & clear success metrics.9. Growth Intelligence & Planning • Build a single source of truth for growth performance and ROI.• Integrate: Market signals, Cohort performance, Win/loss insights.• Embed strategy into: Planning, Forecasting, Board -level reporting.Functional KPIs • Increase share of ARR from new products and new markets.• Drive growth from existing customers by improving retention (NRR) and multi-product adoption (attach rates) across priority segments.• Optimize CAC payback and sales productivity by segment.• Drive adherence to portfolio and capital allocation decisions across business units.• Improve ACV and price realization, while reducing discount variance.• Grow expansion ARR through cross -sell, upsell, and packaging improvements.Strategic KPIs • Drive sustained multiyear revenue growth through a deliberate growth portfolio.• Improve Rule of 40 performance through disciplined allocation of growth investments.• Enhance quality and predictability of ARR (balanced mix of new, expansion, and renewals).• Increase contribution of new growth bets (products, markets, segments) to revenue.• Strengthen competitive positioning through portfolio, market, and monetization choices.• Build leadership and board confidence in capital allocation and growth strategy.Key Competencies: • Strong portfolio thinking with the ability to balance core performance, scaling bets, and future growth opportunities across the business.• Deep command of SaaS growth metrics (NRR, LTV/CAC, payback, Rule of 40) and ability totranslate metrics into clear decisions.• Ability to define consistent growth metrics across teams, linking strategy to execution.• Expertise in one or more growth levers (product, market, GTM, monetization) with the ability to integrate them into a unified growth strategy.• Operates effectively at both strategic and execution levels, sets direction while staying close to outcomes.• Structured, high -judgment decision maker with the ability to prioritize, make trade-offs, and act under ambiguity.• Influences senior stakeholders and drives alignment on high-impact decisions without formal authority.Education & Experience : • Mandatory: Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree from a Tier -1 institution (India or globalequivalent).• 15–18 years across strategy and growth roles in SaaS, tech, or data-driven businesses.• Blend of top -tier strategy exposure and operating experience (Corporate Strategy, Growth, Revenue, or GM roles).• Proven track record of driving growth through product, market expansion, GTM, and monetization levers with measurable impact.• Experience operating in multi-product, global environments and scaling across geos & segments.• Strong ability to translate strategy into execution in cross -functional settings.• Exposure to M&A, partnerships, or new market entry preferred.• Experience in a listed or high-governance environment is a plus.We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. normalizedText: Who we areVerona is India's #1 modern matchmaking community — and India's #1 channel for modern relationship content.Verona is an authenticated matchmaking community designed exclusively for the modern, global Indian. We’re on a mission to foster fulfilling partnerships that last lifetimes. In a country where dating app disillusionment abounds, Verona makes the matchmaking process delightful—and effective.Verona was founded by two serial entrepreneurs Mr. Poshak Agrawal and Mr. Rahul Subramaniam, and backed by some of the biggest names in global technology, such as Mr. Michael Novogratz (ex-Fortress Investment Group, CEO of Galaxy Group Investments) & Mr. Rishi Jaitly (ex-Twitter CEO for Asia, Middle East, and Africa).Security and Science make the basis of Verona where before matchmaking there will be Fintech-grade authentication to ensure fraud detection. Through a deep appreciation for the science of compatibility, with Verona, we will be using AI for matchmaking based on an individual's core & shared values.The 3 S’s of Verona - Standards, Security, and ScienceRole BriefIndia needs to be happier. Happy societies require deep and meaningful relationships. By bringing science to love, we want to transform the way Indians seek lifelong partners.The Head of Growth & Marketing will sit at the intersection of business growth and brand — owning both the numbers (acquisition, revenue, retention) and the narrative (brand story, content, social media). normalizedText: About the CompanyHoora is a full-stack vehicle care platform built to simplify how India maintains and manages its cars and bikes. Positioned as Indias #1 Car & Bike Care App, Hoora brings every essential automotive need into one seamless ecosystem. From doorstep car and bike wash to end-to-end service, insurance support, challan management, and a curated marketplace for products and accessories, Hoora functions as a complete 360 vehicle companion. Powered by technology, on-demand logistics, and trained professionals, the platform replaces fragmented automotive experiences with one integrated solution. Hooras mission is simple: make vehicle ownership effortless, accessible, and reliable, whether its routine cleaning, urgent servicing, compliance needs, or upgrading your ride.Role Summary:We are seeking a dynamic and entrepreneurial Growth Head to lead Car Care Vertical responsible for scaling business by driving demand, acquisition, activation, retention, referral and revenue. Sustain a 10-15 Crore per month revenue target by driving every aspect of the business, from marketing, product development to operations and team leadership. The ideal candidate masters in growth strategies, GTM, demand generation, marketing combined with operational rigor with commercial acumen and has experience in cross functional leadership with product, tech, marketing etc. Ideal candidates will be from hyperlocal startups. Roles & ResponsibilitiesKey ResponsibilitiesGo-to-Market Strategy: Define and execute the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for new services, products, and geographical expansion. This includes launching new offerings and driving market penetration to secure a dominant position.Demand-Side Product Vision: Define the product roadmap for the customer-facing application. Your focus will be on user acquisition, engagement, and retention to drive strong business metrics.Supply-Side Product Oversight: Oversee the development and optimization of the partner-facing app and platform. You will ensure all teams are aligned and working efficiently toward a shared vision.Performance & Growth Marketing: Lead all performance marketing efforts, balancing short-term ROI with long-term brand equity. Your goal is to acquire high-quality customers at an optimal CAC.Data-Driven Decision Making: Establish and monitor key business KPIs across the entire funnel, including CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and repeat rates. You will use these insights to inform all strategic and operational decisions.International Expansion: Identify and execute a plan for expanding the Car Care Services business into new international markets. Founded in 2014, the firm serves ultra-high net worth individuals, family offices, institutional investors, and an ecosystem of founders and entrepreneurs through its Wealth Management and Asset Management divisions. The firm operates across Singapore, Dubai (DIFC), India, and the UK, regulated by MAS, DFSA, and registered with AMFI.Keenai, a wealthtech platform, is part of the Lighthouse Canton Group and represents the technology-forward evolution of the group’s wealth capabilities.ROLE OVERVIEW & CONTEXTWe are seeking an Assistant Vice President – Digital Marketing to develop and lead the digital and social marketing strategy for the business, based in Bangalore (with Mumbai as a secondary location). Digital marketing has advanced significantly through AI-enabled workflows, marketing automation, data-driven personalisation, and integrated marketing technology. This is a strategic, process-driven and data-led role: you will own the group’s digital channels — web, email, social, webinars and paid media — while shaping scalable, AI-enabled processes, marketing operations and technology-enabled ways of working that improve efficiency, governance, engagement and brand awareness across the group’s businesses.Importantly, the group is currently mid-way through a complete transformation of its MarTech stack — spanning the website, content management system (CMS), analytics, and marketing automation platforms — alongside a migration of the Salesforce CRM. This is a priority backfill, and the incoming AVP will be expected to step into this transition at pace, take ownership of in-flight workstreams, and ensure there is no loss of momentum or institutional knowledge during the changeover.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Digital Marketing Strategy & Operating Model•Develop the digital marketing roadmap, strategy and operating model across brand promotion, client acquisition, client retention and marketing operations.•Translate business and revenue goals into digital campaigns, working closely with internal stakeholders and digital vendors.•Manage the digital marketing budget to ensure efficient and effective spend.2. Campaign Execution & Full-Funnel Performance•Plan, implement, measure and optimise digital campaigns across social media, paid ads, website, webinars and email.•Drive full-funnel optimisation to improve engagement, lead generation, lead nurturing and conversion across channels.•Run paid search and organic / natural search campaigns in-house across geographies (India, Singapore, UAE, UK).•Own digital analytics, insights and reporting — attribution modelling, CAC/LTV analysis, conversion-rate optimisation, and campaign ROI.3. AI-Enabled Marketing & Operations•Design and improve AI-enabled marketing processes — content workflows, campaign optimisation, audience insights and reporting automation.•Establish responsible, well-governed use of AI tools across the marketing function.•Build repeatable marketing operations processes, SLAs and reporting cadences; coordinate with marketing counterparts in Singapore and Dubai.4. MarTech Stack, CRM & Data•Own, run and scale the marketing technology stack across key layers — CRM, CMS, CDP and engagement platforms — ensuring systems, integrations and data flows support execution, measurement and growth.•Administer and govern the Salesforce CRM — data hygiene, lead routing, segmentation, and campaign orchestration.•Operate and optimise marketing automation and personalisation for triggered, multi-market lifecycle campaigns.•Maintain a robust analytics and tagging framework (e.g., GA4, Google Tag Manager), ensuring accurate, privacy-compliant measurement.5. Website, Content & Brand Amplification•Own the group’s websites and CMS — performance, SEO, UX, content publishing and conversion optimisation.•Amplify thought-leadership and brand content across digital and social channels (LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, webinars).•Partner with content and design teams to translate research and insights into high-performing digital assets, and support commercialisation plans for products and campaigns.6. Compliance & Regulatory Alignment•Ensure all digital marketing communications comply with MAS, DFSA, SEBI/AMFI, FCA, and PDPA/DPDP regulations across jurisdictions.•Work closely with Legal and Compliance on approval workflows for client-facing materials, disclaimers, and financial-promotion content.CANDIDATE PROFILE — MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS•Graduate with 6–10 years of strong experience in digital, performance and social media marketing, and a proven record of scaling new-customer acquisition and funnel conversion.•Proven knowledge of digital marketing channels and best practices.•Hands-on fluency across digital and marketing-technology platforms — including MoEngage, Segment, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, paid search and
