normalizedText: About UsVisa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.Job DescriptionVisa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) drives tangible, impactful and financial results for Visa’s network clients, including both financial services and merchants. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, data analytics, brand management, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, Visa Consulting and Analytics solves the most strategic problems for our clients.The India & South Asia (InSA) Consulting Market team within Visa Consulting & Analytics provides consulting and solution services for Visa’s largest issuers in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan & Maldives. We apply deep expertise in the payments industry to provide solutions to assist clients with their key business priorities, drive growth and improve profitability. The VCA team provides a comprehensive range of consulting services to deliver solutions that address unique challenges in areas such as improving profitability, strategic growth, customer experience, digital payments and running risk.You will join our consulting team and play a role in delivering and implementing high impact projects and solutions with client across the Payments Ecosystem which includes Issuers, Acquirers, Merchants, Fintechs etc. This person will develop initiatives to promote balanced and profitable growth, thereby ensuring that Visa is both, the preferred brand and outstanding business partner. This role is based in our Mumbai office and reporting into the Head of Consulting, India & South Asia.What a Senior Director Consulting Practices Does At VisaPotential projects could include portfolio management diagnostics, digital transformation leveraging AI & tech, assessments of digital product and marketing strategies, product design and launch, development of industry landscape evaluations to inform payments strategies, and optimization of client customer experience and supporting processes.Why This Is Important To VisaVisa is committed to meeting a broader set of our client’s needs which in turn help to diversify our revenue. Visa Consulting and Analytics is a leading contributor to achieving this strategy. The Senior Director, Client Consulting is responsible for delivering this objective for India and South Asia clients.As the world's leader in digital payments technology, Visa's mission is to connect the world through the most creative, reliable and secure payment network - enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. Our advanced global processing network, VisaNet, provides secure and reliable payments around the world, and is capable of handling more than 65,000 transaction messages a second. The company's dedication to innovation drives the rapid growth of connected commerce on any device and fuels the dream of a cashless future for everyone, everywhere. As the world moves from analog to digital, Visa is applying our brand, products, people, network and scale to reshape the future of commerce.At Visa, your individuality fits right in. Working here gives you an opportunity to impact the world, invest in your career growth, and be part of an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are a global team of disruptors, trailblazers, innovators and risk-takers who are helping drive economic growth in even the most remote parts of the world, creatively moving the industry forward, and doing meaningful work that brings financial literacy and digital commerce to millions of unbanked and underserved consumers.You're an Individual. We're the team for you. Together, let's transform the way the world pays.This is a hybrid position. You will be comfortable in presale consulting engagement, delivery of a project, managing a project end to end and relish the opportunity to work closely with clients to influence their future performance. As a senior director for your practice, you should be a strong leader, working with client senior management team, and internal client relationship and account executives in Visa. -Specific skills and experience you will bring are:15-20 years above experience in Payment Industry, Consulting, Strategy, or financial institutionsPrevious Engagement Management / Business Development experience at large management consulting firm leading or Portfolio Management / Product Leadership at a large Indian Financial InstitutionSuperior analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigorStrong team leadership skills with a collaborative, diplomatic, and flexible style; able to work effectively in a matrixed organizationCurious, up to date with Indian payment landscape with a point of view on what & how of client priorities & problemsFinancial acumen with experience managing a P&L.Detail oriented, ensuring the highest level of quality/rigor in reports and data analysisExcellent presentation skills, including strong oral and written capabilitiesSelf-motivated, results-oriented individual with the ability to progress multiple priorities concurrentlyExperience in and passion for the power of analytics to inform and drive strategy and tactics, and proven ability to generate insights from dataStrong commercial acumen, with experience in working on business/value cases that prove ROIRelevant depth of experience in at least one of the following areas: digital sales/marketing, merchant acquiring / small business customer segments, data analytics and/or credit risk management Preferred Qualifications -In addition, you will ideally bring the following:Strong consulting experience preferred with project management skillsStrong consulting toolkit (e.g. hypothesis driven analysis & problem solving, stakeholder management / facilitation and project management skills)Significant understanding of data analysis, modelling, and technology in payments, and cloud technology, etc.Experience using financial indicators to measure business performance with a significant focus on impacting return on investmentKnowledge and understanding of banking operations and/or payment schemes, including products & services, business systems and processes, marketing initiatives and card issuing experienceVisa is an EEO EmployerQualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. In this role, you will partner closely with senior IT leaders and cross-functional teams to execute business-accelerating initiatives, position the business for strategic success, and lead on-going improvements in products and operations. If you know how to build a brand people trust, spend media dollars with intent, and turn a market moment into a campaign, this role is for you. Demonstrated success in establishing or expanding a consumer-facing brand, with a focus on tech-driven, digital-first, or fintech landscapes.. Deep mastery of full-funnel marketing strategies, spanning ATL and digital media, coupled with a rigorous, hands-on approach to media investment. A compelling brand storyteller who excels at crafting narratives that drive impact, whether in a high-level boardroom or on a public billboard. Sharp analytical capabilities, with a proven knack for converting complex consumer insights and market data into strategic brand actions. Thrives in agile, high-velocity settings, demonstrating extreme ownership and accountability in a fast-scaling corporate landscape. An MBA degree or comparable professional background is highly valued. If you have built a brand in a niche market, or a digital consumer facing brand, we want to speak to you! With billions of interactions automated using our AI-powered technology, we have saved over $500M for these companies.Kore.ai is one of the fastest-growing AI companies globally, recognised as a leader by leading technology and industry analysts like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, ISG, and Everest. Founded in 2014 by serial successful entrepreneur Raj Koneru, Kore.ai supports customers globally across offices in Orlando, Hyderabad, New York, London, Germany, Dubai, Frankfurt, Tokyo and Seoul.Position OverviewWe are seeking a strategic, results-driven, and highly collaborative Associate Director, Global Partner Marketing – Hyperscaler to lead the development and execution of joint go-to-market strategies with Amazon Web Services (AWS).This role is critical to accelerating Kore.ai’s growth through the AWS ecosystem by building joint marketing plans, driving co-sell and co-marketing motions, strengthening executive and field alignment, and delivering measurable pipeline and revenue impact. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in enterprise technology partner marketing, hyperscaler ecosystems, integrated campaign execution, executive stakeholder management, and global program leadership.This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The candidate should be comfortable defining GTM priorities, managing complex cross-functional initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and driving programs from planning through execution, measurement, and optimisation.Location: India, with Hyderabad or Bangalore preferredRole DescriptionAre you passionate about building high-impact partner marketing programs that drive business outcomes? In this role, you will be responsible for leading Kore.ai’s AWS partner marketing strategy and execution globally, with a focus on building awareness, generating demand, accelerating the pipeline, and strengthening Kore.ai’s presence within the AWS ecosystem.You will work closely with AWS partner marketing, alliances, sales, field marketing, product marketing, solution consulting, and revenue teams to create integrated GTM programs that support joint business priorities. This includes campaign planning, content development, digital demand generation, executive engagement, events, agency management, budget oversight, and performance reporting.Key ResponsibilitiesPartner Marketing Strategy and GTM LeadershipDevelop and lead the global AWS partner marketing strategy aligned to Kore.ai’s business priorities, AWS partnership goals, and regional pipeline objectives.Build quarterly and annual joint marketing plans with AWS, including campaign priorities, target accounts, event strategy, content themes, budget allocation, and success metrics.Integrated Campaign ExecutionLead the planning and execution of integrated partner marketing campaigns across digital, field, event, content, and partner channels.Manage campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, dependencies, and cross-functional execution to drive awareness, demand generation, and pipeline acceleration.Content Development and MessagingDevelop compelling joint value propositions, campaign narratives, messaging frameworks, and solution positioning for AWS-focused initiatives.Lead the creation of co-branded assets, including solution briefs, case studies, whitepapers, blogs, landing pages, webinar content, executive presentations, and sales enablement materials.Digital Marketing and Demand GenerationDrive digital marketing programs through Kore.ai and AWS channels to generate qualified demand and accelerate pipeline.Leverage AWS Partner Central, AWS Marketplace, co-sell programs, MDF opportunities, and partner digital platforms to support joint opportunity creation.Events and Executive EngagementDevelop and execute event strategies aligned to AWS priorities, including AWS re, AWS Summits, partner events, executive briefings, webinars, roundtables, and workshops.Coordinate sponsorships, speaking opportunities, executive participation, customer sessions, attendee acquisition, logistics, and post-event follow-up to drive measurable outcomes.Cross-Functional LeadershipAct as the central marketing lead for AWS-related partner marketing initiatives, ensuring alignment across sales, alliances, product marketing, field marketing, marketing operations, and AWS stakeholders.Build strong relationships with AWS partner marketing, field, alliance, and program teams to identify opportunities for deeper collaboration and joint GTM impact.Budget, Agency, and Vendor ManagementManage AWS partner marketing budgets, MDF programs, agency relationships, vendor execution, and program performance.Ensure all campaigns and events are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned to business objectives, pipeline goals, and ROI expectations.Measurement, Reporting, and OptimizationDefine and track success metrics across awareness, engagement, MQLs, meetings, pipeline influence, sourced pipeline, and revenue impact.Build executive-ready reporting that communicates program outcomes, key learnings, pipeline impact, and recommendations for optimization.Must-Have SkillsQualifications & Skills Required10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with strong experience in partner marketing, alliance marketing, ecosystem marketing, or enterprise technology marketing.Proven ability to develop and execute partner marketing strategies and integrated GTM plans that drive awareness, demand generation, pipeline creation, and revenue impact.Strong understanding of hyperscaler ecosystems, preferably AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, including co-sell, marketplace, MDF, and joint campaign motions.Experience leading digital marketing programs, including campaign planning, lead generation, marketing automation, nurture programs, and performance optimization.Strong content development and storytelling skills, with experience creating B2B assets for executive, business, and technical audiences.Demonstrated experience managing events, including conferences, webinars, workshops, executive briefings, roundtables, and virtual programs.Strong cross-functional collaboration and executive engagement skills, with the ability to work across sales, alliances, product, technical, field marketing, marketing operations, and partner stakeholders.Analytical and project management mindset, with the ability to measure performance, optimize programs, and manage multiple priorities, agencies, vendors, campaigns, and deadlines in a fast-paced global environment.EducationBachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience required.MBA or advanced degree preferred.What We OfferJoin the Kore.ai team and help companies of all sizes simplify the adoption of advanced AI solutions responsibly.   • Create a large basket of quality product line for OEM Customers, channels and global exports to serve their requirements effectively and become a worthy contender for the most preferred brand and vendor in their segments
  • Understand the financial aspects of business to make short term (AOP) and long term strategic business plan(Mission) for sustainable and profitable business
  • Keep close monitoring on financial state of business and take proactive steps to Optimize the existing resources effectively to obtain desired P&L as per the AOP (Annual Operating Plan) and ABP (Annual Business Plan)
  • Work on CAPEX planning and give working capital requirements in advance for smooth functioning of R&D, D&D, Projects and NPD functions
  • Keep control on Operative cost to ensure better gross margin and profitability through enhancement of processes, cost optimization projects and innovation
  • Close monitoring of Project CAPEX and optimize the available project budget for optimum utilization

Customer Excellence

  • Keep self updated on the market activities, trends and competitor strategies pertaining to related products to understand the changing pattern of competition in order to formulate value propositions for customers and the organization
  • Build infrastructure to create awareness of their products in the market through attending different conferences/ exhibitions and simultaneously build relations with existing and new customers for better awareness of products
  • Ensure efficient and effective customer services are rendered for retaining and obtaining better penetration of existing customers; building new customer base; understanding customer demands and product/service desires; developing/maintaining appropriate price points
  • Keep continuous Product research on global market trends and build inhouse capability to endorse customer requirements by improving existing products and developing futuristic products line
  • Make significant contribution in overall revenues and P&L by innovation in design, product development and launching new products as per the OEM customers and market trends

Sales Excellence

  • Build strong relationship with existing customers and increase their intake for existing products and get new order for new product launch of customers and work as business partner for them
  • Explore domestic and international markets to channelize new business opportunities and extend horizontal growth of business along vertical growth with sustainable and long term business model
  • Build After Market sales model to expand the companys presence in channel business and give reach to last mile
  • Develop and maintain long-lasting channel partner relationships; visit key partners regularly as needed and proactively/promptly respond to inquiries, acting as the direct and primary contact.

Quality Excellence

  • Drive quality standards to improve the quality of products and manufacturing system as per the global manufacturing standard
  • Study different global quality standards and competitors benchmark and drive quality team to bring required changes in existing products and ensure same standards have been maintained in new products launch
  • Introduce different quality measurements and control (QMS, SPC, CAPA , POKE-YOKE & COPQ) to keep products quality as per the desired standard and reduce on field warranty (FFR) returns
  • Ensure Quality team is working around TQM pillars to improve quality standard of current production to match with global quality standards and practices.
  • Build Lab Testing facilities and infrastructure to cater Quality assurance of Products

Operations & Process Excellence

  • Manage internal & external processes and functions to support the overall Business goals and strategies, without losing sight of the imperative to continuous growth and scaling the organization in an aggressive manner for next levels of performance
  • Build and execute an effective supply chain management model to sustain tenacity of aggressive business growth requirement of existing and prospective customers globally
  • Guide Project Team to Identify and Maintain right Machine and Technology which will help to produce quality Products in efficient manner also identify right source of machine suppliers
  • Monitor installation of new machinery to improve efficacy of process and work on line realignment, reduce cycle time and other improvement plan to optimize resources
  • Work continuously on automation of different processes to reduce human interventions
  • Ensure effective inventory management for raw materials, WIP and finish goods to reduce impact on working capital
  • Analyze raw materials requirements as per the business plan and build strong network of quality and cost effective pool of vendors and suppliers in domestic and global market
  • Work on integrated IT and CRM implementation which will drive smooth functioning of overall processes and increase the efficiencies of system

People Management

  • Build harmonious and conducive working environment with zero tolerance for any unethical, indiscipline or unrest in manufacturing unit
  • Motivate, monitor and manage team in a high Growth environment
  • Ensure everybody has defined KRAs and KPIs to provide better role clarity and performance measures
  • Close monitoring of team performance and pro actively design to enhance their productivity through Training & development
  • Instilling company values & behaviors as demonstrated habits in the organization

Preferred candidate profile

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelors degree of Engineering, or Technology - Mechanical, Automobile, Production, Industrial engineering or a related discipline.
  • MBA, Masters degree in Administration, specializing in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management or Strategic Management qualification preferred.
  • Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt): Essential for demonstrating expertise in waste reduction, quality control, and manufacturing process optimization.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP): Helpful for managing large-scale cross-functional plant expansions or new vehicle program launches.

Experience

  • 15-20+ years of progressive operations leadership experience.
  • Minimum 5 years in a Chief Operating Officer, Operations Head / Director, or senior executive operations role.
  • Strong experience within Automotive component manufacturing, managing multi plant operations & complex global supply chains.

role: Head of Delivery & Business Transformation – Granary
normalizedText: LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary. Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare. About Granary Granary is the technology and operational backbone powering Reliance Retail’s grocery ecosystem. It enables inventory management, replenishment, fulfillment, supply chain operations, merchandising, pricing, store operations, customer experiences, and omnichannel commerce across JioMart and grocery retail channels. Role Overview We are seeking a strategic leader to drive delivery excellence, business transformation, and platform execution for Granary. This role will lead large-scale business-critical initiatives spanning supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, merchandising, commerce, store operations, and customer experience platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with retail domain expertise, product mindset, and the ability to influence senior business stakeholders. The leader will be responsible for translating business priorities into scalable platform capabilities while ensuring operational excellence, predictable execution, and measurable business outcomes. What will you do at Fynd? Business & Transformation Leadership Partner with Reliance Retail business leaders to define and execute strategic transformation initiatives. Drive modernization and optimization across grocery operations and digital commerce capabilities. Identify opportunities to improve inventory productivity, fulfillment efficiency, customer experience, and operational excellence. Translate business objectives into executable platform roadmaps. Delivery Leadership Own delivery of strategic programs across the Granary ecosystem. Establish governance frameworks and delivery operating models. Ensure programs meet quality, timeline, budget, and business outcome commitments. Drive Agile and product-centric ways of working. Product & Platform Execution Collaborate with Product leadership to shape platform capabilities. Drive alignment between business priorities and platform investments. Support roadmap planning, prioritization, and execution. Enable platform scalability, resilience, and operational readiness. Some Specific Requirements Required 15+ years of experience in Delivery, Transformation, Product, or Program Leadership roles. Experience managing large-scale enterprise platforms. Strong understanding of retail, grocery, supply chain, commerce, or omnichannel ecosystems. Experience managing multi-team, multi-vendor programs. Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills. Preferred Grocery retail domain experience. Experience with inventory, fulfillment, supply chain, or commerce platforms. Product management exposure. Experience in platform modernization initiatives. Exposure to data, AI, and operational analytics. What do we offer? Growth Growth knows no bounds, as we foster an environment that encourages creativity, embraces challenges, and cultivates a culture of continuous expansion. We are looking at new product lines, international markets and brilliant people to grow even further. We teach, groom and nurture our people to become leaders. You get to grow with a company that is growing exponentially. Flex University We help you upskill by organising in-house courses on important subjects Learning Wallet: You can also do an external course to upskill and grow, we reimburse it for you. Culture We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections. Regular community engagement and team-building activities Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture Wellness Mediclaim policy for you + parents + spouse + kids Experienced therapist for better mental health, improve productivity & work-life balance We work from the office 5 days a week to promote collaboration and teamwork. Join us to make an impact in an engaging, in-person environment!

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationDelhi Full job description Lead – AI, Platform Excellence & Digital Academy Location: Delhi ITO (Work from Office) Experience: 8–15 Years Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for a visionary Lead – AI, Platform Excellence & Digital Academy to drive AI adoption, platform excellence, and continuous learning across our website production teams. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about website-building platforms, Generative AI, digital enablement, and building scalable learning ecosystems. You will play a key role in transforming how websites are designed, built, and delivered through AI-powered workflows, certifications, and operational innovation. Key Responsibilities Website Platform Excellence Build deep expertise across website platforms such as Duda, Wix Studio, Wix Editor, WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Mono, and emerging AI website builders. Monitor product updates and evaluate new features. Develop platform standards, best practices, and internal documentation. Drive builder certification programs and knowledge-sharing initiatives. AI Enablement & Innovation Lead the adoption of Generative AI tools across production teams. Evaluate and implement AI solutions to improve productivity and quality. Build prompt libraries, AI workflows, and reusable automation frameworks. Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and recommend their adoption. Learning & Digital Academy Design and manage structured learning programs for production teams. Develop onboarding journeys, certifications, workshops, and role-based learning paths. Create engaging learning experiences using videos, live sessions, AI simulations, and microlearning. Process Improvement Partner with Operations to improve production efficiency and quality. Identify opportunities for automation and workflow optimization. Pilot innovative ideas and scale successful initiatives across teams. Knowledge Management Maintain a centralized knowledge repository including SOPs, playbooks, platform guides, prompt libraries, and troubleshooting documentation. Thought Leadership Represent the organization through webinars, industry events, blogs, and LinkedIn. Share insights on AI, website platforms, and digital innovation. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–15 years of experience in SaaS, website platforms, digital enablement, technical education, or related domains. Strong expertise in one or more website-building platforms such as Duda, Wix Studio, WordPress, Shopify, or Mono. Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Canva AI, Figma AI, Perplexity, NotebookLM, or similar technologies. Experience in designing learning programs, certifications, or enablement initiatives. Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for continuous learning and emerging technologies. Preferred Background We prefer candidates from website builder platforms, customer education, technical enablement, digital transformation, solutions consulting, or AI adoption roles. Why Join Us? Work at the forefront of AI-driven website production. Build large-scale learning and innovation programs. Collaborate with high-performing cross-functional teams. Drive organization-wide transformation through technology and AI. Opportunity to shape the future of digital production at scale.

jdEvidence.value: Drive growth and optimize operations across product, pricing, revenue streams, marketing, customer engagement, and analytics to increase profitability and expand the business.
Direct P&L and revenue responsibility, with specific targets for increasing margins, optimizing pricing for profit, identifying new revenue streams, and increasing Average Bill Value (ABV).

normalizedText: Product and Category Management: Scrutinize existing purchase data to determine category-wise margins. Plan and implement strategies to increase the margin contribution of private labels. Coordinate with OEMs for private label products, setting targets for product launches and monitoring progress over three billing cycles. Optimize procurement of own brand and FMCG categories to reduce costs and increase margins by at least 5%. Pricing and Promotions: Optimize pricing strategies to maximize profit without compromising sales. Design and coordinate promotional schemes and offers, ensuring they align with market demand and enhance margin benefits. Revenue Streams: Review and revise franchise models for optimized performance. Identify and develop new revenue streams including B2B partnerships, private label distribution, and rental opportunities. Explore and suggest allied activities (e.g., laundry, test services, pharmacy) to diversify revenue. Plan and implement multi-store expansion strategies. Marketing and Customer Engagement: Develop and implement loyalty programs to increase Average Bill Value (ABV). Analyze and refine store planograms to focus on high-margin SKUs, aiming for a 30% increase in top-line sales. Execute strategies to increase gross margins by 5-7% within three billing cycles. Oversee rebranding efforts, including signage, shelf talkers, and promotional sales. Data, MIS, and Analytics: Implement and maintain an MIS dashboard (DPR/WPR/MPR) for real-time data monitoring. Develop key metrics (e.g., per sqft sales, retention rate) for management and investor reporting. Review and standardize unit economics, fund flow, and business plans to support scaling efforts. Customer Analytics and Experience: Utilize RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) and MBA (Market Basket Analysis) to enhance customer retention and increase ABV. Implement affinity marketing strategies and personalized offers based on customer data. Standardize customer touchpoints and experiences across both offline and online channels. Forecasting and Inventory Management: Analyze the impact of different marketing and pricing initiatives on sales. Develop a balanced product and brand mix tailored to each store location. Implement effective inventory management strategies to minimize out-of-stock situations and reduce inventory aging. Competitive Analysis and Strategic Positioning: Conduct regular competitive analysis to benchmark best practices and identify areas of improvement. Define and promote the company s Unique Selling Proposition (USP) to ensure brand success and scalability. Skills and Qualifications: Strong background in retail operations and growth strategy with experience in new-age FMCG retail companies Experience in product and category management, with a focus on D2C Brand connects and private labels. Proficient in data analysis, customer analytics, and financial forecasting with knowledge of Excel and Financial Models. Ability to design and implement effective pricing, marketing, and revenue strategies. Leadership skills to manage multi-store operations and cross-functional teams. Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities

normalizedText: As the Sr. VP Head of Enterprise Business, you will own and scale IndiaMART’s Enterprise segment through its next growth curve. This is a 1–10 mandate — the early structure exists, but the business is yet to find product-market fit and scale meaningfully. This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a scaled machine.IndiaMART’s core business serves MSMEs. The Enterprise segment targets customers with turnover of ₹500 Cr and above, including Indian corporates and MNCs operating in India.Your first responsibility will be to find product-market fit for this segment, and then to scale aggressively.The ideal candidate is a builder, not just a seller. You will operate as a vertical head with full P&L ownership — setting segment strategy, partnering with product to shape the offering, hiring and building the team across India, and bringing a product-led-growth mindset to the vertical.The role carries significant autonomy, reporting directly to the CEO.1. P&L Ownership & GTM Strategy• Own end-to-end P&L for the vertical — revenue, profitability, unit economics, marketing and investment decisions.• Define the Enterprise business strategy: target customer profile within the ₹500 Cr+ universe, value proposition, pricing, packaging, and GTM model.• Build the multi-year business case for Enterprise as a meaningful revenue contributor to IndiaMART.• Make sharp prioritization calls on where to play (industry verticals, deal sizes, buyer personas) and, equally importantly, where not to play.2. Product-Market Fit & Product Partnership• Lead the search for product-market fit in the Enterprise segment. The current IndiaMART product is built for MSMEs; the assumption is that the Enterprise customer needs something different.• Lead a small team of product strategists embedded in the business who translate customer signals into product requirements.• Partner closely with the central product & tech team to define, prioritize, and build Enterprise-oriented product capabilities.3. normalizedText: About the Role The global economy is being transformed around more powerful customer experiences. The companies that win in this new environment are going to be the ones that understand the customer experience the best. In order to tell the customer experience, one must have a deep understanding of the customer journey. Reporting to the Vice President, Customer Experience, this exciting role encompasses the design and creation of powerful narratives on key sectors targeted toward clients. The position is responsible for developing content for a sector/sectors that will leverage inputs from a global team of Analysts and Consultants across Frost Sullivan s operations. Content created will then be leveraged for targeted marketing campaigns, social media, and account-based marketing. You will be required to demonstrate strong writing, analytical and stakeholder management skills. Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.Toast is the all-in-one restaurant technology platform built for the demands of the restaurant and hospitality industries. From independent operators to global enterprise chains with thousands of locations, Toast powers the full guest and operator experience — point of sale, kitchen display, payroll, analytics, and beyond. We serve over 160,000 restaurant locations and are growing rapidly in the enterprise and international segments.Our Enterprise segment partners with the world's largest restaurant and hospitality brands to modernize their technology stack and deliver the operational intelligence they need to run complex, multi-location operations at scale. Our Bengaluru R&D hub is a first-class part of that storyWe are looking for a Director of Product Management to own and drive consequential charters within Toast Enterprise Core Platform. This is not a contributing role — it is full charter ownership, end-to-end. At this level, you are expected to operate with the scope and strategic impact while remaining deeply hands-on with the product. You will be based in Bengaluru and embedded in our India R&D organization, with meaningful partnership with product, engineering, go-to-market, and customer teams across the company.Toast's largest enterprise customers require features that cut across multiple engineering codebases — features that no single platform team owns end-to-end. The Away Team exists to build those features: shipping enterprise capabilities inside codebases owned by other Toast teams, on behalf of customers whose operational requirements don't fit neatly into any single away team's roadmap.This is a cross-cutting, complex, and high-leverage product charter critical to our success. Full charter ownership here means you define what gets built, in which system, with what sequencing — and you hold the accountability for delivery across all of it.Why This RoleFull ownership, not a slice. You own two complete charters, end-to-end. The Away Team and Enterprise Reporting are yours to define, drive, and deliver — with the scope and strategic altitude that comes with the director level at the company. Genuinely unsolved problems. The cross-codebase delivery model and enterprise analytics vision are not solved problems at Toast. You will be writing the playbook, not executing one that already exists. Customers that run at scale. The enterprise brands on our customer list operate hundreds to thousands of locations worldwide. Your roadmap decisions directly affect how those businesses run. Bengaluru is a first-class org. The Away Team is based here. Toast's India R&D hub has full product and engineering ownership — this is not offshore execution. You will be at the center of it. Visibility to executive leadership. The Enterprise segment is a company-level priority. This role has direct exposure to VP/GM leadership and regular involvement in executive-level roadmap and strategy discussions. India hours, global impact. You will operate primarily from Bengaluru, owning product that runs in markets across the US and internationally — with the credibility and organizational standing to match. A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.Drive cross-codebase delivery. Partner with engineering and product owners across Toast's platform teams to ship enterprise features in their systems. Navigate competing roadmaps, set clear success criteria, and hold delivery against contractual commitments. Define the enterprise reporting vision. Understand deeply how multi-location restaurant operators measure performance and make decisions. Translate that understanding into a multi-year roadmap for enterprise-grade reporting — one that positions Toast as the data platform our largest customers depend on. Represent enterprise customers at the highest level. You will be the PM voice for some of the world's largest restaurant and hospitality brands in roadmap discussions, cross-functional reviews, and executive conversations. These are customers with signed contractual commitments and high expectations. Operate across Bengaluru and the US. Partner daily with engineering, UX, solutions, go-to-market, and customer success across Bengaluru and US-based teams. This role requires consistent US Eastern Time overlap. Contribute to Enterprise strategy. Your two charters — cross-platform delivery and analytics — sit at the intersection of every other Enterprise product charter. You will have a seat at the table on long-range planning, investment decisions, and what Enterprise looks like in three years. What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in enterprise or B2B SaaS — specifically owning complex product surface areas, not contributing to themStrong ability to hire, develop, and lead high-performing teamsTrack record of driving delivery that required cross-team coordination across engineering organizations that did not report to you. Influence without authority is core to this role. Experience owning analytics, reporting, or data platform products — with a clear point of view on what makes enterprise reporting genuinely differentiated vs. table stakes. Exceptional written communication. You move decisions forward with documents; you don't wait for meetings to create alignment. Ability to maintain occasional US Eastern Time overlap (approximately 5:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST). Comfort with ambiguity at the charter level — you have shaped product direction from scratch, not just executed against someone else's vision. Commercial instincts. You understand how product decisions translate into revenue, retention, and customer value, and you make prioritization decisions accordingly. PreferredBackground in restaurant technology, hospitality, retail, or an adjacent industry with multi-location or franchise business model complexity. Experience working in or alongside India-based engineering teams as part of a global product organization. Familiarity with data infrastructure, analytics engineering, or enterprise BI tooling at scale. Experience managing product commitments that are tied to enterprise contracts or MSAs. The Away Team and Enterprise Reporting are yours to define, drive, and deliver — with the scope and strategic altitude that comes with the director level at the company. Genuinely unsolved problems. The cross-codebase delivery model and enterprise analytics vision are not solved problems at Toast. You will be writing the playbook, not executing one that already exists. Customers that run at scale. The enterprise brands on our customer list operate hundreds to thousands of locations worldwide. Your roadmap decisions directly affect how those businesses run. Bengaluru is a first-class org. The Away Team is based here. Toast's India R&D hub has full product and engineering ownership — this is not offshore execution. You will be at the center of it. Visibility to executive leadership. The Enterprise segment is a company-level priority. This role has direct exposure to VP/GM leadership and regular involvement in executive-level roadmap and strategy discussions. India hours, global impact. You will operate primarily from Bengaluru, owning product that runs in markets across the US and internationally — with the credibility and organizational standing to match. A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.Drive cross-codebase delivery. Partner with engineering and product owners across Toast's platform teams to ship enterprise features in their systems. Navigate competing roadmaps, set clear success criteria, and hold delivery against contractual commitments. Define the enterprise reporting vision. Understand deeply how multi-location restaurant operators measure performance and make decisions. Translate that understanding into a multi-year roadmap for enterprise-grade reporting — one that positions Toast as the data platform our largest customers depend on. Represent enterprise customers at the highest level. You will be the PM voice for some of the world's largest restaurant and hospitality brands in roadmap discussions, cross-functional reviews, and executive conversations. These are customers with signed contractual commitments and high expectations. Operate across Bengaluru and the US. Partner daily with engineering, UX, solutions, go-to-market, and customer success across Bengaluru and US-based teams. This role requires consistent US Eastern Time overlap. Contribute to Enterprise strategy. Your two charters — cross-platform delivery and analytics — sit at the intersection of every other Enterprise product charter. You will have a seat at the table on long-range planning, investment decisions, and what Enterprise looks like in three years. Influence without authority is core to this role. Experience owning analytics, reporting, or data platform products — with a clear point of view on what makes enterprise reporting genuinely differentiated vs. table stakes. Exceptional written communication. You move decisions forward with documents; you don't wait for meetings to create alignment. Ability to maintain occasional US Eastern Time overlap (approximately 5:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST). Comfort with ambiguity at the charter level — you have shaped product direction from scratch, not just executed against someone else's vision. Commercial instincts. You understand how product decisions translate into revenue, retention, and customer value, and you make prioritization decisions accordingly. Experience working in or alongside India-based engineering teams as part of a global product organization. Familiarity with data infrastructure, analytics engineering, or enterprise BI tooling at scale. Experience managing product commitments that are tied to enterprise contracts or MSAs. role: Strategy & Planning, Finance Team, Vice President

jdEvidence.value: Global Head of Corporate Strategy and FP&A
Financial strategy, planning, reporting, and analytics for BlackRock firm-wide and JioBlackRock, advising senior leadership on financial objectives and strategic initiatives.

normalizedText: About This RoleBusiness Unit Overview:Finance and Strategy is critical to BlackRock for profitable growth. The team shapes long-term objectives for growth and scale; guides near-term objectives, resource allocations and budgets; analyzes business metrics to identify growth and scale opportunities; and brings insights to help successfully manage our financial objectives amidst a dynamic business environment. We are at the center of the firm, working across all levels of BlackRock to provide both a broad and deep understanding of the firm’s business and financial position and opportunities.Role DescriptionWithin the Finance and Strategy group, BlackRock is seeking a Vice President to join the Strategic Finance team in Mumbai. The Strategic Finance team is responsible for overall financial strategy of the firm and rolls up to the Global Head of Corporate Strategy and FP&A. The team also works closely with the Financial Information and Analytics (FI&A) team which operates with a Center of Excellence (CoE) model and is responsible for efficient, thoughtful, and scalable production to meet operational excellence, deliver high-value business insights through front-end visualization tools, application of modelling and analytics to generate new insights at scale, engage with technology partners to accelerate data and process transformation. The group is also responsible for engaging with business partners to advise and offer expertise on the fundamental building blocks of how we manage the firm and bring insights from our financials.This proposed role is envisioned to have 3 parts to it:Firm wide Reporting, Analytics and Strategy: Working with the global strategic finance and FP&A team on overall BlackRock firm wide long-range forecasts and planning process, board presentations, as well as strategic projects, investment and growth priorities, and analytics (using different types of financial and business metrics to generate insights for the most senior leaders at the firm incl. Global CFO). Key target outcome here will be to have a step jump in the strategic finance work which happens out of India and add overall value to the firm. This will also involve driving forward key CoE priorities of FI&A team to being in efficiency as the firm scales towards 2030 strategy.JioBlackRock: Working front-end with JioBLK teams (asset management, wealth management and brokerage) in Mumbai and helping them set up the right building blocks for Finance and Strategy. This will involve engaging directly with CEO, CXOs and other leaders at JioBlackRock applying a shareholder lens i.e. advising and reviewing business plans, managing capital requirements / cash burn levels, setting right reporting frameworks and being a thought partner to global business leaders at BlackRock ensuring right oversight and pursuing select strategy/ change management initiatives.Select strategy projects / building India as a platform: Working with India leadership on other special projects from time to timeKey ResponsibilitiesFoster and develop strong business partnering relationships, becoming a trusted advisor to the CXOs, business and finance stakeholdersDevelop and maintain financial models to provide accurate and timely insights into business performance, robust long-term planning, and scenario analysisConduct in-depth analysis of business and financial results highlighting key drivers and present analysis in a clear and concise manner appropriate for senior leadershipOversee periodic financial reports (i.e., weekly, monthly, quarterly) for senior management; includes quarterly earnings support, Board of Directors presentations, and firm forecast / budgetDelivering data-driven insights and recommendations to influence key business decisionsDrive enhancement, automation, and scalability in processes and reportingManage a high-performing team, providing mentorship and clear direction to drive excellenceBe hands-on in executing the key priorities along with the people manager responsibilitiesCollaborate with cross-functional partners and other Finance & Strategy sub-teamsDrive a collaborative and supportive work environment, coaching and developing team membersSkills & QualificationsChartered Accountant (first attempt or rank mandatory) with 8-12 years of post-qualification experience in financial due diligence or top tier management consulting or innovate tech organization with strategy/ finance experience or premier asset managerMBA in Finance from top tier institution, CFA from CFA Institute USA (both preferred but optional)Strong problem solving and first principle thinkingExperience in engaging with CXOs with ability to articular well in verbal and written communicationExperience in building and managing high performance teams and grooming young talentStrong commercial and business mindset with ability to identify key drivers moving the needle on top and bottom lineStrong command of data analytics, financial modeling, and scenario planningAbility to manage fragmentation in a fast paced environmentHigh intent to perform and ownershipCollaborative to be able to navigate through the organizationExperience with driving tech transformation and AI initiatives in past organizations a big plusStrong proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skillsOur BenefitsTo help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.Our hybrid work modelBlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.Guidance on AI use for candidatesAt BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. role: VP Retail Marketing Strategy and Brand Partnerships
normalizedText: Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. Job Title Vice President – Retail Marketing strategy, Brand Partnership & Events Business / Function International Wealth & Personal Banking / Global Banking & Markets Location [Mumbai India] Grade GCB 5 Job Introduction The Global Marketing function is focused on supporting the strategic and revenue growth priorities of the Bank. The function focuses on understanding customers and the identification, development and execution of Marketing strategies, campaigns and activities that support and strengthen the HSBC brand, support the drive for revenue and increase customer value and satisfaction in order to meet agreed targets and objectives at both a global and market level.This role will be responsible to bring new Brand partners, create long term Intellectual properties(IPs), strategy and framework for delivery of all events, third party sponsorships and the coordination of all activities to drive Brand recall, acquire new customers and engage with existing customers for HSBC Wealth & Personal Banking business in India.Principal Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of HSBC India’s brand partnership strategy to strengthen brand equity, deepen customer engagement and drive commercial outcomes across priority businesses. Identify, evaluate and negotiate strategic partnerships across sports, entertainment, fashion, travel, luxury, culture, technology and lifestyle that enhance HSBC’s brand proposition and create differentiated customer value. Build and manage a portfolio of signature HSBC-owned intellectual properties (IPs) and flagship experiences that reinforce the bank’s positioning and support customer acquisition, engagement and retention. Develop integrated content strategies that amplify campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, ensuring consistency of brand messaging and measurable business impact. Lead the conceptualisation and delivery of premium client experiences, large-scale events and sponsorship activations, ensuring world-class execution and alignment with HSBC’s global brand standards. Work closely with business teams including Wealth & Premier Banking, Credit Cards, Commercial Banking and Corporate Communications to translate business priorities into impactful marketing programmes. Collaborate with global, regional and local stakeholders to identify opportunities to localise global partnerships and maximise their relevance for the Indian market. Establish strategic relationships with leading rights holders, agencies, creators, media partners and event organisers to unlock innovative collaboration opportunities. Drive end-to-end management of sponsorships and partnerships, including commercial negotiations, governance, activation planning, legal and compliance coordination, measurement and reporting. Lead content creation across multiple formats including digital, social, experiential, video and thought leadership, ensuring relevance to target customer segments and HSBC’s brand positioning. Develop measurement frameworks and KPIs to evaluate partnership effectiveness, event ROI, customer engagement, brand health and commercial impact, using insights to optimise future investments. Manage annual budgets, procurement processes and agency partnerships to ensure efficient allocation of resources and delivery against agreed objectives. Ensure all marketing activities comply with HSBC’s governance, regulatory, legal, risk and brand requirements. Stay abreast of emerging consumer trends, cultural movements, technology innovations and partnership opportunities to continuously evolve HSBC India’s marketing capabilities. Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability and execution excellence. Key Success Measures Brand consideration and perception improvement. Growth in customer acquisition and engagement through partnerships. Commercial impact generated from sponsorships and partner programmes. ROI and effectiveness of events and experiential marketing. Reach and engagement of integrated content campaigns. Successful delivery of flagship HSBC IPs and customer experiences. Stakeholder satisfaction across business, regional and global teams. Strong governance, risk management and budget optimisation. Role Requirements / Qualification / Experience Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business priorities into differentiated brand, partnership and experiential marketing strategies. Proven capability to originate, negotiate and manage high-value strategic partnerships with leading brands, rights holders, agencies and commercial partners. Strong commercial acumen with experience demonstrating measurable business outcomes, customer acquisition, engagement and return on marketing investment. Deep understanding of affluent and wealth customer segments, premium consumer behaviour and luxury marketing. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders across local, regional and global teams. Demonstrated leadership in delivering integrated marketing programmes across digital, content, events, sponsorships and customer experiences. Strong negotiation, influencing and contract management capabilities. Experience managing multiple agencies, production partners and cross-functional teams in a highly matrixed organisation. Ability to balance creativity with governance, regulatory requirements, risk management and brand compliance. Strong analytical mindset with experience using customer insights and campaign performance metrics to drive optimisation. Exceptional communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills. Ability to lead through ambiguity while managing multiple high-profile initiatives simultaneously. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline. MBA or Postgraduate qualification from a reputed institution preferred. Professional certifications in Marketing, Brand Strategy, Digital Marketing or Sponsorship Management would be advantageous. Strong understanding of financial services marketing and regulatory requirements is desirable. Experience 12–15+ years of progressive experience in strategic marketing, brand management, partnerships, sponsorships, content or experiential marketing. Demonstrated success in leading large-scale integrated marketing campaigns with measurable commercial impact. Proven track record of developing and commercialising strategic partnerships across sectors such as sports, entertainment, travel, luxury, fashion, technology or lifestyle. Experience leading premium customer experiences, flagship events and sponsorship activations from strategy through execution. Experience managing significant marketing budgets and driving optimisation based on ROI and performance metrics. Strong experience working with senior executives, external partners and global stakeholders. Prior experience within banking, financial services, premium consumer brands or multinational organisations is highly preferred. Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams in a matrix environment. Demonstrated ability to build and scale proprietary brand IPs that enhance customer engagement and brand differentiation. Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.Additional Information Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required. normalizedText: IntroductionUniversity of the People (UoPeople) is the first non-profit, tuition-free, American, accredited, 100% online university. Today, UoPeople has over 170,000 students enrolled from more than 200 countries and territories, including 18,800 students who are refugees. UoPeople is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC).We believe that higher education is a basic human right and that it can transform not only the lives of students, but also their families’ lives, their communities, their nations, and, by extension, the world. See President Reshef’s TED Talk when he announced the founding of the University.UoPeople is an innovative university, and we welcome team members who bring creativity and innovation to their roles. We’re a fast-paced organization with remote teams all around the globe. If you’re a self-starter who wants to succeed alongside a passionate team, we’d love to hear from you!UoPeople is supported by the generosity of individuals and foundations, including the Gates, Hewlett, Ford Foundations, Foundation Hoffmann, and others. The University has been covered by The New York Times, BBC, NPR, Times Higher Education, U.S. News & World Report, and many other leading media outlets. President Reshef’s TED Talk and Nas Daily interview about the University have more than 30 million combined views.General purposeThe Chief Information Officer (CIO) is responsible for leading the University’s global information systems and technologies and defining the strategy that enables the University’s mission and long-term growth.Reporting to the President, the CIO oversees all Information systems and technology functions, including Product Management, Engineering, Data & Analytics, AI transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and IT Operations. The CIO ensures that all Information Systems remain secure, scalable, resilient, innovative, and aligned with the University’s strategic priorities while delivering outstanding experience for students, faculty, and staff worldwide.We are seeking an accomplished executive who has previously served as Chief Information Officer in a global, mature, service-oriented organization with significant operational complexity.Essential functions & responsibilitiesOrganizational Leadership - Lead and develop a global organization of ~50 professionals, building strong leadership capability, succession depth, and a high-performance culture. Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment across distributed teams.As a member of the executive team, partner closely with the President to advance strategic, business, and cultural priorities, ensuring alignment across functions and geographies.Information System Leadership - Define and execute a university-wide information systems strategy aligned with institutional goals. Establish a clear multi-year roadmap driving growth, innovation, and operational excellence while modernizing the ecosystem with strong governance, architecture standards, and best practices. Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on strategy, risk, and opportunities.Product Management - Lead end-to-end ownership of internally developed systems across their lifecycle, from design through continuous enhancement. Define aligned roadmaps, drive ongoing improvement, and partner with academic and business leaders to deliver meaningful outcomes for students, faculty, and staff.Software Engineering & Enterprise Applications - Oversee engineering, QA, DevOps, and enterprise applications, ensuring modern practices, scalable architecture, and reliable delivery. Drive modernization, cloud adoption, and platform optimization, and guide build, buy, or partner decisions through clear value and ROI analysis.AI Transformation - Lead AI strategy and implementation aligned with institutional priorities and responsible use. Assess and deploy solutions across academic and administrative functions to enhance decision-making, efficiency, and experience, supported by strong governance and integration.Data, Analytics - Define and execute the enterprise data strategy, establishing governance, quality, and security while building scalable analytics capabilities that enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.Infrastructure, IT Operations & Cybersecurity - Lead the global information systems environment, including infrastructure, cloud, networks, and end-user services. Ensure secure, resilient, and reliable operations, with strong cybersecurity, privacy, and continuity capabilities, and full compliance with regulations and standards.Vendor Management - Lead vendor strategy and partnerships, overseeing procurement, selection, contracting, and performance. Govern the investment portfolio to optimize cost, quality, and resilience.Key competenciesStrategic Enterprise Leadership – Translates institutional vision into clear, actionable information systems strategy.Executive Influence & Stakeholder Partnership – Serves as a trusted advisor and aligns senior leaders around priorities and decisions.Innovation & Future Orientation – Curiosity and forward-thinking mindset to identify emerging opportunities (e.g., AI, digital capabilities) and translate them into practical value.Transformation & Change Leadership – Leads complex, organization-wide change and drives adoption at scale.Organizational & Talent Leadership – Builds, develops, and sustains high-performing global teams and leadership pipelines.Business & Value Orientation – Connects investments to outcomes, prioritizes effectively, and ensures measurable institutional impact.Financial & Value Management Mindset – Ability to connect investments to outcomes, optimize costs, and clearly articulate value and ROI at the enterprise level.Risk, Governance & Ethical Leadership – Strong sense of accountability for governance, risk management, security, and responsible use of data and emerging technologies.QualificationsBachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.20+ years of progressive leadership experience in information systems, including executive-level accountability.Prior experience as a CIO (or equivalent) in a mid-to-large, global organization, with end-to-end responsibility for enterprise systems and digital capabilities.Proven ability to define and execute enterprise strategies that drive organizational growth, innovation, and measurable business impact.Demonstrated success leading transformation in complex, customer-facing (B2C) environments, with strong stakeholder alignment and Change Leadership.Strong advantage: experience in EdTech or education-focused organizations, with an understanding of digital learning platforms, student-centric solutions, and the evolving higher education landscape. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description About the Company: Capwise Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. (CFSPL) is a boutique investment bank providing comprehensive financial advisory services across sectors in India. Since our inception in 2020, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing investment banks in Mumbai, having successfully closed 35 equity and M&A transactions and raised ₹22,000 crore in debt. Our services span across debt syndication, private equity, M&A advisory, and capital markets. Role Overview: We are looking for a seasoned professional to lead our Debt Capital Markets (DCM) vertical. The role involves full ownership of origination, structuring, execution, and closure of DCM transactions including structured finance, project finance, acquisition finance, and refinancing. The ideal candidate will bring deep lender relationships, proven deal-making ability, strong leadership, and a track record of delivering large-ticket transactions. Key Responsibilities: Transaction Execution: Drive execution of debt transactions including term loan syndication, structured finance, refinancing, securitization, and acquisition finance. Oversee the preparation of detailed proposals, project reports, CMA data, and Information Memorandums (IMs). Ensure timely execution and closure of transactions, coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders. Lender Relationships & Syndication: Maintain and expand a strong network with Banks, NBFCs, Financial Institutions, and Mutual Funds. Liaise with lenders to secure approvals and ensure smooth disbursement processes. Lead negotiations on terms, pricing, and documentation. Credit Appraisal & Financial Analysis: Evaluate business models and perform detailed financial and credit analysis. Review and guide the development of robust financial models. Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines and bank credit norms. Origination & Business Development: Identify and originate new debt syndication and structured finance mandates. Build and nurture client relationships across industries. Strategize and lead client pitches to win mandates. Leadership & Team Management: Lead and mentor a high-performing team across origination and execution. Provide guidance on project evaluation, structuring, and market strategy. Foster a collaborative, agile, and target-driven team culture. Required Skills: 15+ years of relevant experience in debt syndication, project finance, or structured finance. Deep network across banks, NBFCs, and FIs. Strong financial acumen with hands-on experience in credit appraisal and structuring. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong sense of ownership. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and lead end-to-end deal execution. Qualifications: Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA (Finance), or equivalent qualification. 15+ years of experience in Debt Syndication, Investment Banking, or Corporate Finance with strong lender and client network. Why Join Capwise: Take charge of a high-impact vertical with complete ownership of strategy, team, and outcomes. Be part of a dynamic and fast-growing investment bank that has closed marquee deals in a short span of time. Enjoy the agility and autonomy of a boutique setup with the backing of experienced leadership. Work on a wide range of complex and innovative transactions across sectors and structures. Your performance and initiative are directly recognized and rewarded at Capwise.

role: Senior Process Management Specialist (Six Sigma Certified)

jdEvidence.value: Lead large-scale process transformation initiatives and drive continuous improvement using Lean Six Sigma methodologies.

normalizedText: Position Overview: We are seeking a Senior Process Management Specialist with demonstrated expertise in driving large-scale process transformation initiatives across complex, service-driven environments. This role requires a strategic thinker with deep knowledge of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, capable of influencing operational performance, delivering measurable outcomes, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. As a senior contributor, you will collaborate closely with leadership teams across functions to identify business process inefficiencies, lead cross-functional improvement projects, and create scalable frameworks to support business growth and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities: Lead enterprise-level business process re-engineering (BPR) and transformation initiatives aligned with organizational goals. Champion the deployment of Lean/Six Sigma tools to drive sustainable process improvements across multiple business units. Conduct in-depth diagnostics using tools such as Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, process mapping, and value stream analysis. Develop and track critical KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics to measure the effectiveness of implemented solutions. Partner with senior leadership, department heads, and functional teams to drive process standardization and governance. Own the creation and implementation of SOPs, operational playbooks, and best practice frameworks. Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new processes, systems, and tools. Mentor junior team members and facilitate regular training/workshops on continuous improvement methodologies. Continuously evaluate market/industry trends and internal data to identify new opportunities for process innovation. Required Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or related field (masters degree preferred). Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification is required; Black Belt preferred. 510 years of experience in process improvement, operations, or business excellence roles, preferably in retail, services, or multi-location businesses. Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional projects with measurable ROI and process impact. Shape Preferred Skills & Competencies: Hands-on experience with BPM tools (e.g., MS Visio, ARIS, Bizagi, Lucid chart). Strong working knowledge of ISO standards, Kaizen, Agile, or Lean transformation frameworks. Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Advanced proficiency in data-driven decision-making tools including MS Excel, Power BI, and statistical tools (Minitab, R, or Python is a plus). Strong interpersonal skills with a consultative approach to problem-solving and stakeholder alignment. Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business challenges into process-based solutions.

normalizedText: Job description:Position Description As part of Wipro’s Technology Services Global Business Line (GBL), the Technology Transformation & Managed Service unit simplifies how we solution, deliver, and scale- enabling stronger, more consistent outcomes across our service lines. Our focus is to strengthen go-to-market alignment and execution, helping us win and deliver complex transformation programs through platform-based, specialized solutions. We create an “Experience Continuum” for clients and convert “Wins” that are “Profitable and Deliverable” for Wipro.R͏ole Summary: We are looking for a digitally native, AI-first marketing professional with 8–10 years of experience who can operate at the intersection of strategy, content, branding, demand generation and intelligent automation.In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, demand generation, and stakeholder engagement. normalizedText: Position summary Lead and own the commercial and marketing strategy for an integrated DRI-to-rolling steel plant, driving volume, margin and market share for Sponge Iron, Billets, TMT bars and related products across Odisha and nearby states. Key responsibilitiesStrategy & planning: Develop and execute the annual and 3-year commercial strategy for product lines (Sponge Iron, Billets, TMT bars), including market segmentation, pricing strategy, trade terms, and channel mix.Market development: Map demand, identify high-potential accounts and create plans to grow share in Odisha, West Bengal, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and nearby markets.Sales & distribution management: Build and manage an efficient distribution network , set channel policies, and implement target-based incentives and credit norms.Key account management: Own relationships with large buyers such as construction conglomerates, infrastructure companies, steel fabricators, merchant traders, negotiate long-term contracts and bulk-supply agreements.Pricing & commercial terms: Set dynamic pricing, discounts, freight and payment terms to protect margins while maintaining competitiveness in spot and contract markets.Demand-supply coordination: Work closely with production, logistics, and quality teams to align off-take plans, manage stock, schedule dispatches, and minimize demurrage and delivery failures.Branding & customer communication: Position the plants products in target markets through trade promotions, product certifications, technical seminars, and participation in trade fairs and industry forums.Market intelligence & reporting: Maintain market price trackers, competitor intelligence, raw-material/resale trends, and provide weekly/monthly commercial analytics and sales forecasts to senior management.Compliance: Ensure trade practices, documentation, invoicing, GST compliance, weighbridge reconciliation, and credit controls meet company policies and statutory norms; About The TeamThe Strategy and Transformation team for the Field Operations organization at Uber sets the vision and strategy for Field Ops, runs agent operations, undertakes our most complex and transformative projects, and drives the optimization of our global operations. We execute this future-state vision across five core pillars: Special Projects, Strategy and Programs, Business Planning and Improvement, Transformation, and Analytics. Within Transformation, we act as the catalyst for large-scale structural change, redefining our operating models, optimizing our global footprint, and fostering a high-performance culture that empowers our globally distributed workforce to thrive.About The RoleAs the Head of Transformation, you will lead the Transformation Office for the entire Field Ops organization. You will be the central force driving our most critical organizational shifts, taking ownership of key workstreams spanning our footprint, operating model, people, technology, and culture.In this highly visible leadership role, you will set the overarching agenda and narrative for the transformation, ensuring alignment across the business. You will build the robust tracking and reporting infrastructure necessary to measure success and define the target culture that underpins our future state. Operating in a highly matrixed environment, you will manage complex, interdependent initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
