normalizedText: Job Title: Head Steel Melting Shop (AVP/VP)Job Purpose:To provide strategic and operational leadership to the Steel Melting Shop, covering Induction Furnace (IF), Ladle Refining Furnace (LRF), and Continuous Casting operations, as an independently accountable business unit.The position is responsible for developing long-term capacity, technology, cost, quality, and sustainability strategies; building a future-ready organization; and representing SMS in top-management, investment, and sustainability forums. The role ensures that SMS performance supports the plants overall competitiveness, profitability, and growth objectives.Principal Accountabilities1. SMS Strategic RoadmapOwn and implement the strategic roadmap for SMS covering capacity expansion, technology advancement, product mix, and cost competitiveness. 2. Operational and Business PerformanceDeliver production, quality, cost, safety, yield, and profitability targets in line with plant objectives and industry benchmarks. Manage SMS as an accountable business unit and cost/profit centre. 3. Organizational Capability and SuccessionBuild organizational capability, leadership bench strength, and succession depth to sustain SMS performance beyond the current leadership. Principal Responsibilities1. Strategic Planning & Business AlignmentTranslate the plants growth and profitability objectives into an SMS strategy covering capacity, product mix, operational efficiency, and cost competitiveness. Lead annual strategic and business-planning cycles in alignment with top-management and Board expectations. Monitor steel-market, raw-material, and energy-cost trends and proactively revise the SMS strategy. 2. Capacity Expansion & Technology RoadmapLead feasibility studies, business-case development, and execution oversight for furnace capacity expansion, new casting lines, and automation upgrades. Benchmark SMS technology against global best practices and drive the adoption of suitable Industry 4.0 and automation solutions. Lead SMS CAPEX planning and prioritization, ensuring ROI-based investment decisions. 3. Cost Leadership & Profitability (P&L Ownership)Manage SMS as a cost and profit centre, focusing on cost per tonne, power consumption, refractory and alloy costs, yield, and productivity. Drive cost-reduction and productivity-improvement initiatives through Kaizen, Six Sigma, and TPM methodologies. Deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency and EBITDA. Present periodic financial and operational performance reports to top management and the Board. 4. Organizational Capability & Talent PipelineBuild leadership capability among Shift In-Charges, Process Engineers, and Section Heads. Develop succession plans for critical positions within SMS. Establish technical, safety, and leadership-development programmes for the SMS workforce. Promote a high-performance and accountable culture through structured performance management, coaching, and employee engagement. 5. Quality & Customer Value StrategyDefine the SMS quality strategy, including the grade portfolio, steel-cleanliness standards, and process capabilities. Align quality standards with evolving customer expectations and market requirements. Sponsor new-grade development and process-improvement projects in collaboration with Quality and R&D teams. Ensure consistent product quality and reliability to strengthen the plants competitive position. 6. Safety, Sustainability & ESG LeadershipChampion a zero-harm safety culture and establish a long-term safety and risk-reduction roadmap for SMS. Lead energy-efficiency, emission-reduction, decarbonization, and scrap-mix optimization initiatives. Align SMS operations with the companys sustainability and ESG commitments. Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental, statutory, and regulatory requirements. 7. Digital Transformation & Process AutomationLead the digitalization of SMS operations through advanced process controls, predictive maintenance, and real-time yield and energy dashboards. Promote data-driven decision-making for furnace scheduling, refractory-life optimization, quality prediction, and operational performance. Collaborate with IT and automation teams to develop a digitally mature and future-ready Steel Melting Shop. 8. Stakeholder Management & GovernanceRepresent SMS in senior-management reviews, investment committees, audits, and external stakeholder engagements. Coordinate with Rolling Mill, Raw Material/Scrap Yard, Maintenance, Quality, and Production Planning teams to optimize plant-wide value-chain performance. Build strong relationships with key customers, technology partners, vendors, and regulatory authorities. Support the long-term growth, competitiveness, and strategic positioning of SMS.

normalizedText: Why this role existsNoise has brand recognition. What we need now is brand gravity — the kind that makes culture move toward us, not the other way around. This is a founding leadership role for someone who can run both sides of the equation: build a brand that is impossible to ignore, and take products to market with the precision and speed a #1 brand demands.You will own the full Brand and GTM mandate, build and lead a high-performance team, and operate as a true business partner — not a support function.What success looks likeBrand that earns cultural conversation, not just paid impressionsGTM that makes Day 1 a moment — across every product line, every cyclePartnerships that pay back in brand equity and commercial returnsA team that ships sharp creative and does not settle for mid workBrand health metrics — awareness, consideration, NPS, share of voice — that move and can be provedWhat you will own GTM & product launchesOwn end-to-end go-to-market for Noise’s full portfolio — smartwatch, audio, ring, wearables, and AI categories. Orchestrate Product, Growth, Retail, E-commerce, PR and Performance into one launch narrative. Day 1, Week 1, Month 1 are your KPIs. You set the standard for what a Noise launch feels like. Brand strategy & creativeDefine where Noise plays in culture — which spaces we own, which we ignore, and why. Carry the Noise voice into every campaign, brief, film, design system, and retail touchpoint. Write briefs sharp enough to ship from. Hold the bar relentlessly on creative quality. Partnerships & cultural IPBuild the partnerships engine across sport, music, gaming, OTT, fashion, and creators. Run deals end-to-end — pitch, negotiate, close, activate. Turn logos into stories and partnerships into brand equity. Social, content & communityBuild an always-on creator and community stack — hero athletes, mid-tier voices, micro communities. Make Reels, Shorts and long-form work as one system. Own the social strategy at a VP level: channel mix, tone, cadence, and the line between organic and paid. PR & ORMShape how Noise shows up in media — earned coverage, thought leadership, crisis response, and reputation management. Own the narrative proactively, not reactively. Brand analytics & measurementBuild the measurement framework the team actually uses. Track brand health, partnership ROI, share of voice, and campaign attribution. Connect brand spend to commercial outcomes and present it to the founders and CFO with confidence. Team leadershipHire, structure and develop the Brand and GTM team. Set the culture: high standards, low ego, fast iteration. Be the leader your team builds careers under.Who you are10–14 years in brand and/or GTM roles, with meaningful time in D2C or consumer electronicsYou have shipped 4–6 full-stack product launches and know what breaks at 9am on launch dayYou have sourced, negotiated and closed partnerships — not just briefed them into an agencyYou have led and grown a team, not just managed oneStrong creative instinct — you can tell a sharp idea from a tired one in 10 seconds, and say whyInternet-native — fluent in creator economy, drop culture, meme cycles, Reels grammarNumbers fluent — brand health metrics, partnership ROI, and marketing P&L are not foreign objectsDirect, low-ego, high-agency — you operate well with founders and are comfortable being accountablePedigree is optional. What you’ve shipped is notWhat will not workPlaybook marketing — doing what worked last year because it worked last yearAwards-chasing over outcomesLogo-on-a-banner partnerships with no activation or storyShipping mid creative because the deadline is FridayTreating brand and performance as opposing teamsManaging up instead of building downWhy this roleThis is a build role. You'll have founder access, a blank sheet on brand, a portfolio that's still expanding, and room to build something that outlasts any campaign. If that's the kind of work you do best, we should talk. Company: GI Outsourcing

Job Title: Head of IFRS
Location: Hyderabad
Reports To: Board of Directors
Employment Type: Full-time


About the Company:

Macalvins Group is a dynamic and rapidly growing UK, India and South Africa based accountancy and outsourcing group committed to delivering exceptional services to our customers.

GI outsourcing, part of Macalvins group is in the process of setting up our fifth service delivery centre in Hyderabad. Our goal is to build a centre of excellence in India, delivering high-quality accounting, payroll and compliance services to clients across the UK. With a strong culture of integrity, innovation and client service, we are looking for leaders who thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Job Summary:

The Head of IFRS will lead and develop GI Outsourcings International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) practice across India locations. This leadership role is responsible for oversight, interpretation, and application of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for the GI outsourcing, specifically focusing on UK-based client accounts.

This role will play a key part in strengthening technical capabilities, driving operational excellence, and supporting business expansion across global client portfolios.

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Strategy

    • Provide vision and strategic direction for the IFRS service line, aligning team goals with GI Outsourcing’s overall business objectives.
    • Define and implement IFRS delivery frameworks, KPIs, and best practices across all locations.
    • Collaborate with senior leadership and the Executive Committee to shape the long-term IFRS roadmap and service innovations, and growth strategy.
    • Lead initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, scalability, and profitability within the IFRS division.

  • Technical Excellence
    • IFRS compliance: Ensure client financial statements, reports, and disclosures are prepared accurately and in full compliance with current IFRS and UK accounting regulations.
    • Policy Development: Lead the development, maintenance, and rigorous application of the group's accounting policies and procedures across the Indian operations to ensure consistency with UK regulatory requirements.
    • Statutory Reporting: Oversee the end-to-end preparation, review, and quality control of statutory financial statements for UK clients, ensuring absolute compliance with UK legal and accounting standards.
    • Adoption of new standards: Monitor upcoming IFRS developments, assess their impact on UK clients, and lead the implementation of new standards and policies
    • UK GAAP to IFRS transition: Lead and oversee transition projects for UK clients migrating from UK GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) to IFRS.

  • Compliance & Governance
    • Ensure all IFRS engagements comply with professional, legal, and ethical standards.
    • Establish and monitor internal review mechanisms to maintain data integrity and reporting accuracy.
    • Liaise with regulatory bodies and stay informed about emerging compliance requirements.
    • Champion transparency, documentation standards, and audit-readiness across all IFRS functions.

  • Client Management & Communication
    • Act as a senior technical advisor to clients, providing strategic insights and practical solutions to IFRS-related challenges.
    • Foster long-term client relationships through proactive communication, technical confidence, and reliable service delivery.
    • Support business development by contributing to client proposals, presentations, and IFRS-led consulting opportunities.
    • Collaborate with UK and India-based teams to ensure consistent client experience across all service lines.

  • Technology & Transformation
    • Drive the adoption of modern accounting technologies, automation tools, and analytics platforms to improve IFRS reporting efficiency.
    • Partner with IT and transformation teams to implement digital solutions that enhance accuracy, turnaround time, and data transparency.
    • Promote innovation through continuous improvement initiatives and integration of technology into financial processes.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Professional Qualification: Must possess a globally recognised, senior professional accounting qualification, such as ACA, ACCA or an equivalent Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification.
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 12-14 years of progressive experience in financial reporting and technical accounting, with a significant focus on UK IFRS/UK GAAP.
  • Extensive post-qualification experience, ideally gained within an outsourcing firm or leading audit/consulting organization, followed by a senior role in a multinational corporation, financial services firm, or shared services environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in interpreting and applying complex IFRS standards.
  • Experience in managing UK or international client portfolios preferred.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and client management skills.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Executive Presence: Ability to interact, influence, and communicate effectively at the top leadership and Board.
  • Outsourcing/Offshore Model Experience: Deep understanding of the outsourcing delivery model, including managing service levels, governance, and quality in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strategic & Commercial Acumen: Beyond technical expertise, the candidate must have the ability to translate technical accounting impacts into clear commercial terms that influence business strategy and client outcomes.
  • Change Management: Proven track record in leading large-scale technical change projects, such as system implementations or the adoption of new IFRS standards across a geographically dispersed team.
  • Advanced IT Skills: Proficiency in major accounting software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Xero, CaseWare) and financial reporting systems.


Why Join Us?

  • Global exposure to UK and international clients across diverse industries.
  • Leadership visibility with direct interaction with senior management and Executive Committee.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities in a high-growth environment.
  • Collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven culture.
  • Part of a trusted global brand known for excellence in accounting and outsourcing services.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationMumbai, Maharashtra Full job description Senior Marketing Manager – Real Estate Projects & Corporate Branding Driving Real Estate Growth Through Strategic Marketing At Adwise, we are more than just a real estate mandate firm , we are strategic growth partners for developers. With expertise in project advisory, sales strategy, pricing intelligence, market research, channel partner activation, and project marketing, we help real estate projects gain stronger positioning and faster sales. Our mission is to bridge the gap between great developments and successful market execution. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives for both our mandate projects and the Adwise brand. Position: Senior Marketing Manager Role Overview As a Senior Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for leading the complete marketing function for Adwise Elements LLP and its real estate mandate projects. You will drive end-to-end marketing strategies for residential and commercial projects while strengthening Adwise's corporate brand across digital, offline, and industry platforms. This role requires a strategic marketer who can manage project marketing, performance campaigns, brand building, public relations, creative development, vendor management, and cross-functional collaboration to generate measurable business growth. Key Responsibilities Real Estate Project Marketing Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies for assigned real estate mandate projects. Plan and manage project campaigns across every stage, including Pre-Launch, Launch, Sustenance, Inventory Movement, and Re-Launch. Create integrated marketing plans across digital, print, outdoor advertising, radio, events, activations, and channel partner engagement. Work closely with developers to define project positioning, target audience, pricing strategy, and marketing budgets. Digital Marketing & Performance Plan, execute, and optimise lead generation campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, YouTube, WhatsApp, and other digital platforms. Monitor campaign performance, optimise CPL, lead quality, CTR, and ROI, and work closely with the sales team to improve conversions. Coordinate with performance marketing agencies and media partners to maximise campaign effectiveness. Adwise Corporate Branding Lead the overall branding and positioning of Adwise across all business verticals. Manage the company's website, social media platforms, content strategy, SEO, online reputation, and digital presence. Develop and execute branding initiatives including corporate presentations, case studies, newsletters, PR activities, media coverage, recruitment campaigns, thought leadership content, and industry insights. Ensure consistent brand identity across all marketing and communication channels. Marketing for Business Verticals Develop marketing strategies and promotional campaigns for Adwise's various service verticals, including Real Estate Sales Mandates, CRM Solutions, Project Management Consultancy (PMC), and other real-estate business offerings. Support business development initiatives by creating impactful marketing collateral and sales presentations. Channel Partner & Event Marketing Plan and execute Channel Partner (CP) Meets, Broker Meets, Project Launch Events, Corporate Events, Exhibitions, and On-ground Activations. Develop marketing campaigns to increase channel partner engagement and project visibility. Creative, Vendor & Agency Management Coordinate with creative agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, printers, media buying agencies, and production houses. Review and approve all marketing creatives, brochures, presentations, videos, advertisements, and branding materials. Manage marketing budgets, negotiate vendor commercials, and ensure timely execution of all deliverables. Reporting, Research & Analytics Prepare monthly marketing MIS, campaign reports, and performance dashboards for developers and management. Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, competitor activities, and market trends to improve marketing effectiveness. Recommend innovative marketing initiatives and emerging technologies to drive business growth. Team Leadership Lead and mentor marketing executives, interns, and external agency partners. Establish marketing processes, reporting systems, timelines, and quality standards while fostering a collaborative and performance-driven culture. Candidate Profile Experience 3–6 years of experience in Real Estate Marketing, Advertising, Digital Marketing, or Brand Management. Proven experience managing end-to-end marketing campaigns for real estate projects from strategy to execution. Skills Required Strong understanding of real estate marketing, branding, digital advertising, and lead generation. Expertise in campaign planning, project launches, vendor management, and event marketing. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills. Strong analytical mindset with experience in campaign optimisation and ROI measurement. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Technical Expertise Meta Business Suite Google Ads & Google Analytics CRM Platforms Canva / Adobe Creative Suite (preferred) Microsoft Excel & Reporting Dashboards Knowledge of AI-powered marketing tools, SEO, website management, and marketing automation platforms will be an added advantage. Educational Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Media, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA in Marketing will be preferred. Location Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR)

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Pay₹50,00,000 - ₹60,00,000 a yearJob typeFull-time LocationMaharashtra Full job description Director of Product Marketing at Savant Labs to define market positioning, drive go-to-market strategy, lead product launches, build sales enablement, and shape how finance teams understand and adopt AI-native finance operations. Company Details Savant Labs is a high-growth Series A startup building the AI-native stack for finance. The platform helps finance teams move beyond AI chat and deploy governed, repeatable, and audit-ready AI agents across close, reconciliations, tax, reporting, and other critical workflows. Why Savant Finance teams are rapidly adopting AI, but critical business processes still require governance, consistency, and accountability. Savant is building the infrastructure that enables finance organizations to safely operationalize AI across mission-critical workflows. Opportunity to help define and shape an emerging category within AI-native finance operations. High-impact leadership role with direct influence on company growth, product strategy, and market perception. Chance to work closely with founders and senior leaders in a fast-growing Series A company. Website: Savant Labs Requirements 8–12+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Product Marketing or related GTM roles. Strong experience with enterprise, technical, or complex GTM motions. Proven expertise in positioning, messaging, product launches, and go-to-market strategy. Experience building and leading Product Marketing and/or Content teams. Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and communication skills. Strong sales enablement experience including battlecards, discovery frameworks, demo narratives, and objection handling. Portfolio of writing, launches, decks, strategic projects, or related work required. Experience selling to finance, accounting, tax, audit, or compliance buyers preferred. Background in fintech, ERP, data analytics, or workflow automation software is a strong advantage. Experience in Series A–C startup environments preferred. Active use of AI tools in day-to-day work with a strong point of view on AI-driven productivity. Responsibilities Define and own Savant's market positioning and narrative. Develop messaging that resonates with CFOs, Controllers, finance, accounting, and tax leaders. Establish clear differentiation against legacy finance platforms, AI assistants, and workflow automation tools. Ensure consistent messaging across website, sales materials, launches, executive communications, and analyst engagements. Partner with Product, Sales, Demand Generation, and leadership on GTM strategy and market priorities. Translate product roadmap initiatives into compelling value propositions and campaigns. Bring customer, competitive, and market insights into business decisions. Measure impact through pipeline influence, win rates, sales-cycle improvements, and product adoption. Lead content strategy across thought leadership, product content, customer stories, and launch materials. Build and improve sales enablement assets including battlecards, demo narratives, and objection handling frameworks. Analyze competitive landscape and identify key win/loss trends. Engage directly with customers and prospects to validate messaging and positioning. Lead and develop a team across Product Marketing and Content. Establish team priorities, operating rhythms, and quality standards. Operate as a player-coach, balancing strategy with hands-on execution. What We Are Looking For Strong Product Marketing Judgment Experience solving complex positioning, messaging, and go-to-market challenges for enterprise or technical products. Ability to develop clear, compelling product narratives that align Sales, Product, Marketing, and Leadership teams. Strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive differentiation. Exceptional Craft Outstanding writing, editing, presentation, and communication skills. Ability to simplify complex concepts without losing strategic depth or business value. Strong attention to structure, messaging clarity, and audience relevance. Portfolio of writing, launches, presentations, or strategic work required. AI-Native Working Style Uses AI as a core part of daily workflows across research, content creation, competitive analysis, enablement, and strategy. Demonstrates a clear perspective on where AI creates leverage and where human judgment remains critical. Comfortable working in an AI-first environment and advocating practical AI adoption. Ownership and Pace Operates with urgency and accountability. Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing startup environments. Ability to move seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution. Experience partnering directly with founders and senior leadership teams. Experience 8–12+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Product Marketing and related GTM functions. Experience supporting enterprise, technical, or complex sales motions. Proven success across positioning, messaging, product launches, sales enablement, and GTM strategy. Strong track record of increasing scope, ownership, and leadership responsibility. Experience leading Product Marketing and/or Content teams. Demonstrated examples of work personally created or significantly influenced. Experience marketing AI, analytics, workflow automation, or related software products. Experience working in high-growth startup environments (Series A–C). Experience selling to finance, accounting, tax, audit, or compliance stakeholders strongly preferred. Background in fintech, ERP, data analytics, or workflow automation software is highly desirable. Ability to translate technical product capabilities into clear business outcomes. Job Details Location: Remote, India This role requires significant overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST). Candidates must be available to work until 3:00 AM IST on a regular basis to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders. The budget for this role is up to 60 LPA inclusive of 10% annual variable bonus. Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive Advisory & Enterprise Transformation LeadershipServe as a strategic advisor to C-suite executives across enterprise customer engagements. Lead the most complex and high-impact transformation programs involving customer experience, personalization, AI-enabled operations, content supply chain transformation, and digital operating model modernization. Define AI-native consulting approaches focused on personalization, automation, content intelligence, predictive insights, and productivity transformation. Drive innovation strategies that improve consulting scalability, delivery efficiency, customer value realization, and business growth. Act as a thought leader on emerging trends across AI, customer experience strategy, digital transformation, and enterprise operations. Build high-performing consulting culture through coaching, mentorship, capability development, and leadership enablement. Support hiring, succession planning, competency development, organizational mentoring, and consulting enablement programs. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and strategic thinking across the organization. Represent Adobe and the SBC organization at customer events, industry forums, executive workshops, and leadership discussions. Minimum 15 years of experience in strategic consulting, digital transformation, customer experience, or enterprise technology strategy. Strong executive presence with demonstrated experience influencing C-level stakeholders and driving strategic business outcomes. Proven track record in consulting growth, innovation leadership, mentoring, and organizational impact. normalizedText: Marketing Head-Purple Fabric-PFLocation- Chennai ·Reports to: CEOExp-12+ About Purple Fabric-Purple Fabric is Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform product. It helps financial institutions and increasingly, enterprises beyond them, turn their data into AI outcomes they can act on and defend: governed, explainable, and orchestrated through multi-agent workflows. This isn’t a roadmap promise; it’s in production, with 45+ clients live worldwide. Behind it: a 240+ strong team with a senior core, global clients, and the fintech heritage of Intellect Design Arena (8K employees).The mandate Own the growth thesis: write the global go-to-market playbook, own and create the lead gen machine that takes Purple Fabric to $10M ARR - and be accountable for the marketing half of getting there. This seat sets a growth strategy; it does not take briefs.Make four teams one engine: Product marketing, creative/web, digital and field/event each produce; your job is that they compound, one scorecard, one weekly pipeline number, no pillar optimizing its own corner at the expense of the funnel.Win where buyers now look: enterprise buyers increasingly start with an AI answer, not a search page. Build the discipline of being that answer, AEO/GEO alongside classic SEO, Paid UA; before the category has a playbook for it. You will be writing that playbook.Move the commercial numbers, not the vanity ones: work shoulder to shoulder with Sales and Product on the buyer journey, cost.What you will own Lead generation & the engine: you create and own the pipeline number: qualified opportunities per week, by region and source, feeding coverage ≥3× target. Built on CRM as single source of truth, marketing automation, AI tooling for enrichment and personalization, lead scoring and SDR handoff SLAs. House rule: one working automation shipped every week. Your scorecard, opps/week, pipeline influenced, funnel conversion, CAC trend, search/AI visibility, is auto-generated; a hand-assembled report is a broken one.Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design and execute hyper-targeted, multi-channel account-based campaigns for Tier-1 enterprise targets, orchestrating digital, content, and field touchpoints to accelerate high-value, complex sales cycles.Product marketing: positioning and messaging per segment, launch plans per release, sales enablement (decks, battlecards, objection handling), analyst-facing narrative, pricing/packaging input. Your PMM also runs content (CEO story stream, funnel content, newsletter) and research/competitive intelligence.Brand, design & website: identity system and templates (in tandem with head of Design), all visual and video production on an AI-assisted workflow, the website as a measured conversion asset — not a brochure. Brand architecture decisions go to the CEO; everything else is yours.Digital acquisition: SEO plus the AEO/GEO frontier (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity answers), social channel strategy, performance marketing (UA, Linkedin first and other socials like Meta, Google etc), and instrumented campaigns, every channel measured to opportunity, not clicks.Influencer & creator-led marketing: play the game the way the fastest-growing AI companies now do creator-led, not ad-led. Build relationships with the enterprise-AI and fintech voices who shape the conversation (LinkedIn creators, newsletter authors, technical YouTubers, podcast hosts, practitioner communities, Insta/Tiktok creators for PF’s derivative products), seed the product with them, and turn their credibility into reach and pipeline. Measured on qualified attention into named accounts, not vanity impressions.Events, partnerships & field: flagship event calendar per hemisphere (WHEM/EHEM field marketers on your team), CEO and leadership speaking slots, partner co-marketing including Intellect co-sell moments, post-event pipeline attribution. The team: hire, develop and run the ~10-person org above , every hire screened for ability to exploit AI in their role. You are accountable for the function outproducing its headcount.What we need from you 12+ years in B2B/enterprise software marketing with a proven track record of scaling an engine through high-growth phases (eg $1M to $10M+ ARR). You must have built or rebuilt at least one function end to end and led through managers, not just as an individual contributor.AI-native operator - a hiring gate: show us, in a work sample, how you use AI tools to do the work of a larger team, and how you would institutionalize that across your org.Enterprise and regulated-industry fluency: you can market to banks and large enterprises without triggering their allergy to hype - governance and explainability are selling points you know how to use.Hands-on command of the modern stack: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), automation (n8n/Make/Zapier-class), enrichment (Clay/Apollo-class), analytics/attribution (GA4, Search Console, dashboarding), SEO/AEO tooling, and daily fluency with frontier AI assistants. You configure before you hire.Demand-gen credibility with a number attached: you have owned a pipeline target and can talk specifically about what worked. Strong written English and comfort in a written-first culture — the pre-read replaces the status meeting here. normalizedText: OverviewThis is a senior orchestration role at the heart of our ecommerce marketing engine. We have dedicated, specialist teams for off-app marketing (YouTube, Meta, Influencer), on-app performance marketing (sponsored shelf, in-app activation), and customer relationship management. What we need now is an integrator/orchestrator who makes all of them work as one.The Ecommerce Integrated Marketing Manager (Full-Funnel) will be the connective tissue between these teams — owning the integrated full-funnel strategy, the shared calendar, the unified attribution framework, and the commercial outcomes that result. This role ensures alignment on the agenda, identifies gaps, and holds the funnel accountable end-to-end.The right person for this role is a systems thinker with deep ecommerce fluency — someone who can speak the language of each specialist team, translate brand objectives into channel-level briefs, and connect off-app demand signals to on-app conversion outcomes with rigor.Responsibilities Full-Funnel Strategy & Integrated PlanningUnderstand the Digital Shopper and translate that into a cross functional strategy between the Channel/Media/GCC teams — ensuring each team understands the commercial context behind every activation.Build and maintain the integrated ecommerce marketing calendar, sequencing off-app campaigns, on-app activations, and customer engagement initiatives so they work in concert, not in silos.Work with the Media team to build a first party database – to be used to drive targeted marketing full funnel interventions across our brandsIdentify white spaces — occasions, audiences, or conversion moments — and drive cross-functional solutions.Work with media team on the first party data — Leveraging this data to design targeted, brand-specific full-funnel interventions: using known audience signals to personalise off-app media, sharpen on-app promotional targeting, and enable the customer team to drive higher-value retention and cross-sell across the portfolio. Cross-Functional Orchestration & AlignmentAct as the primary integration point between the off-app marketing team (YouTube, Meta, Influencer), the on-app performance marketing team, and the customer/ecommerce account management team.Run a regular cross-functional rhythm — weekly syncs, monthly funnel reviews, quarterly planning sessions as needed — to ensure shared visibility of goals, metrics, and campaign progress. Attribution, Measurement & Commercial AccountabilityOwn the full-funnel attribution framework — defining how off-app media investment connects to on-app GMV outcomes, and holding each team accountable to their contribution in the funnel.Build unified dashboards giving a single view of full-funnel health: reach, frequency & branded searches (off-app), share of search, conversion and ROAS (on-app), and repeat rate and retention (customer).Run post-campaign analyses and QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with internal teams, translating performance into actionable optimisation briefs. Platform & Ecosystem StewardshipRepresent the ecommerce marketing in Joint Business Plan (JBP) discussions with platform partners, ensuring marketing commitments are integrated with commercial and supply chain plans.Stay ahead of emerging formats, features, and first-party data opportunities across platforms and feed these insights into the specialist teams' roadmaps. Capability Building & GovernanceEstablish and maintain ecommerce marketing SOPs, playbooks, and governance frameworks that help specialist teams operate with speed and consistency.Champion best-in-class practices — from creative standards for quick commerce to influencer-to-conversion tracking — and drive adoption across teams.Build internal capability by facilitating knowledge sharing across the three specialist teams, reducing duplication and accelerating learning loops. Stakeholder ManagementManage relationships with a broad and complex stakeholder map: internal teams (E-Com Sales, Media, Brand ), specialist ecommerce teams (off-app, on-app, customer), and external partners ( agencies, influencer networks).Build and sustain trust with platform partners, ensuring PepsiCo is positioned as a preferred brand partner for co-investments, early access to new ad products, and strategic collaboration.Navigate competing priorities and tensions across stakeholder groups with maturity — balancing short-term commercial pressures with long-term brand and channel health.QualificationsMust-Have11–12 years of experience with at least 4 years in ecommerce, digital marketing, or digital commerce within FMCG, D2C, or a large consumer tech platform.Demonstrated experience working across — not just within — multiple digital marketing specialisations (paid media, on-app, CRM/retention), whether in a central role, consulting capacity, or matrixed leadership position.Strong commercial acumen: ability to connect campaign activities to NSR, GMV, and marketing ROI outcomes with clarity.Fluency in the Q-com platform landscape: Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and familiarity with their advertising products, promotional mechanics, and JBP structures.Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams without direct authority — a natural integrator and influencer.MBA from a reputed institution strongly preferred.Good-to-HavePrior experience in strategy, planning, or centre-of-excellence role within a large FMCG or digital commerce organisation.Exposure to full-funnel attribution methodologies and multi-touch measurement frameworks.Familiarity with first-party data strategy and its role in connecting off-app audiences to on-app conversion.Experience working directly with platform category or marketing teams at Blinkit, Zepto, or Swiggy Instamart at a senior level. normalizedText: The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of FinanceAt CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next. If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.About The RoleAt CoinDCX, Brand is our primary trust engine - the system that translates frontier financial technology into mass adoption, institutional credibility and category leadership.As SVP - Marketing, you will be the Category Architect for Crypto in India. Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalize and institutionalize it - shaping how millions of Indians understand, assess and trust this new asset class.You will own the full arc of brand impact: trust, recall, organic acquisition and market share. Operating at the intersection of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation management and capital discipline, your work will determine how CoinDCX is seen as the default, responsible gateway to the future of finance.This role calls for a leader who thinks in multi-year horizons, stays steady under external scrutiny and builds brand systems that endure market cycles. You will lead a 20+ member, multi-disciplinary team across brand, media, social, PR, content and creative, while partnering closely with Growth, Product, Policy, Business and Leadership to ensure absolute alignment between what we build, say and stand for.If defining a category, stewarding institutional trust at scale and building one of India’s most consequential financial brands excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.What You’ll DoMetric & Budget Ownership: Directly own all Brand KPIs (Brand Health and Social Media Metrics, and Organic Acquisition) and a ₹100Cr+ annual brand budget. You are the DRI (Direct Responsible Individual) for optimizing spend across ATL, BTL, Digital Media, Social, Content and PR to drive organic pull and ROI. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for capital allocation logic behind every brand decision. Category Architecture: Own the multi-year category roadmap. Translate technical VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) complexities into high-trust, education-led consumer narratives that move the Trust Index.Org Design: Scale and lead a 20+ person team across Brand and Media, Creative, PR, Social, and Content. Build a "minus-one" leadership layer to reduce SVP intervention in daily execution.Category Creation and Market Leadership: Define and execute the playbook for expanding the Indian crypto category while disproportionately increasing CoinDCX’s share of users, trust and mindshare.Reputation Systems: Design and own proactive PR and "Issue Readiness" playbooks to safeguard institutional credibility during market volatility.Strategic Integration: Partner with Product and Policy teams to ensure the brand promise of "Responsible Education" is lived in the App UX and is fully compliant.You’ll Excel in This Role If YouThink in First Principles: You solve for the root "Trust Gap" rather than quoting standard marketing frameworks.Act as an Owner: You treat company capital and reputation as your own; you make difficult trade-offs to protect long-term equity over short-term "hacks."Translate Strategy: You convert disruptive technologies into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.Build Systems: You prioritize building scalable content and PR engines over managing individual creative tasks.You are comfortable being the final decision maker during moments of reputational, regulatory or public scrutiny. You’ll Know You’re Winning WhenTrust & Recall: Measurable uplift in "Institutional Trust" scores and "Responsible Education" recall.Efficiency: Blended CAC reduces as a result of improved organic acquisition and brand-driven conversion.Market Share: Targeted increase in CoinDCX's % share of the total Indian crypto user base.Independence: Your leadership bench executes high-impact campaigns with minimal intervention from you.Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For YouYou are shaping how an entire nation perceives the future of money. This is a rare opportunity to define the category standards for a $2.45B unicorn and work side-by-side with founders to drive the company’s mission. You will gain an unfiltered view of how a brand scales from 10 → 100 in one of the world’s fastest-evolving industries. Very few roles allow you to shape how a nation learns to trust a new financial system. This is one of them.Hiring ProcessHere’s what your journey with us looks like:Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intentRecruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you betterFunctional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solvingAssignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenariosCulture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive bestFounder Conversation – For certain roles at senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fitWhere We WorkWe believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bangalore office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.Perks That Empower YouWe believe great people deserve great experiences.Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyleUnlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you needMental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resourcesLearning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunitiesReady to Build What’s Next?If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together. Job DescriptionSenior Vice President, Product DesignWe’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Design, Platform, AI Hub to join our team. This role is located in Pune.The way products are built has changed. If you know how an .md file becomes experience design, this role may be for you.In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:We believe the shifts happening with AI are enabling us to spend more time on what design is actually for: crafting deeply user-centric experiences with deliberate outcomes. We're changing quickly, and we're doing it on purpose. The person in this role doesn't just adapt to that shift; they help lead it. Own platform design strategy. Define and maintain the design vision for a complex platform. Operate from first principles when needed. Bring coherence to experiences that have grown up across many teams and many years.Demonstrate before you describe. Use prototyping and rapid concept work to make design strategy tangible. In a world where AI tools can close the gap between intent and working experience, the best design leaders don't wait for resourcing. They show the possibility first.Work at the intersection of systems and users. Connect workflows, data, and interaction patterns across the platform. Know when to zoom in on a specific friction point and when to step back and redesign the underlying model.Lead design in a cross-functional environment. Partner with product and engineering as a peer, not as a hand-off point, but as a co-creator. Influence product strategy and technical decisions by grounding them in user evidence and design quality.Shape a design system built for how design works now. The design system on this team is structured as machine-readable infrastructure. Tokens carry semantic meaning. Components encode the reasoning behind when and how they apply. AI agents consume it alongside human developers. At the SVP level, you're not just contributing to this grammar, you're shaping how it's defined and ensuring it reflects the quality and intent of the experiences we're building.Set a high bar and transfer it. Provide feedback and mentorship that raises the work quality of everyone around you. Cultivate a design culture where rigor, curiosity, and user-centricity are defaults, not aspirations.Communicate design at the executive level. normalizedText: About Snapmint: India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad-tech and bank-tech software services.Role Overview As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth & Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth & Retention in leadership forums.Responsibilities● Full Lifecycle P&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.● Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout-origin) into first-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time-to-first-purchase.● Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi-product adoption.● Retention & Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.● Rewards & Loyalty: Oversee the rewards programme as an integrated lifecycle lever—merchant partnerships, unit economics, and programme ROI.● Team & Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stackQualifications: ● 7+ years of experience, with 4+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.● 3+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high-growth phases. ● Proven P&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.● Strong analytical foundation: SQL, Python, CLTV/RFM modelling, A/B testing, and cohort economics.● Hands-on familiarity with CRM platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar) and multi-channel campaign design (push, WhatsApp, SMS, email, IVR).● Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.● A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science. The firm, founded in 2006, is known for its proprietary market data, in-depth knowledge of provider ecosystems, and the expertise of its 1,600 professionals worldwide working together to help clients maximize the value of their technology investments.ISG Software Research, part of ISG Research, delivers trusted advisory and research services to enterprise decision-makers. For over 20 years, we’ve combined deep knowledge of software categories and providers with the expertise of seasoned analysts to help clients navigate constant technological change. Our mission is to deliver independent, insightful research and tailored advisory services through a client experience built on trust and empathy.Position OverviewISG is seeking a leader to serve as Research Director for Marketing Technology, with expertise across software domains including, CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, SEO/GEO and related systems. This role will guide ISG’s consulting, advisory, research, and thought leadership portfolio in these areas, helping enterprises optimize people, processes, information, and technology.The Research Director will drive market research of enterprises, software providers, and products to deliver high-quality insights and ensure the strength of ISG Research offerings. Success requires close collaboration with marketing, revenue, product, and client success teams to execute programs effectively and support enterprise clients. Working closely with analyst peers and research teams, the Research Director will ensure reliability, depth, and relevance across ISG’s product portfolio. Performance will be measured by three key objectives: Client Engagement, Market Expertise, and Revenue Bookings, supported by defined KPIs.ResponsibilitiesThe Research Director will lead the research agenda for marketing technology, working closely with analysts and the product team to apply both experience and subject-matter expertise. This role ensures the full value of the analyst team is realized across consulting, advisory, research, and thought leadership, and will represent the team in key products such as Analyst Perspectives, Market Perspectives, and the ISG Buyer’s Guides. A core responsibility is the analysis of software providers and the leadership of ISG Buyer’s Guides. The Research Director will also support ISG enterprise clients through advisory and consulting engagements, partnering with Client Success and Product teams to strengthen relationships, engage new and existing clients, and drive revenue growth.This position will report to the Executive Director for Business Research.This is a remote position located in the India Travel is potentially 25-50%, with most of it to the United States Provide thought leadership in the office of the CMO and marketing functions Build and maintain working relationships with software providers Guide enterprises and buyers on software categories and products Engage into research processes to ensure critical and timely research and client deliverables Collaborate with sales and client success teams to achieve revenue Participate in analyst leadership and team meetings to help improve and innovate processesRequired SkillsetsOverall 18 to 22 years of experience in Research Advisory.At least 5 years of experience as a recognized thought leader, serving as an industry analyst and/or leading Product Marketing or Product Management functions at a recognized technology vendor. ORMinimum 10 years of practitioner experience working with Sales and Marketing processes, platforms, and systems, combined with a strong consultative and analytical background, fast-paced company environmentPrevious experience providing guidance in strategy and planning on marketing processes and technologyKnowledge of business technology industry in area of marketing related softwareDemonstrated ability to engage with a well-developed point of viewStrong communication and collaboration skills with industry leadersExperience in managing multiple priorities yielding positive resultsDemonstrated writing and presentation skills are essentialEducationBA/BS degree in Communications, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related discipline.An advanced degree (MBA, Master's, or equivalent) is preferred but not required.At ISG, we don’t just accept difference — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, and our communities. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ISG is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The more diverse and inclusive we are, the better our work will be.The duties and responsibilities described in this job description may not be a comprehensive list. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time and/or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands. job description Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact. Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable end-to-end. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for a Technical Lead, AI & Platform to lead our engineering, ML/DS, and analytics teams while staying close to architecture and execution. This role will lead and manage the Engineering team, ML/Data Science team, and Data Analytics team. You'll drive how we build, how we use data and AI, and how our systems scale as the company grows. We're looking for a strong technical leader who thinks from first principles, makes clear decisions, and stays close to the technology. Someone who can step into complex problems, break them down clearly, and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions. You'll work closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, and Customer teams to translate real customer problems into systems, tools, and AI capabilities that drive outcomes, value to our customer and company revenue, not just features. This is not a pure management role. It requires strong technical judgment, comfort operating across engineering and data, and the ability to lead through both direction and execution. You'll set the technical bar, strengthen how teams work together, and ensure engineering, ML, and analytics move as one cohesive capability supporting the business. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE: Engineering, ML, and Analytics operate as a clear, structured, and high-performing unit with defined ownership and strong delivery predictability. Technical decisions are grounded in first-principles thinking, scalable architecture, and long-term product clarity. AI and data capabilities are consistently deployed into production and directly tied to measurable business impact. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: Engineering Leadership & Architecture Drive technical direction across platform, infrastructure, and product systems Define scalable architecture and ensure reliability, performance, and security Improve engineering velocity, code quality, and delivery discipline Strengthen documentation, ownership, and system clarity Mentor tech team: Engineering, ML, Analytics AI, Data Science & Analytics Strategy Define how AI and data drive competitive advantage in our product Ensure ML models move from experimentation into production environmentsStrengthen MLOps, data pipelines, and real-time data systems Align analytics insights with product and customer decision-making Ensure AI investments translate into real outcomes, not just experiments Product & Business Alignment Partner closely with Product to shape technical roadmap Work with Sales and Customer teams to understand enterprise requirements Guide solution design for complex customer use cases Ensure engineering effort maps directly to business impact Team, Culture & Organizational Development Lead and develop Engineering, ML/Data Science, and Analytics teams Hire strong senior talent and raise the technical bar Create clarity in roles, responsibilities, and technical ownership Reduce single-point dependency across critical systems Build a culture of accountability, curiosity, and effectiveness Hands-On Technical Leadership Stay close to architecture and key system decisions Review critical designs and technical proposals Step into complex technical problems when neededPrototype or validate high-impact ideas Lead by example in technical depth and problem solving WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, data, or ML environments Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Experience leading technical teams in a startup or product-driven B2B SaaS company Track record building and scaling production AI/ML systems Experience with distributed systems, real-time data, and cloud infrastructure Background in logistics or supply chain industry, or data-heavy SaaS is a strong plus Previous experience working in enterprises/fortune 500 is a plus Technical Depth Strong backend and system architecture expertise Experience deploying ML/AI systems into production, not just research Deep understanding of MLOps, data platforms, and model lifecycle management Comfortable operating across engineering, data science, and analytics domains Leadership & Culture First-principles thinker who breaks down complex problems clearly High ownership and accountability Builder mindset with strong technical judgment Clear communicator across technical and business teams Focused on effectiveness and real outcomes WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe,built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. Tech-first team: You'll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problem using technology. Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you'll be a major part of our story. Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You'll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do: Curiosity: We stay hungry to learn and explore. Ownership: We act like founders and take responsibility. Raising the bar: We aim higher, never settling for good enough. normalizedText: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. normalizedText: Marketing Head-Purple Fabric-PFLocation- Chennai ·Reports to: CEOExp-12+ About Purple Fabric-Purple Fabric is Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform product. It helps financial institutions and increasingly, enterprises beyond them, turn their data into AI outcomes they can act on and defend: governed, explainable, and orchestrated through multi-agent workflows. This isn’t a roadmap promise; it’s in production, with 45+ clients live worldwide. Behind it: a 240+ strong team with a senior core, global clients, and the fintech heritage of Intellect Design Arena (8K employees).The mandate Own the growth thesis: write the global go-to-market playbook, own and create the lead gen machine that takes Purple Fabric to $10M ARR - and be accountable for the marketing half of getting there. This seat sets a growth strategy; it does not take briefs.Make four teams one engine: Product marketing, creative/web, digital and field/event each produce; your job is that they compound, one scorecard, one weekly pipeline number, no pillar optimizing its own corner at the expense of the funnel.Win where buyers now look: enterprise buyers increasingly start with an AI answer, not a search page. Build the discipline of being that answer, AEO/GEO alongside classic SEO, Paid UA; before the category has a playbook for it. You will be writing that playbook.Move the commercial numbers, not the vanity ones: work shoulder to shoulder with Sales and Product on the buyer journey, cost.What you will own Lead generation & the engine: you create and own the pipeline number: qualified opportunities per week, by region and source, feeding coverage ≥3× target. Built on CRM as single source of truth, marketing automation, AI tooling for enrichment and personalization, lead scoring and SDR handoff SLAs. House rule: one working automation shipped every week. Your scorecard, opps/week, pipeline influenced, funnel conversion, CAC trend, search/AI visibility, is auto-generated; a hand-assembled report is a broken one.Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design and execute hyper-targeted, multi-channel account-based campaigns for Tier-1 enterprise targets, orchestrating digital, content, and field touchpoints to accelerate high-value, complex sales cycles.Product marketing: positioning and messaging per segment, launch plans per release, sales enablement (decks, battlecards, objection handling), analyst-facing narrative, pricing/packaging input. Your PMM also runs content (CEO story stream, funnel content, newsletter) and research/competitive intelligence.Brand, design & website: identity system and templates (in tandem with head of Design), all visual and video production on an AI-assisted workflow, the website as a measured conversion asset — not a brochure. Brand architecture decisions go to the CEO; everything else is yours.Digital acquisition: SEO plus the AEO/GEO frontier (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity answers), social channel strategy, performance marketing (UA, Linkedin first and other socials like Meta, Google etc), and instrumented campaigns, every channel measured to opportunity, not clicks.Influencer & creator-led marketing: play the game the way the fastest-growing AI companies now do creator-led, not ad-led. Build relationships with the enterprise-AI and fintech voices who shape the conversation (LinkedIn creators, newsletter authors, technical YouTubers, podcast hosts, practitioner communities, Insta/Tiktok creators for PF’s derivative products), seed the product with them, and turn their credibility into reach and pipeline. Measured on qualified attention into named accounts, not vanity impressions.Events, partnerships & field: flagship event calendar per hemisphere (WHEM/EHEM field marketers on your team), CEO and leadership speaking slots, partner co-marketing including Intellect co-sell moments, post-event pipeline attribution. The team: hire, develop and run the ~10-person org above , every hire screened for ability to exploit AI in their role. You are accountable for the function outproducing its headcount.What we need from you 12+ years in B2B/enterprise software marketing with a proven track record of scaling an engine through high-growth phases (eg $1M to $10M+ ARR). You must have built or rebuilt at least one function end to end and led through managers, not just as an individual contributor.AI-native operator - a hiring gate: show us, in a work sample, how you use AI tools to do the work of a larger team, and how you would institutionalize that across your org.Enterprise and regulated-industry fluency: you can market to banks and large enterprises without triggering their allergy to hype - governance and explainability are selling points you know how to use.Hands-on command of the modern stack: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), automation (n8n/Make/Zapier-class), enrichment (Clay/Apollo-class), analytics/attribution (GA4, Search Console, dashboarding), SEO/AEO tooling, and daily fluency with frontier AI assistants. You configure before you hire.Demand-gen credibility with a number attached: you have owned a pipeline target and can talk specifically about what worked. Strong written English and comfort in a written-first culture — the pre-read replaces the status meeting here. normalizedText: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.Position OverviewFor more than 140 years, Eli Lilly and Company has been committed to discovering and developing medicines that improve lives. Facing an accelerating pace of digital and AI transformation across healthcare, Lilly established Lilly Bengaluru India (LBI) as a strategic investment in future-ready capabilities: a globally connected, agile and innovation-driven organization, deeply attuned to the evolving needs of patients and healthcare systems. Within it, the Commercialization Capabilities organization enables Lilly's commercial teams worldwide across the end-to-end commercialization lifecycle, spanning five core focus areas: Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), Global Operations Sales Organization (GOSO), Global Content Hub (GCH), Experience Activation (EXPA), and Commercial Learning Services (CLS).Lilly's enterprise AI agenda is delivered through NOVA (Next-generation Organizational Value through AI), the program through which AI initiatives are submitted, shaped, governed and scaled across GCCI, Medical Capabilities, GOSO and IBU Central.To further elevate LBI's strategic impact, we are seeking an accomplished AI leader to serve as Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation. The role leads NOVA's global rollout and operational execution across these four organizations, working directly with their senior leaders to shape AI submissions into work that can credibly reach enterprise scale. Beyond NOVA, it drives Lilly's most critical cross-functional AI initiatives — including frontier programs such as SAGE, focused on agentification within brand launches — and maintains the enterprise's line of sight into a fast-moving external technology landscape.This is a deep-domain senior technical leadership role. The incumbent brings independent judgment on AI architecture, feasibility and cost-to-scale, and is the person the enterprise relies on to distinguish an AI initiative that will scale from one that will not. Success depends on technical credibility and the willingness to redirect or stop well-sponsored work that cannot reach production.This position reports to the Vice President and Global Head of LBI Commercialization Capabilities and operates with an enterprise mandate across the organizations NOVA serves.Primary ResponsibilitiesNOVA Rollout & Operational Execution (~50%) Own NOVA's rollout and operational execution across the four organizations, establishing it as the route through which enterprise AI work is shaped, prioritized, built and scaled. Partner with senior leaders to shape AI submissions against the enterprise bar for scalability — value hypothesis, data readiness, architecture, cost-to-scale and path to production — reshaping what's unready and redirecting, consolidating or stopping what cannot clear it, so work reaches governed production rather than stalling as a proof of concept.Maintain the governance that makes speed safe (risk tiering, decision gates, responsible-AI standards, model and agent oversight), and raise the AI fluency of the leaders you advise so they sponsor AI work with realistic expectations of cost, risk and value.Own the value framework and KPIs that hold the NOVA portfolio accountable to realized impact, and help lead the organizational change, culture and talent development.Drive Next-Generation Frontier & Cross-Functional Programs (~40%) Lead the cross-functional AI initiatives that span organizational boundaries, have no natural single owner, and will not succeed without senior technical leadership.Drive frontier programs from concept to a defensible path to deployment: define the technical thesis, pressure-test feasibility, sequence milestones and secure cross-functional investment.Advance Lilly's agentic mission — multi-agent architectures, orchestration, tool use, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design — and resolve the architectural, data and operating-model dependencies that block scale, working across Tech@Lilly, legal, compliance and privacy.Assess the External Environment and Accelerate External Innovation (~10%) Maintain a rigorous, current read of the external AI landscape — models, agents, tooling and applied practice within and beyond life sciences — and route it back through NOVA in actionable form that shapes live submissions, architecture choices and investment sequencing.Maintain an active map of companies, including startups, that can accelerate Lilly's agentic mission, and partner with Procurement, Legal, Privacy and Information Security on a fast-track evaluation pathway — pre-negotiated terms, right-sized risk assessment, time-boxed evaluation — so promising partners aren't lost to a multi-month onboarding cycle.Minimum Qualification RequirementsA postgraduate qualification (MBA, MSc, M.Pharm or equivalent), or an equivalent depth of professional experience.15+ years of progressive leadership across enterprise strategy, transformation and technology, in pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences, or other complex regulated global enterprises, including substantial experience leading AI initiatives.A track record of taking AI from concept to production at enterprise scale across multiple business functions — including the architectural, data and responsible-AI decisions required to deploy safely — with measured business impact, not strategy alone.Proven success as the senior technical voice on large, cross-functional initiatives within Global Capability Centers and/or Fortune-100 enterprises — including the standing to challenge and redirect executive-sponsored work, and a track record of influencing decisions across a matrixed, global organization.Deep, current expertise across the AI and generative-AI lifecycle — large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and multi-agent systems, evaluation methodology and the data foundations they depend on — sufficient to independently assess feasibility, interrogate architecture and cost-to-scale, and hold your own with engineering and research leaders. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but it demands genuine technical depth; program and process-management capability alone will not suffice.Sound judgment on enterprise AI governance, operational risk and performance measurement, and on where to trade speed against trust and compliance.Exceptional executive presence and communication: the ability to influence executives, align diverse teams, explain complex technical and risk factors in clear business terms, lead through ambiguity, and develop others.Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technology vendors and startups on technical merit and build co-innovation partnerships that convert into enterprise adoption, working with procurement, legal and security functions to compress evaluation and onboarding cycles without weakening enterprise risk standards.Preferred QualificationsFluency with recognized responsible-AI and governance frameworks (for example, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act).Experience elevating Global Capability Centers from delivery into innovation and value creation.Familiarity with Lilly's commercial model or other regulated, global operating environments.A background in digital product, platform or automation delivery.Recognized project or process-excellence credentials (PMP, Lean or Six Sigma) are a plus.Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions.
