role: Associate Director - Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts
normalizedText: CardioMetabolic MarketingNovo Nordisk Pvt Ltd (Affiliate)Your new roleThe Associate Director – Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts will be responsible for leading the end-to-end brand strategy and execution for Wegovy in India. The role is accountable for driving business growth, strengthening brand positioning, and shaping the obesity care market through insight-led and customer-centric strategies. It requires strong cross-functional leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate plans into impactful and compliant execution. The role also requires agility to understand and adapt to evolving organisational structures, go-to-market models, and customer needs as the obesity market develops in India.Your key responsibilities as Associate Director – Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts will include:Own and drive Wegovy brand strategy with accountability for business performance, including sales, market share, and profitabilityLead market shaping initiatives to improve obesity awareness, diagnosis, and treatment adoption in partnership with Medical, Market Access, and external stakeholdersDesign and execute an effective omnichannel customer engagement strategy for HCPs, institutions, and priority customer segmentsEnsure execution excellence through timely, high-quality implementation of marketing plans aligned to field needs and execution prioritiesDrive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Medical, Market Access, and Global teams to ensure integrated planning and delivery of business objectivesManage lifecycle planning to support launch readiness, portfolio expansion, and long-term brand sustainabilityDevelop and execute key account/institution engagement plans, ensuring measurable outcomes and continuous adaptation to evolving market and organizational needsAbout International OperationsAs part of International Operations, you will join our largest operational unit. Covering 194 countries and 95% of the world's population, more than 18,000 of us work passionately to serve 35 million patients each day. With a promise to outperform the competition, we continue to be the growth driver for Novo Nordisk, and to improve health at scale across the globe.About The DepartmentThe Cardio-Metabolic Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies for cardiometabolic and related therapeutic areas. The team ensures strong brand leadership and measurable business performance by driving initiatives that improve disease awareness, appropriate diagnosis, and treatment adoption in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.Your Skills & QualificationsMBA / PGDM or equivalent qualification, preferably with a strong academic background.Approximately 12 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare marketing7–8 years of experience in the marketing domain and at least 4+ years of people management experiencePrior experience in launch strategy and execution, along with consumer awareness or patient activation campaigns, will be an added advantage.Demonstrated experience in leading brands, launch readiness, lifecycle management, or specialty portfoliosStrong track record in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaborationPrior exposure to high-growth, competitive, or innovative therapy areas will be an advantageWorking at Novo NordiskEvery day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.What We OfferThere is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.Deadline31 July 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. We’re not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health. jdEvidence.value: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of owned marketing channel campaigns (primarily email), ensuring timely and quality delivery, coordination between product marketing managers, production teams, and development, and optimizing campaign performance.

normalizedText: Join Us!At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!Program Management Senior Specialist is the glue that keeps all the elements of an owned marketing channel campaign (i.e. email) project together. They are well organized project managers, excellent communicators, proactive problem solvers and technical subject matter experts well versed in growth marketing. They are the connective tissue between the business (product marketing managers), production project managers and development team. They ensure projects are well defined, and delivered on time and meet quality standards.Position ResponsibilitiesPartner with product marketing managers (PMMs) in campaign ideation and intake document formulationCollaborate with PMMs during the campaign ideation stage, gather technical requirements, confirm feasibility of ideated campaign features, define potential execution timeline and the intricacies of email personalization and complex logic.Provide strategic input on growth best practices, segmentation, and user journey optimization to help achieve campaign business goals.Act as a consultative partner, advising PMMs on how to translate business objectives into effective owned channel (i.e. email) strategies.Guide the PMM through the Campaign Requirement Document creation, ensure the intake documents are completed and comprehensive for the production team.Project manage campaign development and deploymentKick off and strategically manage campaign development with offshore production team, provide guidance and answers to production team during the production process, manage production timelines. Prepare work orders for the production team and create project estimations for the PMM, managing the approval process for these estimates.Coordinate with Data Specialists to ensure that data requirements and inputs are fully aligned with HTML development and production process, as well as be a strategic partner between Data Specialists and offshore production team.Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) reviews on all deliverables against client specifications before releasing to the PMMCommunicate production progress to PMM, facilitate approval of simulations, proofs and prototypes, ensure any changes are implemented after prototype and proof review.Flag issues that arise during the production process and proactively seek solutions. Manage campaign deployment in Internal Growth tools, monitor campaign healthActively manage the Internal growth tool (i.e..Gamma) campaign deployments and proactively manage the campaign lifecycle (pause, activate, launch Gamma campaigns). GAMMA is Google’s internal email marketing platform.Be the expert on Gamma campaigns under their management.Monitor campaign deployment health through Gamma reporting tools and internal tools. Where applicable, delegate monitoring to Data Specialists and email specialists acting as the accountable party for campaign health monitoring and error escalation.Conduct post-launch campaign performance analysis to derive engagement insights and identify areas for future improvement.Troubleshoot and solve escalationsWhen issues arise on existing or newly deployed campaigns, proactively lead the resolution process by quickly identifying root causes, work closely with product marketing managers, production project managers, and the development team.Document the issue in the form of a blameless post mortem, ensure alignment across stakeholders and facilitate process adjustments mitigating repetition of the issue in the future across the team. Keep things organized Attend regular scrums and stand ups, provide updates on project status and act as a collaborative business partner to the PMM leading the scrum.Effectively and proficiently communicate with the offshore production team by setting up and leading weekly calls. Maintain internal project status trackers and post launch quality control sheets.Ensure accurate work progress tracking in Asana. Drive innovation and thrive for excellenceProactively look for ways to improve the process to drive efficiency and reduce risk such as through implementing AI tools in the email creative or production processes.QualificationsMinimum Qualifications:Overall 5+ years of experience in project management roles, coordinating projects across multiple organizations/cross functional teams.Complex Email Campaign Management: 2-3 years of proven ability to manage high-complexity, interdependent email campaigns, anticipating risks across multiple systems and stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment.Email Marketing Technology Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in primary email marketing technology tools (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua, Hubspot etc.) with the ability to learn and navigate independently across multiple platforms.Technical Proficiency (HTML): Basic understanding of web development, HTML/CSS & QA processes, with the ability to identify root causes, troubleshoot technical issues, and architect resilient solutions."Strategic Client Handling: Advanced client handling skills with a track record of acting as a strategic advisor, understanding scope and providing estimates that align with long-term business goals.Data Analysis: Proficiency in data analysis tools to interpret performance results and recommend strategic improvements to stakeholders.Communication: Strong, polished, and professional communication skills required for interacting with stakeholders and leading the production team.Preferred QualificationsPreferred Qualifications:Understanding of marketing operations, processes, business requirements.Proactive and curious attitude, strong problem solving skills.Familiarity using GenAI (generative AI) for email marketing content, production and optimization.Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with rapidly changing priorities and a high volume of projects.BenefitsWe support you with competitive wages and with normalizedText: Job Details Position title: Senior Manager, Individual Giving (Grade-9) Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka ChildFund office: Bengaluru office Manager/Supervisor title: Director, Business Development Sustainability Position type: Full-time fixed term Work environment: Hybrid Job Summary The Senior Manager, Individual Giving will provide strategic leadership to ChildFund India s in raising resources from individual supporters through Face-to-Face (F2F), Telemarketing, Digital Fundraising, and High Net-Worth Individual (HNI) engagement. The role will embed analytics into fundraising operations to ensure data-driven decisionmaking, campaign optimisation, and donor retention. Remain alert and responsive to any safeguarding risks; acquire and maintain the relevant knowledge and skills necessary to promote strong safeguarding practices; understand and adhere to ChildFund India s Safeguarding Policy and Procedures; and conduct yourself at all times in a manner consistent with ChildFund India s safeguarding principles and standards. Primary Responsibilities Lead in drafting and executing strategies for quality acquisition, donor retention, and increasing lifetime value of individual donors across F2F, Telemarketing, Digital, and HNI channels. Deliver income targets for IFR ensuring efficiency and ROI. Develop a business case for in-house F2F fundraising. Track progress against KPIs, income targets, and alignment with the organizational strategy. Conceptualize innovative ideas for raising awareness for garnering support and resources from public at large. Ensure alignment of fundraising opportunities with the Country Strategic Plan and other relevant norms of ChildFund India. Ensure compliance with organizational policies and processes in selection of relevant agencies and supporters for various fundraising initiative. Fundraising Channels Digital Fundraising: Drive online campaigns, and social media-led donor acquisition, leverage analytics dashboards for optimisation. High Net-Worth Individual (HNI) Fundraising: Build tailored donor journeys,personalised stewardship, and bespoke reporting for HNIs. Face-to-Face (F2F) Fundraising: Lead F2F operations, including recruitment,training, and monitoring; innovate engagement strategies to improve donor acquisition and retention. Telemarketing: Oversee telemarketing campaigns, donor conversion strategies, and integration with other IFR channels. Donor Servicing and Reporting Support in designing and execution of relevant communication and branding strategies to support fund raising initiatives. Develop innovative strategies, plans and systems for improved donor experience and donor upgrade /recapture Responsible for high quality donor servicing and regular communications, such as mailers and newsletter, with individual supporters, corporates and institutions. Ensure timely completion and delivery of internal and external reporting requirements. Skills Building Capacity Development Update and deliver training plans for partner agency and internal staff to strengthen fundraising skills in F2F, HNI, and Digital. Build team capacity to handle donor queries and potential issues effectively. Ensure proper use of collaterals (pitch cards, welcome Kits, digital donation sites) to aid donor communication. Monitoring Problem Solving Set up systems to monitor KPIs such as Weekly acquisition. Set up systems to monitor KPIs such as Attrition and retention. Set up systems to monitor KPIs such as Lead acquisition and management. Set up systems to monitor KPIs such as Digital conversion. Set up systems to monitor KPIs such as Cost-benefit analysis per channel. Provide inputs to improve efficiency of donor acquisition through evidence-based approaches. Lead in resolving issues and addressing challenges across IFR channels. Team Management Manage Individual Fundraising team Orient/train and mentor teams for effective delivery of fundraising plan and targets. Responsible for periodic performance review of teams and recognize best performances. As a member of the CLT, participate and represent organisataion in various internal and external forums. Any other tasks that may be assigned by the Line Manager from time to time. Required Experience and Education Education: Graduate in Management/Marketing/Social Sciences. Post Graduate or equivalent will be a plus. Experience: Minimum 8 years experience in individual fundraising/resource mobilization leading around 10-member team. Proven track record in digital fundraising, HNI relationship management, F2F, and telemarketing. Skills Abilities: Evidence-based analytical skills. Strong donor relations and engagement skills. Excellent communication skills (verbal, written and interpersonal). Adept in using computers, particularly in using Microsoft Office suite applications. Required Competencies ChildFund s Core Competencies Teamwork: the ability to work effectively and collaborate with others; values and respects individual differences. Communication: demonstrates empathy and tact when communicating with others and uses a storytelling approach when appropriate. Results orientation: gets things done; takes proactive steps to achieve organizational goals and quality standards. normalizedText: Position - Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) Industry - Food FMCG (Edible Oils / Packaged Foods) Experience - 18-25 Years Location - Mumbai Job Summary We are looking for a commercially driven Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to lead the company's marketing strategy and drive profitable business growth. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in the Food FMCG industry, with a strong understanding of brand management, pricing, innovation, consumer insights, distribution, and category management. The CMO will be responsible for growing revenue, market share, and profitability while building strong brands across multiple consumer segments and sales channels. Key Responsibilities 1. Business & Category Strategy Develop and execute marketing strategies to achieve revenue, volume, market share, and gross margin growth. Drive category growth across different geographies and consumer segments. Identify new business opportunities through market and consumer analysis. 2. Brand Portfolio Management Define clear positioning for mass, value, premium, and health-focused brands. Build a strong brand portfolio while minimizing overlap and internal competition. Strengthen overall brand equity and consumer preference. 3. Pricing & Revenue Management Develop effective pricing strategies and pack-price architecture. Manage product pricing considering consumer affordability and commodity price fluctuations. Improve profitability through pricing, promotions, and revenue optimization. 4. Go-to-Market Strategy Lead growth across: General Trade Rural Markets Modern Trade Institutional Sales / HoReCa E-commerce Quick Commerce Drive distribution expansion and improve market penetration. 5. Consumer & Market Insights Analyse consumer behaviour, regional food preferences, market trends, competitor activities, and retail data. Convert market insights into actionable business strategies. 6. Innovation & New Product Development Lead product innovation and new product launches. Develop new oils, blends, fortified products, premium offerings, and packaging innovations. Identify suitable price points and commercialization opportunities. 7. Sales & Trade Marketing Partner closely with Sales to improve: Distribution Trade profitability Secondary sales Trade schemes Retail visibility Ensure marketing initiatives support business growth. 8. Marketing Effectiveness Manage ATL, BTL, Digital, Retail Branding, Trade Marketing, and Influencer Marketing. Measure and improve marketing ROI using data-driven decision making. Optimize media investments for maximum business impact. 9. Digital Commerce Drive business growth across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms. Manage assortment, search visibility, content quality, promotions, conversion, and profitability. 10. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Build and mentor a high-performing marketing organization. Manage agency relationships and marketing budgets. Present business performance, strategic initiatives, and investment proposals to the CEO and Board. Collaborate closely with Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, and R&D teams.

normalizedText: Company Description ZOOM Communications is South Asia’s largest provider of outdoor broadcast systems, solutions, and services, with over three decades of experience in the industry. The company works across sports, media, entertainment, and the public sector, supporting high-profile events and complex broadcast requirements. ZOOM’s portfolio includes major projects such as ICC U-19 World Cup, FIFA U-17 World Cup, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, IPL, WPL, ISL, National Games, Big Boss, and Indian Idol. The company also designs and builds studios for leading news channels and executes turnkey systems integration projects, offering end-to-end broadcast infrastructure solutions. Professionals joining ZOOM are exposed to large-scale, dynamic events and cutting-edge broadcast technologies.Role Description Chief Business Officer - Events will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic vision for the Events Business, driving sustainable growth, market leadership, and profitability in domestic and international markets. The incumbent will own the end-to-end events ecosystem, from conceptualization and creation of intellectual properties (IPs) to commercialization, execution, audience engagement, and client success.Key Responsibility Areas: 1. Business Strategy and Growth · Define and execute the long-term growth strategy for the events business, aligned with organizational objectives.· Identify new market opportunities, audience segments, industry verticals, and event formats to drive expansion and market leadership.· Own the P&L for the events business and drive revenue growth across sponsorships, partnerships, ticketing, delegate sales, exhibitor participation, and ancillary revenue streams.· Build and nurture relationships with sponsors, brands, industry associations, government bodies, media partners, and strategic stakeholders. 2. Successful candidate will bring a unique blend of commercial acumen, creative thinking, operational excellence, and leadership capability to create industry-leading event properties and deliver exceptional stakeholder experiences. normalizedText: Job Description We are seeking an experienced and visionary Marketing Head to lead our marketing strategy and drive brand growth at Emerging India Analytics. This senior leadership role is perfect for a strategic marketing professional who thrives in the dynamic ed-tech landscape and has a proven track record of building successful marketing teams and campaigns. As our Marketing Head, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that enhance brand visibility, drive lead generation, and support our mission of transforming careers through technology education. Youll lead a diverse marketing team and work closely with senior leadership to achieve ambitious growth targets. This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned marketing leader to shape the marketing direction of a rapidly growing ed-tech company and make a significant impact on our expansion across India and beyond. Key Responsibilities Strategic Marketing Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, market trends, and competitive landscape analysis. Team Management: Lead, mentor, and expand the marketing team including digital marketing specialists, content creators, and marketing coordinators. Brand Management: Oversee brand positioning, messaging, and visual identity to ensure consistent brand experience across all touchpoints. Digital Marketing Strategy: Drive multi-channel digital marketing campaigns including SEO/SEM, social media, email marketing, and content marketing. Lead Generation & Conversion: Develop and optimize lead generation funnels, improve conversion rates, and maximize ROI on marketing investments. Market Research & Analytics: Conduct market research, analyze customer behavior, and leverage data insights to inform marketing decisions and strategies. Partnership Marketing: Establish and manage strategic partnerships, influencer collaborations, and co-marketing opportunities to expand reach. Budget Management: Manage marketing budget allocation, track ROI, and ensure cost-effective marketing spend across all channels and campaigns. Requirements & Qualifications Essential Requirements: MBA in Marketing or related field from a premier institution 5-8 years of progressive marketing experience with 2+ years in leadership roles Proven track record in ed-tech, technology, or education industry Strong expertise in digital marketing, performance marketing, and analytics Experience managing marketing budgets of 50 lakh+ annually Exceptional leadership and team management skills Data-driven approach with proficiency in marketing analytics tools Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills Preferred Qualifications: Experience scaling marketing teams from 5 to 20+ members Track record of achieving 100%+ growth in marketing qualified leads Expertise in marketing automation platforms and CRM systems Experience with global or multi-regional marketing campaigns Knowledge of B2B and B2C marketing strategies Previous experience in startups or high-growth companies Industry certifications in Google Ads, Facebook Marketing, etc. What We Offer Executive Package 5-6 LPA + Performance Bonus Leadership Role Lead marketing strategy and build your team Equity Participation Employee stock options in a growing company Premium Setup MacBook Pro and premium marketing tools Travel & Events Conference attendance and industry events Executive Benefits Premium health insurance and wellness package

job descriptionJob Description – Chief Operating Officer (COO)Position: Chief Operating Officer (COO)Reporting To: Managing Director / Chief Executive Officer (CEO)Location: Corporate Office - Panvel, Mumbai Job Summary The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is responsible for leading and overseeing the day-to-day operations of the organization, ensuring operational excellence, profitability, clinical quality, and business growth across all clinics. The COO will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to develop and execute business strategies, optimize processes, improve patient experience, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive sustainable growth in the Hair Transplant and Skin Aesthetics business. Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Leadership: Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the organization's vision and business objectives. Drive revenue growth while maintaining high standards of patient care. Lead expansion initiatives including new clinic setup and operational readiness. Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost optimization, and business scalability. Participate in annual business planning and budgeting. Operations Management: Oversee end-to-end operations across all clinics. Standardize operational processes and ensure SOP adherence. Monitor clinic performance through defined KPIs. Improve operational efficiency and resource utilization. Ensure seamless coordination between clinical, sales, HR, finance, marketing, and administration. Clinical Operations: Ensure compliance with established clinical protocols and patient safety standards. Monitor OT utilization, surgery scheduling, and doctor productivity. Collaborate with Clinical Heads to improve treatment outcomes. Ensure high-quality patient care throughout the treatment journey. Patient Experience: Enhance patient satisfaction through continuous process improvements. Monitor patient feedback, complaints, and service recovery. Develop initiatives to improve patient retention and referrals. Ensure consistent patient experience across all locations. Revenue & Business Performance: Drive clinic profitability and operational efficiency. Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly revenue performance. Review consultation conversion rates, surgery conversions, package sales, and service utilization. Implement performance improvement initiatives where required. Financial Management: Prepare and monitor operational budgets. Control operational costs without compromising quality. Review profitability reports and financial performance. Ensure optimum utilization of manpower and resources. Leadership & People Management: Lead Regional Managers, Clinic Managers, Clinical Heads, Sales Teams, and Operations Managers. role: Senior Principal - Development & CMO Digital & Tech Strategy
normalizedText: GSK Development and Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Digital and Technology’s mission is to disrupt and transform the way GSK thinks about, generates and submits evidence to radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines for our patients and participants.We act as a strategic thought partner for the Development Operations and CMO organisations, bringing together diverse stakeholders to radically transform and connect siloed processes using innovative and integrated technology. Your roleAs the Senior Principal, Strategy you will be a pivotal partner for the Development and CMO Digital and Technology leadership team, responsible for both shaping our strategic agenda and driving its execution to help us radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines.You will probe and clarify strategic choices, lead analysis on critical business problems, and own high-priority initiatives from concept to completion. Alongside this, you will serve as a chief of staff to the leadership team - acting as the throughline across our planning cycles, governance, and leadership sessions to ensure strategy translates into decisive action. You will work closely with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio team, ensuring their capabilities and processes are leveraged in service of our objectives.This role requires you to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and the hands-on work of keeping a complex leadership team focused, aligned, and moving forward.Your ResponsibilitiesDrive and Facilitate the Leadership Team's Strategic Agenda: Act as the throughline for the leadership team's strategic agenda - ensuring what gets discussed becomes decided, and what gets decided gets done. You will own the meeting rhythm: setting agendas, ensuring pre-reads are in place, and working with teams across the department to drive actions to completion between sessions.Lead High-Priority & Cross-Cutting Strategic Initiatives: Take direct ownership of ambiguous, high-impact projects, particularly those that cut across multiple programmes and teams. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle: shaping the hypothesis, conducting analysis, building consensus, and delivering integrated solutions that drive our transformation forward.Co-lead Annual Planning: In partnership with the Strategy Director, co-lead the annual planning cycle - driving both the OKR-setting process and the investment planning process, ensuring the two are aligned and that clear trade-off decisions are made.Build and Communicate a Shared Strategic Narrative: Own the communications that bring our strategy to life across the department - translating leadership decisions and strategic priorities into clear, compelling messages for all staff, so that everyone understands where we are going and how their work connects to it.Partner with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio Team: Work closely with the Portfolio team to ensure the operational processes that underpin both our strategic programmes and the day-to-day running of the department are effective and efficient — identifying where things aren't working and driving improvements that help the department deliver against its objectives.Why you?Basic Qualifications:Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a scientific area (e.g. computer science, engineering, mathematics), or related quantitative discipline.15+ Experience in technology strategy, within a large-scale technology organisation, a corporate strategy function, or a management consulting firm.Experience supporting or operating as chief of staff to a senior leadership team, including owning meeting rhythms, governance forums, and cross-team action tracking.Relevant experience in the life sciences industry.We are looking for professionals with the following capabilities:Senior Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to act as a trusted partner to leaders, building strong relationships, providing candid advice, and facilitating high-stakes discussions to drive alignment and clear decisions.Structured Problem-Solving and Analysis: A highly analytical mindset with the ability to take ambiguous, complex business problems, structure them, and drive them to a concrete solution through hands-on analysis and project management.Exceptional Communication and Synthesis: The ability to synthesise complex information into clear, concise narratives for a range of audiences, from executive leadership to all staff. You can distil the "so what" and make strategy feel relevant and actionable at every level.Preferred Qualifications:R&D Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the pharmaceutical R&D value chain, from drug discovery and clinical development through to regulatory submission.Agile Ways of Working: Familiarity with Agile principles and ways of working (e.g. Scrum, SAFe), with the ability to operate effectively within an organisation that runs on agile rhythms.AI-Augmented Working: Practical experience applying AI tools to accelerate strategic and analytical work, and a track record of helping others do the same — for example, driving adoption of AI tools that enhance how product owners and delivery teams operate day-to-day.SkillsChange Management, Compliance Risk Management, Dependency Analysis, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications, Stakeholder ManagementWhy GSK?Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.Inclusion at GSK:As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.Important notice to Employment businesses/ AgenciesGSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. normalizedText: Minimum qualifications:Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.8 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role. Preferred qualifications:Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.10 years of experience leading scaled operations/Managed Service Providers (MSPs).Experience in process optimization methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping) to identify bottlenecks and reduce customer effort.Ability to drive AI quality assurance and operational automation through prompt engineering, code-based workflow integrations (e.g., using Python, Java, Apps Script, or similar), and the development of Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents and SQL-backed reporting dashboards.Familiarity with digital advertising technology, Google's sellside products (Google Ad Manager, AdMob, AdSense), or technical support environments.About the jobYou will be responsible for defining the future of quality assurance for our sellside support organization balancing the strategic design of our quality framework and the integration of AI tools and agentic technology with the operational execution and vendor management required to maintain high quality standards. You will serve as the independent "connective tissue" across cross-functional teams to resolve customer experience blockers and ensure consistent, high-value support delivery. You will lead the transition from manual, sample-based auditing to a 100% continuous coverage model powered by Gemini, setting a standard for quality operations at Google. You will work directly with gTech Ads Sellside technical support and consulting team, vendor management, Product, Global Partners (GP) Sellside, and regional technical support teams, including training functions to drive product improvements and process redesigns, holding the organization accountable for quality. You are an "AI-first" applicant who is willing to develop agents or use AI to automate heavy operational tasks and act as a team multiplier for the team's impact. You will interact face-to-face with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and our internal vendor management team. You will be responsible for gathering direct feedback, aligning cross-functionally, driving down inaccuracies, and holding vendor operations accountable from an impartial standpoint.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.To learn more about gTech, check out our video .ResponsibilitiesLead the design, evolution, and oversight of the Sellside Quality Framework, aligning audit criteria with the end-to-end publisher journey.Transform traditional manual auditing workflows to AI-powered, continuous baseline audits augmented by targeted human calibration and partner with technical teams to design, test, and implement agentic quality tools to scale audit coverage to 100%.Maximize AI reliability and accuracy by designing, testing, and relentlessly optimizing complex system prompts that successfully minimize hallucinations and efficiently handle challenging operational edge cases.Drive improvement of partner experiences, identifying areas of opportunity to streamline processes, content and strategy, implement updates etc.Manage daily operational activities (reporting, root cause analysis, and feedback loops) required to enforce quality standards and accountability across global vendor operations and Managed Service Providers (MSPs).Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form . normalizedText: About Loop: Loop is an agentic restaurant intelligence software that augments back office of restaurant chains by automating workflows and delivering intelligence across the finance, operations and marketing functions. Loop deploys AI agents built by our in-house team of AI engineers, strategists and subject matter experts into restaurant brands bringing industry best practices in handling complex internal functions. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Tampa and India.Loop is one of the fastest growing restaurant technology companies powering a few billion dollars in revenue and growing to serve 10K+ restaurants within 3 years across some of the most recognizable brands of the USA, helping them grow their topline & bottomline.Loop is built by a world class team of entrepreneurs, operators, leaders and AI engineers from different industries, ranging from cutting edge big-tech, management consulting, investment banking among others across companies like Uber, Google, Amazon, McKinsey and others.About the Role: As a Principal strategist in the Strategy & Operations charter of Loop, you will own a mix of Product & Customer Strategy & Operations for all products of Loop, across the lifecycle of a customer from onboarding, engagement and retention. Loop’s products power a few billion dollars in revenue today and are poised to scale multifold over the next few years. As the products and the scope of service expands,you are expected to be a value custodian of Loop’s products, donning a product & business lens to maximize customer value.In this role, you will cross-functionally impact Loop’s strategy by collaborating across functions while owning key customer value metrics.Responsibilities: Ownership of product north star metrics and customer value metricsBuilding playbooks for the product, product support, customer strategy & success functionsOwnership of all internal products & processes needed to be built across functions to ensure value delivery to customersOwnership of internal processes needed to monitor and improve agentic workflows, not limited to evals, system prompts, creating templates and agentic workflows for customers, etcCollaborating with the product team on the product roadmap, taking business needs and customer needs into account Leadership of high performance, rockstar teamsEligibility/ Fit: You are most likely a strong candidate for this role if you: Have 10-15 years of experience building/shipping/scaling software/ digital products in SaaS, AI, Consumer Internet, Fintech and other tech-forward industriesHave been a revenue or PnL owner/ leader in your previous rolesHave worked across product, growth, revenue, strategy & operations or founder rolesAre inherently a great sales person - be it selling a product, vision or anything else! Have the ability to break fairly complex problems into smaller parts and build the necessary products, processes and systems around them. Have hired rockstar employees & teams and have scaled functions multiple times. Have the ability to think metrics, funnels and dashboards and work backwards from a large problemHave exhibited leadership while also having worked in IC roles across your previous roles Have the ability to understand complex customer/ business problem statements from the lens of business and can make tradeoffs and build for the right customer outcomesDemonstrate key cultural values of Loop across radical ownership, customer obsession and have the ability to lose no time & move fast on solving problems. Have the wisdom of your experiences to separate the forest from the trees and have an intuition to be often right. Have a strong hunger for personal growth and wish to build and deploy products of the next generation at scale, as an operator or a founder. normalizedText: About JLG, An Oshkosh CompanyJLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.SummaryThe Digital Technology (DT) Leader – India provides operational leadership for DT services supporting approximately $40 million in regional revenue. This role is accountable for delivering technology solutions aligned with Enterprise DT strategy, overseeing India’s DT offshore shared services in support of global DT operations, and enabling international digital technology and onsite Manufacturing Operations in India. This position will be reporting to the Segment CIO.The DT Leader builds and develops a high-performing team, drives operational excellence, manages budgets, ensures compliance, and partners with business stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes. This role fosters a culture rooted in DT Competencies—customer obsession, agility, results, and entrepreneurship—while demonstrating Oshkosh leadership behaviors.The ideal candidate must possess extensive experience working with U.S.-based teams and the ability to communicate effectively across local and global audiences, ensuring smooth collaboration in a matrixed global environment.Your Impact Execute DT strategy within the India region, ensuring alignment with global DT standards, roadmaps, and strategic initiatives. Provide management oversight to India’s DT offshore shared services model to support global DT service delivery. Ensure compliance with DT policies, cybersecurity requirements, risk controls, and audit standards while maintaining strong operational performance. Partner with business leaders to deliver technology solutions that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and business outcomes. Manage departmental budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to maximize ROI and operational value. Drive innovation, process improvement, and service optimization across DT operations, tools, and platforms. Build strong, collaborative relationships with stakeholders and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. Evaluate emerging technology trends to identify opportunities for modernization or enhanced capabilities. Support implementation of DT best practices, governance frameworks, and global operating models. Serve as the lead negotiator for India DT vendor management, ensuring alignment with enterprise DT services and cost optimization. Perform other duties as assigned to support DT and broader business priorities.Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or related field. Ten (10) or more years of experience in DT or related fields. Seven (7) or more years of management or team leadership experience. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across local and global stakeholders. Knowledge of ITIL, COBIT, financial planning, budgeting, agile, scrum, data analytics, business acumen, and design thinking. Strong communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and leadership skills.Standout Qualifications Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or global/matrixed environments. Experience driving digital transformation or service excellence initiatives. Experience with cloud infrastructure, enterprise platforms, and data analytics & AI solutions. normalizedText: About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.For more information, visit wppmedia.com.About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comAt WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Reporting of the roleThis role reports to the SVP - Commerce.3 Best Things About The Job: A fun environment that combines the best of being entrepreneurial and being part of an award-winning & young global media agency network - the largest marketing services group in the world. Working on a fast-growing industry first E-commerce practice with access to multiple strategic partnerships, proprietary industry first tools and opportunity to grow in the e-commerce ecosystem. A P&L management role where you will constantly be inspired, challenged and learn something new every day.In 3 Months:In this role, your goals will be: Get an understanding of the client’s e-commerce business & understand stakeholder engagement. Started to build relationships with the key decision makers and strategic partners. Take a handover on complete client business – internalize brand playbooks, past e-commerce campaigns * efforts & any client specific framework trainings. Support in development of category>brand specific Playbooks/SOPS/Calendars for the client on media commerce plans & opportunities at a platform level. Develop a framework to track and share category insights & learnings basis past & current e-commerce activations and campaigns – also track competition activity & cascade to relevant stakeholders. Have a broad POV on e-commerce business in India across various business models, understanding & value of “media” as a lever to drive incremental growth for the client on e-commerce. Develop & share reporting formats and SLAs – streamline data requirements (internal & external). Identify all relevant internal support teams and drive effective engagement.In Six Months, You Would Have: Work with e-commerce platform partners on campaign planning, deployment & track deliverables. Work with the e-commerce team lead on all media commerce strategy & planning discussions. Manage active communication & support on all client related e-commerce needs with central trading & e-commerce team. Support on e-commerce focused workshops & trainings as required for internal & client teams. 100% certification on all e-commerce related platform trainings & certifications for self & team E.g.: AMS (Amazon), Google, FB etc.In 12 Months, You Would Have: Work with E-commerce Team Lead to ensure 100% achievement of targets delivered to client. Manage a daily/weekly/monthly tracking dashboard to track category>sub-category>brand level Metrics. Support in development of e-commerce media AOPs in collaboration with mainline + digital teams.Responsibilities Of The Role: Manage integration of media commerce campaigns with overall mainline & off-platform digital campaign planning & execution. Execute & Track performance of all media commerce campaigns for the client, across search, display, DSP and off-platform performance marketing campaigns. Lead Evangelization of the use of e-commerce across all client media plans & drive early adoption with both internal & external teams. Managing a team of 2-3 practice & platform specialists based in Mumbai.What You Will Need: A smart / sharp leader who: Has an entrepreneurial spirit and is self-motivated Understands the e-commerce ecosystem & business landscape (Marketplace, E-grocers, Hyperlocal platforms etc.) Strong understanding of the digital ad & media platforms like Google, FB, Amazon, etc. – knowledge on capability, metrics & business implication on client’s e-commerce business strategy Ability to leverage industry connects & sources to help achieve the e-commerce targets for the client. Has execution experience & understanding of e-commerce industry ad platforms like Amazon Search, DSP, etc. and strong knowledge of media opportunities that exist on other e-commerce platforms Isn’t wary of getting their hands dirty or stepping into the trenches Have a minimum experience of 10+ years in the e-commerce industry Experience of having worked with any of the large e-commerce/internet platforms or experience in an e-commerce profile having worked for a company within FMCG/ Consumer Durables/ Mobile/Electronic categories Experience of having managed performance marketing & brand media campaigns on leading e=commerce platforms will be a plus Experience of working in roles such as Category Management/Marketing, Media Monetization, Ecommerce Key Account Management, Business Development & Strategic Alliances Experience of working in a media/e-commerce agency having managed e-commerce business or media campaigns for mid/large clients across categories like FMCG, Consumer Durables, Electronics etc.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. jdEvidence.value: Responsible for testing and delivering high-quality trading, market data, clearing, settlement, compliance, and post-trade applications across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

normalizedText: Job Description Job Purpose Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and solve complex business challenges in the ficial sector. This role is responsible for testing and delivering high-quality trading, market data, clearing, settlement, compliance, and post-trade applications across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). We are seeking a highly skilled Senior QA Engineer with strong experience in Equities, Options, Market Data, FIX Protocol, Linux, SQL, Trading Systems, Clearing Settlement, Trade Lifecycle validation, and Trading Systems UI Testing. The ideal candidate should have proven experience designing and executing test scenarios for complex trading platforms, validating order and trade workflows, troubleshooting logs and database records, and supporting regression, UAT, production validation, and release sign-off activities. The successful candidate will work in a dynamic, globally distributed team environment and collaborate closely with Development, Product Management, Operations, Support, and Business teams. The role requires strong domain knowledge, hands-on technical troubleshooting, strong analytical ability, clear communication, and the ability to independently drive QA activities with minimal supervision. This role is best suited for a Senior QA professional with strong Capital Markets domain knowledge, hands-on technical troubleshooting capability, and proven experience validating complex trading, market data, clearing, settlement, UI, and trade lifecycle workflows. The candidate should be able to independently own QA delivery, collaborate across teams, improve test coverage, and support high-quality releases for mission-critical trading systems. Responsibilities Trading Systems QA Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases for Equities, Options, Market Data, Clearing, Settlement, and Trading applications. Validate order entry, routing, execution, cancellation, modification, trade capture, allocation, clearing, settlement, reporting, and downstream workflows. Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, UAT, and production-like validation across integrated trading systems. Trade Lifecycle Testing Validate complete trade lifecycle workflows from order entry through execution, trade capture, clearing, settlement, reporting, and downstream consumption. Verify lifecycle transitions, business rules, reference data impacts, trading session behavior, and product-specific scenarios for Equities and Options. FIX Protocol Testing Validate FIX order entry, execution reports, cancel/replace flows, cancel rejects, drop copy, trade capture, allocation, and market data message flows. Analyze FIX logs for message sequencing, tag-level validation, session behavior, connectivity, reject handling, and execution flow accuracy. Market Data and Feed Validation Test market data feed ingestion, transformation, dissemination, replay, recovery, and downstream publishing workflows. Validate trades, quotes, order book data, symbol/security lifecycle events, market status messages, session transitions, and reference data updates. Verify market data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, sequencing, entitlement/availability, and consistency across systems. Clearing and Settlement Testing Validate clearing account processing, trade allocation, settlement workflows, reconciliation, and post-trade processing accuracy. Ensure exchange, business, and regulatory processing requirements are correctly applied across end-to-end trade flows. Trading Systems UI Testing Validate application screens, user workflows, navigation, field behavior, permission-based behavior, error messages, data consistency, and usability aspects. Perform front-end and back-end reconciliation to confirm UI behavior aligns with database, logs, FIX messages, and downstream system outputs. Defect Management and QA Delivery Identify, document, and track defects using Jira or equivalent tools, including clear evidence, logs, screenshots, data points, and impact details. Review and triage test failures, isolate root cause, collaborate with developers and product teams, and verify fixes through retesting and regression validation. Maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases, execution results, defect summaries, sign-off notes, and release readiness updates. Automation and Continuous Improvement Develop, maintain, and execute automated tests for regression, recurring validations, and high-value business workflows. Improve test coverage, execution efficiency, defect triage, test data management, and regression quality through process and automation enhancements. Use AI-based tools where appropriate for test case generation, log analysis, root cause investigation, and intelligent defect triage. Production, UAT, and Release Support Support UAT preparation, production change validation, release testing, issue investigation, service restoration, and post-deployment verification when required. Work with minimal technical supervision while maintaining strong ownership, timely communication, and quality-focused delivery. Knowledge and Experience Capital Markets Domain: Strong hands-on experience with Equities, Options, electronic trading systems, market structure, exchange operations, and end-to-end trade lifecycle workflows. FIX Protocol: Proven ability to validate and troubleshoot FIX messages for order entry, execution, drop copy, cancel/replace, trade capture, and session-level behavior. Linux: Strong command-line skills for log analysis, process monitoring, file handling, grep/awk/sed usage, scripting basics, and QA environment troubleshooting. SQL: Hands-on experience writing SQL queries for backend validation, result verification, reconciliation, database state analysis, and test data preparation. Market Data: Experience validating feed ingestion, data transformation, dissemination, symbol/security lifecycle events, reference data, trade/quote data, order book data, and downstream consumption. QA Methodologies: Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, usability, smoke, UAT, and production-like validation techniques. Defect Lifecycle: Experience using Jira or similar tools to manage defects from identification through resolution verification and release closure. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze complex issues, identify edge cases, isolate root cause, document evidence, and communicate impact clearly. Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with Development, Product, Operations, Support, Business, and globally distributed QA teams. Ownership: Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results within tight schedules. Preferred Knowledge and Experience Experience with exchange trading platforms, order management systems, market data distribution systems, clearing platforms, or regulatory reporting applications. Knowledge of XDP, multicast feeds, real-time feeds, replay/recovery concepts, market status messages, order book validation, or similar market data technologies is a plus. Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, test data management, release validation, and regression optimization practices. Experience supporting production deployments, UAT testing, production issue debugging, and post-release validation activities. Experience leveraging AI tools to improve QA productivity, including test design, log analysis, defect triage, and root cause investigation. Results-driven mindset with strong ownership, attention to detail, customer focus, and commitment to delivering quality in the right way. normalizedText: Associate Director / Director / Senior Director- Product Marketing, Strategic Growth InitiativesReporting to Chief Marketing OfficerLocation- Mumbai/ Bangalore/ SingaporeAbout Pine LabsPine Labs is the Commerce OS for the Global South—a $1.5B+ business scaling to $5B+ across India, Southeast Asia, UAE, and Africa. We're launching new product lines, entering new markets, and building a unified platform narrative across merchant and enterprise segments.The challenge: we need to write new playbooks, not execute existing ones. This requires a marketing leader who thinks like a business strategist first, marketer second.The RoleYou're a strategic operator who identifies high-impact opportunities across our portfolio and drives them to commercial success. You stand up new markets, launch category-defining products, and orchestrate complex cross-portfolio GTM motions.You own outcomes: pipeline contribution, acquisition economics, revenue attribution, time-to-market. You make growth vs. profitability trade-offs with clear business judgment. You see cross-sell, bundling, and platform opportunities that siloed teams miss.Creativity differentiates: you bring fresh thinking to tired categories, craft campaigns that connect human-to-human, and reject formulaic approaches when the opportunity demands something bolder.Scope: Associate Director to Senior Director depending on experience.You'll lead specific initiatives or architect our entire strategic growth agenda—calibrated to your capability.What You Own• Market entry strategy: sequencing, positioning, target segments for multi-product launches• How products complement, extend, or redefine our value proposition• Enterprise acquisition: airlines, e-commerce platforms, corporate clients, hospitality• Cross-portfolio synergies: bundling strategies that create disproportionate value• White-space opportunities: segments and use cases between existing product mandates• Cross-functional execution: lead product, sales, partnerships to solve business unit growth constraints• Strategic advisory to CMO: portfolio decisions and resource allocation• Commercial accountability: channel mix, segment prioritization, monthly business impact reportingSuccess Looks Like• New market/business line launched on-time, on-budget with clear revenue contribution• Cross-portfolio synergy activated that drives measurable incremental revenue• Business heads seek your partnership—you're a strategic peer, not support function• CMO trusts you to own initiatives end-to-end; your recommendations shape company strategy• Speed: market entry defined in weeks, not monthsMinimum QualificationsExperience: 10-16+ years in B2B or B2C marketing (Tech, CPG, fintech, payments), with 3-8+ years in senior leadership. Track record of strategic impact, not just tenure.Market Entry & GTM: Launched products/brands in new markets. Established category or drove rapid brand build. Pipeline/revenue attribution in high-growth contexts.Commercial Acumen: Own business metrics (pipeline, CAC, LTV, unit economics, ROI). Model profitability, make growth vs. margin trade-offs. Think like a BU owner.Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives. Orchestrate product, sales, partnerships. Resolve conflicts without escalation.Strategic Thinking: See connections across products and architect as unified platform. Identify cross-sell and bundling opportunities. Think in systems, not silos.Creative Marketing & H2H Mindset: B2B and B2C are both H2H (human to human)—buyer groups differ, but creativity differentiates. Out-of-the-box thinking. Know when to use the playbook and when to rewrite it. Fresh approaches that break through crowded categories.High Autonomy: Thrive when the playbook doesn't exist. Decide with incomplete information, move fast, course-correct. No hand-holding needed.Preferred: Emerging markets/Global South experience. Enterprise customer marketing (complex B2B buying). Merchant-first or underbanked business models.Why This MattersPine Labs is at an inflection point. We have product-market fit in core markets and the capital, team, and ambition to become the defining Commerce OS for the Global South. We need operators who write new playbooks, not execute old ones.This isn't about optimizing campaigns or managing steady-state programs. It's about finding $50M-$100M+ revenue opportunities in white space, standing up category leadership before competitors arrive, and making our platform exponentially more valuable than the sum of its parts.If you think like a GM, get energized by zero-to-one builds, and want strategic work that translates directly to revenue at scale—this is it. Direct CMO access, strategic autonomy, and the problems that define Pine Labs' full potential. normalizedText: Meet Our TeamPega Consulting partners with clients to deliver measurable business outcomes faster. We combine consulting expertise, Blueprint-driven delivery, and AI to help clients transform how work gets donePicture Yourself At PegaAs Director of Consulting, you own client outcomes, portfolio growth, consulting excellence, and talent development. Success comes from creating measurable value for clients and translating that value into long-term growth.What You'll Do At Pega Delivery & the One Number Drive idea-to-outcome cycle time down across your portfolio, engagement over engagement — shortening the distance from a client idea to a realized result. Lead and coach a high-performing team of consulting managers and senior consultants. Hold the standard for Blueprint-led delivery as a design authority — advising and assuring and setting the bar our partners deliver at scale. Design back from the outcome. A requirement met is not an outcome delivered — challenge the ask when it will not get the client where they need to go. Client Engagement & Trusted Advisor Earn trusted-advisor status by consistently delivering results, building executive confidence, and demonstrating deep understanding of client priorities. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.CNS - BC - Marketing Sales & Service : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. normalizedText: About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.For more information, visit wppmedia.com.About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comAt WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role: Platform Innovation, Emerging Tech & GamingTeam: Content & CultureReporting into: Content leadRole Purpose: Lead the end-to-end process of designing, executing, analysing and scaling creative experiments across the emerging tech, gaming and platform innovation agenda for HUL brands that enables breakthrough content experiences, richer storytelling, stronger engagement and measurable business impact.Key Responsibilities Emerging Tech, Innovation and Problem SolvingReframe brand, category and business challenges through a tech-led innovation lens and identify where technology can unlock speed, scale, personalisation, participation, experience, measurability or commerce.Connect tech choices to brand truth, audience behaviour, culture, commerce and business outcomes.Lead innovation across AI, AR, VR, interactive content, automation, mobile-tech, immersive experiences, social destinations, web/app-based platforms and other emerging technologies.Build sustainable experience engines that can support both tactical campaigns and longer-term platforms or IPs.Develop tech-enabled destinations across content creation, content optimisation, community participation, commerce, shoppability and online-offline integrations.Assess feasibility, operating logic, partner capability, scalability, cost and execution complexity for every tech-led idea. Platform Innovation and Creative ExperimentationDevelop and champion a quarterly test-and-learn roadmap for creative innovation, esp with digital media and non-media platforms.Identify and prioritise platform-led innovation opportunities across, but not limited to Meta, Google, Snap, JioStar, Pinterest, ShareChat, Spotify, Gaming networks and other emerging digital partners.Drive experiments across ad formats, content strategies, interactive user journeys, creator-led formats, platform-native storytelling and new engagement mechanics that improve creative effectiveness, engagement and campaign performance.Translate successful experiments into scalable BAU solutions, playbooks and reusable frameworks. Gaming, Esports and Interactive CommunitiesBuild gaming-led brand solutions across esports, mobile gaming, casual gaming, streaming, creators, tournaments, communities and interactive experiences.Develop strong gaming formats across in-game integrations, playable ads, branded environments, creator streams, out-of-game content, community challenges, live tournaments, campus activations, AR, AI and interactive pilots.Lead large-scale gaming events, esports associations and brand-owned gaming IPs from opportunity mapping to execution.Ensure gaming solutions are strategically sharp, brand-safe, executable, measurable and commercially viable.What We’re Looking For10+ years of experience across emerging tech, platform innovation, gaming, esports, digital platforms, brand partnerships, media, content, entertainment, creator economy or youth culture marketing.Deep understanding of digital platforms, platform betas, ad innovation, interactive formats, content experimentation and emerging consumer behaviours.Ability to connect technology, platform behaviour, gaming culture and brand strategy into sharp consumer-facing ideas.Proven ability to build and execute large-scale partnerships, IPs, events, experiments, platform-first campaigns or integrated brand solutions.Strong network across platforms, publishers, gaming partners, right holders, tournament organisers, creators, streamers, production partners, tech partners and communities.Commercially sharp, with strong negotiation, partner evaluation, budget ownership and cost-efficiency skills.Comfortable working across ambiguity, rapid experimentation, multiple stakeholders and evolving technologies.Strong storytelling ability to turn experiments into case studies, internal learnings and scalable brand playbooks.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.
