normalizedText: Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes , Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others. KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market.KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.KONE IT is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation areat the core of everything w.e do, and this makes us an integral part ofKONE’s success.IT professionals - KONE CorporationDevOps Engineer, Power PlatformDevOps engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform suite, including Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder, CoPilot studio. DevOps Engineers ensure that the products and platforms are usable by target users as per agreed service levels, in collaboration with other teams and stakeholders. They combine DevOps principles and practices with service management processes and proactively contribute to realizing the operations performance targets and enabling uninterrupted business operations.Your deep knowledge and hands-on experience with low-code concepts and patterns will enable you to create scalable, robust, and efficient solutions that align with our business objectives. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery. Our mission is to empower businesses to streamline their processes, increase operational efficiency, and drive growth through cutting-edge Low-Code Automation and data-driven solutions. This position requires robust technical capabilities, team spirit, and a customer-centric mindset.Main responsibilities Develop and implement custom solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate ( incl use of Co-Pilot studio, Dataverse ) Automate workflows and business processes Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and provide technical solutions Stay up to date with the latest Power Platform features and trends Automate business processes and workflows using Microsoft Power Automate.. Integrate Power Platform solutions with other Microsoft services and third-party applications. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure. Provide technical support and training to users. Applying Power Apps including an in-depth understanding of customisation, configuration, integration, and extensibility, as well as boundaries and constraints Assisting in collecting and identifying functional requirements Raising the causes of bugs or potential issues of the product and fixing technical issues Being adept at leveraging new approaches to solutions for system design and functionality Addressing and remediating security vulnerability Help guide teams to effectively use the Microsoft Power Platform ( Understand business difficulties to provide solutions by applying problem-solving and decision-making skills Keep abreast of new technologies and be aware of industry standards, best practices, and trends Use various connectors to connect disparate systems to Power Platform applications. Recommend and guide development of APIs for Line of Business applications that do not have native connectors Identify areas and processes where Power Platform and Microsoft 365 can be better leveraged and facilitate process improvement Assists in the evaluation, development, and implementation of company systems, including custom developed, off-the-shelf, and/or hosted solutions. Contribute across all phases of the software development life cycle Adept at crafting Power Apps and Power Platform solutions with the ability to impart your knowledge to both pro-developers and citizen developers.Requirements for the role Min 8+ years experience in enterprise automation, low-code/no-code platforms, as developer Have strong development experience on Power Platforms ( Power Apps, Power Automate) Experience with common data service, data connectors, and APIs. Knowledge of additional programming languages like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and collaboration abilities. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. Solid experience on backlog management, using JIRA, capable of translate between business and technical viewpoints. Strong familiarity and experience with agile, DevOps ways of working and Value- driven prioritization and execution practices Excellent team player, able to take/give feedback directly and improve ways of working & collaboration towards positive direction Deeply interested in automation solution technology, have interested in understanding how technology can help KONE business in productivity gain and efficiency improvement Excellent verbal and written communication in English, able to present content with clarity conciselyAt KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.Read more on https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html

Reporting of the role This role reports to the VP Commerce. 3 best things about the job: 1. A fun environment that combines the best of being entrepreneurial and being part of an award-winning & young global media agency network - the largest marketing services group in the world.2. Working on a fast-growing industry first E-commerce practice with access to multiple strategic partnerships, proprietary industry first tools and opportunity to grow in the e-commerce ecosystem.3. A P&L management role where you will constantly be inspired, challenged and learn something new every day. In this role, your goals will be: In 3 months: Get an understanding of the client s e-commerce business & understand stakeholder engagement. Started to build relationships with the key decision makers and strategic partners. Take a handover on complete client business - internalize brand playbooks, past e-commerce campaigns efforts & any client specific framework trainings. Support in development of category>brand specific Playbooks/SOPS/Calendars for the client on media commerce plans & opportunities at a platform level. Develop a framework to track and share category insights & learnings basis past & current e-commerce activations and campaigns - also track competition activity & cascade to relevant stakeholders. Have a broad POV on e-commerce business in India across various business models, understanding & value of media as a lever to drive incremental growth for the client on e-commerce. Develop & share reporting formats and SLAs - streamline data requirements (internal & external). Identify all relevant internal support teams and drive effective engagement. In six months, you would have: Work with e-commerce platform partners on campaign planning, deployment & track deliverables. Work with the e-commerce team lead on all media commerce strategy & planning discussions. Manage active communication & support on all client related e-commerce needs with central trading & e-commerce team. Support on e-commerce focused workshops & trainings as required for internal & client teams. 100% certification on all e-commerce related platform trainings & certifications for self & team E.g.: AMS (Amazon), Google, FB etc. In 12 months, you would have: Work with E-commerce Team Lead to ensure 100% achievement of targets delivered to client. Manage a daily/weekly/monthly tracking dashboard to track category>sub-category>brand level Metrics. Support in development of e-commerce media AOPs in collaboration with mainline + digital teams. Responsibilities of the role: Manage integration of media commerce campaigns with overall mainline & off-platform digital campaign planning & execution. Execute & Track performance of all media commerce campaigns for the client, across search, display, DSP and off-platform performance marketing campaigns. Lead Evangelization of the use of e-commerce across all client media plans & drive early adoption with both internal & external teams. Managing a team of 2-3 practice & platform specialists based in Mumbai. What you will need: A smart / sharp leader who: Has an entrepreneurial spirit and is self-motivated Understands the e-commerce ecosystem & business landscape (Marketplace, Qcom, E-grocers, Hyperlocal platforms etc.) Strong understanding of the digital ad & media platforms like FB, Amazon, etc. - knowledge on capability, metrics & business implication on client s e-commerce business strategy Ability to leverage industry connects & sources to help achieve the e-commerce targets for the client. Has execution experience & understanding of e-commerce industry ad platforms like Amazon Search, DSP, etc. and strong knowledge of media opportunities that exist on other e-commerce platforms Isn t wary of getting their hands dirty or stepping into the trenches Have a minimum experience of 8+ years in the e-commerce industry & with an overall experience of 10+yrs Experience of having worked with any of the large e-commerce/internet platforms or experience in an e-commerce profile having worked for a company within FMCG/ Consumer Durables/ Mobile/Electronic categories Experience of having managed performance marketing & brand media campaigns on leading e=commerce platforms will be a plus Experience of working in roles such as Category Management/Marketing, Media Monetization, Ecommerce Key Account Management, Business Development & Strategic Alliances Experience of working in a media/e-commerce agency having managed e-commerce business or media campaigns for mid/large clients across categories like FMCG, Consumer Durables, Electronics etc. Life at WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when were together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. Thats why we ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. normalizedText: Americas Strategy, Planning, and Operations (SP&O) is a dynamic organization where innovation and technology come together to help our sales teams deliver on customer outcomes. We are seeking a best-in-class Sales GTM Strategy & Transformation Manager to help shape Americas Specialist strategy, support Run the Business & execute key initiatives that translate into sales growth in partnership with the Sales Leadership Team and cross-functional collaborators (Operations, Engineering, Finance, & Business Units). What Youll Do: This Manager will be reporting to Director and will own below Support GTM Strategy leader to Build Growth Plan: Support & Develop Annual/Long Range strategic sales growth plan through structure frameworks, partnerships with cross functional teams, and the build-out of a repeatable sales play engine. Design & operationalize growth priorities (including KPIs) with the structure PMO approach. Drive Strategic Initiative: Identify, develop, and lead high-impact strategic sales initiatives that align with the organizations goals and drive transformation across global markets. Partner & Conduct Strategic, Data-Driven Analyses (using Market Research, Business & Competitive intelligence): Identify levers to grow across discrete new, renew, and expand sales motions. Advise GTM strategy that supports growth and scale of the global business. Define and leverage GTM levers to instrument growth-driven programs in our business. Thought Leadership: Serve as a Thought leader and guide a dynamic Sales GTM Strategy & Transformation team by providing strategic guidance and insights to drive innovation and continuous improvement in sales practices. Executive Communication: Tell the growth plan & priorities story in both what we need to do and how we will do to senior executives across sales, specialist, product business unit and executive leadership teams. Prepare Specialist leader (VP/SVP) for the Board, ELT and SLT level strategic meetings and presentations. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with internal stakeholders, including sales, specialist, marketing, product development, and operations, to ensure alignment and successful execution of strategic initiatives. Strategic Assessment: Assess how best to spend a $1 of coverage against what customers, regions, products to increase output, including key strategic questions around renewals, customer success, field roles and Sales organization structure/governance/design. Who You Are: Problem Solver: You think deeply through problems and aim to find creative solutions even when they are not readily apparent Synthesizer: You can quickly structure ambiguous information by drawing out patterns, building hypotheses, and supporting with the right data & insights Storyteller: You are confident in presenting and supporting a data-driven point of view, whether to peers or to superiors, in complex and cross-functional settings Organizer: You prioritize tasks on a constant and ongoing basis to effectively and efficiently manage your time and resources Trusted partner: You have a consistent track record in cross-functional collaboration, establishing relationships and driving successful outcomes in a matrixed environment. Self-starter: You have a strong pulse on your own workload and productivity level, and know when to ask for help - or for new projects. Multi-functional: You are curious, flexible, and enjoy variety. As business needs evolve, you tackle new problems with a growth mindset. Our minimum requirements for this role: MBA with at least 3 years of post-MBA consulting experience at a top-tier firm OR Bachelor s degree with 7 years of consulting experience at a top-tier consulting firm. Desired Skills: Experience in Corporate Strategy, Strategic Planning, or BizOps role in large tech company (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft, Dell, Google) Exposure to B2B enterprise hardware & software, SaaS, or platform business models. Experience in supporting the development of Long Range and Annual Strategic growth plans (yearly / half-yearly) and developing processes to accelerate timing. Outstanding communication skills, including written, verbal, and visual (PowerPoint decks, storytelling, data synthesis). Experience in framing & structuring business problems, prioritizing efforts, conducting complex quantitative and qualitative analysis, building an executive level story complete with recommendations Fact-based and hands-on with data and analysis. Able to independently lead Excel modeling, scenario analysis, and KPI development. Strong knowledge of business intelligence (BI) tools and SQL a plus Ability to travel domestically or internationally as needed Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. This is a leadership role requiring strategic thinking, operational excellence, and the ability to build and scale a high-performing acquisition function. B2C Business Expansion Lead the setup and scaling of the B2C business vertical. Drive customer onboarding initiatives to improve acquisition and retention. Expand the companys presence across key markets through innovative acquisition strategies. Build sustainable customer engagement models to improve lifetime value and retention. jdEvidence.value: Take end-to-end ownership of Patrika Digital's organic traffic footprint, including traffic recovery, future-proofing against AI search, and optimizing Google News/Discover placement.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Pay₹22,00,000 - ₹24,00,000 an hourJob typeFull-time LocationJaipur, Rajasthan Full job descriptionWe are seeking a deeply hands-on and technical Head of SEO to take end-to-end ownership of Patrika Digital's organic traffic footprint. You will not function as an isolated individual contributor; instead, you will lead a dedicated team of technical and content SEO analysts and possess the authority to mandate technical adjustments to our CMS/dev pipelines and content standards to editorial. Years of Experience: 12 years + Key Responsibilities & Core Problems to Solve Traffic Recovery: Perform a swift, root-cause diagnosis of our organic traffic bleed (evaluating indexation, Core Web Vitals, E-E-A-T/YMYL health for critical segments like astrology/health, and competitor market share loss) and reverse it within 60–90 days. Future-Proof Search Shift: Formulate and execute strategies to protect traffic against AI-driven search models, zero-click landscapes, and AI Overviews across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode. Optimize Primary Acquisition Levers: Refine technical and structured data configurations exclusively for Google News and Google Discover placement—our largest acquisition funnel. Editorial Integration: Actively embed with the newsroom planning conversations daily to ensure headline architectures and story verticals maintain top Discover eligibility. Experience & Scale Requirements Must have owned SEO strategy for a massive news or publisher platform generating 10M+ monthly organic sessions, ideally within Hindi or Indic language markets. Hands-on mastery of Google News and Discover optimization pipelines, including schema markup, Core Web Vitals for news, and Publisher Center ecosystem management. Demonstrated history of successfully navigating and recovering a major content site through at least one Core Update or Helpful Content Update. Critical Disqualifiers SEO backgrounds confined strictly to e-commerce or B2B/SaaS verticals; news/publishing SEO is fundamentally different and mandatory here. Lacking hands-on technical depth (e.g., someone who can only brief developers but cannot personally debug indexation errors or audit raw schema markup). Lack of an immediate actionable perspective on AI search engines, treating them as a future concern rather than an active shift. Pay: ₹2,200,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jdEvidence.value: Establish and run the AI & Data Centre of Excellence (CoE), defining its vision, roadmap, operating model, and leading capability building and delivery enablement.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typematching preferenceFull-time LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job description Job Title: Centre of Excellence Lead – AI & Data Location: Pune, India Experience: 15+ Years Employment Type: Full Time Shift Timings: 2:00-11:00 PM IST / 3:00-12:00 AM IST About the Role We are looking for a hands-on, senior technology leader to establish and run our AI & Data Centre of Excellence (CoE). This is a pivotal role at the intersection of technology strategy, solution architecture, capability building, and delivery enablement. The CoE Lead will be the single point of accountability for the maturity, standards, and commercial impact of our AI & Data practice across the organization. You will own the technical direction of the CoE while actively partnering with Delivery Managers across multiple client accounts to ensure engagements are architected well, de-risked early, and delivered to a consistently high standard. You will shape how we sell, build, and scale AI and data solutions for our clients. Key Responsibilities CoE Strategy & Leadership Define and execute the vision, roadmap, and operating model for the AI & Data CoE. Establish reusable frameworks, accelerators, reference architectures, and IP to differentiate the firm and reduce time-to-value for clients. Build and lead a high-performing team of data engineers, ML engineers, AI/GenAI specialists, data scientists, and architects. Stay ahead of the curve on emerging technologies (LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, MLOps, modern data stack, vector databases, governance tooling) and translate them into pragmatic offerings. Define hiring bar, competency frameworks, training paths, and certification strategy for the AI & Data community. Delivery Enablement & Account Support Partner with Delivery Managers across accounts as the senior technical authority for AI & Data engagements. Review solution designs, conduct architecture reviews, and provide hands-on support during critical phases of delivery (discovery, design, go-lives, escalations). Help Delivery Managers with capacity planning, skill matching, technical risk identification, and mitigation. Act as an escalation point for complex technical issues and quality concerns on live engagements. Presales & Solutioning Support business development teams with technical solutioning, proposals, RFP responses, estimations, and client pitches. Lead technical discovery workshops and translate client problems into commercially viable solutions. Build credibility with CXO-level stakeholders as a trusted advisor on AI and data strategy. Experience Required 15+ years IT experience with heavy emphasis in a Data leadership role. Relevant & recent Gen AI / Agentic AI experience Proven track record of building or scaling a CoE, practice, or horizontal capability. Hands-on delivery experience across data engineering, analytics, ML, and modern AI/GenAI engagements. Experience working in a client-facing services environment, supporting multiple concurrent accounts and delivery managers. Strong presales instincts – can shape deals, defend estimates, and negotiate scope with clients. Excellent communicator, able to move fluently between boardroom and engineering room.

Digital Marketing & Marketing Automation Expert Shape the Future of Digital Growth at Newgen At Newgen Software, we're transforming the way enterprises engage with customers. The NewgenONE Platform brings together content, processes, and communications into a unified orchestration layer, enabling organisations to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're seeking a Digital Marketing & Marketing Automation Expert who thrives at the intersection of marketing, technology, and analytics. You'll play a critical role in driving demand generation, delivering engaging digital experiences, and building scalable marketing programs that contribute directly to business growth. What You Will Be Doing Drive Digital Demand Generation Plan, execute, and optimize multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Display Network, YouTube, RollWorks, Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), Quora, and other relevant platforms. Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to understand business priorities and Go-to-Market strategies, and translate them into effective digital campaigns. Work closely with content and design teams to develop compelling creatives and campaign assets. Manage digital marketing budgets and allocate investments across channels to maximize campaign performance and ROI. Conduct A/B testing and campaign experimentation to improve engagement, conversions, and pipeline contribution. Deliver high-quality inbound engagement from target audience segments. Analyze campaign effectiveness and generate actionable insights, recommendations, reports, and dashboards. Drive programs for SEO and LLM optimization for product focused keywords Manage Marketing Automation & Customer Journeys Support and manage Newgen's marketing technology ecosystem. Design and execute lead nurturing, engagement, and drip marketing programs using HubSpot and related tools. Optimize visitor-to-lead and lead-to-opportunity conversion processes through marketing automation best practices. Ensure data accuracy, system hygiene, and operational excellence across marketing platforms. Manage database segmentation, list acquisition/import, data cleansing, form capture, lead routing, and lifecycle marketing initiatives. Support the adoption of marketing automation processes and best practices across marketing and sales teams. Deliver Data-Driven Insights Create dashboards, reports, and performance analyses to track campaign success and marketing impact. Monitor funnel performance, lead quality, engagement metrics, and conversion rates. Provide meaningful insights and recommendations to help marketing and sales teams make informed decisions. Support customer journey analysis and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and user experience. Innovate and Optimize Stay current with evolving digital marketing trends, marketing technologies, and industry best practices. Evaluate emerging martech solutions and recommend enhancements to improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness. Contribute ideas and innovations that help Newgen stay ahead in an increasingly digital marketing landscape. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 3-5 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing automation, demand generation, or marketing operations. Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms such as LinkedIn Ads, Google Display Network, YouTube Ads, RollWorks/AdRoll, and similar channels. Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Eloqua, Pardot, or equivalent solutions. Knowledge of lead generation, lead nurturing, customer journey mapping, and marketing automation best practices. Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools, including Google Analytics and marketing performance dashboards. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations to improve campaign outcomes. Experience managing and optimizing campaigns across multiple digital channels. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a continuous learning mindset. Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or digital transformation industries will be an added advantage. Why Join Newgen? Be part of a leading global provider of digital transformation and automation solutions. Work on impactful campaigns across global markets and enterprise customers. Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge marketing technologies and AI-powered marketing initiatives. Collaborate with talented teams across marketing, sales, product, and leadership. Play a key role in driving business growth while accelerating your own professional development. If you're excited about combining digital marketing, automation, technology, and data to create measurable business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

normalizedText: The purpose of this role is to implement and execute Paid Search campaigns, in line with the agreed strategy, to maintain, develop and exceed client performance targets.Job Description:Purpose of the Role The Paid Search Manager will be responsible for planning, implementing, and optimising paid search campaigns across various platforms to meet client objectives. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and a passion for delivering outstanding results.Key ResponsibilitiesDevelop and execute paid search strategies aligned with client goals and objectives. Manage all aspects of paid search campaigns, including campaign setup, optimisation, monitoring, weekly reports, and performance analysis. Collaborate with clients, internal planning teams and platform reps to drive best in class performance. Attend and represent the team at regular external and internal client meetings. Work closely with the Account Director, and oversee the Account Executive, to deliver strong strategic approaches and adhere to Dentsu’s QA policies and procedures. Actively mentor and empower your team to increase quality and performance on your clients. Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and platform updates related to paid search. Proficiency in managing and planning campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, with experience on Skai and international search engines a bonus. Strong understanding of paid search principles, best practices, and industry trendsExcellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, draw insights, and make data-driven decisions. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients and internal teams. Proven track record of delivering successful paid search campaigns and achieving key performance metrics. What We OfferThis is a permanent role. This is a remote role, working with our London and Singapore offices which operates under flexible working arrangements. normalizedText: At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Senior Analyst - (Data Engineer) Business Unit: EDS Finance Opportunity An exciting opportunity has arisen within the EDS finance. The primary focus will be to support the clients across all our Service Lines. The role will require the individual to provide financial and management information, develop new reports and analysis in collaboration with stakeholders and systematise existing assets. A key part of the role will be presenting this information and analysis to the end user, highlighting variances and actions accordingly. Candidates will need to demonstrate an understanding of financial analysis work including significant processing and checking. They will need to build credibility and maintain relationships both within the team and the business and have ability to problem solve to overcome constraint. This role is in a fast-changing evolving environment with several changes taking place to the team s processes and systems as the firm undertakes a Global Finance Transformation Programme. Therefore, the ideal candidate will need to be flexible and can deal with change on an on-going basis. Key Skills Experience Skills Python: (Advanced - Essential) - Strong hands-on experience writing production-quality Python (PySpark) with proven ability to develop reusable, modular, and scalable data processing code, focused on ETL/ELT pipeline development within Databricks environments. SQL: (Advanced - Essential) - Deep expertise in writing and optimising complex SQL queries (joins, window functions, performance tuning) with strong experience designing data models and transformations in a LakeHouse architecture. Spark / Databricks (PySpark / Scala): (Advanced - Essential) - Strong experience using Apache Spark for distributed data processing with the ability to design, optimise, and maintain scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks and Delta Lake principles. Change Management Adaptability: (Intermediate-Advanced) - Demonstrated ability to manage and adapt to evolving data requirements, implementing changes to pipelines and processes while maintaining stability and data integrity. Project / Delivery Management: (Intermediate-Advanced) - Proven ability to manage end-to-end data engineering deliverables, prioritise workload, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. Azure DevOps: (Intermediate) - Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment of data engineering solutions, ensuring reliable and repeatable releases. Git / Version Control: (Intermediate - Essential) - Proficient in Git-based workflows including branching, pull requests, and version control for collaborative development and controlled deployment of data pipeline code. Data Pipeline Development: (Advanced) - Strong experience designing and maintaining ingestion pipelines across batch and streaming workloads with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. Data Quality Governance: (Intermediate-Advanced) - Experience implementing data validation, monitoring, and governance controls to ensure high data quality and trust in data outputs. Azure Cloud: (Intermediate) - Working knowledge of Azure data services and integration patterns to support scalable, secure, and cloud-native data engineering solutions. Professional Behavioural Competencies Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to demonstrate initiative and ownership Highly detail oriented, with strong organisational skills and a commitment to quality, efficiency, and accuracy Client focused mindset, with a clear understanding of service delivery concepts Strong communication and presentation skills, enabling clear and effective articulation of insights to stakeholders across all levels Collaborative team player, contributing positively to the team environment and supporting junior team members Comfortable working in a project based environment, managing deliverables end to end and owning processes from initiation to completion Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond effectively to change. What we offer Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com. Organizational Overview: Our Analytics organization comprises of data analysts who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through data management and development of full stack descriptive to prescriptive analytics solutions using cutting edge technologies thereby enabling business growth. Role Summary/Purpose: VP, Business Intelligence - Bank, Digital and DV&L: This People Manager role is part of India Analytics Hub & Business Intelligence (IAH & BI) org. The role will deliver on business and organizational priorities for Consumer Bank, Digital, and Diversified and Value and Lifestyle platforms focusing on business intelligence solutions, that are powered by data and analytics. The candidate will own both product outcomes (roadmap, adoption, value realization) and delivery execution (planning, dependencies, predictable releases) for assigned Business Intelligence products and capabilities. The candidate will also collaborate with internal Synchrony platform analytics teams across US and India, cross-functionally and with our partners to enhance overall customer experience and guide our stakeholders in making more informed decisions by delivering governed, scalable, and user-friendly BI solutions. Key Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of assigned BI products/features (intake discovery build launch adoption continuous improvement). Define and maintain product vision, roadmap, and priorities, securing alignment and leadership buy-in. Establish and track success measures / OKRs (e.g., adoption and usage, stakeholder satisfaction, time-to-deliver, data quality/accuracy, productivity). Lead discovery to translate business needs into clearly defined problem statements, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and standardized metric definitions. Drive adoption and change management: communications, training, user guides, release notes, onboarding, and recurring enablement (office hours). Ensure on-time delivery, high-quality outputs, including performance, scalability, reliability, and supportability; and complete documentation in alignment with audit and governance requirements. Own project execution from scoping through delivery using Agile/Hybrid methods; manage scope, schedule, resourcing, and delivery commitments. Maintain an up-to-date, transparent delivery plan (backlog, milestones, and dependencies) and a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, decisions) for leadership reporting. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned platform/CoE/enterprise stakeholders; run operating cadences (e.g., weekly status, prioritization reviews, steering updates). Lead stakeholder working sessions and product demos in partnership with analytics teams; document decisions, actions, owners, and timelines. Mentor/coordinate team members in a matrix environment; clarify RACI, ensure accountability, and remove blockers. Manage and develop the team, including workforce planning, hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. Required Skills/Knowledge: Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in relational databases (SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) for validation, reconciliation, and data-driven decisioning. Minimum 8+ years of hands-on and demonstrated experience delivering BI/analytics products (dashboards, standardized reporting, self-service BI, metrics/semantic layers) with measurable adoption and business outcomes. Hands-on familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI/visualization platforms and BI best practices (performance, usability, basic security/access concepts). Strong project and team management capability: workload, backlog management, user stories, dependency estimation, sprint/release planning. Working knowledge of data warehousing/lakehouse concepts, ETL patterns, and data modeling fundamentals (schemas, dimensions/facts). Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and ability to tell a clear story with data and numbers to senior leaders. Experience in managing teams with ability to motivate team, drive change, create a culture of learning, innovation and recognition Ability to solve complex technical and business problems with minimal supervision. Desired Skills & Knowledge: Python and/or SAS for analysis, automation, or prototyping. Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks) and related tooling. Knowledge of AI/GenAI applications in BI and associated considerations. Functional knowledge of Marketing, Sales, and/or Credit lifecycle. People and project management experience along with superior thought leadership and framework based solutioning abilities. Innovative mindset to improve current capabilities and discover new ones. Eligibility Criteria: Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or any other quantitative streams with 8+ years of hands-on relevant analytics/business intelligence experience, or in lieu of a degree 10+ years of relevant analytics/business intelligence experience. Work Timings: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events. Who are we? Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. normalizedText: The Applications Development Group Manager / Digital Design Service Pillar Lead is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.The Digital Design Service Pillar Lead is a senior leadership position responsible for establishing, governing, and continuously evolving the digital design and engineering capabilities that power Citi's Oracle Ledger, Accounting, and Controls Technology applications. This role combines strategic vision with hands-on delivery leadership, driving a multi-disciplinary team of UX designers, UI developers, backend and full-stack engineers, and AI/ML engineers to deliver modern, resilient, and intelligent financial technology solutions.The successful candidate will define and own the pillar's capability roadmap across five core domains: Enhanced User Experience (UX), Architectural & System Design Governance, Dashboard Analytics & Insights, AI Integration, and Accelerated Development & Operational Resilience. They will act as a senior technology leader, influencing engineering culture, championing innovation, and ensuring delivery outcomes are aligned to Finance Technology's strategic objectives.ResponsibilitiesLead the Digital Design Service Pillar, setting the strategic direction and delivery roadmap across all five capability domains for Oracle Ledger, Accounting, and Controls Technology applications, including budget accountability, resource planning, and risk management.Define and govern application methodologies, architecture standards, and design guidelines across the full SDLC — from UX and system design through to development, performance and security testing, deployment, and monitoring.Build and lead a high-performing UX capability encompassing user research, design systems, accessibility, and inclusive design, embedding feedback and iteration loops into the product development lifecycle and measuring the strategic business impact of UX investment.Establish and govern the application architecture strategy for the pillar, including tech stack selection, architecture patterns, performance benchmarks, SLAs, quality assurance & testing frameworks and data governance policies, ensuring all solutions adhere to Citi's enterprise architecture blueprint and security standards.Lead the design and delivery of analytics and insights capabilities, governing data extraction, visualisation standards, and feedback mechanisms to enable data-driven decision-making across Finance Technology and business stakeholders.Drive the strategic adoption and integration of AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI technologies across Oracle Ledger, Accounting, and Controls applications, identifying high-value use cases for automation and process optimisation, and establishing AI ethics and governance frameworks to ensure responsible, compliant deployment.Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling — including Agentic AI platforms, autonomous coding tools (e.g., Devin.AI), and developer co-pilots (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot) — to accelerate engineering velocity and elevate developer experience across the pillar.Define and drive modern development practices across the pillar, including code reusability, SDLC automation, and technical debt management, tracking efficiency metrics and developer experience indicators to maximise engineering output.Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary team spanning UX Design, UI Development, Backend Engineering, Full-Stack Engineering, and AI/ML Engineering, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture.Consult with end users and business stakeholders to identify system function specifications, translate complex requirements into scalable technology solutions, and incorporate AI and modernisation possibilities into strategic discussions.Influence and negotiate with senior leaders across Finance Technology and business functions, acting as the primary technology voice for the pillar and communicating progress, risks, and outcomes with clarity and transparency.Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Citi Policy, and escalating control issues with transparency — particularly in relation to responsible AI, data governance, and financial application integrity.Qualifications10+ years of relevant experience in Applications Development, Systems Analysis, or Technology Leadership, with a proven track record of leading large-scale modernisation and delivery programmes in financial services or complex enterprise environments.Demonstrated experience building and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams spanning UX, UI, backend, full-stack, and AI/ML engineering, with strong people development, coaching, and performance optimization strategies, robust testing methodologies.Deep knowledge of application architecture patterns (microservices, event-driven, API-first), enterprise system design, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with hands-on familiarity with container-based infrastructure (Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift).Strong understanding of UX design principles, design systems, user research methodologies, and accessibility standards, alongside proficiency in modern frontend technologies (React JS, TypeScript) and UI development practices.Proficiency across multiple programming languages and frameworks (Python, Java, TypeScript; Spring Boot, FastAPI, Node.js) and experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (Oracle, MongoDB) and integration platforms (Kafka, JMS/MQ).Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies — including LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and RAG implementations — combined with hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as autonomous coding platforms (e.g., Devin.AI), developer co-pilots (e.g., Copilot), and agentic workflow orchestration frameworks.Experience governing responsible AI deployment, including AI ethics frameworks, model risk management, explainability, and guardrails development in regulated financial services environments.Experience designing and delivering analytics and dashboard capabilities, including data pipeline development, data governance, and BI/visualisation tools.Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, and SDLC automation tools (Jenkins, Harness, Gradle), with experience in Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.Background in Oracle Ledger, Accounting, or Controls Technology applications, or equivalent financial technology platforms, is highly desirable.Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to senior executives and non-technical audiences alike.Growth mindset with a passion for innovation, pragmatic problem-solving, and a commitment to inclusion, diversity, and continuous learning.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required; Master's normalizedText: About AgodaAt Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.Get to Know our Team: Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in-person, real-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly, doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience. We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to a core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support. Are you a dynamic leader with a knack for driving success in a multicultural environment?This role is responsible for leading the customer service teams supporting English Languages as they provide support to customers across voice, email, chat, and back-office activities.The Manager of Customer Experience Group provides vision, leadership, and guidance to each team leader and associates in the key operating areas through performance and goal setting. Effectively communicates with team, developing a climate in which information is shared openly. Clearly defines team goals and expectations. Develops tactical plans to reach these goals. This role requires a high level of personal and professional skills associated with running global operations teams. First and foremost, this is a people leader role and enabling local teams to be successful is core to the role. In addition to being a brilliant people leader and communicator, the ideal candidate will bring a vision, a sense of curiosity, a passion for travel, keen analytical skills, a tech-centric mindset, and a willingness to lead by example. This position will report to the Head of Customer Service Delivery: English and is open to applicants based in India only.What You'll Do:Identifies operational issues affecting the team and credibly explains this with the use of relevant data to customer service leaders along with recommendations that consider overall business impact (such as cost, service levels, team engagement) Understands key drivers of SLA performance and recommends structural adjustments to customer service leaders and enablement teams to ensure team resources are optimally utilized Understand call routing strategies, good understanding of metrics used to evaluate call center performance, familiar with principles of workforce management (understanding how to ensure sufficient workforce availability and levers to influence workforce availability), basic process improvement Takes ownership to understand how changes outside the team (g., new suppliers, changes to SOP, new product lines) will impact team and prepares team well for this through combination of large group meetings and effective 1-on-1 coaching Understands the key drivers of customer satisfaction & dissatisfaction and works with customer service leaders to address customer dissatisfaction and implement self-healing processes where possible Regularly review customer feedback and QA insights to help educate teams about Agoda products and services as well as identify customer handling improvement opportunities Invests energy to inspire, coach, mentor, and develop emerging customer service leaders so we develop individuals as well as organizational resilience Raises the bar on talent through serving as faculty in internal learning programs, or helping inform development of new L&D programs, or helping to attract credible external talent Creates a positive team culture, employee engagement where teams understand and live Agoda values, particularly around taking ownership and striving to be their best Ensures teams “get the right results, the right way”; goes beyond numerical team SLA achievement to build an ethical team culture What You'll Bring:A minimum of 10 years of work experience, with at least 3 years in a senior role managing operational responsibilities (contact center, vendor management at scale, etc.). Excellent problem-solving capabilities, with a knack for identifying process improvement opportunities using a data-driven approach. The ability to successfully lead or support multiple initiatives concurrently. A proven track record of leading change. Persuasive skills to convince senior leaders. A fast-paced approach to problem-solving and decision-making. The ability to foster a culture of personal development through coaching and partnership with L&D, engagement, and continuous improvement. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Excellent personal and interpersonal skills to lead the team and partner effectively with other departments. E-commerce or travel industry experience is a plus. Strong background in multi-channel Contact Center / BPO operations: demonstrated experience in scaling leadership roles Knowledge of PC applications / tech savvy Must be an assertive team player with high energy to work in fast-paced environment Ability to work with very minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment. Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. Director, Customer Success (Regional Leader)Location: Chennai, India | Work Model: In-office (5 days per week)About the TeamOur Chennai Shared Services Center (SSC) is the engine room that powers Appian’s global Customer Success delivery. We are a high-performing, rapidly growing hub of world-class consultants and specialists who enable global enterprise clients to maximize the value of the Appian platform. Our culture thrives on operational excellence, collaboration, and a shared pride in driving tangible business outcomes for our customers worldwide.The OpportunityAs the Director, Customer Success (Regional Leader), you will hold the keys to the overall health, performance, and scalability of our Chennai SSC. This is a pure operational and people leadership role where your success is measured not by technical code, but by organizational vitality- ensuring we have a healthy, optimally staffed, and highly motivated operation. Acting as a critical bridge between local execution and global strategy, you will balance the fast-paced expectations of our US headquarters with the unique needs of our regional talent. If you are an operational strategist who loves building cohesive team cultures, managing global stakeholder matrices, and scaling high-performing regional hubs, this role offers an incredible platform for global impact.What You’ll DoBuild and Scale the Team: Define hiring profiles in collaboration with Capability Leaders and Talent Management, support interviewing, and manage headcount growth to keep supply aligned with the SSC's expanding service portfolio. Proactively keep an eye toward the operational infrastructure needed as the center scales.Set and Uphold the Standard: Establish a culture of excellence and intensity across the Chennai team. Hold consultants to high expectations for quality, accountability, and conduct. Reinforce those standards through performance conversations, recognition, and a consistent, visible leadership presence. Resolve performance issues quickly. Own the Supply Side of the Business: Maintain complete visibility into available capacity across all resource pools and make final consultant assignment decisions in close consultation with Chennai Leaders, who advise on technical readiness, Engagement Managers, who carry the engagement context, and US HQ.Drive Utilization Performance: Monitor and manage billable utilization across the Chennai team as an active, ongoing discipline. Proactively identify underutilization risk. Resolve allocation gaps before they become problems, and hold theater leaders accountable for the pipeline visibility that makes good staffing possible.Govern Regional Finances: Collaborate closely with operations to manage cost tracking, theater charge-backs for unbillable work, and financial discipline across the SSC. Serve as the primary point of contact for Ops finance and ensure the center operates within a clear, defensible cost model.Create and Run Operational Governance: Lead the BAU steering cadence, manage the staffing conflict resolution process, and enforce the lead-time and forecasting expectations that theater leaders must meet. Treat reactive, last-minute staffing requests as a governance issue to be corrected, not an inconvenience to be absorbed.Lead People and Organizational Health: Own the full people management lifecycle for the Chennai team, including performance reviews, career development conversations, compensation inputs, and HR matters. Ensure consultants have the support and clarity they need to grow and stay.Required QualificationsBachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.10+ years of professional experience with a proven track record of leading operations, resource management, or regional hub delivery within a global enterprise software company or top-tier consulting firm.Direct experience working within a US-headquartered organization, with a demonstrated ability to successfully navigate the pace, operating frameworks, and communication style of a US-based matrixed business.Deep expertise in managing resource management metrics, including billable utilization, capacity planning, and operational forecasting.Demonstrated experience in people management, including performance development, compensation planning, and scaling large teams.Strong financial acumen with experience managing regional budgets and internal charge-back models.Ability to work on-site 5 days a week at our Chennai office.Preferred QualificationsMaster of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree in Operations or Management.Experience scaling a Global Capability Center (GCC) or Shared Services Center (SSC) during a phase of rapid growth.Exceptional stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills, with a history of successfully partnering with global executives across different time zones. Tools and Resources Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.BenefitsAppian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.About AppianAppian provides process automation technology. You will work closely with Consulting leaders, Alliance leaders and Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to influence senior leaders, shape priorities, guide investment trade-offs and build integrated campaigns that drive demand, strengthen market positioning and support major transformation opportunities for clients.You will lead a team responsible for demand generation, alliance activation, market engagement and campaign execution while helping mature the marketing function through scalable ways of working, stronger governance, operating discipline, repeatable processes, to see across organizational silos and bring together people, capabilities and investments to achieve business outcomes.What We OfferWe offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be normalizedText: Join Barclays as AVP Regulatory Reporting, responsible for the end-to-end delivery of the internal and external BBI resolution reporting requirements, including internal governance processes and support of other requirements as they arise, for example implementation of EBA reporting taxonomies, ad hoc Regulatory data requests and queries. To be successful in this role, you should have: Previous experience of working in a Regulatory Reporting role. Proven ability to meet tight timelines. Strong communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work with and present to senior stakeholders. Some other highly valued skills may include: Strong analytical/problem solving mindset but with the ability and willingness to get into the details to find solutions. Proven experience of managing projects in the delivery of a change agenda, including early identification and satisfactory management of risks and issues. Experience of working across multiple business areas, functions, and locations. Excellent PC skills, including Excel, Word & MS Suite. You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. The role is based out of Gurugram. Purpose of the role To identify, assess and mitigate prudential regulatory reporting risks, provide oversight on regulatory reporting, and maintenance of open communication with regulators to ensure that the banks activities and operations comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal control policies. Accountabilities Identification and assessment of prudential regulatory reporting risks arising from the banks activities, products, and services. Development and implementation of strategies to mitigate prudential regulatory reporting risks, ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal control policies, and conduct regular compliance reviews and audits to identify and address potential compliance gaps or violations. Assessment of the effectiveness of the bank s internal control processes and governance framework, including addressing any weaknesses or gaps that could lead to regulatory reporting non-compliance, and implementation of measures to strengthen internal controls. Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports. Analysis and presentation of regulatory data to provide insights into business performance, identify trends, and support decision-making. Development and implementation of training programmes to educate employees on regulatory requirements and compliance responsibilities. Communication and liaising with regulatory bodies, prompt responses to inquiries and provision of requested information, and representation of the bank in meetings with regulators. Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of regulatory reporting systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate regulatory reporting systems with other enterprise systems. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc). to solve problems creatively and effectively. Communicate complex information. Complex information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Proven track record of scaling traffic from zero to significant volumes in high-competition industries, preferably EdTech. Deep understanding of technical SEO, content SEO, link building strategies, and algorithm updates. Hands-on experience with tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and Screaming Frog. Strong data interpretation and business acumen skills. Experience managing large-scale content ecosystems and leading cross-functional teams. Strategic thinker with execution excellence and strong stakeholder management skills. Ability to align SEO with revenue goals and maintain an ownership mindset with high accountability. With a strong digital presence and multi-brand architecture, we are focused on scaling organic growth as a core acquisition engine.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typeFull-time LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job descriptionSenior Manager, Marketing (FRWD) - MarTech Region: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH FRWD is Bain & Company's marketing acceleration capability—a community of expert practitioners who partner with clients and their agencies to drive meaningful business results and transformation. Our team brings together specialists from leading in-house marketing organizations, agencies and technology platforms who combine deep practical expertise with a passion for measurable results. We don't just help clients determine what to do—we work alongside them to define how to make it happen. FRWD partners with Bain clients across a range of strategic marketing challenges, including: Marketing diagnostics to identify performance improvement opportunities Marketing transformation and capability building E-commerce acceleration across retail, marketplace and direct-to-consumer channels Marketing operating model, MarTech and data strategy design Commercial due diligence and value creation planning for private equity investments WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM We're looking for a Senior Manager, MarTech to join FRWD in APAC. You'll bring broad marketing expertise together with deep MarTech experience, helping clients integrate technology, customer data and digital capabilities into larger marketing, commercial and growth transformations. As a senior practitioner and workstream leader, you'll shape MarTech strategies, operating models and implementation roadmaps while partnering closely with Bain consulting teams, FRWD practitioners and senior client stakeholders across marketing, sales, technology, analytics and digital functions. You'll also play an important role in growing Bain's MarTech capability across the APAC region through thought leadership, coaching and business development. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead MarTech strategy and client delivery Lead MarTech diagnostics, assessments and client workstreams across marketing technology, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, analytics, attribution, privacy and AI-enabled marketing capabilities. Develop data-driven recommendations, investment cases, implementation of roadmaps and capability-building plans that connect technology decisions with measurable business outcomes. Assess existing MarTech ecosystems, vendor landscapes, organizational models and operating processes to identify opportunities for simplification, optimization and growth. Design customer data and activation strategies across leading platforms including Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related technologies. Develop measurement frameworks, experimentation strategies and attribution approaches that improve customer acquisition, retention, lifecycle engagement and marketing ROI. Collaborate closely with client implementation teams, agencies, platform partners and Bain technical specialists, translating complex technical concepts into actionable business recommendations. Build trusted client relationships Develop strong relationships with senior client stakeholders across marketing, growth, digital, technology, sales and executive leadership. Facilitate executive workshops and stakeholder interviews to align priorities and define practical transformation roadmaps. Deliver clear, compelling presentations that connect MarTech investments to commercial performance, customer experience and operating model improvements. Ensure all analyses, recommendations and client deliverables meet Bain's high standards for quality, accuracy and impact. Lead teams and grow the FRWD capability Lead and coach integrated Bain and FRWD teams throughout client engagements. Share MarTech expertise across the broader Bain ecosystem through tools, methodologies, training and case examples. Support capability building, recruiting, intellectual property development and business development across the APAC FRWD practice. Foster a collaborative, feedback-rich culture while modeling Bain's values and leadership expectations. ABOUT YOU You are an experienced MarTech leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on experience delivering marketing transformation. Required Qualifications 5-8 years of experience across marketing, digital, growth, marketing operations or MarTech, with demonstrated leadership progression. 5+ years of experience in MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, customer journey orchestration, measurement, attribution or marketing technology investments. Experience in consulting, agencies, in-house marketing, customer data or marketing technology environments; client services experience is strongly preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect technology, data and process decisions to commercial outcomes. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams across marketing, technology, analytics and business stakeholders. Practical experience with leading MarTech platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related customer data and marketing automation technologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both executive business leaders and technical stakeholders. Experience working across APAC markets or the ability to navigate diverse regulatory environments, partner ecosystems and client cultures. Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred. Willingness to travel as required. MarTech capabilities we're seeking While candidates are not expected to have expertise across every platform, we value experience in several of the following areas: MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments and roadmap development Customer data platforms (CDP), CRM, identity resolution, segmentation and customer activation Marketing automation, lifecycle marketing, personalization and journey orchestration Marketing measurement, attribution, experimentation and performance analytics Privacy, consent management, AI-enabled marketing, workflow automation, e-commerce, retail media and AdTech integration Certifications or practitioner experience across platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Google Marketing Platform, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude or comparable technologies ABOUT BAIN & COMPANY Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world's most ambitious change makers define the future. We work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Our vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators complements our integrated consulting expertise to deliver better, faster and more enduring outcomes. Since 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients and continue to lead the industry in client advocacy.
