normalizedText: LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Location: Gurugram, India Date Posted: Jun 29, 2026 About Alvarez & Marsal Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work-guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M. The Team Our DTS team provides following services to clients: Data & Applied Intelligence - Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision-making and transform businesses Product and Innovation - Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage Technology M&A and Strategy - Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M&A, integrations and carve-outs Technology Transformation - A&M helps clients create a scalable, cost-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities. How you will contribute The Change Manager will play a critical role in enabling end to end change management for Digital & Technology initiatives across A&M client engagements. Sitting within DTS, this role partners closely with technology, data, AI, and business teams to translate complex digital transformations into practical, adoptable change - driving value realization and sustained outcomes. This role is particularly relevant to A&M’s growing work across enterprise digital transformation, AI-led solutions, platform modernization, and technology-enabled operating model changes Key Responsibilities 1. Change Leadership within DTS Engagements Lead end-to-end change management for DTS-led transformations, including digital platforms, analytics, AI solutions, and operating model redesigns Embed change management into tech delivery lifecycles, ensuring adoption is planned alongside build, not post-implementation Act as the bridge between business, technology, and leadership, translating technical change into business-relevant narratives 2. Enable Digital & AI-Driven Adoption Support adoption of AI-enabled tools and digital solutions such as intelligent workflows, agentic or decision-support systems Design user-centric adoption strategies covering communications, enablement, risk management, and behavioural change Partner with product owners and tech teams to ensure solutions are usable, explainable, and responsibly adopted 3. Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement Partner with client leadership, DTS engagement leads, and internal stakeholders to shape change strategies aligned to value and outcomes Develop leadership-ready materials (change roadmaps, adoption dashboards, rollout approaches) tailored to senior audiences 4. Operating Model & Capability Change Support digital operating model shifts, including ways of working, role changes, governance, and capability uplift Design practical enablement approaches that help business users work differently from Day 1 5. Measurement & Sustainment Define and track adoption and change metrics tied to business value, not just activity completion Put in place sustainment mechanisms to ensure changes hold post go-live Skills & Capabilities (Must-Have) Change & Transformation 5–10 years of experience in Change Management, preferably in technology-led or digital transformation programs Strong grounding in change frameworks (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) with the ability to apply pragmatically, not theoretically 6. Digital & Technology Orientation Proven experience working with DTS, Digital, Data, or Technology teams Strong comfort engaging with technical concepts (digital platforms, AI, automation, analytics) and translating them for business audiences Experience integrating change into agile / product-based delivery models 7. Stakeholder & Consulting Skills Consulting-grade communication and storytelling skills, especially for leadership and senior stakeholders Ability to operate in complex, fast-moving, ambiguous environments typical of A&M engagements Strong facilitation, problem-solving, and influencing skills Exposure to Tech-enabled M&A (technology separation, integration, or value creation) • Experience supporting adoption of AI, GenAI, or Agentic A Qualifications Master’s degree in business, Change Management, Organizational Psychology, HR, Technology Management, or a related field Change certifications (Prosci, APMG, etc.) preferred but not mandatory Prior experience in consulting or transformation-heavy environments strongly preferred Your journey at A&M We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals. Culture & Values At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts. Equal Opportunity Employer It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A&M policy statements and additional information by region here. Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

normalizedText: LocationKochi, Kerala Full job description JOB PURPOSE The Senior Manager - Marketing will own, build, and scale EyeROV's marketing function to support business growth, brand positioning, pipeline creation, and market expansion. This is a senior leadership role requiring strategic thinking, revenue orientation, team leadership, and the ability to position complex technical products in a simple, compelling, and business-relevant manner. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Leadership, and Partner teams to ensure marketing initiatives directly contribute to lead quality, funnel efficiency, brand credibility, customer acquisition, and long-term market presence. Preferred Sectors : Industrial, engineering, marine, robotics, deep-tech, infrastructure, oil & gas, defence. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong B2B/B2G marketing leadership experience with ownership of marketing strategy and execution. Proven track record of scaling marketing functions, not just executing campaigns. Demonstrated success in revenue-linked marketing outcomes, including pipeline creation and conversion improvement. Strong understanding of sales funnels, lead quality, customer acquisition, and business growth metrics. Ability to work closely with sales leadership and align marketing efforts with business targets. Experience in brand positioning, market presence, and thought leadership in competitive or emerging sectors. Ability to understand and position complex technical products for business and government decision-makers. Strong experience in marketing systems, processes, CRM usage, automation, reporting, and performance dashboards. Proven ability to lead, mentor, hire, and scale marketing teams. Experience in partner marketing, alliances, ecosystem development, and strategic events is highly desirable. Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Marketing Strategy & Function Ownership Own and scale the overall marketing function in line with EyeROV's business goals. Develop annual and quarterly marketing plans linked to revenue, pipeline, brand visibility, and market expansion. Set up and optimize marketing systems, processes, reporting structures, and team workflows. Build a performance-driven marketing function with clear KPIs, accountability, and measurable outcomes. 2. Revenue-Linked Marketing & Sales Alignment Drive marketing initiatives that contribute to qualified pipeline creation, lead conversion, and business growth. Work closely with sales leadership to align on target segments, lead quality, campaign priorities, and funnel efficiency. Establish structured lead generation, lead nurturing, and lead qualification processes. Track and improve marketing contribution to sales pipeline, conversion rates, and customer acquisition. 3. Brand Positioning & Market Presence Strengthen EyeROV's brand positioning in marine robotics, underwater inspection, hydro-infrastructure, defence, disaster management, and related sectors. Build a clear and differentiated market narrative in competitive and emerging markets. Simplify complex technical offerings into strong customer-focused messaging. Enhance EyeROV's visibility through thought leadership, industry forums, media, strategic events, and content platforms. 4. Partner Marketing & Ecosystem Development Identify and build marketing opportunities with partners, alliances, channel partners, and ecosystem stakeholders. Drive co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, joint events, and strategic collaborations. Support market expansion through industry associations, government bodies, consultants, resellers, and sector-specific partnerships. Strengthen EyeROV's presence across domestic and international markets through ecosystem-led initiatives. 5. Digital, Content & Communication Strategy Lead content strategy across website, social media, email, newsletters, case studies, videos, product collaterals, and presentations. Ensure all communication clearly conveys EyeROV's technology value, customer impact, and business outcomes. Oversee digital campaigns, SEO, paid campaigns, social media, and marketing automation initiatives. Ensure communication consistency across all external and internal brand touchpoints. 6. Events, PR & Industry Representation Represent EyeROV in industry forums, exhibitions, conferences, webinars, media interactions, and strategic business events. Identify high-impact events that support brand visibility, lead generation, partnerships, and business growth. Oversee event strategy, participation planning, messaging, collaterals, budget, execution, and post-event ROI tracking. Build EyeROV's thought leadership presence in relevant industry and technology platforms. 7. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead, mentor, and scale the marketing team to deliver strategic and operational goals. Hire, develop, and manage team members across content, digital, design, events, lead generation, and marketing operations. Set clear goals, review performance, provide feedback, and build marketing capability within the team. Drive a culture of ownership, creativity, business alignment, and performance excellence. normalizedText: Marketing Head-Purple Fabric-PFLocation- Chennai ·Reports to: CEOExp-12+About Purple Fabric-Purple Fabric is Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform product. It helps financial institutions and increasingly, enterprises beyond them, turn their data into AI outcomes they can act on and defend: governed, explainable, and orchestrated through multi-agent workflows. This isn’t a roadmap promise; it’s in production, with 45+ clients live worldwide. Behind it: a 240+ strong team with a senior core, global clients, and the fintech heritage of Intellect Design Arena (8K employees).The mandateOwn the growth thesis: write the global go-to-market playbook, own and create the lead gen machine that takes Purple Fabric to $10M ARR - and be accountable for the marketing half of getting there. This seat sets a growth strategy; it does not take briefs.Make four teams one engine: Product marketing, creative/web, digital and field/event each produce; your job is that they compound, one scorecard, one weekly pipeline number, no pillar optimizing its own corner at the expense of the funnel.Win where buyers now look: enterprise buyers increasingly start with an AI answer, not a search page. Build the discipline of being that answer, AEO/GEO alongside classic SEO, Paid UA; before the category has a playbook for it. You will be writing that playbook.Move the commercial numbers, not the vanity ones: work shoulder to shoulder with Sales and Product on the buyer journey, cost.What you will ownLead generation & the engine: you create and own the pipeline number: qualified opportunities per week, by region and source, feeding coverage ≥3× target. Built on CRM as single source of truth, marketing automation, AI tooling for enrichment and personalization, lead scoring and SDR handoff SLAs. House rule: one working automation shipped every week. Your scorecard, opps/week, pipeline influenced, funnel conversion, CAC trend, search/AI visibility, is auto-generated; a hand-assembled report is a broken one.Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design and execute hyper-targeted, multi-channel account-based campaigns for Tier-1 enterprise targets, orchestrating digital, content, and field touchpoints to accelerate high-value, complex sales cycles.Product marketing: positioning and messaging per segment, launch plans per release, sales enablement (decks, battlecards, objection handling), analyst-facing narrative, pricing/packaging input. Your PMM also runs content (CEO story stream, funnel content, newsletter) and research/competitive intelligence.Brand, design & website: identity system and templates (in tandem with head of Design), all visual and video production on an AI-assisted workflow, the website as a measured conversion asset — not a brochure. Brand architecture decisions go to the CEO; everything else is yours.Digital acquisition: SEO plus the AEO/GEO frontier (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity answers), social channel strategy, performance marketing (UA, Linkedin first and other socials like Meta, Google etc), and instrumented campaigns, every channel measured to opportunity, not clicks.Influencer & creator-led marketing: play the game the way the fastest-growing AI companies now do creator-led, not ad-led. Build relationships with the enterprise-AI and fintech voices who shape the conversation (LinkedIn creators, newsletter authors, technical YouTubers, podcast hosts, practitioner communities, Insta/Tiktok creators for PF’s derivative products), seed the product with them, and turn their credibility into reach and pipeline. Measured on qualified attention into named accounts, not vanity impressions.Events, partnerships & field: flagship event calendar per hemisphere (WHEM/EHEM field marketers on your team), CEO and leadership speaking slots, partner co-marketing including Intellect co-sell moments, post-event pipeline attribution. The team: hire, develop and run the ~10-person org above , every hire screened for ability to exploit AI in their role. You are accountable for the function outproducing its headcount.What we need from you12+ years in B2B/enterprise software marketing with a proven track record of scaling an engine through high-growth phases (eg $1M to $10M+ ARR). You must have built or rebuilt at least one function end to end and led through managers, not just as an individual contributor.AI-native operator - a hiring gate: show us, in a work sample, how you use AI tools to do the work of a larger team, and how you would institutionalize that across your org.Enterprise and regulated-industry fluency: you can market to banks and large enterprises without triggering their allergy to hype - governance and explainability are selling points you know how to use.Hands-on command of the modern stack: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), automation (n8n/Make/Zapier-class), enrichment (Clay/Apollo-class), analytics/attribution (GA4, Search Console, dashboarding), SEO/AEO tooling, and daily fluency with frontier AI assistants. You configure before you hire.Demand-gen credibility with a number attached: you have owned a pipeline target and can talk specifically about what worked. Strong written English and comfort in a written-first culture — the pre-read replaces the status meeting here. normalizedText: Marketing Director- Paytm (Inference and Agentic AI) Location: NoidaCompany: PaytmAbout Paytm: Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability. Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics. The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI solutions from opportunity discovery to deployment and scale. Role Overview: Paytm is looking to hire a Marketing Director to own B2B marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and sales enablement for Paytm’s Inference and Agentic AI products. This is a managerial role that will lead a team of marketing managers and drive marketing across enterprise clients and mid market merchants. normalizedText: Nuvr is a tech-enabled, full-stack growth accelerator that partners with consumer brands - especiallythose transitioning from offline to scale rapidly across e-commerce marketplaces like Amazon and Quick-Commerce platforms such as Blinkit and Zepto, offering end-to-end operational support,AI-driven insights, and a revenue-sharing model focused on long-term, profitable growth. Job Summary As Brand Manager for E-commerce Quick-Commerce, you will own the strategic growth, performance and positioning of partner brands across leading marketplaces and Quick-Commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon Seller Vendor Central, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart). You will lead brand operations, campaign planning, performance analysis and cross-functional alignment to drive sales growth, margin improvement and strong brand presence. Key Responsibilities Brand Strategy Ownership: Define and drive the end-to-end brand strategy for assigned brands, aligning with business objectives, positioning and growth targets. Marketplace Platform Leadership: Lead the creation, optimization and maintenance of product listings; ensure catalog accuracy, SEO/SEM compliance, promotional readiness and standardized brand presentation across E-Commerce and Quick-Commerce channels. Campaign Planning Execution: Own campaign planning, budget allocation, and execution in partnership with marketing, design and operations teams. Track performance metrics (ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CR) and optimise accordingly. Inventory Fulfilment Oversight: Monitor and steer stock levels, dark-store/delivery operations, ensure high fill-rates, OTIF (On-Time In-Full) metrics and minimise out-of-stock or write-off situations. Account Health Compliance: Manage marketplace account health (case tickets, compliance, payment reconciliation), track KPIs, escalate issues, and ensure vendor/channel partnerships remain strong. Customer Market Insights: Monitor reviews, ratings, customer sentiment and competitor activity; translate insights into actionable brand improvement strategies. Performance Data Analytics: Use Excel, BI/reporting tools (Power BI, etc) to evaluate sales trends, promotions, campaign effectiveness and profitability. Present actionable insights to senior stakeholders and intervene where performance is under-par. PL Responsibility (or Support): Actively participate in or lead the budgeting, forecasting, margin analysis and profit maximisation for the brand portfolio. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in e-commerce brand/marketplace management (ideally Amazon Seller/Vendor Central + Quick-Commerce platforms) or related brand/marketing roles. Proven track record with Amazon listings, SEO, PPC, vendor/seller operations; plus familiarity with Quick-Commerce ecosystems (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart). Strong analytical and reporting skills: Excel expertise, experience with dashboards, campaign metrics, marketplace KPIs. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Comfortable working with marketing, operations, design, logistics and channel teams. Solid understanding of brand management principles: positioning, equity, messaging, customer experience and competitive differentiation. Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce or related field. MBA or advanced qualification is a plus. Bonus: Experience in PL management, strategic growth planning, product portfolio management and offline-to-online brand transitions. job descriptionJob Description: Operations & Growth Lead Company: Bogmalo Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. (Uncle Peter's Pancakes) Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Employment Type: Full-time About Uncle Peter’s Pancakes: Uncle Peter's Pancakes (UPP) is a rapidly growing Indian pancake QSR chain that began as a cloud kitchen in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, in 2019. The brand aims to bring the essence of pancake culture to India, offering a variety of both sweet and savory options tailored to the Indian palate. UPP has expanded to over 120+ outlets across 40 cities. The brand has been featured on Shark Tank India Season 3, highlighting its innovative approach and rapid growth. With plans to open over 500 stores across India in the next three years, Uncle Peter’s Pancakes is on a mission to make pancakes a staple in Indian cuisine. About the Role: Having opened nearly 120+ Uncle Peter's Pancakes outlets in under 3 years,we are seeking an Operations & Growth Lead to command the engine room of India’s largest pancake brand. This role is designed for an experienced F&B leader who combines deep operational expertise with datadriven decision-making to scale high-growth businesses quickly and precisely. Key Responsibilities: 1. P&L & Financial Ownership  End-to-End P&L Ownership: Take complete accountability for the P&L across 100+ outlets, driving unit-level profitability, controlling Food Cost, minimizing wastage, and optimizing labor/utility costs.  Aggregator & Unit Economics Optimization: Master and optimize unit economics across Aggregators and dine-in channels. Deep dive into commission structures, ad spending ROI, discount strategies, packaging expenses, and aggregator margin contribution to maximize EBITDA. 2. Operational Excellence & Scale  Scale Operations Management: Oversee day-to-day multi-city outlet operations across the UPP ecosystem, ensuring consistency in product quality, speed of service and guest experience.  Team Leadership & Escalations: Directly lead, mentor, and manage the operations team. Serve as the final escalation point for complex franchisee, customer, operational, and supply chain issues with a calm and decisive hand.  Process Standardization & Scaling: Ensure strict adherence to the SOPs across all stores to enable seamless rollout for the next wave of store openings. 3. Audit Framework & Quality Assurance  Design & Implement Audit Frameworks: Build, roll out, and enforce a rigorous store audit framework covering hygiene, safety, brand guidelines, and operational standards.  FSSAI & Regulatory Compliance: Standardize FSSAI compliance, pest control protocols, temperature checks, and raw material quality checks across all outlets.  Variance & Loss Prevention Audits: Conduct routine inventory audits, physical-vs-system variance checks, yield management assessments and pilferage tracking across company and franchised units.  Franchisee Compliance Audits: Ensure franchise-operated stores strictly follow core brand SOPs, ingredient sourcing rules, and quality control metrics. 4. Data Analytics, Tech & AI Integration  Data-Driven Decision Making: Transform complex, messy operational datasets (POS data, order aggregator metrics, inventory logs) into actionable strategies and daily operational priorities.  AI Tool Integration: Utilize modern F&B tech suites and AI-assisted workflows to automate inventory forecasting, predict demand spikes, and streamline operational reporting Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 10+ years of proven operational leadership in QSR, café, or F&B chains (Multi-unit management experience is strictly mandatory). Aggregator Expertise: Deep domain knowledge of ecosystems—commission models, rider handover times, operational ratings, cancellation rates, and aggregator marketing mechanics. Data & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in financial modeling, data analytics, and operational metrics; ability to translate complex spreadsheets into business outcomes. Tech-Savvy: Active comfort using modern AI platforms and modern F&B tech suites. Leadership Style: Hands-on leader who enjoys the grind of operations, builds clear accountability, and thrives in high-growth environments. job descriptionBuild the market. Create the revenue engine. Help take NeuraMach from product to scale. Company: NeuraMach AI Studio Pvt. Ltd. Location: Pune — On-site Experience: 5+ years, with strong zero-to-one commercial execution Compensation: Meaningful ESOP-led founding package; no fixed salary during the current stage The Product Is Live. Now We Build the Business Around It. At NeuraMach AI, we are building AI-native products and solutions designed to transform how people learn, prepare and work. Our first major platform, ScoreVedaa, is now live in beta—reimagining competitive-exam preparation through personalised strategy, intelligent learning, adaptive practice and deep performance insights. The product is live, supported by a developed AI architecture, a substantial content ecosystem and an established initial brand foundation. We are now entering the next phase: building distribution, acquiring users, creating institutional partnerships and expanding ScoreVedaa into the next wave of major competitive-exam markets. Alongside ScoreVedaa, NeuraMach AI Solutions helps businesses and institutions build AI products, intelligent agents, automation systems and customised technology solutions. We have built the foundation. Now, we need the commercial leader who can build the market around it. This Is Not a Conventional Leadership Role You will not inherit a mature brand, established pipeline, large marketing budget or ready-made commercial team. You will create them. We are looking for a commercial co-builder who can turn early momentum into customers, partnerships, repeatable revenue and a scalable commercial engine. Someone who can think strategically, sell like a founder and execute without waiting for perfect conditions. This is a builder’s role—not a caretaker’s role. Your First Mission: Revenue and Distribution Your immediate priority will be to establish repeatable growth, distribution and revenue channels for ScoreVedaa. You will: Build and execute the go-to-market strategy Drive student acquisition, activation and paid conversion Create partnerships with coaching institutes, educators, creators and institutions Personally lead early outreach, demonstrations, proposals, negotiations and closures Identify the channels worth scaling and eliminate those that do not work Establish CRM, pipeline management and revenue forecasting systems Build launch playbooks for future competitive-exam categories You will work closely with the existing product, technology and creative teams, with the authority to shape and build the commercial organisation as traction develops. You will have direct decision-making authority across GTM execution, channel priorities, partnerships and the design of the future commercial team—within agreed company objectives and budgets. Build Across Two Growth EnginesScoreVedaa — Immediate Commercial Priority Build the revenue and distribution engine for an AI-powered competitive-exam preparation platform serving students, educators and institutions. NeuraMach AI Solutions — Selective Strategic Growth Develop high-value enterprise opportunities across AI product development, intelligent agents, automation, analytics and customised AI solutions. ScoreVedaa will remain the primary near-term focus. NeuraMach AI Solutions opportunities will be pursued selectively where there is strong strategic and revenue potential. Create Demand, Not Just Visibility You will shape how NeuraMach and ScoreVedaa are positioned in the market. You will help create and scale the right mix of: Product positioning and messaging High-converting acquisition funnels Performance and content-led campaigns Creator, affiliate and community partnerships Founder-led marketing Institutional activations Outbound sales Strategic distribution partnerships We are not hiring someone to generate impressions. We are hiring someone to create demand, adoption and revenue. Connect the Market to the Product You will work directly with the founders and technology team. Insights from students, educators, institutions and enterprise clients will influence: Product strategy Pricing and packaging User experience Onboarding and retention Future features Market expansion Your responsibility is not only to understand what customers say they want—but to identify what they will adopt, recommend and pay for. What Success Looks Like During the first 12 months, you should help establish: A focused and executable GTM strategy Repeatable acquisition and conversion funnels A qualified institutional-sales pipeline Strategic partnerships that improve distribution and revenue A selectively developed enterprise AI Solutions pipeline Measurable progress across acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue Structured CRM, pipeline and forecasting systems Strong positioning for NeuraMach and ScoreVedaa Commercial traction that strengthens the fundraising story The foundation for a high-performance sales and growth team You Could Be the Right Person If You have 5+ years of experience across startup sales, growth, marketing, business development or revenue You have personally built a product, market, pipeline or revenue function from zero You have acquired customers, closed partnerships or generated meaningful commercial traction You can build momentum without waiting for a large budget or established brand You understand both digital growth and consultative selling You can move comfortably between strategy, execution and customer conversations You can sell to individual users as well as institutional and enterprise decision-makers You understand acquisition, conversion, retention, partnerships and commercial negotiation You have experience in EdTech, AI, SaaS, consumer technology, enterprise solutions or another high-growth sector You know how to prioritise ruthlessly You want meaningful ownership, autonomy and long-term upside Most importantly, you are an entrepreneur at heart. You do not need a finished playbook. You create one. Why Join NeuraMach Now?Real Founding Ownership Influence the company’s GTM strategy, positioning, partnerships, revenue model and future commercial organisation. Direct Founder Access Work closely with the founders and product leadership, with genuine influence over business and product direction. Two Routes to Long-Term Scale Build ScoreVedaa’s commercial engine while selectively developing strategic opportunities for NeuraMach AI Solutions. Build the Function Your Way Design the commercial playbook, select channels, establish partnerships and recruit the future team. Meaningful Long-Term Upside Participate in the value you help create through a meaningful ESOP package aligned with the scope, commitment and long-term importance of the role. Compensation: Please Read Before Applying This is currently an ESOP-led founding leadership role. There will be no fixed monthly salary during the company’s current stage. Salary will commence after NeuraMach completes a suitable fundraising round or achieves sustainable profitability and becomes capable of supporting leadership compensation. Shortlisted candidates will receive transparent visibility into the indicative ESOP structure, vesting, commitment expectations and salary-trigger conditions during the first serious discussion. Any additional performance-linked grants or incentives, where applicable, will be discussed separately. Final terms will be documented before joining. There is no guaranteed timeline for fundraising, profitability or salary commencement. This opportunity is best suited to someone who can make a serious entrepreneurial commitment and is motivated by ownership, responsibility and long-term value creation. This Role Is Not for You If You require an immediate fixed salary You want to manage an established team rather than build one You need a large budget before beginning execution You prefer presentations over customer conversations You are uncomfortable carrying direct revenue responsibility You want a predictable corporate role with limited ambiguity The Operating Style High ownership. Clear priorities. Direct communication. Fast execution. No avoidable bureaucracy. We are not looking for someone to occupy a senior position. We are looking for someone who can help build a serious company. How to Apply Share the following at HR@neuramach.ai: Your resume or LinkedIn profile Something you have personally built or scaled from zero Your strongest sales, growth or revenue achievement What you would prioritise during your first 90 days Why an ESOP-led founding role makes sense for you Your availability to work on-site from Pune Generic applications will not tell us enough. Show us what you have built, how you think and why you should be the person who takes NeuraMach from technology to commercial scale. Build the market. Build the revenue. Build the company. Join NeuraMach AI as our Founding Head of Revenue & Growth. Job Description Head of Digital MarketingIndustry: EdTech (Education Technology)Location: BangaloreReporting To: Vice President Global MarketingPosition Overview We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Head of Digital Marketing to lead a high-growth global EdTech organization into its next phase of expansion and sustained profitability. TutorCloud is a pre-launch. We are an AI native K–12 learning ecosystem entering multiple global markets simultaneously: US, Middle East, India, UK/EU, and Thailand. The product is pedagogy first, compliance ready, and genuinely differentiated in a category flooded with noise. We are not pitching another AI study tool. We are selling integrated learning outcomes to institutions, schools, districts, and chains that have purchase authority, procurement processes, and a real need for something that moves the needle on student outcomes. Your job is to build the performance engine that creates demand, generates qualified pipelines, and converts institutional intent into signed pilots and school contracts. This is a player coach role. You will be running campaigns, not just reviewing them. You will be in pipeline reviews, not just sending dashboards.Key Responsibilities What You Will Own • Full funnel performance marketing strategy and execution across Google Search, LinkedIn, Meta, programmatic, and app channels across all target geographies• Two Regional Performance Managers, one covering US and UK, one covering ME, India, and Thailand, hired, developed, and held accountable by you• Demand generation P&L, with CAC efficiency and pipeline contribution as your primary measures of success• MQL to SQL funnel quality, working closely with sales leadership to tighten ICP targeting, reduce junk rate, and maximise conversion of leads into qualified opportunities• Full attribution and tracking infrastructure: MarTech stack, UTM discipline, regional tracking architecture, CRM hygiene• Weekly pipeline reviews with VP Marketing and sales leadership, shared revenue accountability, not separate marketing reporting• Creative briefing and iteration loop with the Head of Content, ensuring every lost deal informs the next round of creative and messaging• Regional campaign localisation, understanding that the same message does not land the same way in Dubai, Bangalore, and Boston• Ongoing competitive intelligence and channel benchmarking across the K–12 and EdTech landscapeWho You Are • 8 to 12 years of marketing experience spanning both consumers facing brands and enterprise or institutional sales environments. You understand how to drive mass adoption and how to move to a procurement committee• Proven track record in performance marketing across B2C and B2B contexts. You have built funnels that acquire individuals at scale and funnels that generate qualified institutional pipelines. Both are on your records.• Deep hands-on fluency in Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Business Suite, and programmatic platforms, not just oversight• You have worked at a well-regarded consumer internet or tech brand and at a 0 to 1 startup. Both references matter.• Premier institution background preferred, IIM, ISB, or equivalent, or a track record that more than compensates• P&L mindset. You think in unit economics, payback periods, and return on investment, not just platform metrics.• AI native in your approach. You use AI tools to build faster and smarter, not as a replacement for strategic thinking.• You can hold your own in a conversation with a school principal, a district superintendent, or an education chain CTO. Marketing is not behind glass here.What We Offer • A founding team role at a pre-launch AI native K–12 platform, building the performance engine from scratch with real ownership over outcomes• Direct access to the VP Marketing and founding leadership from day one• Competitive compensation with a performance linked structure that grows alongside the company’s commercial trajectory• The chance to build and lead a global team across multiple high-growth markets• A platform to be at the helm of one of the most meaningful AI native growth stories in K–12 education globallyEqual Opportunity Employer We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Applications are welcome from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. normalizedText: What is this role about?As an Associate Director – Customer Experience, you will own the business success of a portfolio of enterprise accounts on the Kapture platform.You will operate as the business owner for your accounts, taking end-to-end ownership of customer outcomes, product adoption, revenue growth, and long-term account health. Acting as the trusted advisor to your customers, you will partner with them to maximize the value they derive from Kapture's SaaS and AI offerings while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and business performance.This is not a traditional Sales or Customer Success role. It requires a strong blend of business acumen, technical understanding, and consulting skills. You will leverage customer insights, platform data, operational metrics, and product knowledge to proactively identify risks, recommend improvements, and drive measurable business outcomes.Working closely with customers as well as Product, Engineering, AI, Delivery, Support, and Sales teams, you will ensure that every engagement delivers tangible value and contributes to the long-term growth of the account.Here's what you'll doOwn the business for your accountsTake end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they continuously realize value from Kapture's platform while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, expand product usage, and grow revenue.Think like the business owner for your accounts—not just the relationship manager.Proactively improve customer outcomesContinuously monitor customer health, platform performance, operational KPIs, and business metrics to identify risks and opportunities before they impact the customer.This could include identifying trends such as: Declining CSAT or NPS , Reduced adoption of key capabilities , Drop in automation or self-service rates , Increasing support volumes , Performance degradation ,Low utilization of licensed features ,Operational inefficiencies ,Emerging business opportunities. Rather than waiting for customers to raise concerns, you will proactively drive corrective actions and continuous optimization.Act as a strategic advisorBuild trusted relationships with customer leadership and become their go-to advisor for platform strategy, product adoption, and business transformation.Establish and drive a measurable operating cadence by ensuring timely MBRs/QBRs, regular governance reviews, and active participation from the appropriate customer stakeholders.Understand their business objectives and recommend solutions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.Drive growth within existing accountsIdentify opportunities to expand platform adoption across new teams, functions, or use cases.Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to develop business cases, influence stakeholders, and drive sustainable revenue growth within your portfolio.Lead cross-functional executionCollaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery, AI, Support, and Customer Success teams to remove blockers, prioritize enhancements, and ensure customer commitments are delivered successfully.Take ownership until the desired business outcome is achieved.Lead and develop the CX team by coaching managers, building team capability, and driving a high-performance cultureDrive governance and operational excellenceLead regular governance reviews with customers, covering platform performance, business KPIs, product adoption, roadmap discussions, operational health, risks, and growth opportunities.Establish structured operating rhythms that create transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.What does success look like in this role?Success is measured by the business outcomes you create for your customers.You consistently improve customer health, increase product adoption, strengthen executive relationships, grow account revenue, and proactively address risks before they become escalations. You are recognized by customers as a strategic partner and internally as the single owner driving the success of your accounts.What would make you a good fit?Basic requirements7-10 years of experience in Enterprise SaaS, Customer Experience, Consulting, Solution Engineering, Program Management or a related field.Experience managing enterprise customers and working with multiple business and technical stakeholders.Strong understanding of SaaS products, enterprise implementations, and customer lifecycle management.Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive outcomes without direct authority.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.What are the most critical skills for this role?You think like an owner and take accountability for customer and business outcomes.You use data, operational metrics, and customer insights to proactively identify risks and opportunities.You can balance business priorities with technical constraints and drive informed decisions.You excel at executive communication and stakeholder management across both customer and internal teams.You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, prioritizing effectively, and coordinating multiple teams to deliver results.You'll have an advantage if youHave experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, CRM, Contact Center, Customer Experience, or AI products.Have worked with APIs, integrations, dashboards, analytics, or monitoring platforms.Have experience driving customer adoption, business transformation, or digital initiatives.Are comfortable interpreting operational metrics and using them to influence business decisions.Why should you be interested?This role offers the opportunity to own the success of some of the world's leading enterprise brands and shape how they leverage technology to transform customer experience.You'll work at the intersection of business, technology, and strategy—partnering with senior customer leaders while collaborating with Product, Engineering, AI, Delivery, and Sales teams to solve complex problems, drive measurable business impact, and influence the future of Kapture's platform. We are seeking a metrics-obsessed operator to own the full-funnel expansion of our mobile application environment. As the Head of Growth (App), you will be directly accountable for active app MAU, retention curves, user activation, and premium subscription conversions. You will maintain a direct integration line into the App Product team to unify feature engineering with rigorous growth loops. Key Responsibilities & Core Problems to Solve Build Conversion Funnels: Establish an efficient web-to-app infrastructure that successfully migrates Patrika's high-volume, unowned web traffic into logged-in, highly trackable app users. Solve the Retention Challenge: Redesign user journeys to move away from low-duration "drive-by" visit behaviors, cementing the app as a home for habitual, daily interaction. App Store Discovery Optimization: Drive strategic App Store Optimization (ASO) and user acquisition architectures to compete effectively against premium news application offerings from major regional competitors. Continuous Experimentation: Conduct continuous, small-scale onboarding, push notification, and pricing tests to steadily improve CAC and LTV economics. Experience & Scale Requirements Must have led the growth engine of a consumer app with several million MAU featuring a live subscription or paywall business model. Complete mastery over full-funnel analytics, including onboarding drop-offs, D1/D7/D30 retention analytics, and trial-to-paid conversion metrics. Practical familiarity operating within price-sensitive, low-ARPU emerging markets dominated by payment friction (such as UPI-dependent behaviors). Critical Disqualifiers Growth expertise limited to paid-acquisition-heavy categories (such as gaming or fintech) that bypass structural retention and long-term habit-loop design. No direct exposure to subscription or premium paywall models (having only scaled free, fully ad-supported applications). Inability to address technical Indian Android ecosystem realities, such as optimizing for low-RAM performance, minimizing app download sizes, and navigating data constraints. Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

normalizedText: Who are we? Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.This intelligence powers our entire product suite.Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster. Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps. Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments. These are embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf. Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category. Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group. With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards. Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively. We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8% Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees. Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category. RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year” These recognitions are matched by business performance:Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list. Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023 Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!About the role:Whatfix is looking for a strategic, data-driven leader to build and run the operating system behind our Customer Success organisation. As Head of CS Operations & Strategy, you will own the frameworks, tools, processes, and intelligence that enable our CS teams to drive measurable customer outcomes at scale.Reporting directly to senior CS leadership, you will sit at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution, translating business goals into operational playbooks, and surfacing insights that shape how we grow and retain our enterprise customer base globally.Key Responsibilities: Design and own the CS operating model — including coverage design, segmentation strategy, capacity planning, and headcount modelling across onboarding, adoption, and renewal motions. Build and maintain the CS analytics practice: dashboards, health scoring, churn prediction models, and expansion signals that give CS leaders real-time visibility into portfolio health. Own the CS tech stack (CRM, BI tools), driving adoption, governance, and continuous improvement across the tooling layer. Lead quarterly and annual CS planning cycles, working cross-functionally with Finance, Sales, and Product to align on ARR targets, retention goals, and resource allocation. Define and operationalise customer journey playbooks , from onboarding through renewal and expansion, ensuring consistency across regions and segments. Partner with RevOps and Sales Ops to ensure seamless hand-offs, unified data definitions, and a single source of truth across the customer lifecycle. Drive strategic initiatives such as digital CS motions, scaled customer programmes, and the integration of AI-assisted workflows into the CS delivery model. Act as a trusted thought partner to CS leadership on organisational design, performance management, and go-to-market strategy. Qualification Criteria:10+ years of experience in CS Operations, Revenue Operations, or Strategy roles within B2B SaaS. Proven track record of building CS operational infrastructure from the ground up or significantly scaling an existing function. Deep expertise in Salesforce, and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) and Excel (or Gsheets) Strong analytical and financial modelling skills; comfortable building business cases and presenting to executive leadership. Experience working with enterprise-segment customers and understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder sales and success cycles. Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills. Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is strongly preferred. You will stand out if:You have worked in a Digital Adoption Platform or adjacent category (LMS, ITSM, CRM implementation). You have led a CS Ops function through a hypergrowth phase or a pre-IPO/liquidity event. You have built AI-assisted CS workflows or automated customer health triggers at scale. You have experience with global CS operations spanning North America, EMEA, and APAC. You are comfortable with ambiguity and have strong instincts for prioritisation in a fast-moving environment. Perks & Benefits (India):Best-in-class medical insurance coverage Free lunch & dinner buffet Doorstep cab drop facility Education sponsorship Internal job transfer & global mobility programs Scope to represent Whatfix at global events We also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers Note:We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it; We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status At Whatfix, we deeply value collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We believe that being together in the office five days a week fosters open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and accelerates innovation—ultimately helping us achieve our goals more effectively. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month. In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we’re open to considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis to ensure you’re supported in managing both work and life seamlessly. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typematching preferenceFull-time LocationIndia Full job description About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. This is a high-trust, high-impact role for someone who combines sharp strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll be the operational backbone and strategic partner to the India GM - driving revenue operations, keeping the team accountable to process, and making sure nothing slips as we scale fast in ElevenLabs' largest APJ market. Critically, you won't just support strategy from the sidelines - you'll help identify where the next wave of growth comes from and own execution of the initiatives that move the growth needle, seeing them through from plan to result. No job is too small. No task is beneath you. The upside is significant. What you'll do Act as a strategic thought partner to the GM - pressure-testing plans, not just executing them. Scope and build the case for new growth bets - new segments, channels, or motions. Bring an outside-in view of where India GTM is under-indexed and turn market and competitive signal into a plan. Own end-to-end execution of key growth initiatives - driving them from plan to measurable outcome, not just tracking status. Serve as the connective tissue across Legal, Marketing, and Product on India-specific initiatives. Track the KPIs and OKRs that matter for the India business and surface what needs attention before it becomes a fire. Identify and fix operational problems before they escalate. Use AI tools to automate, streamline, and multiply your own impact. Handle sensitive matters with discretion and act as a trusted partner across the org. Requirements Who you are Low ego, high ownership, no task beneath you - you drive things to done, not just to "assigned." Smart, structured, and practical with genuine commercial instincts. Track record of owning a growth initiative end-to-end and landing a measurable result, not just coordinating one. Comfortable operating with ambiguity - you can take a vague growth thesis and turn it into a scoped plan with an owner and a timeline. Passionate about AI and excited to be at the center of a category-defining company. Prior experience in consulting, strategy & ops, or a high-growth startup GTM environment. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About CopadoCopado is the #1 DevOps Platform for Salesforce and the Cloud. We deliver an AI-enabled devops platform to enhance human’s ability to orchestrate business application development in the agentic age to drive digital transformation for 1,500+ of the most innovative brands on the planet — from Coca-Cola to T-Mobile to Volkswagen. Our agentic platform unites non-technical admins and pro-code developers on the same system and empowers enterprises to scale end-to-end software delivery across multi-cloud environments. We operate in a dynamic and competitive industry and our consistent growth reflects our continued commitment to innovation and customer success.Job SummaryWe are looking for a visionary, hands-on Country Lead to build, scale, and transform our support operations in Bangalore, India. This is not a "maintenance" role; we are looking for a leader who has "been there and done that"—someone who thrives in startup environments, embraces ambiguity, and is ready to execute an ambitious organizational transformation. You will act as the architect of our Bangalore support hub, responsible for creating a 24/7 follow-the-sun operational model, building a high-performance culture, and instituting a "continuous learning" ecosystem.Key ResponsibilitiesCenter Build-Out: Spearhead the rapid establishment and growth of our Bangalore support center, including recruiting, hiring, building call center infrastructure and onboarding a diverse team of support engineers, contractors, and leads.Operational Transformation: Drive organizational change by implementing best-in-class support frameworks, including Swarming models for complex issue resolution and a "Fix Once" mandate to institutionalize knowledge management.Culture & Career Architecture: Build a culture of "Excellence is not an accident." You will be responsible for defining clear career paths, mentoring talent, and ensuring continuous technical learning is the heartbeat of the office.AI & Knowledge Integration: Champion an "AI-First" support strategy. You will ensure that knowledge is captured organically as part of the support process (KCS principles) and that our teams leverage AI to deflect and resolve issues efficiently.Technical Leadership: Partner with global engineering and product leadership to ensure the Bangalore team is deeply integrated into the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC). You will oversee technical triage and resolution protocols utilizing Git, Jira, and Azure DevOps.24/7 Operational Excellence: Design and enforce a global "Follow-the-Sun" support model that ensures high-tier coverage, seamless handoffs, and consistent SLA achievement for our enterprise customers.We Are Looking For Someone With ExperienceStartup DNA: Proven experience in a high-growth startup environment. You understand how to build from scratch and have a high bias for action—you are not risk-averse.Transformation Track Record: Demonstrated experience leading organizational transformation projects; you know how to shift culture and process from reactive to proactive.AI Fluency: You are AI-literate and know how to integrate AI tools into support workflows to drive efficiency and case deflection.Technical Depth: You understand the modern technical stack, including Git, Jira, and Azure DevOps. You have a thorough understanding of the product development lifecycle and can coach others on these concepts.Strategic Leadership: Experience building out teams, mentoring managers, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.Operational Rigor: We are going to build a center that quickly gets a customer to a human being that can help.Customer Service: Candidates will have to build based on the Copado way. A mandate to help with an unwavering commitment to resolve customer issues. We are looking for a leader that understands excellence is not an accident.Experience Building out an new fashioned call center complete with autonomous voice agents speaking to customers and handing over to humansQualifications & ExperienceSalesforce Support Leadership: Experience leading enterprise support teams within the Salesforce ecosystem.Follow-the-Sun / 24/7: Proven success in designing and managing global, 24/7 follow-the-sun support organizations.Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS): Deep experience in building organizations that treat knowledge as a primary output of the support process.DevOps Experience: A strong background in DevOps principles and practices is considered a major plus.Foundational Expertise: Deep background in establishing support centers from scratch, incorporating operational discipline for ticket resolution and client interactions. Head - Marketing (Shopping & Luxury Malls)Position SummaryThe incumbent will be responsible for driving the overall marketing strategy for the Shopping & Luxury Malls portfolio, contributing to revenue growth, profitability, customer engagement, and brand equity. The role will focus on creating differentiated marketing platforms, strengthening consumer connect, enhancing mall footfall, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives across properties.Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Marketing & Business GrowthDevelop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with business objectives and portfolio growth plans. Provide strategic direction through consumer insights, market intelligence, data analytics, and emerging retail trends. Drive brand positioning and long-term growth initiatives across the mall portfolio. Mall Launches & Brand PositioningLead end-to-end launch marketing for new mall developments. Design and execute high-impact market entry strategies to maximize awareness, footfall, and brand visibility. Build strong positioning for shopping and luxury mall assets in their respective markets. Customer Engagement & LoyaltyConceptualize, implement, and scale customer loyalty programs across the portfolio. Enhance customer engagement, retention, repeat visits, and lifetime value through data-driven initiatives. Leverage consumer insights to strengthen customer experience and engagement. Events, Activations & PartnershipsOwn and drive the annual marketing calendar, including events, festivals, experiential campaigns, promotions, and brand collaborations. Develop innovative marketing platforms that enhance consumer participation and drive commercial outcomes. Establish strategic partnerships with brands, influencers, media, and external stakeholders. Consumer Research & AnalyticsConduct periodic consumer research to identify evolving shopping patterns and customer preferences. Utilize analytics and market intelligence to improve campaign effectiveness and optimize marketing investments. Collaborate with research and analytics partners to derive actionable business insights. Digital Marketing & CommunicationsDrive digital marketing initiatives across the mall portfolio, including social media, performance marketing, CRM, and customer engagement platforms. Lead digital transformation initiatives to improve consumer outreach and campaign effectiveness. Centralize and strengthen public relations efforts across all properties. Stakeholder & Tenant RelationsDevelop strong relationships with tenant marketing teams and key retail brands. Maintain a deep understanding of retail trends, brand movements, and category developments. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of marketing initiatives. Brand Governance & Marketing EffectivenessEnsure consistency in brand communication, storytelling, and customer experience across all properties. Drive marketing ROI through effective budget utilization, performance tracking, and outcome measurement. Lead, mentor, and guide mall marketing teams across locations. Desired ProfileEducational QualificationMBA / PGDM with specialization in Marketing from a reputed institute. Experience15-20 years of progressive marketing experience, preferably in: Retail FMCG / FMCD Consumer-facing brands New-age media, entertainment, or lifestyle businesses Key CompetenciesStrong understanding of retail marketing, consumer behavior, and customer engagement.Experience in mall marketing, loyalty programs, events, and experiential campaigns. Strong analytical and research orientation. Proven ability to develop and execute large-scale marketing strategies. Strong network across marketing agencies, media houses, PR agencies, and industry partners. Excellent stakeholder management and leadership capabilities. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strategic thinker with a results-driven approach. Job description:Join us at GPN and inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! At Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN), our mission is to inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! We are a global leader in the performance nutrition industry and have a portfolio of nine brands including Optimum Nutrition (ON), BSN and Isopure. Our products are sold in over 130 countries and our brands are in the top three performance nutrition brands in more than 20 countries. Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN) is headquartered in Dublin, ROI, with operating facilities in Illinois, California, South Carolina, the UK, the Netherlands, India, Asia and Australia. GPN employs more than 1,800 people globally and has revenues of approximately $1.5B. We are a values led organisation focused on driving sustainable business performance. Join us on our journey now! Head of RGM We are seeking a Head of Revenue Growth Management for driving RGM analytics for pricing, assortment, promotion and trade, drive insights to support RGM strategy-setting for Asia, Middle East and Africa.This role will work with the Commercial functions in ad-hoc requests (e.g., new customer VC, evaluating new promotion) The opportunity where you will make an impact: Work on the AMEA Business Strategy as RGM is a key Business driver Lead revenue analytics - core pricing, assortment analytics (e.g., brand ladders, pack price curves) and promotional analytics for key accounts and across channel archetypes Analyze market trends and create associated reports for key brands and pack sizes Analyze product volume, margin and competitive prices to provide recommendations Provide fact base to assist in determining pricing guidelines on brand/pack/channel level Run analytics to measure trade spend efficiency (e.g., incremental margin or growth per dollar invested in a given account) and make recommended changes Build and update pricing & assortment guidelines Develop promo event-level guidelines and work with Sales to develop ROI-informed promotional calendars/plans Maintain promo effectiveness scorecards Monitor pricing, assortment, promotion and trade execution (e.g., create summary reports & score cards) and participate in regular reviews Monitor and provide consolidated view of competitor activities Partner with Sales & Marketing to develop customer sell-in stories when needed Db ROI annual exercise Channel wise value chain Performance marketing ROI Business case for Retailer Investments What you will bring to GPN: 10+ years experience within finance or commercial. Broad multi-channel experience preferably in established FMCG industry Strong strategic mindset with deep understanding of commercial and financial drivers Experience leading pricing, promotions, and trade investment strategies Ability to analyze complex datasets and convert insights into actionable business plans Strong leadership and influence skills to drive change across the organization, collaborate cross functionally and feed functions with market trends. Results-oriented approach focused on sustainable growth and profitability Advanced writing and communication skills, and be able to interact and persuade individuals levels senior to him or her, as well as actively participate in meetings and group discussions with individuals from other functions (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Finance) Analytical skills – ability to follow detailed instructions to perform complicated financial analyses, as well as determine basic analyses required to support pricing decisions (e.g., structure the problem, collect data, identify issues and present results) Computer skills – advanced knowledge of Excel, Tableau, and PowerPoint is required CA or MBA is an added bonus Knowledge of SAP Where and how you will workThe opportunity will be based in Gurgaon office with hybrid working arrangements available through our Smart working model which allows you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance. What we would like to offer you!The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package. normalizedText: Who are we?Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. normalizedText: About The CompanyTata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of CommunicationsJob SummaryWe are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Product Owner to drive the successful delivery of digital products and business solutions. This role is primarily responsible for backlog ownership, requirements definition, prioritization, and collaboration with Agile delivery teams to ensure products deliver measurable business value.The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong Product Manager instincts—including strategic thinking, customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, market awareness, and outcome-oriented prioritization.The Product Owner will be expected to look beyond feature delivery and actively contribute to product direction, value realization, and continuous product improvement.Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog in alignment with business objectives and customer needs. Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications. Partner closely with development, QA, UX/UI, and architecture teams throughout the product lifecycle. Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and other Agile ceremonies. Provide timely clarification and decision-making support to delivery teams. Validate delivered solutions against defined requirements and acceptance criteria. Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment on priorities and scope. Continuously refine requirements and priorities based on feedback, learnings, and changing business needs. Product Thinking & Strategic Contribution Understand the broader business context and customer problems behind requested features.
