role: Director - Customer Marketing, B2C, India, Creativity & Productivity (C&P)
normalizedText: The opportunityIn this leadership role, you’ll be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing the India marketing strategy to meet the business’ goals for the Digital route to market covering flagship products like Adobe Photoshop, Firefly and Acrobat. As an innovative marketing leader, with a deep understanding of the Indian market and a passion for driving marketing excellence in a competitive environment, you will shape the future of digital marketing in India and are pivotal to Adobe's continued growth in the Asia Pacific region.What You’ll DoSet the vision and provide strategic marketing leadership for the Creativity & Productivity (C&P) portfolio in India. Develop the marketing strategy, aligning cross-functionally to meet quarterly and annual targets including revenue, conversion, retention and ROMS. Lead content creation for full-funnel marketing campaigns, managing creative agencies. Adapt global strategies to the local market and capitalize on regional opportunities. Build effective relationships with Go-to-Market, Product Marketing Management, Comms, A.com, Corporate Marketing and other functions to ensure the India marketing strategy is aligned and delivered effectively. Set and communicate the cross-functional team’s marketing priorities, adapting and making necessary trade-offs. Mange the marketing budget, working with Corporate and regional PMM to allocate across the product portfolio and manage spend to achieve targets. Lead and develop a high-performing cross-functional team and cultivate a working environment aligned to Adobe’s values. Oversee efforts to enhance and localize the Adobe brand for the India market, ensuring cultural relevance and resonance. Influence the martech/infrastructure used internally to shape the future of Adobe and the industry. Develop strategic partnerships for the C&P business unit in India collaborating with the Corp Partnerships team. Play a key role in quarterly business and marketing reviews, defining the ‘narrative’ for India and influencing the Executive team including the India SVP and Country Manager to again agreement on strategic shifts and trade-offs. Establish meaningful regional targets to measure the effectiveness of marketing programs, gaining agreement from Corporate. Use data analytics and market insights to identify key drivers for growth and optimization. What You Need To SucceedDemonstrated track record of working in a global marketing organization as well as “matrixed” functions to deliver more than double digital growth. Excellent project management skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with attention to detail. 20+ years of marketing leadership experience in B2C, in software or a technology related field. Deep understanding of the digital marketing (including social & influencer) and media landscape in India with a customer-first approach. Strong understanding of digital business models and demonstrated impact creating and launching initiatives to drive conversion, paid member value expansion and increase customer engagement and retention. Demonstrated success in fast-paced environments, rapidly anticipating and adapting to shifting priorities with strong project management skills. Excellent leadership skills, showing strength in motivating a team to exceed goals. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Exceptional critical thinking, with the ability to translate market insights into actionable marketing strategies focused on outcomes. Outstanding communication, presentation and negotiation skills (verbal and written) in English. Fluent Hindi. Additional local languages highly desirable. Ability to engage and manage culturally diverse team members cross-functionally. Proven success in influencing executives, VP and/or “C” level. Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is preferred. Knowledge of Adobe products desirable. About AdobeAdobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.Let’s Adobe togetherAt Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience. mmediate Joiners PreferredLocation - ChennaiExp - 12+yearsJob description :OverviewThe Director of Marketing Operations & Digital is a strategic and operational leader responsible for transforming Marketing into a disciplined, data-driven growth engine. Reporting directly to the CMO, this role will architect and scale the systems, processes, analytics, and digital experiences that power demand generation, revenue acceleration, and measurable enterprise value creation.This leader will combine operational rigor with digital innovation, building the infrastructure that enables marketing and sales alignment, pipeline visibility, performance accountability, and modern buyer engagement.Critically, this role will also lead the CBTS AI-first marketing transformation. As BCG research confirms, 96% of CMOs believe AI is driving end-to-end transformation of their function but only about a third have moved beyond the basics. This leader will put CBTS in that top tier: designing, deploying, and scaling AI agents and autonomous workflows that transform marketing from a cost center into a strategic growth engine. This is not a role for someone who uses AI tools. It's for someone who builds with them and who understands that the larger opportunity is not efficiency, it's growth.AI-First Leadership & Marketing Agent DevelopmentThis is a differentiating priority. normalizedText: Associate Director- MarketingAbout Urban CompanyUrban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated servicesPartner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihoodTechnology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry.What will you do?As a leader for Cleaning & Pest Control, you will be the "CEO of Demand" for our largest and most complex business cluster, covering Bathroom & Kitchen Cleaning, Full Home Deep Cleaning, and Pest Control. Your mandate is to move the needle on top-line growth while building a brand that customers trust for their most intimate home needs.Key Responsibilities 1. Consumer Insight & Empathy: Go beyond the data. Spend time with customers and service partners to understand the "why" behind the "what." Identify the triggers and barriers for professional cleaning versus the unorganized sector.2. Growth Charter & Problem Identification: Take a first-principles approach to identify why a category isn't growing faster. Is it a frequency issue? A trust deficit? You will define the 6-12 month roadmap to unlock exponential growth.3. Full-Stack Brand Marketing: Lead the creative and media strategy for the cleaning cluster. Whether it’s a massive TVC or a hyper-targeted digital "InstaHelp" campaign, you will ensure the brand remains salient and "top of mind."4. Pricing & Revenue Strategy: Own the P&L levers. You will design pricing experiments, loyalty constructs, and promotional guardrails to optimize for both market share and unit economics.Who Should Apply?● You have experience in brand/content management, growth in start ups, or top-tier consulting.● You get a kick out of building things and growing them, you aren’t afraid of ambiguity.● You are comfortable with data analytics and data visualization but can also write a compelling creative brief that inspires an agency.● First-Principles Thinker: You don't do things because "that's how it's done." You question every assumption until you find the most efficient path to growth.● Cultural Fit: You thrive in high-intensity environments, value radical candor, and have a deep sense of ownership.What Can You Expect? ● Unmatched Ownership: You are the primary driver of a multi-hundred crore business vertical.● High-Growth Environment: A seat on a rocket ship that is scaling globally.● Peer Excellence: Work alongside some of the sharpest minds from IIMs, ISB, and top global firms. ● Impact: The opportunity to build a brand that changes the lives of thousands of service professionals and millions of households. jdEvidence.value: Own and grow total subscription revenue across a portfolio of four products by building and running a unified acquisition and monetization engine.

normalizedText: In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place — one app, local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight: when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies and marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalizing. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the knowledge, opportunities, tools, and experts they've always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:Edutainment & Skill Learning — practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)Matrimonial Matchmaking — hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)Agri Consulting — farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)Local Jobs — blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)Social & Community — a place to find and post social updates (Lokal app)Emotional Well-being & Peer Support — safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)Astrology & Guidance — instant access to trusted astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)& many more in testing & experimental spaceUnder the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight + AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a WhatsApp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the center: access changes lives. We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.RequirementsFour of those focused apps — GyanTV, Sahi English, Poster Maker, and Matrimony — run on subscription revenue. What's missing is one owner who can see all four at once, allocate the next rupee and the next hire across them, and build the acquisition and monetization engine as a single system instead of four disconnected ones.You will own subscription revenue — the whole number, not a slice of it — across four products with four different consumers, four different LTV curves, and one shared marketing org that you build and run. This is not a "run performance marketing" role. It's a P&L seat, sitting in leadership, parallel to the product heads, not underneath them — partnering with them as an equal.What You'll OwnThe number Total subscription revenue across the four-product portfolio, tracked on revenue scale and LTV/CAC — not spend, not impressions, not a ROAS target handed down from someone else.Acquisition, end-to-endPerformance marketing across Meta, Google, and emerging channels, with an explicit mandate to cut single-platform dependenceASO and organic pull, so growth isn't 100% spend-ledInfluencer marketing and channel mix decisions across four audiences that don't look alikeHigh-volume, vernacular-first creative testing — an iteration engine, not a monthly campaign calendarCAC optimization as an ongoing discipline, not a one-time fix — continuously testing channel mix, bidding strategy, and creative to bring CAC down without starving volumeFunnel and experimentationBuilding and owning the full product and marketing funnel — awareness through acquisition, activation, trial, paid conversion, and win-backRunning a structured, high-velocity experimentation engine across funnel stages: pricing tests, paywall placement, onboarding flows, creative-to-landing-page matchBringing genuinely new growth plays to the table, not just optimizing what already existsMonetization mechanicsPricing, packaging, trial design, paywall placement, autopay mandate economics, and win-backThe line between ad promise and in-app delivery — if the hook oversells, trial-to-paid conversion and trust both break, and that's your problem to preventMoney and peopleMarketing budget allocation across four businesses with different LTV curves — deciding where the next rupee and the next hire go is a live judgment call, not a formulaBuilding and running a multi-function team: performance marketing, lifecycle/CRM, creative, ASO, growth analyticsThe rigor underneath itBlended and channel-level ROAS, M0-to-payback visibility, and CAC/payback targets set by product and category — a single blended number tells you nothing across four different businessesIncrementality and attribution done properly — MMM plus platform data, not last-clickCompliant, resilient account structures and creative guidelines for categories that get scrutinized hard — personal finance-adjacent and matrimony traffic doesn't survive lazy account hygieneWhat You'll Bring5+ years of relevant growth marketing experience, with a track record you can walk through in detail — not just describe at a high levelYou've owned a revenue P&L before, ideally in a subscription business — not just a spend budget or a ROAS target someone else set for youExperience scaling a business to ₹200-300 Cr+ in annual revenue, or managing a business generating ₹8-10 Cr+ in monthly revenue — you've operated at a scale where the trade-offs are real and the margin for error is thinStrong, hands-on expertise in CAC optimization and performance marketing — you can walk through exactly how you brought CAC down while protecting volume and qualityProven ability to build and optimize product and marketing funnels end to end, with a bias toward experimentation — you treat the funnel as something to be continuously rebuilt, not a fixed pipe you pour spend intoYou've run growth across more than one product or business line at once, and made real trade-off calls between competing bets with a shared budgetYou know India consumer subscription mechanics cold: UPI autopay/e-mandate economics, low-ARPU high-volume funnels, vernacular creative at scale — this isn't a market you're learning on the jobExperience in subscription-based business models is strongly preferred — you understand content/subscription LTV curves, churn, and win-back dynamics specificallyYou're fluent in ad-platform policy and account health, and have built compliant creative guidelines and resilient account structures for a regulated or heavily scrutinized category (fintech-adjacent, matrimony, health, etc.)You can talk unit economics without notes: CAC, payback period, cohort LTV, blended and channel ROAS, and the MMM/attribution stack underneath themYou've built a marketing org, not just operated inside one — hiring, structuring, and managing performance/CRM/creative/ASO/analytics functionsYou have a real network across ad platforms, agencies, and creative supply that you can activate in month one, not month sixHow You'll Be MeasuredTotal subscription revenue and LTV/CAC across the portfolio. Everything above is in service of that number. jdEvidence.value: Drive success of AMD's Embedded Partner Marketing initiatives by accelerating co-marketing, partner enablement, and demand generation across the Embedded Partners ecosystem.

normalizedText: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHINGAt AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. The RoleThe right candidate will drive the success of AMD's Embedded Partner Marketing initiatives by accelerating co-marketing, partner enablement, and demand generation across the Embedded Partners ecosystem, including ODMs (Original Design Manufacturers), IP (Intellectual Property) providers, Software, and Design Services partners. This highly collaborative role partners closely with Product Marketing, Partner Management, Field Marketing, and Sales to develop and execute integrated marketing programs that strengthen partner engagement, increase solution awareness, and generate measurable business impact.The PersonYour passion for technology marketing and partner collaboration will enable you to build strong relationships across AMD's ecosystem while delivering impactful marketing programs. You are a proactive self-starter with exceptional organizational skills who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. You have the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling value propositions and can successfully manage multiple initiatives while driving alignment across internal teams and external partners.Key ResponsibilitiesBuild and execute joint co-marketing plans with priority partners across the AMD Embedded Partner ecosystem, aligned with AECG (Adaptive and Embedded Computing Group) business objectives and regional priorities. Drive partner enablement through the development of sales and technical enablement materials, including messaging frameworks, pitch decks, FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions), training content, and sales tools for partner sellers, FAE (Field Application Engineering) teams, and solution architects. Support solution and platform launches by developing positioning and messaging, coordinating campaign assets, managing launch calendars, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring launch readiness. Plan and execute integrated partner demand generation campaigns, including audience targeting, campaign offers, landing pages, email nurture programs, webinars, paid media, and lead management coordination. Lead partner events and activations, including trade shows, workshops, demonstrations, and webinars by managing timelines, logistics, speaker preparation, asset delivery, and post-event reporting. Manage marketing program operations, including project intake, cross-functional schedules, legal and brand reviews, localization requests, MDF (Market Development Funds) planning and claims where applicable, and executive reporting. Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing liaison for assigned partners by leading status meetings, tracking actions and risks, resolving issues, and ensuring effective communication across AMD and partner organizations. Measure, analyze, and report campaign and enablement KPIs (Key Performance Indicators), including content engagement, MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads), influenced opportunities, event ROI (Return on Investment), enablement adoption, and partner satisfaction through regular dashboards and business reviews. Identify opportunities to scale marketing programs by developing reusable content, reference architectures, solution messaging templates, and best-practice playbooks across regions and partner tiers. Collaborate effectively across Product Marketing, Partner Management, Field Marketing, Sales, Legal, Brand, and external ecosystem partners to ensure successful program execution. Proactively drive continuous improvement across partner marketing processes, campaign execution, and partner engagement initiatives. Must be a self-starter with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. Preferred ExperienceExp in semiconductor product marketing, solutions marketing, partner marketing, or a closely related role. Industry familiarity with FPGAs (Field Programmable Gate Arrays), adaptive SoCs (Systems-on-Chip), EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tools, or embedded processors. Proven experience planning and executing co-marketing programs with ecosystem partners or strategic alliances, including co-branded campaigns, product launches, demand generation programs, and partner events. Ability to translate complex technical concepts—including adaptive SoCs, FPGAs, IP blocks, boards and SOMs (Systems-on-Modules), reference designs, and embedded software stacks—into compelling customer value propositions and marketing narratives. Strong project and program management skills with the ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives and coordinate cross-functional teams. Experience collaborating with Product Marketing, Partner Management, Field Marketing, Sales, Legal, Brand, and external partners. Excellent written, verbal, presentation, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with experience in partner-facing communications. Familiarity with marketing technologies such as CRM (Customer Relationship Management), PRM (Partner Relationship Management), marketing automation platforms, content management systems, and project management tools. Strong analytical skills with experience measuring campaign performance, reporting KPIs, and driving data-informed marketing decisions. Detail-oriented with excellent planning, organization, and multitasking abilities. Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed organization with global teams and external stakeholders. Willingness to work on-site in Hyderabad, India, collaborate across North America time zones, and travel as required to support partner events. Academic CredentialsBachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). An advanced degree is considered a plus.Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance.AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. jdEvidence.value: Turn vision into strategy, build the North America growth engine, and bring order to early-stage chaos.

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Paymissing preference₹99,000 - ₹1,00,000 a monthJob typematching preferenceFull-time LocationRemote Full job descriptionOur client, a founder of a US-based company (LLC, Miami) is building technology and AI-driven services for small businesses across North America — starting in Florida, then expanding through the US and Canada. We are looking for one exceptional person in India to be her right hand: a strategist and operator who thinks like a partner, not an employee. This is not a role that already exists with a tidy job description. We'll shape it together. If you've spent a decade in corporate life building real things and there's a quiet voice asking “shouldn't I be building something of my own?” — read on. Two non-negotiables (please read before applying) Full US Eastern Time overlap. This role runs on US EST hours, every working day — not a couple of overlapping hours, the full day. In India, that means a 6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST working day. Our clients, our momentum, and our future are in North America, so your day is aligned to theirs. This is non-negotiable, so please apply only if this schedule genuinely works for your life. All in, or not at all. We want someone ready to commit 100% — not someone holding on to a current job and testing this on the side to see if it works out. That mindset can't build a company; it keeps one foot on the shore. Building this needs your full focus, energy, and conviction. If you're not ready to go all in, this honestly isn't the role for you — and that's completely okay. Who we are looking for 30–35 years old, roughly 10+ years of experience, and restless for your next chapter. Software + MBA background. You've actually built things — apps, systems, platforms — and then went deeper into the business side. You speak engineering and strategy fluently. Strong with numbers. P&Ls, pricing models, unit economics, forecasts — you're comfortable, even happy, living inside a spreadsheet, and you catch the mistake in the model. Experience with US / Canada / global clients. You know the rhythm, standards, and trust it takes to work with North American businesses. A genuine AI enthusiast who's past the hype and has real opinions on where AI creates leverage for a lean services business. Ex-corporate but wired to build. You've delivered inside big companies and now want to create something of your own — with the grit to build even on hard days. Conviction to sell. You believe small businesses in North America are underserved by technology, and you want to help win and grow that market, Florida first. What you'll do Turn vision into strategy, milestones, and a real execution roadmap. Own the numbers — build and run the models and tell me the truth about what's working. Help build our North America engine: how we find, win, and keep small-business clients. Bring order to early-stage chaos as we grow — systems, standards, hiring, culture. Be my thinking partner: stress-test my ideas, argue with me, and never be a yes-person. Compensation Base: ₹1,00,000 per month (independent contractor), with clear intent to grow it as the company grows. Ownership: a meaningful equity stake in the company, earned and vested over time — real ownership, not a token. Profit share: a defined share of company profits once we're profitable. Full specifics (equity %, vesting, profit-share, buyback) are shared privately with shortlisted candidates. This is a deliberate early-stage trade: modest cash today, real ownership and upside in what we build together. This probably isn't for you if… You want to keep your current job and try this on the side. You can't (or don't want to) work full US Eastern Time hours. You want defined boundaries and a predictable week. You need someone to tell you what to do next. “Early-stage ambiguity” makes you anxious rather than excited. You want a title for LinkedIn more than a company to build. …and it might be exactly for you if You read the top of this and felt something click — even if your résumé isn't perfect. How to apply Don't just send a CV. In a short note, tell me: 1. The thing you built that you're proudest of. 2. The thing you wish you'd built but never got the chance to. That second answer tells me more than any résumé ever could. Location: Remote (India). Working hours are 6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST (full US Eastern Time overlap), every working day (Mon-Fri) — non-negotiable. This is a full-time, all-in commitment. Pay: ₹99,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month Work Location: Remote

normalizedText: LocationBengaluru, Karnataka Full job description Senior Director, Product Management About GW RhythmX AI GW RhythmX platform delivers precision care intelligence natively embedded in Epic EHR, putting the right treatment recommendation in front of the right clinician at the right moment without adding to their burden. Our products reach 85M+ patients including 8M US military veterans across 150+ health systems. We are recognized by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace. We operate with startup agility backed by $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data on 300M patients, 4.4B annual claims, and a global network of 1.8M healthcare professionals across 3,000+ facilities. Our core thesis: AI should find the patient not the other way around. The Precision Care Platform is how we deliver on that thesis at scale across inpatient, outpatient, specialty, and nursing care settings, embedded in the daily workflows of every clinician who touches a patient. The Platform You Will Lead The Precision Care Platform is a clinical intelligence layer embedded in Epic EHR. It surfaces contextual, guideline-driven insights derived from our library of clinical guidelines from professional societies at the moment a clinician needs them, within the workflow they are already in. Care Settings and Product Areas Inpatient: AI-driven clinical intelligence across admission, rounds, handoffs, and discharge workflows — supporting hospitalists, attendings, and care teams in real-time inpatient decision support Outpatient: Context-aware precision care insights for ambulatory workflows — surfacing guideline gaps, care opportunities, and documentation support at the point of outpatient encounter Specialty: Role-specific intelligence for Cardiology, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology, and other specialty service lines — driven by specialty-specific guideline sets and patient data Nursing: A dedicated and emerging product layer targeting discharge readiness, shift handoff, and break handoff — built from first-principles nursing discovery and designed for the specific workflow constraints of bedside nurses Cross-setting infrastructure: EHR-native integration architecture, FHIR-based data pipelines, AI insight generation, and clinical validation frameworks that underpin every care setting The Role As Senior Director of Product Management for the Precision Care Platform, you are the product leader for India team, accountable for the quality, execution, and strategic direction of everything the India team builds. You report directly to the Global Head of Product and operate as a true partner to US-based product, engineering, clinical, and GTM leadership. This means you are not managing a feature team. You are running a product organization - setting strategy, building teams, driving execution, and maintaining the clinical and technical depth to make the right calls across a complex, multi-setting platform. The role demands two things simultaneously: the judgment of a senior strategist and the hands-on engagement of a lead PM. You will set direction and roll up your sleeves. You will own outcomes, not just workstreams. What You Will Own Platform Product Strategy Own the product vision and roadmap for the Precision Care Platform across all care settings — inpatient, outpatient, specialty, and nursing Translate enterprise customer priorities, clinical insights, and GTM requirements into a coherent, phased product strategy Define what gets built, when, and why — with the rigor to defend those decisions to engineering, clinical leads, customers, and executive leadership Ensure continuity between short-term execution and long-term platform architecture Product Execution and Delivery Drive end-to-end product delivery across multiple concurrent product streams, from discovery through clinical validation to live deployment in production EHR environments Establish delivery cadence, sprint accountability, and cross-team coordination across the India product and engineering organization Own the dependency map across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Data, and GTM — and proactively surface risks before they become blockers Hold the bar on execution quality — products that work in real clinical environments under real time pressure, not just in controlled demos Team Leadership and PM Development Build, lead, and mentor a team of Product and Program Managers working across care settings and product areas Raise the bar on product thinking, ownership culture, and execution quality across the entire India PM team Develop PM talent through direct coaching, structured feedback, and clear career pathing Create an environment where accountability, speed, and clinical empathy coexist — startup energy with professional craft Technical and AI Depth Engage directly in architecture discussions — LLM-based insight generation, RAG pipelines, HL7/FHIR data flows, and Epic EHR integration patterns Guide tradeoffs across AI model selection, clinical data pipelines, and integration architecture with the confidence to hold informed positions Work closely with engineering leaders and executives to ensure AI systems are clinically sound, technically robust, and scalable Clinical Workflow and Care Setting Ownership Maintain deep fluency in the actual workflows of every care setting the platform serves — rounds, clinic visits, specialty consultations, nursing handoffs, discharge planning Partner with clinicians and clinical advisors, customer champions to validate product direction continuously Global Collaboration and Customer Alignment Work in close, consistent alignment with the PM leads, US engineering leadership, and customer-facing teams Represent India product direction clearly in global forums — as a voice for execution quality, clinical insight, and technical depth Align product roadmaps with active enterprise customer commitments and GTM priorities, including new health system onboarding and expansion from pilot to enterprise Operate effectively across time zones with high trust, low friction, and clear communication What We Are Looking For HealthTech Expertise Deep experience building and shipping products in US healthcare environments, with strong preference for inpatient or multi-setting clinical experience Genuine understanding of how clinicians — physicians, nurses, specialists, CDI teams — work under time pressure inside hospital and ambulatory systems Solid knowledge of EHR systems and how software integrates into live clinical workflows, with Epic experience strongly preferred Fluency with interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR R4, and common healthcare integration patterns Product and Execution Leadership 12+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role owning a team or a major product area Proven track record of taking clinical or enterprise healthcare products from early-stage through scaled enterprise adoption Strong execution discipline — you ship, you measure, you iterate, and you hold your team to the same standard Demonstrated ability to run programs across multiple product streams simultaneously without losing context or momentum Technical Depth Ability to engage substantively with engineering and AI teams on system design, architecture tradeoffs, and technical constraints Understanding of LLM-based product development — prompt design, RAG architecture, hallucination mitigation, clinical validation approaches Comfortable working with clinical data models, FHIR resources, and the integration patterns that connect AI systems to EHR workflows Familiarity with modern cloud infrastructure and the operational requirements of production healthcare AI systems Expertise in building data pipelines for the longitudinal record using HL7/FHIR ingested data and leveraging the longitudinal record to build RAGs, Knowledge Graphs, etc. People Leadership Experience building and leading PM teams — hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development Strong communicator across engineering, clinical, design, and commercial audiences — you adapt the message without losing the substance High emotional intelligence and the ability to build trust with distributed, cross-cultural teams across time zones A coaching orientation: you invest in the people on your team, not just the outcomes they deliver Startup Mindset Proven ability to operate in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where structure must be created, not inherited Strong bias toward action, iteration, and shipping — you know the difference between being busy and being effective Comfortable making hard product calls with incomplete information and standing behind them Focus on outcomes and clinical impact, not process compliance or documentation volume Global and Market Orientation Deep familiarity with US healthcare market dynamics — buyer behavior, procurement cycles, clinical governance, and enterprise adoption patterns Experience working directly with US-based executives, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders as a peer, not a support function Proven ability to build trust across geographically distributed organizations What Success Looks Like In the first 90 days, you have established a clear picture of the platform, the team, and the gaps — and you have credibility with US leadership, India engineering, and clinical stakeholders. Products are live in clinical workflows and driving measurable impact. Nursing is emerging as a credible product line. The pipeline of PM talent is stronger because of how you lead. We’re now looking for two Marketing Strategy & Transformation Leads to help shape how Seco builds relevance and drives long‑term growth – one in Europe and one in the Asia-Pacific region. Your new team You’ll be part of our Marketing Strategy and Customer Insights team, a collaborative group that turns insights into strategic impact. We work across the organization to shape bold, data‑driven direction, strengthen our brand, and support marketing excellence. Our focus is to bring clarity, alignment, and practical tools that help teams create consistent, meaningful experiences for customers and the business. About the job Your role is to translate customer understanding, future signals, and business priorities into clear marketing strategies. You set up structures that help teams prioritize, make decisions faster, and stay aligned. You shape frameworks, define strategic choices and make sure insights play a natural part in how plans are developed and executed. Part of the work is transformational. You support improved operating models, develop new ways of working, and help the organization adopt strategy in a consistent, scalable way. You also turn strategic direction into compelling narratives that make sense to leaders and teams across the organization. Here are some of the areas you work with: Developing and refining marketing strategy frameworks and prioritization models. Turning strategic ambition into roadmaps, operating models, and ways of working. Facilitating cross‑functional alignment between BMC, Sales, Product, Digital, and other teams. Integrating insights and foresights into strategic decision‑making. Creating strategic narratives, communication material, and engagement plans. Preparing analyses, scenarios, and recommendations for senior leaders. Defining success metrics, objectives, and measurement structures. Supporting alignment across markets to ensure coherent brand and communication execution. Coaching colleagues and contributing to capability building within the strategy function. Location and reporting The location for this role is flexible within either Europe or the APAC region. You report to the Director of Marketing Strategy and Customer Insights. Your profile A background in strategic planning, marketing strategy, or a similar area gives you the foundation to connect insights, business objectives, and customer value. Your analytical skills are strong, and you’re comfortable interpreting data, structuring complex information and documenting strategy with precision. A proactive mindset, clear written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work both independently and in cross‑functional setups are essential. Collaboration comes naturally, and you build trust across functions through diplomacy, clarity, and steady communication. You’re able to translate big‑picture thinking into practical direction that teams can follow, and you enjoy working in a setting where structure, adaptability and continuous improvement go hand in hand. Our Seco culture At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. How to apply Send us your application no later than July 26, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English.

This leader will put CBTS in that top tier: designing, deploying, and scaling AI agents and autonomous workflows that transform marketing from a cost center into a strategic growth engine. This is not a role for someone who uses AI tools. It's for someone who builds with them and who understands that the larger opportunity is not efficiency, it's growth.AI-First Leadership & Marketing Agent DevelopmentThis is a differentiating priority. normalizedText: Job highlightsWe value diversity of thought,background,and experience,and believe it strengthens our team and drives our successRequired Skills & Qualifications .Job match scoreEarly ApplicantKeyskillsLocationWork ExperienceJob description Associate Manager (CTO Office) Department: CTO Office / Strategy & Growth Location: Gurugram Reports to: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) About Us: BharatRohan is an Indian agricultural technology (AgTech) company that specializes in providing drone based solutions for farmers. Our primary goal is to empower farmers with advanced technology to improve their yields, profitability, and sustainability. We offer various products and services, including: 1. CropAssure : A decision support system that utilizes hyperspectral imaging technology to provide farmers with early pest and disease detection, nutrient deficiency analysis, and yield prediction. 2. SeedAssure : A platform that helps seed companies research and develop the right seeds for their specific market needs and conditions. 3. SourceAssure : A platform that enables buyers to purchase residue-free, traceable, and sustainably grown agri-commodities BharatRohan is committed to promoting sustainable agriculture and we have aligned its operations with nine United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). We have recently received a significant investment of $2.3 million to further expand our drone-based agricultural solutions. About the Role As the Associate Manager in the CTO Office, you will be the primary liaison between technical innovation and market execution. You will support the CTO in driving the-adoption of BharatRohan s drone based crop monitoring and asset intelligence solutions. This is a "hybrid impact" role requiring a blend of technical storytelling, strategic sales, and agile project management. You will not just sell a service; you will architect data,driven solutions that redefine agricultural and industrial efficiency. Key Responsibilities: 1. Strategic Sales & Business Development Solution Selling: Identify and engage with B2B clients (FMCG giants, Seed Companies, Insurance Providers) to sell our CropAssure, SeedAssure, and SourceAssure platforms. Asset Intelligence Expansion: Lead the charge in diversifying our drone services into new verticals like powerline monitoring, infrastructure inspection, and environmental surveys. Proposal Engineering: Collaborate with the R&D team to translate complex HSI data capabilities into high,impact commercial proposals and ROI,focused pitch decks. 2. Technical Project Management End,to,End Execution: Manage the lifecycle of drone,based projects from initial pilot design and DGCA compliance to data acquisition and final delivery of actionable insights. Stakeholder Orchestration: Act as the "glue" between Drone Pilots, Remote Sensing Engineers, and Agronomists to ensure project timelines and data accuracy (5cm/pixel resolution) are met. Product Feedback Loop: Synthesize client feedback to help the CTO prioritize features in our Decision Support System (DSS) and proprietary HSI algorithms. 3. CTO Office Operations Special Initiatives: Support the CTO in high,stakes meetings (e.g., TDB, IFC, or Government bodies) and assist in strategic roadmapping for next, gen hardware like the Pravir-X6. Market Intelligence: Stay updated on global trends in Edge Computing, AI/ML in Remote Sensing, and evolving DGCA regulations to keep BharatRohan at the frontier of the industry. Required Skills & Qualifications The BharatRohan "Ideal Fit" You are a problem,solver who doesnt just see a drone as a flying camera, but as a data,gathering tool for sustainable change. You are comfortable with ambiguity transitioning from a boardroom presentation in the morning to a dusty field trial in the afternoon. You possess a "Founders Mindset", taking extreme ownership of project outcomes and client satisfaction. Why Join Us Frontier Tech: Work with India s pioneers in Hyperspectral Imaging. Impact: Directly contribute to improving farmer livelihoods and food security (reducing crop loss by an average of 26%). Growth: This role offers a "birds,eye view" of how a listed DeepTech company operates, providing a fast track to leadership roles. BharatRohan is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value diversity of thought, background, and experience, and believe it strengthens our team and drives our success. job description Position Overview: The Senior Marketing Manager has a strategic role and is responsible for the product branding, crafting, and leading the product marketing strategies, and demand generation. This also involves researching competitors, creating the messaging, and working on the go-to-market plan. The Senior Marketing Manager will be required to drive innovation and creativity, which will help in generating strong positioning, brand value and brand recall. Role & Responsibility: Strategy: you’ll build and execute, through your team, a product marketing strategy to improve the success of our solutions in the market. Management: lead, develop and inspire a team of marketers. Product Champion: help inform the overall marketing strategy with valuable product marketing intelligence. Be the evangelist, internally and externally, for our full solutions set and monitor the performance of solutions to educate key stakeholders. Drive brand strategies to enhance the Brand Value, Product placement, and work towards being the brand of choice in the industry. Customer Research: build detailed persona’s and gain a deep understanding of the markets we serve to help inform sales and marketing activities. Market Intelligence: build and keep up to date a competitor comparison matrix. Using this intelligence to inform new product development, pricing strategies and marketing tactics. Conduct strategic marketing analytics with respect to the competitors and create strategies with both short term and long-term focus. Product Messaging: using customer research and competitor intelligence, develop product positioning and messaging, including differentiators and use cases. GTM: work closely with sales and marketing teams to create and support the go-to-market strategy. Stakeholder Management: work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders and regularly present to the board Demand Generation: create a strong presence in the industry which will lead to inbound and outbound demand generation. Build, manage and optimize the pipeline and work towards Sales Funnel Creation. Marketing Budget Management: Optimally manage and utilize the Marketing budgets to ensure the maximum Return on Investments. Data Analytics: Have great analytical ability and be comfortable with data driven decision making consistently - should be able to put in frameworks & processes which generate measurable and accurate data. Above is a summary of expected role and responsibility and must not be considered as an exhaustive list of duties. Skills and Qualifications: Minimum 12 years of proven marketing and branding experience in IT/Software Industry. IT Product Marketing (SAAS) experience is highly preferred and valued. Must have a minimum of 4 years of experience in Channel Marketing. Experience with HubSpot, and other outbound data tools Must have planned and successfully executed events / road shows in existing and new territories. A proven track record of successful marketing programs and strategies Excellent Written and Verbal communication skills. Must have represented the organization on Domestic/International market. Must have led team of marketeers to success, leadership skills to encourage the team members towards excellence are a required. Education Requirements: MBA in Marketing from a reputed business school This role is based in Ahmedabad (Work from Office). Were open to receive applications from candidates who are based in CET time zone.

About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading provider of employee, financial and legal administration services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. Our 11k+ experts in 125+ offices across 87 jurisdictions worldwide serve corporates, financial institutions, asset managers, private clients and family offices, providing the combination of accounting, tax, payroll, fund administration, compliance and entity management services essential to global business success.

Discover the Role

We re looking for a Global Accounting Tax RDC Lead (Regional Delivery Center). Shaping the vision for the service delivery across all the RDCs. Defining and executing the global practice strategy by driving operational excellence, innovation and technical background across RDCs.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Global AT Service Strategy and Governance

  • Define, maintain, and enhance the global AT service framework, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across all markets.
  • Oversee the alignment of deliverables, terminology, and pricing models across RDCs

Lead and coordinate RDCs

  • Establish, expand, and guide Regional Delivery Centers (RDCs) to ensure scalable, high-performing AT delivery teams.
  • Coordinate cross-region service capabilities.

Ensure Operational Excellence Across RDC AT Services

  • Oversee standard AT processes across procure to pay, order to cash, and record to report functions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Monitor performance against KPIs and SLAs.

Strengthen Quality, Compliance, and Risk Management

  • Ensure global compliance frameworks are applied consistently across RDCs.
  • Oversee global coordination for audits and ensure high quality workpapers and reconciliations.

Act as Primary Global Partner to Commercial, Solutioning, and Market Teams

  • Support global solution architects by aligning AT capabilities with client proposals, RFPs, and global solution models.
  • Engage with Pricing Team.

Develop Talent and Build a Global AT Community

  • Mentor and elevate AT leaders across markets, ensuring alignment with global frameworks and promoting knowledge sharing.
  • Build competency roadmaps and provide coaching to delivery teams, ensuring a consistent AT skill baseline across all regions.
Key Requirements
  • Extensive senior leadership experience (12+ years) in Accounting Tax (AT), with a strong track record operating across multiple jurisdictions and global environments
  • Proven experience designing and executing global operating models, including establishing or scaling Shared Services / Regional Delivery Centres (RDCs) / Centres of Excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale transformation programmes, including:
  • Transitioning work across regions
  • Driving standardisation, efficiency, and cost optimisation
  • Managing complex, cross-border change initiatives
  • Strong background in multi-client service delivery models, ideally within a Big 4 or professional services environment (or equivalent outsourcing organisation)
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end AT processes
  • Robust expertise in global tax compliance, statutory reporting, and regulatory frameworks across multiple jurisdictions

jdEvidence.value: Multinational Client Retention and Relationship Management for Property & Casualty Insurance Solutions
Client Retention, Renewal Management, and Opportunity Expansion

normalizedText: DescriptionAbout WTWWillis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance.Together, we unlock potential.About The TeamThe Multinational Client Retention team partners with global and regional clients to deliver tailored Property & Casualty insurance solutions while driving long-term client relationships and retention. The team works closely with insurers, brokers, and internal stakeholders to provide strategic risk management support, seamless renewals, and exceptional client service across complex multinational programs.Key Responsibilities Client Needs Assessment/Client Retention: Conduct thorough assessments of clients' insurance requirements by analyzing their existing coverage, evaluating risks, and understanding their financial goals. Effectively communicate and educate clients on available insurance products and their benefits. Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to foster loyalty and long-term partnerships as well as focus on servicing existing clients and expanding opportunities. Market Research: Stay updated with industry trends, market conditions, and changes in insurance regulations. Conduct regular market research to identify emerging opportunities, competitive pricing, and new insurance products that can benefit clients. Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to streamline processes and provide a seamless experience to clients. Ensure client service team understanding of client needs, service delivery methods, and the other framework relevant to services delivered as well as offering technical support to sales and servicing teams.Drive the renewal process, assembling the appropriate team to develop and implement the client-specific renewal strategy. Booking & invoicing of business on time and coordinate with teams – internal/external.Educate clients on risk management, market issues and relevant trends. Serve as a trusted adviser; monitor client satisfaction; report and resolve client issues and concerns and review client expectations to ensure relationship is mutually acceptable.Perform other related duties as assigned. QualificationsPost-Graduate with 7+ years of demonstrated experience in client servicing role preferably in property/casualty insurance solution. In-depth working knowledge of the insurance business and the clients’ needs as well as all major lines of business.Effective problem solving, communication, presentation, influencing and negotiation skills.Good relationship development skills, in dealings with both internal and external customers and stakeholders.Demonstrated ability to deliver impeccable service to new/existing clients by following a well-planned and structured retention process.The Application ProcessStage 1: Online application and recruiter reviewStage 2: Live video interview with hiring manager and teamStage 3: Offer and onboardingWe’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com. normalizedText: Role & responsibilities Lead and deliver Sourcing and Procurement transformation projects in the areas of strategic cost reduction, sourcing optimization, procurement transformation, and intelligent procurement by using tools such as Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, O9 Solutions working with mid to large sized teams-Understand the clients business, priorities and leadership agenda-Help originate deals based on defined commercial pathways; jdEvidence.value: Lead service delivery management, governance, workforce planning, portfolio reporting, and operational oversight activities to drive consistent delivery outcomes, organizational alignment, and team effectiveness across PFI India.

normalizedText: PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.a Purpose Driven Company – 150 YearsWhile the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.What Will You DoAs a Director, Service Delivery Management, you will be responsible for the delivery and management of technology solutions and services, working with business partners, internal delivery teams, and supporting functions to ensure an appropriate level of service and consistent delivery execution.This role serves as a central point of coordination across PFI India teams, driving consistent delivery outcomes, establishing governance practices, and maintaining alignment across roadmaps, priorities, and execution plans. The role also provides direct administrative leadership for Tech Leads and Product Owners across aligned teams, encompassing workforce planning, capacity management, performance alignment, onboarding, development, and overall team effectiveness.In addition, this role is accountable for establishing and maintaining delivery standards, supporting financial and resource forecasting, and ensuring adherence to enterprise policies. The role plays a key part in portfolio reporting, roadmap planning, and executive communications, ensuring transparency into delivery progress, risks, and business impact.Role Purpose: Lead service delivery management, governance, workforce planning, portfolio reporting, and operational oversight activities that drive consistent delivery outcomes, organizational alignment, and team effectiveness across PFI India while ensuring transparency into delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and business impact.What You Can ExpectDelivery & Service ManagementResponsible for the delivery and management of technology solutions and services, ensuring alignment to business priorities and expected outcomes. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to drive consistent, predictable delivery execution aligned to roadmaps.Administrative Leadership (Tech Leads & Product Owners)Provide direct administrative leadership for Tech Leads and Product Owners across aligned teams, including strategy, delivery, workforce planning, capacity and demand management, and performance alignment.Oversee onboarding, development, and team effectiveness to ensure strong engagement and alignment within PFI India. Portfolio Reporting, Roadmaps & CommunicationsOwn and coordinate portfolio-level reporting, including delivery status, risks, dependencies, key performance indicators, and roadmap alignment. Deliver clear, concise, and actionable communications to senior leadership regarding delivery progress, risks, and business impact. Governance & Operational OversightEstablish and maintain governance frameworks that ensure visibility, accountability, and disciplined delivery execution. Ensure adherence to enterprise standards, policies, and audit requirements. Financial & Resource ManagementSupport financial forecasting related to technology delivery, including resource demand, capacity planning, and expense management. Partner with leadership to optimize resource allocation and improve delivery efficiency. Issue Management & EscalationAct as an escalation point for delivery issues, risks, and service impacts.Coordinate resolution efforts and ensure appropriate communication of impacts to business and technology leadership. Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Team CollaborationCollaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure delivery outcomes meet business needs and strategic objectives. Serve as a key liaison between PFI India teams and global partners, ensuring strong alignment and communication. Continuous Improvement & Capability BuildingIdentify and implement opportunities to improve delivery processes, reporting, and team effectiveness. Drive adoption of best practices and promote consistency across teams. Contribute to the ongoing evolution and strengthening of PFI India delivery capabilities.What You Will Bring12+ years of experience leading technology delivery in a global matrixed environment. Experience driving delivery consistency, governance, and operational discipline across multiple teams and priorities. Proven ability to provide administrative leadership, including workforce planning, capacity and demand management, and team effectiveness. Strong understanding of portfolio management practices, including reporting, roadmap alignment, and management of risks and dependencies. Strong working knowledge of modern technology and engineering practices, including AI/ML and data domains, with the ability to actively engage, challenge assumptions, and guide aligned delivery decisions. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear, concise, and actionable updates to senior leadership. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations, evaluate multiple variables, and drive informed decision-making. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a focus on execution, accuracy, and accountability. Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate across business and technology stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.What will set you apart?Success working in distributed or global delivery models, with the ability to collaborate and influence across geographic boundaries. A track record of supporting or managing programs with diverse stakeholders across regions and time zones. Experience strengthening delivery capabilities through process improvements, reporting enhancements, governance practices, and adoption of best practices across teams. Financial services or asset management industry experience.PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. You will work closely with the CEO and other co-founders to drive product development, oversee the technical team, and ensure the successful launch and growth of our Fintech product. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, technical expertise, and entrepreneurial spirit. Key Responsibilities: Technology Vision and Strategy: Define and implement the technology roadmap in alignment with the company’s vision and goals. Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure our product remains competitive and innovative. Product Development: Lead the development and delivery of the Fintech product, ensuring it meets market needs and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and launch new features and improvements. Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and manage a high-performing technical team, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Provide technical guidance and support to team members, ensuring best practices in software development and system architecture. Infrastructure and Security: Oversee the design and maintenance of a scalable and secure technology infrastructure. Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive financial data and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with the CEO and other co-founders to shape the company’s overall strategy and direction. Communicate technical concepts and strategies to non-technical stakeholders, including investors and board members. Innovation and Problem-Solving: Foster a culture of innovation, encouraging the team to explore new ideas and technologies. Address technical challenges and identify solutions that drive efficiency and growth. Qualifications: Proven experience as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or in a similar leadership role within a Fintech or tech startup environment. Strong technical background with expertise in software development, system architecture, and emerging technologies. Experience in building and scaling technology teams, with a track record of successful product launches. Deep understanding of financial services, regulatory requirements, and cybersecurity. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Skills: Tech Savy , FinTech

normalizedText: JOB DESCRIPTION This is a senior leadership role for someone who has spent the better part of their career at the intersection of CPG business strategy and technology, and is now ready to build, own, and grow a practice.The CPG Practice Director will be responsible for defining Zensar's point of view in the Consumer Packaged Goods space, growing the revenue pipeline, and ensuring that what we deliver to clients reflects genuine domain expertise. This is not a delivery management role. It is an ownership role. The person in this seat will shape Zensar's CPG narrative externally, build the internal capability to back it up, to turn domain credibility into commercial outcomes.You will report into the Global Head of Industry Solutions Group, MCSWhat You Will OwnAI-Native Innovation Define and drive Zensar's AI-first agenda for CPG across Revenue Growth Management, Trade Promotion, Supply Chain, and Consumer Insights Identify where AI and GenAI create tangible business value for CPG clients and build that into our service offerings, not as a layer on top, but as the design principle Partner with Engineering and Data and Analytics practices to co-develop solutions that are commercially viable and domain-authentic Stay ahead of how CPG companies are adopting AI at scale and translate that into Zensar propositions before clients ask for them Revenue Pipeline: Growth and Influence Own and grow a defined revenue pipeline in collaboration with the Consulting Growth Office and account delivery teams Lead or influence pursuit strategy for CPG accounts, from shaping the conversation early to closing Bring a point of view into client conversations before an RFX exists, identify where the problem is, frame the opportunity, and position Zensar as the right partner Build and maintain relationships with economic buyers, CFOs, CCOs, CPOs, not just program sponsors Own new logo conversion end-to-end, meaning personally leading solutioning, building the commercial narrative, and closing, not directing a pursuit team from the sidelines Develop and own domain centric solution constructs for CPG pursuits, RFXs, SOW framing, pricing rationale, and delivery approach, with direct hands-on involvement, not delegation Work across Zensar's service lines, Data and Engineering, Experience Services, Digital Marketing, to assemble the right solution for each pursuit and ensure the CPG domain lens runs through the full proposal Client Excellence Set the standard for how Zensar shows up with CPG clients, in the quality of thinking, the relevance of recommendations, and the credibility of the team we put in the room Actively participate in key client engagements at a strategic level, not to manage delivery, but to ensure the client relationship grows beyond the current SOW Own client satisfaction and advocacy at a practice level. NPS, repeat business, and reference-ability are outcomes this role is accountable for Domain-Centric Delivery Aligned to SOW Commitments Ensure that IT delivery teams across CPG engagements are operating with domain context, not just technical competence Work with Delivery Heads to resolve situations where execution is drifting from the strategic intent of the engagement Review SOW commitments on key accounts and ensure the practice is delivering to the outcome, not just the activity Serve as the senior escalation point for clients when delivery conversations need strategic re-alignment Capability Building Build a CPG consulting team that can hold its own against Big 4 and specialist boutiques Define the capability profile Zensar needs, by role, by seniority, and by domain specialisation Own the learning agenda for the CPG practice, structured programs, client exposure, and knowledge assets that make the team sharper over time Identify, hire, and develop the next layer of domain leaders within the practice based on visibility of the confirmed revenue pipeline. Thought Leadership and Analyst Relations Represent Zensar's CPG point of view externally, at industry forums, analyst briefings, and client events Build relationships with ISG, Everest Group, Avasant, Gartner, Forrester, and relevant CPG-focused analyst communities Publish, speak, and create content that positions Zensar as a credible voice in CPG transformation, not generic technology content, but opinionated, practitioner-grade thinking Develop a consistent drumbeat of thought leadership that supports both brand and pipeline Industry Relationships Maintain and deepen relationships with senior leaders across Tier-1 CPG companies, built over a career, not from a CRM Represent Zensar at CPG industry associations, councils, and executive networks Bring external perspective into Zensar, what clients are prioritising, where the market is moving, and what competitors are doing, and use that to sharpen our positioning GTM Partnerships Identify, establish, and nurture GTM relationships with relevant technology and platform partners, TPM/RGM platforms, data and AI vendors, cloud providers Shape co-sell and co-delivery models with partners that expand Zensar's reach and credibility in CPG accounts Work with the Consulting, Delivery, Services Lines and Growth Office teams to formalise partner relationships into structured GTM motions with clear pipeline accountability ExperienceWhat We Are Looking For 18+ years of experience with a significant portion in CPG, either on the consulting - SDLC Implementation on either client side, or both Proven track record working with Tier-1 CPG companies, the kind where you have been in the room with the business, not just the IT team Has carried P&L or revenue responsibility, knows what it means to own a number, not just a project Has led large, complex IT programs and more importantly, has shaped the strategy that the program was built to deliver Multi-market experience, has operated across geographies, not just one region Domain Knowledge Deep expertise in Revenue Growth Management, Trade Promotion Management, and Commercial Excellence Strong understanding of CPG value chain, from demand planning and supply chain through to trade execution and consumer engagement Familiarity with the AI and data landscape relevant to CPG and a credible point of view on where it is going Working knowledge of relevant platforms, Xtel, Salesforce CG Cloud, SAP, o9, or equivalent Educational Qualifications (Good To Have) MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management from a reputed institution, preferably with a focus on Marketing, Strategy, or Operations B.Tech or equivalent undergraduate degree in Engineering or a related discipline Candidates with equivalent experience and demonstrated impact in lieu of formal qualifications will be considered Leadership Profile Has built teams and developed talent, not just managed headcount Operates with executive presence, comfortable in board-level conversations without a script Thinks commercially, connects domain expertise to revenue outcomes naturally Brings an independent point of view, not someone who waits for the brief before forming an opinion The Way You Will Need to WorkA few things that are important to be explicit about: This role starts without a team. You will not have a bench to delegate to. The expectation is that you are personally productive from day one, writing proposals, leading client conversations, shaping solutions, and developing content. The ability to build a team comes after you have demonstrated what the practice can do. You will need to travel, regularly and globally. Client relationships in CPG are built in person. This role requires presence across geographies, sometimes with short notice, and a willingness to be where the client is. You need to be hands-on. This is not a role for someone who reviews other people's work. You will be in the room, on the whiteboard, writing the narrative, and closing the deal in association with the Sales, and Service Line teams. You will work across service lines. Data and Engineering, AI, Digital, and Managed Services are your partners, not your support structure. The ability to collaborate horizontally across Zensar and bring the right capability together for a client is core to how this role operates. It is not for someone who needs a team around them to be effective. It is for someone who has already made the shift from execution to strategy, has the relationships and credibility to influence CPG C-suites, and is ready to build something, starting with their own hands.
