Job Description Job Title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Social Justice & Empowerment Location: Mulund, Mumbai Employment Type: Full-Time Salary: Up to ₹1,50,000 per month (Based on experience) Experience Required: 12–15+ years in NGO/Development Sector, Social Justice, Community Development, or related fields About the Role We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and impact-driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Social Justice & Empowerment to lead and strengthen our programs focused on social justice, inclusion, community empowerment, disability inclusion, women empowerment, education, livelihood, and sustainable development. The COO will oversee day-to-day operations, drive strategic growth, manage cross-functional teams, build partnerships, and lead fundraising initiatives to ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of the organization. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Develop and execute organizational strategies aligned with the vision and mission. Drive operational excellence across all social impact programs. Identify opportunities for expansion, innovation, and long-term sustainability. Support the leadership team in policy development and organizational planning. Program & Operations Management Lead the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of all social justice and empowerment initiatives. Ensure timely execution of projects with measurable impact. Develop operational systems, SOPs, and quality standards. Monitor program budgets, timelines, and performance indicators. Fundraising & Resource Mobilization Develop and execute fundraising strategies to support organizational growth. Build and maintain relationships with CSR partners, corporate donors, foundations, HNIs, trusts, and philanthropic organizations. Identify and pursue grant opportunities from national and international funding agencies. Prepare compelling proposals, concept notes, presentations, and donor reports. Lead fundraising campaigns, donor engagement initiatives, and strategic partnerships. Ensure compliance with donor requirements and funding guidelines. CSR & Partnership Development Develop strategic partnerships with corporates, government agencies, NGOs, academic institutions, and international organizations. Represent the organization in CSR meetings, conferences, networking forums, and stakeholder engagements. Build collaborations that enhance the organization's reach and impact. Government & Stakeholder Engagement Liaise with central and state government departments. Leverage government schemes and policies to strengthen program outcomes. Coordinate with regulatory bodies and ecosystem partners. Advocate for inclusive policies and social justice initiatives. Financial & Compliance Management Oversee annual budgets and financial planning. Ensure efficient utilization of organizational resources. Monitor statutory, legal, CSR, and donor compliance requirements. Review financial reports and operational performance. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary teams. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance work culture. Drive capacity building and professional development initiatives. Conduct performance reviews and succession planning. Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting Develop monitoring frameworks and impact measurement systems. Present organizational progress to the Board of Directors, donors, and senior leadership. Ensure timely submission of project, financial, and donor reports. Qualifications Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW), Development Studies, Public Policy, Rural Development, Social Sciences, or related field. MBA or Master's in Management is preferred. Certification in CSR, Fundraising, Project Management, or NGO Management is an added advantage. Experience & Skills 12–15+ years of leadership experience in NGOs, Foundations, CSR, or Social Impact Organizations. Proven experience in managing large-scale social justice and empowerment programs. Strong experience in fundraising, CSR partnerships, grant management, and donor relations. Excellent understanding of CSR regulations, government schemes, and development sector frameworks. Experience managing multi-location teams and cross-functional operations. Strong financial planning and budget management skills. Exceptional stakeholder management and networking abilities. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and leadership skills. High level of integrity, strategic thinking, and decision-making ability. Preferred Experience Social Justice & Advocacy Disability Inclusion & Accessibility Women Empowerment Education & Skill Development Livelihood & Community Development Healthcare & Public Health Rural & Urban Development CSR Project Management Fundraising & Resource Mobilization Government Liaison & Policy Advocacy Job Type: Full-time Pay: Up to ₹4,000,000.00 per year Application Question(s): Total Years of Experience CCTC ECTC Notice Period Comfortable for Pan-India Travelling? job description About Sarvam Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC. About the Role The Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Performance) owns the paid and conversion side of growth - getting more of the right people to try Sarvam, activate, and convert, efficiently and at scale. This role owns paid acquisition, conversion-rate optimisation, lifecycle, and the experimentation that turns spend into signups, usage, and revenue. The mandate is measurable: drive efficient, compounding growth where every rupee and experiment is accountable to outcomes. This person works closely with Product, Sales, and Analytics to move users through the funnel - from paid acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion. They own the performance channels and the conversion levers, and partner with the Organic counterpart on shared funnel, experimentation, and analytics. What You’ll Do PLG funnel conversion. Own conversion across the developer journey: signup first successful API call habitual usage paid conversion team expansion. Instrument it, experiment on it, and compound it. Paid acquisition. Own performance marketing across paid search, paid social, display, and other paid channels. Manage budgets with discipline and optimise toward quality signups and revenue, not clicks. Conversion-rate optimisation. Own the conversion levers across landing pages, signup flows, and paywalls. Continuously test and improve the steps that turn visitors into activated, paying users. Activation & onboarding. Design onboarding, in-product nudges, and lifecycle programs that move developers from signup to first call to habit to revenue. Reduce time-to-value at every step. Retention & expansion. Own the levers that keep users active and grow accounts — lifecycle messaging, re-engagement, retargeting, and the signals that predict churn and expansion. Experimentation. Run a continuous program of growth experiments across acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention. Maintain a backlog, ship fast, measure honestly, and double down on what compounds. Attribution & budget. Own attribution for paid and lifecycle programs and the efficiency of spend. Know your CAC, payback, and LTV, and report them honestly. Analytics & instrumentation. Define the performance metrics that matter, instrument the product and funnel to capture them, and build the dashboards the team runs on. Partner with Organic on a shared funnel view. AI-native workflows. Use AI across creative, targeting, copy, and analysis to compress every cycle and run a leveraged, low-overhead performance motion. What We're Looking For 7 - 10 years in growth or performance marketing, with hands-on ownership of a PLG or self-serve funnel Hands-on expertise running paid acquisition across search, social, and display, with clear attribution and disciplined budget management Strong experimentation discipline; you design, run, and read experiments rigorously and act on the results Comfort with analytics and instrumentation; you define metrics, pull your own data, and know your CAC, payback, and LTV Experience marketing to developers or technical buyers with quantified outcomes Fluent in modern AI tools for creative, targeting, content, and analytics Bonus Points Experience driving paid conversion for an API, SDK, or open-weight/open-source model Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and lifecycle/retention tooling at depth Experience at a founder-led or early-stage company where the performance motion had to be built from scratch Familiarity with both a self-serve developer motion and an enterprise sales motion running side by side Experience managing or mentoring performance, lifecycle, or analytics contributors Why Sarvam? Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar High ownership and high impact, from day one Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be. .css-1f63e20{display:-webkit-box;display:-webkit-flex;display:-ms-flexbox;display:flex;position:relative;-webkit-box-flex-wrap:wrap;-webkit-flex-wrap:wrap;-ms-flex-wrap:wrap;flex-wrap:wrap;text-align:center;-webkit-align-items:center;-webkit-box-align:center;-ms-flex-align:center;align-items:center;-webkit-align-self:stretch;-ms-flex-item-align:stretch;align-self:stretch;-webkit-box-pack:center;-ms-flex-pack:center;-webkit-justify-content:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--ifl-colors-foreground);inline-size:100%;padding-block-start:1.5rem;margin-block-start:0;margin-block-end:0;margin-inline:-0.875rem;inline-size:auto;}.css-1f63e20::before,.css-1f63e20::after{content:"";-webkit-flex:1 1 auto;-ms-flex:1 1 auto;flex:1 1 auto;background-color:var(--ifl-colors-border-weak);block-size:1px;}.css-1f63e20 .e15p7aqh0{padding-block-start:0.5rem;padding-block-end:0.5rem;-webkit-padding-start:0.5rem;padding-inline-start:0.5rem;-webkit-padding-end:0.5rem;padding-inline-end:0.5rem;}

Who We AreWPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.The opportunityWPP Enterprise Solutions is building technology leadership across the globe to power its focus on technical transformation. The Global Talent Hub is our centre of engineering and architecture excellence, providing the technical capability and capacity that underpins global delivery.The CTO for the Global Talent Hub is a senior technical leader who owns the "How" and the "How well" of delivery — the technical authority behind WPP Enterprise Solutions' engineering and architecture teams based in the hub. While commercial strategy, go-to-market, and client relationships are predominantly won and shaped in our global markets, this role ensures those ambitions are delivered to a consistently high technical standard.You will provide architectural and technical leadership across the hub's engineering and architecture teams, run internal technical governance, drive the adoption and measurement of AI tooling, and build a high-performing cross-functional organization. You will work hand-in-hand with global locations and Operating Companies (OpCos) to understand what they need — including the required level of technical specification — and translate that into clear, actionable direction for hub teams. Working alongside the SVP of Engineering, who leads hands-on delivery execution, you will focus on architecture, design integrity, technical standards, and continuously evolving how the teams workWhat you’ll be doingArchitecture & Design Authority:Act as the senior authority on architecture and design across the hub, ensuring solutions are well-structured, scalable, and consistent with best practice across all global deliveries.Technical Governance:Establish and chair internal technical governance — architecture review, design and delivery standards, security, quality, and technical risk management — setting and enforcing the standards teams work to.Global Collaboration & Requirements Translation:Partner with global locations and OpCos to understand delivery requirements and the expected level of technical specification, translating these into structured inputs, standards, and guidance for hub teams.Innovation & Ways of Working:Bring an innovation mindset to how the teams operate — identifying where ways of working need to evolve and introducing new processes, tooling, and practices to raise productivity, quality, and consistency.AI Tooling Adoption & Measurement:Own the adoption of AI-enabled engineering tools across the hub, defining how their use, impact, productivity, and quality gains are measured and continuously improved.Building a High-Performing Team:Build, scale, and develop a high-performing cross-functional engineering and architecture organisation — driving capability building, talent development, and career progression, in partnership with the SVP of Engineering.Platform & Partner Enablement:Maintain strong technical alignment with key platform partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Shopify, Google, AWS, etc.), keeping teams certified, current with product roadmaps, and at the forefront of platform capabilities.Cross-OpCo Delivery Coordination:Coordinate across OpCos within WPP to ensure hub teams deliver unified, high-quality technical solutions that meet the needs of global engagements.What we want from youProven track record of senior technical leadership, ideally within the E-Commerce and MarTech sectors.Strong background in architecture and design across enterprise-scale solutions.Extensive experience leading large engineering and architecture teams within a delivery-focused offshore/nearshore service-hub environment.An innovation mindset, with a track record of evolving team ways of working — introducing new processes, practices, and tooling to improve performance.Solid working knowledge of enterprise MarTech and Commerce technologies.Strong expertise across enterprise ecosystems — Adobe (AEM, Commerce), Salesforce (Commerce, Marketing), Shopify, and cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.Demonstrable experience operating within sophisticated global delivery models (onshore, nearshore, offshore) supporting large enterprise accounts.Experience defining and running technical governance — standards, architecture review, quality, and technical risk management.A track record of driving the adoption and measurement of AI tooling within engineering teams.Experience working with key platform partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Shopify, Google, AWS) to maintain certifications, tier status, and roadmap alignment.Prior experience within a major technology consultancy, systems integrator, or digital agency is highly preferred.Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align hub teams with global technical and delivery leaders and set clear technical direction.What we can offer youAlongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.AT VML Enterprise SolutionsOur Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi-channel growth for world-leading brands.We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes-Benz, Johnson & Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany & Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.About WPPWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.About the Role:To serve as the Head of the Digital Suraksha Network (DSN), a not‑for‑profit foundation established by CoinDCX to build national‑scale digital‑trust and cyber‑safety infrastructure for India’s digital‑financial ecosystem.The Head will lead the foundation’s strategy, governance, operations, and stakeholder ecosystem, ensuring credible, independent, and scalable impact on fraud reduction, consumer awareness, and law‑enforcement coordination.What You’ll Do: Strategic Leadership & Vision: Define and drive the 3–5 year mission, vision, and strategic roadmap for the Digital Suraksha Foundation, anchored in fraud detection, consumer awareness, and cyber‑safety for Indian digital‑finance users. Translate CoinDCX’s commitment into a credible, multi‑year institutional roadmap for DSN, including platform‑agnostic helplines, Open Fraud Intelligence APIs, and public / LEA ‑awareness campaigns. Act as the primary bridge between the Foundation Advisory Board and the internal leadership team, ensuring alignment with CoinDCX’s broader mission and values while maintaining the foundation’s independent, public‑interest character. Governance & Institutional Stewardship: Lead the foundation’s governance, working closely with the Board to set policies, approve budgets, and oversee risk, compliance, and internal controls. Establish and chair internal governance bodies (steering committee, risk‑&‑compliance committee, and programme‑review panels) and ensure transparency, audit‑readiness, and NPO‑compliance (FCRA, income‑tax, CSR, etc.), where applicable. Represent the foundation in engagements with regulators (MeitY, I4C, CERT‑In, RBI, NPCI), state police cyber‑cells, and industry bodies, articulating DSN as a neutral, public‑good platform Programme & Operations Oversight: Oversee the end‑to‑end design and execution of core DSN capabilities: 24×7 platform‑agnostic helpline (e.g., WhatsApp‑based verification of links, platforms, and offers). Open Fraud Intelligence API to enable real‑time fraud‑detection across institutions. Consumer‑awareness and digital‑literacy campaigns (multi‑languages, mass media, and digital channels). Ensure robust internal operations covering tech, data protection, customer support, case‑tracking, and reporting dashboards, with clear SOPs and service‑level standards. Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships: Build and manage a formal partner network of banks, payment platforms, telcos, fintechs, crypto exchanges, and consumer‑protection bodies as part of the foundation’s public‑interest mandate. Lead fundraising and resource‑mobilisation beyond the initial corpus (e.g., CSR, institutional grants, partnerships) to ensure long‑term sustainability of the foundation. Serve as the primary spokesperson for DSN in media, conferences, and policy forums; collaborate with CoinDCX’s communications and public‑policy teams while maintaining the foundation’s independent voice. Policy, Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure the foundation’s architecture and data‑handling practices comply with IT Act, DPDP rules, and relevant financial‑sector cybersecurity standards, working with internal and external legal counsel. Advise the Board and CoinDCX leadership on systemic risks in digital fraud, phishing, and social‑engineering, and recommend evidence‑based interventions. Develop and institutionalise protocols for interaction with law‑enforcement and cyber‑crime cells, including data‑sharing frameworks that respect privacy and due‑process. People, Culture & Performance: Build and lead a high‑performance, cross‑functional team (tech, product, data, operations, policy, communications, and helpline/CS) with clear career pathways and performance metrics. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and public‑interest ethics consistent with the foundation’s not‑for‑profit, digital‑trust mandate. Prepare and present regular impact and performance reports to the Board, highlighting KPIs such as fraud reduction, case‑resolution time, awareness reach, and institutional adoption. You’ll Excel in This Role If You: Minimum Requirements: Master’s degree in Law, Public Policy, Management, Computer Science, or related field; PhD or advanced certification in cybersecurity / information security is a plus. 15+ years of experience, including at least 8–10 years in senior leadership roles in cybersecurity, digital‑trust, fintech, or not‑for‑profit organisations. Demonstrated experience in leading a not‑for‑profit or mission‑driven organisation, including governance, fundraising, and cross‑sector stakeholder management. Preferred Experience: Hands‑on experience in building or leading national‑scale cyber‑safety, fraud‑detection, or consumer‑protection platforms (e.g., helplines, intelligence APIs, or incident‑coordination networks). Familiarity with Indian cyber‑laws, CERT‑In advisories, UPI and payment‑system risk‑frameworks, and DPDP‑related compliance. Strong track record of working with regulators, police cyber‑cells, and large‑tech or financial‑sector organisations from a neutral, public‑good perspective. You’ll Know You’re Winning When: Strategic Trust: You are viewed by the founders and leadership as a strategic advisor who unblocks P0 initiatives, resulting in a high Trust Index for the organisation due to the governance systems you’ve put in place. Regulatory Resilience: You’ve built a legal system that anticipates and absorbs regulatory shifts with zero disruption to the product roadmap. Execution Velocity: Contract lifecycles and legal clearances are no longer a bottleneck for P0 initiatives. Institutional Trust: CoinDCX is recognized by regulators and industry bodies as the benchmark for legal and governance standards in India. Operational Autonomy: Your team operates as a self-sustaining unit, resolving complex disputes and clearings with minimal founder intervention. Hiring Process:Here’s what your journey with us looks like:Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit Where We Work:We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bangalore office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.Perks That Empower You:We believe great people deserve great experiences.Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities Ready to Build What’s Next?If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together. normalizedText: We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, Bid Management, or Proposal Management to drive business growth, support strategic sales initiatives, and work closely with executive leadership. The role combines solution strategy, opportunity management, sales enablement, customer engagement, and business development to accelerate revenue growth and improve win rates. The individual will act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, Technology, and Executive Leadership while helping shape growth strategies and expand customer relationships. Key Responsibilities: Presales Solution Development Lead end-to-end solution design for strategic opportunities. Manage RFI, RFP, RFQ, and tender responses. Collaborate with technical, delivery, and sales teams to prepare winning proposals. Develop customer-focused value propositions and business cases. Conduct solution presentations and executive workshops. Sales Enablement Growth Support sales teams in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities. Develop account growth plans for key customers. Create sales collateral, capability decks, and solution playbooks. Improve deal qualification and opportunity management processes. Increase proposal win rates through competitive positioning. Strategic Revenue Initiatives Identify innovative revenue-generation opportunities. Develop new service offerings and packaging strategies. Drive cross-selling and upselling initiatives. Explore AI-driven, subscription-based, managed services, and outcome-based business models. Customer Reference Development Build strong customer relationships. Develop customer success stories, case studies, and reference programs. Support executive engagement with strategic customers. Enhance customer satisfaction and retention. Sales Operations Governance Assist in pipeline reviews and business forecasting. Track bid performance, conversion metrics, and revenue outcomes. Establish proposal management and governance best practices. Drive continuous improvement in sales and presales processes. CEO Leadership Alignment Work closely with senior leadership to execute business growth initiatives. Support strategic planning and market expansion activities. Provide market intelligence and competitor analysis. Contribute to annual business planning and growth strategies. Preferred Experience 8-12 years of experience in: Presales Solution Consulting Bid Management Proposal Management Business Development Support RFx Management Experience in: IT Services Digital Transformation Cloud AI/GenAI Solutions Managed Services Enterprise Software Disclaimer: This job description has been sourced from a public domain and may have been modified by Naukri.com to improve clarity for our users. Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence andinspire teams. normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typePermanentFull-time LocationPune, Maharashtra Full job description Description The Transformation Analysis & Strategy Lead is a is a transformation management role accountable for identifying and shaping critical strategic change initiatives across the organisation, to support successful and embed delivery outcomes. This role partners with the Group Transformation Director and in turn into Group Executive, C‑suite and operational leaders to balance priorities, shape the best solutions, and deliver clear financial outcomes (margin expansion, efficiency and capability uplift). This role will lead a small high‑performing team of analysts and change professionals. Key to this role is ensuring Davies adopts a data‑driven, scalable, and best‑practice approaches to operational and strategic delivery. The role sits within the Transformation Office, reporting to the Group Transformation Director, and is a key contributor to the strategic growth agenda, alongside Group initiatives and projects. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Enterprise Change Partner into leadership to define, shape, and deliver strategic initiatives across the enterprise. Act as a core member of the Transformation management team, contributing to high-level planning and decision making. Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including executive leaders, investors, and third‑party vendors. Provide strategic insight grounded in data analytics, financial modelling, and market understanding, particularly within the insurance sector. Data, Insights & Business Case Development Champion a data-science-informed approach, enabling data-led decision making across the enterprise. Build compelling, investment-ready business cases with clear benefit profiles and tracked, realisable value. Develop high-quality executive-level materials, including board papers, investment decks, and performance updates. Build and review financial models (CapEx, OpEx, exceptional items) to support strategic decision-making. Team Leadership & Capability Development Lead, nurture, and grow a small team of business analysts and change professionals, fostering a culture of excellence. Coach and mentor junior and senior team members, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong career development pathways. Step in to assume team responsibilities if required, supporting business needs during periods of change or transition. Delivery Excellence & Continuous Improvement Oversee multiple complex initiatives simultaneously, ensuring alignment with organisational strategy and target outcomes. Promote continuous improvement across the Transformation Office and Davies Enterprise-wide, embedding Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and other process improvement methodologies. Guide the function through delivery maturity, helping teams adopt stronger practices, structures, and ways of working. Drive effective matrix working, ensuring clarity, collaboration, and accountability across organisational boundaries. Governance, Risk & Vendor Management Manage and oversee third-party vendors, ensuring value for money, performance accountability, and aligned delivery. Ensure all initiatives are governed effectively, with appropriate cadence, reporting, risks, and mitigation structures. Provide challenge and upward management to executive leaders to secure timely decisions and delivery-critical inputs. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Essential 10-15yrs experience data science and/or consulting management role under strategy, transformation, or change. High‑energy, self‑directed change agent who takes end‑to‑end ownership of investment and project delivery to drive measurable value creation. Strong understanding of data science concepts and their application in enterprise decision making. Deep knowledge of process improvement methodologies, including Lean, Six Sigma, and Agile. Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority work pacakages simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and executive storytelling. Expertise in building business cases, financial models, and investor-level strategic materials. Desirable Consulting background, with experience delivering within complex, matrixed organisations. Experience within the financial services sector, ideally with significant exposure to insurance. Experience working within a private equity–backed environment. Familiarity with large-scale digital, operational, or technology-enabled transformation. Behaviours & Attributes Big picture thinker with strong commercial acumen. Highly polished communicator with strong executive presence. Collaborative, influential, and effective at managing up and across. High energy, resilient, adaptable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. Passionate about developing people and elevating organisational capability. Sets clear success metrics up front (ROI, payback, KPI baselines); reports before/after impact. Operates with minimal oversight; escalates only on risks/decisions that unblock value. Shortens time‑to‑value via iterative delivery and rapid benefit capture. Challenges legacy processes; brings data to drive decision and prove benefits realisation. About Davies We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses. We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management. Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

normalizedText: Who We AreAddepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.The RoleThe Head of Services, APAC, is responsible for building, scaling, and leading a high-performing services organization within the Asia Pacific region. This leader will translate the global services strategy into local execution, ensuring Addepar’s standards for implementation, partner solutions and client support are met. A primary focus will be resolving ongoing business-as-usual (BAU) requirements, managing existing feed enhancements, and mitigating the recurring service escalations that have necessitated a dedicated local leadership presence.As a key leader in a matrixed organization, this role reports directly to the VP, Global Services & Delivery, while maintaining a strategic partnership with regional business leadership. The successful candidate will navigate a collaborative structure where cross-functional alignment is essential, as some regional team members may maintain dual reporting lines to global and regional functional leads.Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. normalizedText: Patrika Digital is looking for a hands-on strategic operator to assume full P&L ownership of our digital ecosystem. As the Chief Digital Officer, you will lead the digital business as a true peer to print and editorial leadership, setting and defending the annual digital roadmap. This role demands an executive who can navigate a legacy, family-owned governance structure while aggressively modernizing our products, technology, and distribution surfaces. Key Responsibilities & Core Problems to Solve Reverse Traffic Decline: Diagnose the root causes behind Patrika's recent slide from ~5,600 to ~6,500 in global ranking and double-digit MoM traffic drops (uncover algorithm hits, AI-overview shifts, or internal product debt) and implement a permanent fix. Diversify Distribution & Revenue: Build a reliable second leg of distribution and monetization beyond Google organic traffic, which currently commands 35–42% of our footprint, by scaling native apps, premium subscriptions, social media, and owned-audience channels. Cross-Functional Alignment: Unify SEO, product, app development, revenue, and editorial functions under a single cohesive product roadmap. Strategic Governance: Manage regular dashboard audits, tightly run the digital leadership team, and personally steer platform relations (Google, app stores) and critical editorial-digital tradeoffs. Experience & Scale Requirements Years of Experience: 12 years + Must have managed a digital P&L for a property driving 5–20M+ monthly visits or a comparable DAU-scale consumer application. Experience operating a multi-property digital portfolio (web, app, e-paper, and print-adjacent surfaces) with distinct economics per surface. Proven track record of navigating major Google algorithm updates (Core updates, Helpful Content updates, or AI Overview shifts) with clear strategic pivots. Critical Disqualifiers No experience with vernacular or regional-language (Hindi/Indic) digital products; a career built exclusively on English-language, metro/urban media will not transfer to this audience behavior. A pure growth-marketing or performance-marketing background lacking deep product and technical fluency. A tactical mindset without the ability to operate strategically. Lack of comfort working within a legacy-institution or family-owned corporate structure. Pay: ₹6,000,000.00 - ₹6,500,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

job description The Head of Digital Engineering, India is ADM’s India execution and scale leader, accountable for engineering delivery capacity, velocity, and quality across Digital & Technology. This role builds and runs ADM’s India digital hub as a global execution engine—delivering Finance products, AI capabilities, and enterprise digital engineering at scale—while acting as site leader for talent attraction, retention, and leadership development. Your Responsibilities India as a Global Execution Engine Own end‑to‑end engineering execution from India across Finance products, AI platforms, and priority enterprise digital products. Scale India from ~80 to ~160 engineers by 2026 with predictable delivery, high quality, and strong bench strength. Ensure India contributes materially to ADM’s digital outcomes—not supplemental capacity. Finance & AI Product Delivery Build and scale 2–3 core Finance products in partnership with Product leaders. normalizedText: DescriptionPrime Video's Global Shared Services (GSS) is the operational engine behind the marketing that brings hundreds of millions of customers to the content they love. We produce high-volume digital assets and execute campaigns at global scale — fast, with quality, and across Prime Video.We're looking for a Head of GSS Operations to lead end-to-end operations across our India sites. This is a senior leadership role accountable for Design Production and Campaign Operations — owning the operational strategy, team performance, and people development for a multi-layered organization of individual contributors and people managers. You will set the standard for how work gets done: driving operational excellence, building scalable mechanisms, and developing the leaders who will grow with us.The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader who thrives in high-volume, fast-paced environments. You bring deep experience managing large teams across multiple functions, a track record of raising the bar on quality and efficiency, and the judgment to balance short-term delivery with long-term capability building. You communicate with clarity, earn trust across levels and geographies, and are energized by the challenge of scaling operations in a business that moves quickly.Key job responsibilities Own end-to-end operations for Design Production and Campaign Operations across two India sites, translating global GSS plans into site-level execution Lead a multi-layered organization of people managers and individual contributors, setting clear accountability and performance standards at every level Drive operational metrics including quality, throughput, efficiency, and on-time delivery — identifying root causes and implementing solutions when performance gaps emerge Build and develop the leadership bench: mentoring people managers, driving succession planning, and creating career pathways that retain top talent Drive organizational design and scaling decisions, determining optimal team structures and capability distribution as the business evolves Lead cross-functional collaboration with global GSS leadership, marketing teams, and technology partners — communicating with clarity across levels and geographies Champion operational efficiency through process improvement, automation opportunities, and resource optimization Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture across both sites while navigating ambiguity and guiding the organization through changeAbout The TeamGlobal Shared Services (GSS) is a centralized, multi-functional organization within Prime Video Global Marketing that delivers design production, campaign operations, planning, and business intelligence at scale. Operating across sites in India, Costa Rica, the EU and the US, GSS brings together these functions to deliver with speed, quality, and efficiency. We're a team that thrives on operational rigor while continuously evolving through automation, AI, and smarter ways of working.Basic Qualifications 8+ years of creative services experience Experience managing teams Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions Experience with digital asset management tools Experience leading process improvements or operations tool implementations (e.g. digital asset management tool) Experience scaling an organization through rapid growth or expansionPreferred Qualifications Experience setting metric driven goals to improve a department or an organization Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner Experience managing through other managers (leading leaders), with demonstrated ability to build and develop multi-layered teams Leadership experience in operations, marketing operations, or creative/digital production environmentsOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. normalizedText: As the India County Head, this role is fully responsible for IT operations management across the India region and is accountable for India IT service quality, business support capability, and project delivery results. It coordinates local IT teams, business demand, project implementation, and vendor management, carries forward the Groups digital strategy on the ground, connects the Global IT Capability Center with the China IT COE, and ensures effective integration between global standards and local business needs.Key responsibilities:1. IT Operations Management: Fully responsible for regional IT operations in India and for ensuring stable operation of business systems. Establish and continuously optimize the local IT service model, improve user satisfaction, IT KPI, SLA performance, and continuously improve IT operation capability by leading local application support, ITBP/ITBA, and infrastructure teams.2. Business Demand Management: Act as the ultimate owner of India business IT demand, managing the ITBP/ITBA team to complete business demand collection, analysis, prioritization, and ongoing tracking. Promote continuous business process optimization, identify digital improvement opportunities, coordinate the Global IT Capability Center to complete demand assessment, solution design, and implementation delivery, and ensure local demand complies with Group digital standards and global template requirements.3. Project Management: Manage the full lifecycle of local IT projects in India, including initiation, planning, implementation, go-live, and user acceptance. Support the local deployment and rollout of Group global projects in India. Manage project risks, resources, cost, and schedule to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery, and coordinate business departments, vendors, and Group IT teams to complete implementation.4. Local Team and Vendor Management: Build and manage the India local IT team, including ITBP, application support, and related external resources. Manage local IT service providers, establish performance evaluation and continuous improvement mechanisms, and build standardized operations processes and a knowledge base to enhance overall team capability.5. International Collaboration: Implement management standards, service specifications, and technical requirements defined by the Global IT Capability Center. Coordinate the HQ IT resources to provide professional technical support and operations support (L2-L3). Promote the codification of excellent India practices into the Groups global digital templates and support replication in other overseas regions.Educational Background:Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, information management, industrial engineering, supply chain management, or a related major. Work Experience:More than 15 years of IT experience in manufacturing, including at least 8 years of IT team management experience.Experience in implementation or operation of core enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, and CRM.Experience in IT management for multinational companies or overseas factories is preferred.End-to-end project management experience, with the ability to independently deliver medium- to large-scale digital projects.Professional Capabilities:Familiar with manufacturing business processes across supply chain, production, procurement, sales, and finance.Familiar with ITIL service management concepts and project management methods (PMP preferred).Strong business demand analysis and process optimization capability.Able to coordinate application systems, infrastructure, and external vendors to solve complex problems.Candidates familiar with localized IT applications, regulations, and business scenarios are preferred.Management Capabilities:Excellent team management and cross-functional communication and coordination skills.Strong problem analysis, risk management, and decision-making capability.Able to drive efficient collaboration across cultures in complex environments.Possesses a global mindset and international project management experience.Language Requirements:Fluent English as a working language, both written and spoken.Chinese communication ability is preferred. jdEvidence.value: Drive patient acquisition and business growth through trade, referral, corporate, and community marketing initiatives.

normalizedText: Trade & Referral Marketing:Develop and strengthen relationships with consultants, general physicians, specialists, and other healthcare providers to enhance patient referrals. Build and manage referral networks with clinics, diagnostic centres, and individual practitioners. Organize CME (Continuing Medical Education) programs, medical conferences, and doctor engagement activities to enhance partnerships. Ensure regular doctor visits, maintaining strong rapport with the medical fraternity. Work closely with the hospital's medical and operations teams to create seamless referral processes. Neighbourhood Marketing & Community Engagement:Implement localized marketing strategies to target residential areas, apartments, and gated communities. Establish partnerships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), local clubs, religious institutions, and NGOs to promote hospital services. Conduct health camps, awareness drives, free check-up programs, and medical outreach initiatives in the community. Organize door-to-door campaigns and BTL (Below the Line) activities to engage local populations effectively. Drive patient engagement through word-of-mouth referrals, digital outreach, and community influencers. Corporate & Institutional Marketing:Develop strategic partnerships with corporates, MNCs, government organizations, and insurance companies for employee health programs. Conduct corporate wellness programs, annual health check-up camps, and tie-ups for OPD & IPD services. Collaborate with HR and Admin heads of large firms to design corporate healthcare benefits. Establish relationships with insurance providers and TPAs (Third-Party Administrators) for seamless processing of cashless treatments. Work on loyalty programs and special healthcare plans for corporate clients and their employees. Job Specification: Qualification:Graduate/Postgraduate in Marketing, Healthcare Management, or Business Administration. Experience:Minimum 12 years of experience in hospital marketing, with a strong focus on doctor engagement, corporate tie-ups, and community marketing. Skills Required:Strong networking and relationship management skills. Experience in trade (doctor) marketing, corporate outreach, and neighbourhood campaigns. Ability to generate business through partnerships and referrals. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Understanding of Indian healthcare market dynamics and regional hospital marketing strategies.

normalizedText: About PayoneerFounded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.Role SummaryAs a Global Marketing Program Manager, you will own and scale global marketing programs and operational systems that turn business priorities into structured, repeatable, and measurable execution across markets. This role focuses on building the program infrastructure, governance, workflows, and cross-functional rhythms needed to deliver strategic projects at scale. You will operate as a strong cross-functional program lead—working closely with Product Marketing, Growth, Creative, Sales, RevOps, and Regional teams—to manage project roadmaps, improve delivery predictability, scale localization and translation workflows, and embed AI-enabled ways of working across marketing operations.Hybrid / Full-timeWhat You’ll DoBuild & Run Global Marketing Programs Own the planning, coordination, and delivery of global marketing programs and strategic projects aligned to business, GTM, and revenue priorities. Translate priorities into clear program plans with defined scope, milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, and success metrics. Manage project roadmaps, timelines, and delivery rituals to ensure teams are aligned and execution stays on track.Drive Operational Excellence & Governance Establish repeatable program workflows, briefing templates, stage gates, RACI models, and operating cadences that improve clarity, accountability, and speed to market. Support intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and resource coordination across Creative, Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, and Regional teams. normalizedText: Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.A Snapshot As an Associate Director for Success Manager based in India, you will be part of AirTrunk’s centralised customer engagement function, reporting directly to the Director of Customer Success. You should enjoy working in a fast paced environment, with high level of flexibility and be able to navigate change with ease. You will work closely with various teams and leadership across the region, making your mark in a number of ways:Support front end customers engagement with key global cloud service providers, providing dedicated leadership covering broad areas such as commercial, legal, and technical aspects of our infrastructure solutions to support our customers rapid growth. Lead multi-billion dollar complex deals from proposal development to contract execution, including managing strategic escalations post-execution, across Indian markets in alignment with the strategy set by the Director of Customer Success. Take ownership of internal collaboration across all functions in the company to deliver gold standard experience for our customers across the front-end engagement through to contract execution. Your Day to Day Strategy Implementation: Working with the Director, develop and implement customer success strategies that align with company objectives and enhance the overall customer experience. Develop and own high quality complex proposals with very fast due date and minimum guidance. Customer Engagement: Build solid relationships with key customers to gain understanding of their demand and lead the development of infrastructure solutions to expand AirTrunk market share across Ind in partnership with cross-functional internal teams. Develop and utilise a deep understanding of commercial constructs & funding requirements for customer deals (e.g. be able to suggest appropriate commercial construct for solutions, project cost and funding tailored to specific customers and sites). Converse with both customers and internal cross-functions on key technical items affecting the final solutions (e.g. temperature, power, MW capacity, connectivity, renewable, etc.). Communicate outcome of meetings clearly and draft concise emails to senior customers with clear articulations of issues/topic summaries from calls or contract discussions, with resolution options, next steps and so forth. Complete regular customer governance updates Ability to manage customer business reviews and proactively drive improvement actions Act as first contact for customer escalation and coordinate the resolution with the internal teams to safeguard trust and long-term relationships.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various internal teams to ensure a seamless customer journey during front-end engagement and address customer needs proactively. RequirementsMore than 5 – 7 years of working experience across customer success, account management, or related roles, with a minimum of 3 years in a position of mid-seniority. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic and flexible environment. Excel at complex proposal development for cloud infrastructure solutions (through proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel). Excellent commercial acumen, good ability to grasp technical concepts and data center knowledge preferrable across site development and construction. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with diverse stakeholders, including conflict resolution across various functions across the organisation. Able to lead complex customers engagement and work within high performing teams in the cloud computing or infrastructure industry. Proven track record of driving customer satisfaction, retention, and growth in a B2B environment. Excel at distilling complex customer information into clear, concise, and easy to understand messaging and action plans for various internal teams as well as executive leadership. Familiarity with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce) and customer success tools a bonus. The AirTrunk Culture Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. Market Research

Digital Marketing

In-depth knowledge of branding, creative development and execution, digital marketing, and campaign deployment and optimization
  • Provide expertise on Content design and campaign execution: Able to provide a perspective on identification and selection of the right digital channels and content types based on campaign objectives.Able to understand client requirements based on their briefs ideate to appropriate creative designs. Support end to end campaign execution and suggest ways for optimization.

Marketing Technology
  • Lead platform assessment and solution design : Understand the marketing value chain across process, technology people. Conduct a thorough assessment, propose a solution along with an operating model define KPIs for different marketing technologies Adobe / SF / Veeva. Have an understanding of the regulatory, compliance and governance landscape in the industry and build frameworks for scale up.
  • MarTech Consulting Projects: Lead projects focusing on optimizing the MarTech stack and develop use cases to improve utilization of existing MarTech stack. Research, evaluate and recommend new martech systems and suppliers. Keep a holistic understanding of existing and upcoming martech platforms and how they connect into the broader marketing technology landscape.
  • Tools Platforms: Hands on experience on Mar-tech tools such as Adobe campaign, Marketo, Adobe, Cloud, Google Marketing platform, Google Ads, Pega decisioning, SFMC etc.
  • Value realization : Crafting a value tree and developing business cases for implementation and scale up

Gen AI
  • Be aware of the latest AI developments in the Life Science industry and be able to co-create customized solutions for the client to meet their objectives.
  • Have experience in CDP tools and platforms.
  • Design and implement GenAI use cases

  • Generating new business engagements: Drive new business opportunities by identifying and pursuing new leads, defining GTM strategy, facilitate client discussions and presentations to drive new business and client relationships.
  • Own and drive RFP/RFI response coming in from Life Science customers

Practice Development
  • Take on leadership role: Support overall growth of practice across all the pillars Marketing as well as sales, service through a combination of business development, talent management, oversight of delivery work, and thought leadership.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe, IQVIA etc. business groups, to enable business capabilities with agility, velocity, and quality while optimizing costs.
  • Establish a strong network with key stakeholders in the Accenture ecosystem, across geographies to socialize and amplify the GN Song capabilities, operating model and ways of working to generate demand and meet the KPIs
  • Lead and motivate teams with diverse skills and backgrounds. Manage and mentor talented teams of consultants and technologists supporting, providing input and guidance into the talent strategy and actively participate in engagement, capability development activities.

normalizedText: Vice President Fundraising (Ethnus Foundation)Department: Fundraising – Ethnus FoundationDesired Qualification & Experience: Any Postgraduate (MBA preferred), 10 to 15 years.Work Mode: Work from officeLocation: BangaloreRole OverviewThe Vice President – Fundraising will lead Ethnus Foundation's overall fundraising strategy and build a diversified, sustainable funding pipeline across corporate, CSR partners, institutional donors, foundations, and HNIs. This is a senior leadership role, working closely with the CEO/Executive Director and Board, responsible for driving revenue growth, building donor relationships, and leading a high-performing fundraising team.1. Strategy & Leadership Develop and drive the Foundation's long-term fundraising strategy aligned with organizational goals. Set annual fundraising targets, budgets, and KPIs; own overall accountability for revenue growth. Build and lead a multi-channel fundraising portfolio, including corporate/CSR partnerships, institutional donors, foundations, HNIs, and international funding agencies. Represent the Foundation at senior industry forums, donor meetings, and strategic partnership discussions.2. Donor & Partnership Management Cultivate and manage relationships with existing and prospective major donors, corporate partners, and institutional funders. Lead high-value proposal development, donor pitches, and negotiations to close large partnerships and grants. Ensure robust donor stewardship, timely reporting, and compliance with donor requirements and grant agreements.3. Team & Organizational Leadership Coordinate with the Recruitment and HR team to build the fundraising team, and mentor and lead Managers and program staff supporting fundraising. Set individual and team performance goals; build capability across the fundraising function. Collaborate cross-functionally with Programs, Communications, Finance, and Board members to align fundraising priorities with organizational strategy.4. Governance, Reporting & Compliance Present periodic fundraising performance updates, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to the CEO and Board. Ensure adherence to statutory and regulatory requirements applicable to non-profit fundraising (FCRA, CSR guidelines, tax exemptions, etc.). Oversee accurate donor documentation, MOUs, and grant compliance in coordination with Finance and Legal.Requirements Postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Development Studies, Social Work, or a related field (MBA preferred). 10-15 years of overall professional experience, with a significant portion in fundraising, CSR partnerships, or business development within the non-profit/development sector. Demonstrated track record of securing large-value grants, CSR funding, or institutional partnerships. Prior experience leading and building a fundraising team is essential. Relevant industry experience within the social sector, CSR ecosystem, or philanthropic/donor landscape strongly preferred. Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong understanding of the CSR, philanthropy, and institutional donor landscape in India. Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent the Foundation at a senior level.Benefits Health insurance coverage for you and your dependents Company-provided SIM card Partnerships with leading brands such as Google, Zoho, and more Attractive variable pay structure rewarding performance Tenure-based bonus to recognize long-term contributionRole & responsibilities Preferred candidate profile

normalizedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Paymissing preference₹20,00,000 - ₹30,00,000 a yearJob typematching preferenceFull-time LocationHyderabad, Telangana Full job description Company Overview We are a professionally managed Inspection and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Services company with over two decades of successful operations across multiple industrial sectors in India. We have built a strong reputation for technical excellence, integrity, quality, and customer satisfaction. While we currently have a significant presence in the Mining sector, the company is positioned for accelerated growth and diversification into other industrial segments. Position Summary The Board of Directors is seeking a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and growth-oriented Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the organization into its next phase of expansion and value creation. Reporting to the Managing Director and Board, the CEO will take complete ownership of business operations, business development, organizational capability building, customer relationships, and financial performance. This role requires a leader who combines entrepreneurial drive with professional management practices and possesses the capability to transform a successful founder-led organization into a scalable, professionally managed growth enterprise. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the strategic roadmap approved by the Board, translating the vision into measurable business objectives and driving long-term sustainable growth. Business Development & Growth: Lead all revenue growth initiatives, building strategic relationships with customers, consultants, mining companies, service providers, and government agencies. Operations Management: Assume full responsibility for day-to-day business operations, ensuring efficient utilization of resources, process standardization, and timely delivery of services while maintaining quality. Financial Leadership: Deliver annual revenue, profitability, and cash flow targets. Prepare budgets and improve operational margins through productivity enhancement and cost optimization. Leadership & Talent Development: Build and lead a high-performing management team, develop future leaders, and establish succession planning processes. Quality, Compliance & Governance: Ensure compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements, maintain ISO, NABL, and other relevant certifications, and implement robust risk management practices. Three-Year Mandate The CEO will be entrusted with transforming the company from a successful niche service provider into a significantly larger and professionally managed organization. Key objectives include: Achieving substantial and sustainable revenue growth while expanding market share beyond Mining into Manufacturing, Power, Infrastructure, Metals, Oil & Gas, and Process Industries. Building a strong second line of leadership and implementing the governance structures necessary for a scalable organization, reducing dependence on founder-driven operations. Introducing modern management systems, digital tools, and operational technologies to upgrade technical capabilities. Desired Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Metallurgical, Production, Industrial, Civil, or related discipline). MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred. Minimum 10 to 15 years of progressive leadership experience. Experience in Inspection Services, NDT, Industrial Services, Engineering Services, Mining, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, Power, Oil & Gas, or related sectors. Proven track record of business growth, organizational development, and profitability improvement. Experience managing P&L responsibility is an added advantage. Desired Personal Attributes Entrepreneurial mindset with strong commercial acumen and visionary execution capabilities. High integrity, ethical standards, and a customer-centric, results-oriented approach. Strategic thinker capable of driving transformation with strong people leadership skills. Comfortable working closely with founders and Board members while independently leading the organization. Compensation Compensation will be competitive and aligned with the candidate's experience, capabilities, and track record. A significant portion of compensation may be linked to business growth, profitability, and achievement of strategic objectives.

For over three decades, The Leela has been on a journey to delight guests by providing unparalleled luxury in captivating environs ensconced in the lap of nature, wrapped in the graciousness of Indian hospitality. Headquartered in Mumbai, The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts is owned by a Brookfield Asset Management- sponsored private real estate fund and operates thirteen award-winning properties in major cities and leisure destinations across India. These include the flagship hotel in the capital city of New Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Udaipur, Jaipur, Gurugram, East Delhi, Mumbai, Gandhinagar, Kovalam, and Ashtamudi. The brand is also delighted to announce the upcoming opening of its latest property in Hyderabad. The Leela has a strong pipeline of future projects. The brand celebrates each hotel through its unique location, art, culture, and cuisine with thoughtful services, celebratory rituals, and immersive experiences. The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts was voted the World’s Best Hotel Brand twice in a row by Travel + Leisure, USA, World’s Best Awards Survey, 2020 and 2021. In 2024, the brand has once again featured in the top 3 World’s Best Hotel Brands, after the recognition in 2023. An epitome of true Indian luxury hospitality, The Leela is committed to providing guests with unforgettable stays in settings that capture the essence of India. The brand has a marketing alliance with US- based Preferred Hotels & Resorts and is a member of the Global Hotel Alliance. Why join The Leela? • Award-Winning Brand: Join a brand that has been recognized as one of the World’s Best Hotel Brands for two consecutive years. • Commitment to Excellence: Be part of a team that is dedicated to providing the highest standards of service and hospitality. • Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that encourages creativity and innovation, ensuring that we stay at the forefront of luxury hospitality. • Career Growth: Benefit from our strong pipeline of future projects and opportunities for career advancement within The Leela and our global alliances. • Cultural Experiences: Engage with the rich cultural tapestry of India, bringing unique and authentic experiences to our discerning guests. Position Overview Reporting to: Senior Vice President and Head of Marketing and Brand Location: The Leela Corporate Office Responsibilities: The Director – Brand Communications will lead the strategic communications agenda for The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts, ensuring a consistent, compelling, and premium brand narrative across all internal and external touchpoints. The role is responsible for developing and executing integrated communication strategies that strengthen The Leela's position as India's leading luxury hospitality brand. Working closely with senior leadership, hotel teams, public relations agencies, marketing, digital, and commercial functions, the incumbent will oversee corporate communications, media relations, executive communications, crisis management, brand storytelling, awards, thought leadership, and reputation management. The ideal candidate is an experienced communications professional with a strong understanding of luxury brands, hospitality, lifestyle, and corporate communications, capable of influencing stakeholders and shaping brand perception across domestic and international markets. Key Responsibilities: Corporate Brand Communications • Develop and execute The Leela's integrated corporate and brand communications strategy aligned with business objectives. • Ensure consistency of brand messaging across all corporate, hotel, digital, media, and stakeholder communications. • Build and strengthen The Leela's brand positioning through impactful storytelling and strategic communication initiatives. • Develop annual communication calendars aligned with business priorities, hotel openings, campaigns, partnerships, and corporate milestones. Public and Media Relations • Lead national and international media relations to strengthen brand visibility and reputation. • Build and maintain relationships with leading business, travel, hospitality, luxury, lifestyle, and trade media. • Manage PR agencies and evaluate communication effectiveness through measurable outcomes. • Develop press releases, media kits, fact sheets, speeches, and key messaging documents. • Identify opportunities for proactive media engagement and brand visibility. Brand Storytelling and Content Strategy • Develop compelling narratives that showcase The Leela's heritage, luxury positioning, service philosophy, sustainability initiatives, culinary excellence, wellness offerings, and guest experiences• Oversee development of high-quality communication content across print, digital, video, and social platforms. • Ensure consistency in tone of voice, editorial quality, and brand standards across all communications. Executive Communications: • Partner with the CEO, senior leadership team, and Executive Committee to develop strategic communication materials. • Draft leadership speeches, keynote presentations, interviews, opinion articles, and executive messaging. • Support communication for investor engagements, industry forums, awards, and corporate events. Reputation and Crisis Communication • Develop and maintain crisis communication protocols and response frameworks. • Lead communication during business-sensitive situations, ensuring timely, transparent, and brand-appropriate messaging. • Monitor media sentiment and proactively manage reputation risks. • Advise leadership on communication strategies during critical business situations. Awards, Recognition and Thought Leadership • Lead submissions for national and international hospitality, luxury, travel, sustainability, and employer branding awards. • Identify speaking opportunities, conferences, and industry platforms for executive leadership. • Position The Leela and its leadership as thought leaders within the hospitality and luxury sectors. Internal Communications • Develop communication strategies that strengthen employee engagement and reinforce organizational culture. • Partner with Human Resources to communicate key initiatives, leadership messages, employer branding campaigns, and employee recognition programmes. • Ensure alignment between internal and external brand messaging. Brand Partnerships and Strategic Campaigns • Support strategic partnerships and brand collaborations through integrated communication plans. • Develop communication strategies for hotel openings, renovations, product launches, culinary festivals, wellness initiatives, and experiential campaigns. • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Digital, Revenue Management, Sales, and Operations to maximize campaign impact. Agency and Stakeholder Management • Manage PR agencies, communication consultants, creative partners, photographers, content creators, and production agencies. • Develop communication budgets and ensure optimum utilization of resources. • Build strong relationships with tourism boards, hospitality associations, luxury publications, influencers, and strategic partners. • Track communication effectiveness through media coverage, share of voice, brand sentiment, PR value, campaign reach, and stakeholder engagement. • Prepare periodic communication reports and dashboards for senior leadership. • Continuously evaluate emerging communication trends and recommend innovative approaches.
